articles.title: White: Opetaia could become a global star with spectacular Wilder win

paras.en: Fury vs AJ undercard: Jai Opetaia could become a global star with spectacular Deontay Wilder win, says Dana White
paras.zh: 富里 vs AJ Undercard：达纳·怀特 (Dana White) 表示，凭借 Deontay Wilder 的精彩胜利，杰·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 可能会成为全球明星

paras.en: Jai Opetaia steps up to heavyweight for a bout against hard-punching former champion Deontay Wilder on the undercard of Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua in Cardiff on December 11; "If he wins this fight spectacularly, everything is open and available to Jai Opetaia," promoter Dana White says
paras.zh: 12 月 11 日，在卡迪夫举行的泰森·富里对阵安东尼·约书亚的比赛中，贾伊·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 晋级重量级，与实力强劲的前冠军德昂泰·维尔德 (Deontay Wilder) 进行较量；发起人达纳·怀特 (Dana White) 表示：“如果他出色地赢得了这场比赛，那么一切都对杰·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 开放并可用。”

paras.en: Jai Opetaia could become a global star if he defeats Deontay Wilder on the undercard of Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff on December 11.
paras.zh: 如果贾伊·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 于 12 月 11 日在卡迪夫公国体育场举行的泰森·富里 (Tyson Fury) 对阵安东尼·约书亚 (Anthony Joshua) 的底牌比赛中击败德昂泰·维尔德 (Deontay Wilder)，他可能会成为全球巨星。

paras.en: Opetaia, an elite cruiserweight, is stepping up to heavyweight for what could be a one-off bout in the division against the former world champion.
paras.zh: 奥佩塔亚是一名轻量级精英选手，他正在向重量级选手迈进，与这位前世界冠军进行一场可能是该级别的一次性比赛。

paras.en: Wilder, who previously held the WBC heavyweight title, had a spectacular championship run that earned him the reputation as one of the hardest punchers the sport has ever seen.
paras.zh: 怀尔德此前曾获得 WBC 重量级拳王头衔，他在冠军赛上取得了令人瞩目的成绩，这为他赢得了这项运动史上最强悍的拳击手之一的声誉。

paras.en: Opetaia is already a force in the cruiserweight division and has continued to impressed.
paras.zh: 奥佩塔亚已经是轻量级的一支力量，并且继续给人留下深刻的印象。

paras.en: But a victory over Wilder, especially if he wins in style, would take the Australian to a new level of fame.
paras.zh: 但战胜维尔德，尤其是如果他以风格取胜，将使澳大利亚人的名气上升到一个新的水平。

paras.en: "Imagine if on this Netflix card Opetaia knocks him out or wins this fight spectacularly, everything is open and available to Jai Opetaia," promoter Dana White told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “想象一下，如果在这张 Netflix 卡上，奥佩塔亚击倒了他，或者以惊人的方式赢得了这场比赛，那么一切都对杰·奥佩塔亚开放并可用，”发起人达纳·怀特告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "He's one of these unique people who basically has an entire country behind him. He's got Australia and New Zealand. The more he wins, the higher profile fights he has, the bigger he becomes, not just there but all over the world. Everybody knows who Jai Opetaia is now."
paras.zh: “他是这些独特的人之一，基本上有整个国家支持他。他有澳大利亚和新西兰。他赢的越多，他打的比赛就越引人注目，他变得越大，不仅在国内，而且在全世界。现在每个人都知道杰伊·奥佩塔亚是谁。”

paras.en: Opetaia wants to remain active. "He's willing to fight all the time," White said. "That's the way you stay relevant, forget about making more money and all the stuff that's common sense, that's how you become a legend.
paras.zh: 奥佩塔亚希望保持活跃。 “他愿意一直战斗，”怀特说。 “这就是你保持相关性的方式，忘记赚更多的钱和所有常识性的东西，这就是你成为传奇的方式。

paras.en: "We're sitting here and talking about Ray Robinson [boxing so frequently] and he did that. That's how you become a legend. Jai is one of those guys."
paras.zh: “我们坐在这里谈论雷·罗宾逊（经常打拳击），他做到了。这就是你成为传奇的方式。杰伊就是其中之一。”

paras.en: Oleksandr Usyk, an unbeaten undisputed champion at both heavyweight and cruiserweight, potentially returning to 200lbs creates a new dynamic for the division.
paras.zh: 亚历山大·乌西克 (Oleksandr Usyk) 是重量级和次轻量级无可争议的不败冠军，他有可能重返 200 磅，为该级别带来新的动力。

paras.en: "There's a chance of working with everybody," White hinted, adding: "What does that tell you? It tells that that's the money division right now and Jai Opetaia is a part of it."
paras.zh: “有机会与每个人合作，”怀特暗示道，并补充道：“这告诉你什么？它告诉你现在就是资金部门，而杰·奥佩塔亚是其中的一部分。”

paras.en: Zuffa Boxing's 21-year-old heavyweight Da'Mazion Vanhouter dazzled again on Saturday when he took out Ivan Balaz with stunning speed.
paras.zh: 周六，祖法拳击队21岁的重量级拳手达马齐恩·范豪特(Da'Mazion Vanhouter)再次表现出色，他以惊人的速度击败了伊万·巴拉兹(Ivan Balaz)。

paras.en: White wants to keep Vanhouter busy and have him box in a month's time on the Fury-AJ undercard too.
paras.zh: 怀特想让范胡特保持忙碌，并让他在一个月的时间里也能在Fury-AJ底牌上打球。

paras.en: "Is this kid the next great American heavyweight? And the answer seems to be yes right now," White said.
paras.zh: “这孩子是下一个伟大的美国重量级人物吗？现在答案似乎是肯定的，”怀特说。

paras.en: "He's another one turning around and fighting again quickly and I believe that [after Balaz] he'll probably be on the Cardiff card too.
paras.zh: “他是另一个迅速转身并再次战斗的人，我相信（在巴拉兹之后）他也可能会出现在卡迪夫的名单上。

paras.en: "The truth of the matter is why would you not want to be on that card? That's the card you want to be on, especially if you're a heavyweight."
paras.zh: “问题的真相是，你为什么不想加入那张牌？这就是你想要加入的牌，特别是如果你是重量级选手的话。”

paras.en: Watch Carlos Adames vs Gerome Warburton from 4pm live on Sky Sports Mix on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六下午 4 点，观看 Sky Sports Mix 直播卡洛斯·亚当斯 (Carlos Adames) 对阵杰罗姆·沃伯顿 (Gerome Warburton) 的比赛。

articles.title: Carney on Australia challenge, 'Magic' concept, and 'necessary' domestic limbo

paras.en: Brian Carney on the challenge of usurping Australia, a 'Magic' style 2030 World Cup, and the 'necessary' domestic limbo
paras.zh: 布莱恩·卡尼 (Brian Carney) 谈篡夺澳大利亚的挑战、“神奇”风格的 2030 年世界杯以及“必要的”国内困境

paras.en: Sky Sports Rugby League's Brian Carney takes a look at the upcoming Rugby League World Cup finals, the Rugby League World Cup 2030, and the domestic limbo over the potential NRL partnership on the horizon
paras.zh: 天空体育橄榄球联盟的布莱恩·卡尼 (Brian Carney) 探讨了即将到来的橄榄球联盟世界杯决赛、2030 年橄榄球联盟世界杯，以及即将与 NRL 合作的国内不确定性

paras.en: Sky Sports Rugby League's Brian Carney analyses the big talking points from the world of rugby league, including the upcoming Rugby League World Cup finals, the 'Magic' style concept for the Rugby League World Cup 2030, and the ongoing work towards an NRL partnership.
paras.zh: 天空体育橄榄球联盟的布莱恩·卡尼分析了橄榄球联盟世界的热门话题，包括即将举行的橄榄球联盟世界杯决赛、2030 年橄榄球联盟世界杯的“魔术”风格概念，以及正在进行的 NRL 合作伙伴关系工作。

paras.en: The more things change, the more things seem to stay the same.
paras.zh: 事情变化得越多，似乎就越多保持不变。

paras.en: In a World Cup where we were hailing Tonga and Samoa and their emergence as title contenders, not just for an upset here and there but as title contenders, you have Australia and New Zealand in the final.
paras.zh: 在世界杯上，我们赞扬汤加和萨摩亚作为冠军争夺者的出现，不仅仅是因为这里或那里的爆冷，而且作为冠军争夺者，澳大利亚和新西兰进入了决赛。

paras.en: - Rugby League World Cup 2026 schedule and results
paras.zh: - 2026 年橄榄球联盟世界杯赛程表和结果

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或无合同直播

paras.en: - Download Sky Sports app for analysis, news and video
paras.zh: - 下载天空体育应用程序进行分析、新闻和视频

paras.en: Australia and New Zealand are deserved finalists. They opened the tournament with an absolute bell-ringer and we will hope for more of the same in the final.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚和新西兰当之无愧地入围决赛。他们以绝对的敲响了比赛的序幕，我们希望在决赛中能有更多同样的表现。

paras.en: I really cannot split them. I give New Zealand a really good chance but like Australia have done for nearly half a century now, they keep finding ways to win.
paras.zh: 我实在无法将他们分开。我给新西兰一个非常好的机会，但就像澳大利亚近半个世纪以来所做的那样，他们不断寻找获胜的方法。

paras.en: When they are down and out, dead and buried, off their game, like they were against Fiji, they find a way to win.
paras.zh: 当他们陷入困境、死亡和埋葬、失去比赛时，就像对阵斐济时一样，他们找到了获胜的方法。

paras.en: Kalyn Ponga coming back in for New Zealand was a massive boost and he obviously had no problems defensively off the back of his broken arm- he threw himself into tackles and came up with try-savers.
paras.zh: 卡林·庞加（Kalyn Ponga）为新西兰队回归对他来说是一个巨大的推动，他在断臂后的防守上显然没有任何问题——他全身心投入铲球并提出了保护措施。

paras.en: We are in for a sensational final between the two best nations in the world. There are no complaints there.
paras.zh: 我们即将迎来世界上最好的两个国家之间的一场激动人心的决赛。那里没有抱怨。

paras.en: In the women's final, I cannot look past the Jillaroos. They are at a level of dominance that I don't think we have ever seen from the Kangaroos ever.
paras.zh: 在女子决赛中，我无法忽视 Jillaroos 队。我认为他们的统治力是我们从未在袋鼠身上看到过的。

paras.en: The scorelines they are posting, their ability to win games at a canter, even sometimes leaving points out there.
paras.zh: 他们发布的比分，他们以慢跑赢得比赛的能力，甚至有时会留下分数。

paras.en: It is remarkable. It looks a greater hurdle to catch up with them for the likes of New Zealand and Samoa than the hurdle in the men's game.
paras.zh: 这是非常了不起的。对于新西兰和萨摩亚这样的球队来说，追赶他们的难度似乎比男子比赛的难度更大。

paras.en: Will Tonga rue going all out against Samoa?
paras.zh: 汤加会后悔全力对抗萨摩亚吗？

paras.en: I do not think there is a huge amount between Australia, New Zealand, Tonga, and Samoa on any given day. I would not have fallen over in shock if Tonga or Samoa had won either of the semi-finals.
paras.zh: 我认为澳大利亚、新西兰、汤加和萨摩亚之间的任何一天都没有大量的往来。如果汤加或萨摩亚赢得半决赛，我不会感到震惊。

paras.en: I was probably more surprised that Tonga went full-on against Samoa a week earlier in a game that they did not have to win.
paras.zh: 更令我惊讶的是，汤加在一周前对阵萨摩亚的比赛中全力以赴，而他们不必赢。

paras.en: They went all out for that game and it would have taken plenty out of both teams heading into the semi-finals.
paras.zh: 他们在那场比赛中全力以赴，如果两支球队进入半决赛，他们都会付出很大的努力。

paras.en: While I understand and applaud that the emotion of the game and the occasion drove Tonga and Samoa to field strong sides, it didn't make a whole lot of strategic sense for Tonga in particular. They could have rested players and prepared for their semi-final.
paras.zh: 虽然我理解并赞扬这场比赛的情绪和场合促使汤加和萨摩亚派出强队，但这对汤加来说并没有多大的战略意义。他们本可以让球员休息并为半决赛做准备。

paras.en: I was somewhat surprised at that approach not withstanding the fact the game meant so much passion wise.
paras.zh: 我对这种做法感到有些惊讶，尽管事实上这款游戏意味着如此多的激情。

paras.en: The whole purpose was to win the World Cup, not to beat Samoa.
paras.zh: 整个目的是赢得世界杯，而不是击败萨摩亚。

paras.en: Tonga and Samoa's Tier 1 status: A warning shot for England?
paras.zh: 汤加和萨摩亚的一级地位：对英格兰的警告？

paras.en: In terms of Tonga and Samoa now being given Tier 1 status, I would be surprised if that warning shot wasn't felt all the way back in 2017 when Tonga emerged as a force in international rugby league.
paras.zh: 就汤加和萨摩亚现在获得一级地位而言，如果早在 2017 年汤加成为国际橄榄球联盟的一支力量时就没有感受到这种警告，我会感到惊讶。

paras.en: I do not think for a minute that England will have been taken by surprise by the performances of Tonga and Samoa and the subsequent reward which appears to be Tier 1 status.
paras.zh: 我不认为英格兰会对汤加和萨摩亚的表现以及随后的似乎是一级地位的奖励感到惊讶。

paras.en: It is only good for the game and I think people will applaud the efforts that have been made by a variety of people and organisations to get those teams to where they are.
paras.zh: 这只会对游戏有利，我认为人们会赞扬各种人和组织为让这些团队达到目标而付出的努力。

paras.en: You also have to give a nod to those Tonga players back in 2017. Andrew Fifita, Jason Taumulolo, and Daniel Tupou in particular made the decision to make themselves available to Tonga.
paras.zh: 你还必须向 2017 年的汤加球员致敬。安德鲁·菲菲塔、杰森·陶穆洛洛和丹尼尔·图普特别决定让自己为汤加效力。

paras.en: That decision has been the spark that has lit this Pacific rebirth of Tonga and Samoa in international rugby league.
paras.zh: 这一决定点燃了汤加和萨摩亚在国际橄榄球联盟中重生的火花。

paras.en: Doing things differently: 'Magic' style in 2030
paras.zh: 以不同的方式做事：2030 年的“魔法”风格

paras.en: The Rugby League World Cup 2030 is fascinating. We are told it is going to be a Magic Weekend style event where they will descend upon a city for a weekend, play all the games, then decamp to another host city.
paras.zh: 2030 年橄榄球联盟世界杯非常精彩。我们被告知这将是一场万智牌周末风格的赛事，他们将在一个城市度过一个周末，玩完所有比赛，然后逃往另一个主办城市。

paras.en: That is not a traditional way of doing a World Cup but the mastermind and the brains behind it is Peter V'Landys and the Australian Rugby League Commission.
paras.zh: 这不是举办世界杯的传统方式，但其幕后策划者和大脑是 Peter V'Landys 和澳大利亚橄榄球联盟委员会。

paras.en: The ARLC have all the power, all the money, and at the helm they have a man who, in his professional history, has shown a willingness to challenge the establishment and the status quo.
paras.zh: ARLC 拥有所有权力、所有资金，掌舵者是一位在其职业生涯中表现出挑战体制和现状的意愿的人。

paras.en: Cast your minds back to 2017 and the Melbourne Cup, one of the most prestigious horse races in the world.
paras.zh: 让您的思绪回到 2017 年和墨尔本杯，这是世界上最负盛名的赛马比赛之一。

paras.en: So, if you are the boss of New South Wales horse racing, how do you try and take on the Melbourne Cup? Do you go like-for-like? No.
paras.zh: 那么，如果你是新南威尔士州赛马界的老板，你会如何尝试挑战墨尔本杯呢？你会像往常一样去吗？不。

paras.en: V'Landys decided to create something different and did the Everest race. The draw would be done differently; the audience and the sponsors they would be targeting would be very different.
paras.zh: V'Landys 决定创造一些不同的东西，并参加了珠穆朗玛峰比赛。抽签的方式会有所不同；他们的目标观众和赞助商会有很大不同。

paras.en: It would look and feel very different to the Melbourne Cup and it has been a roaring success by all metrics.
paras.zh: 它的外观和感觉与墨尔本杯非常不同，但从所有指标来看，它都取得了巨大的成功。

paras.en: He is not going to take on, for example, the Rugby Union World Cup and try and go blow for blow with them and replicate what rugby union or football does.
paras.zh: 例如，他不会去参加橄榄球联盟世界杯，并试图与他们针锋相对，并复制橄榄球联盟或足球的做法。

paras.en: 'We are different' is how he thinks and he will think differently and act differently with this Magic style World Cup.
paras.zh: “我们不同”是他的想法，在这届万智牌风格的世界杯上，他的想法和行为也会有所不同。

paras.en: I am fascinated by it. They have got all the wind behind them at the moment. They have all the money and will to do this.
paras.zh: 我对它着迷。此刻他们已经掌握了所有的风向。他们有足够的资金和意愿来做到这一点。

paras.en: This is the man who brought games to Las Vegas when people said it could and would not happen and it would not be a success.
paras.zh: 当人们说这可能发生、不会发生、也不会成功时，就是这个人把游戏带到了拉斯维加斯。

paras.en: While it is not for the traditionalists, V'Landys' thinking is what is best for rugby league and he might have landed on something there.
paras.zh: 虽然这不适合传统主义者，但 V'Landys 的想法对橄榄球联盟来说是最好的，他可能已经在那里找到了一些东西。

paras.en: That goes hand-in-hand with the extension of the eligibility rules to great-grandparents because he wants Tonga, Samoa, Fiji, Cook Islands, Papua New Guinea. He wants to secure all of Pacifica.
paras.zh: 这与将资格规则扩展到曾祖父母齐头并进，因为他想要汤加、萨摩亚、斐济、库克群岛、巴布亚新几内亚。他想要保护整个帕西菲卡。

paras.en: This is another step towards ensuring that these teams have the players available to them to create stories that resonate back in their countries.
paras.zh: 这是确保这些球队拥有足够的球员来创造在他们的国家引起共鸣的故事的又一步。

paras.en: We are a nimble sport because we are small, we have got fewer institutional breaks than others which can be good and bad.
paras.zh: 我们是一项灵活的运动，因为我们规模较小，我们的制度性突破比其他国家少，这可能是好是坏。

paras.en: It has allowed the ARLC to determine what international rugby league is going to look like.
paras.zh: 它使 ARLC 能够确定国际橄榄球联盟的外观。

paras.en: When you are paying the piper, you call the tune and the ARLC are paying the piper.
paras.zh: 当你付钱给风笛手时，你就决定了，ARLC 也在付钱给风笛手。

paras.en: Most people in administrative roles spend their lives trying to solve problems. V'Landys seems to make a living discovering that they weren't problems in the first place.
paras.zh: 大多数担任行政职务的人一生都在努力解决问题。维兰迪斯（V'Landys）似乎以谋生为生，并发现他们一开始就不是问题。

paras.en: It is hard to argue that we are not in a case of limbo domestically with so much to be announced and the fact we are in November.
paras.zh: 很难说我们在国内并没有陷入困境，有这么多事情需要宣布，而事实上我们已经在 11 月了。

paras.en: There is a lot going on and if the NRL partnership deal comes to pass, it is a major development in our game and it has taken a long time to get to this point.
paras.zh: 正在发生很多事情，如果 NRL 合作伙伴协议得以通过，这将是我们游戏的重大发展，并且花了很长时间才达到这一点。

paras.en: If that means a delay on other things, I say so be it. It is not ideal but I won't lose sleep over it.
paras.zh: 如果这意味着其他事情的延迟，我会说就这样吧。这并不理想，但我不会因此而失眠。

paras.en: It might set back planning but if we get where we need to be at the end of it all, I am sure it will be worth it.
paras.zh: 这可能会阻碍计划，但如果我们最终能达到我们需要的目标，我相信这是值得的。

paras.en: Improvement in the domestic game is vital, not just for international rugby league. We need to continuously improve the domestic game for our audiences, who are our most important people.
paras.zh: 国内比赛的进步至关重要，不仅仅是对国际橄榄球联赛而言。我们需要为观众不断改进国内游戏，观众是我们最重要的人。

paras.en: We have to improve it for those people, you have to keep the product on top for those people.
paras.zh: 我们必须为这些人改进它，你必须为这些人保持产品的最佳状态。

paras.en: If the domestic game improves, then you would imagine the international game would improve by extension but your focus first and foremost has to be on the fans and ensuring you are giving them a game they want to watch in increasing numbers and are happy with.
paras.zh: 如果国内比赛有所改善，那么你会想象国际比赛也会随之改善，但你首先要关注的是球迷，并确保你为他们提供了一场他们想要观看的比赛，他们越来越多地想观看并且感到满意。

paras.en: That is the only question you need to answer.
paras.zh: 这是您需要回答的唯一问题。

articles.title: Parents, sister of far-right Kraków shooter found dead in family home
articles.author: Shayna Jacobs

paras.en: Three bodies found in the home of the 24-year-old shooter in Saturday’s rampage in the heart of Kraków, Poland, belonged to the gunman’s family, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，周六在波兰克拉科夫市中心发生的枪击事件中，在 24 岁枪手的家中发现了三具尸体，这些尸体属于枪手的家人。

paras.en: Investigators are looking at the deaths of the shooter’s parents and sister as they unravel events surrounding the random violence in the Polish city’s historic center, Main Market Square, around 3 p.m. Saturday.
paras.zh: 调查人员正在调查枪手父母和妹妹的死亡情况，同时调查下午 3 点左右在波兰城市历史中心主市场广场发生的随机暴力事件。周六。

paras.en: The relatives, who lived about 90 miles from Kraków, most likely died from gunshot wounds, according to police.
paras.zh: 据警方称，这些亲戚住在距离克拉科夫约 90 英里的地方，很可能死于枪伤。

paras.en: Authorities said the shooter, who survived a shootout with police and remains in the hospital, wore a bulletproof vest.
paras.zh: 当局表示，枪手在与警方的枪战中幸存下来，目前仍在医院，他穿着防弹背心。

paras.en: World leaders paid tribute to victims, and Poland declared two national days of mourning after the shooter, motivated by far-right ideologies killed six people in Kraków in what the country’s defense minister characterized as a “terror attack.”
paras.zh: 世界领导人向受害者表示哀悼，波兰宣布全国哀悼两天，此前克拉科夫枪击案凶手在极右意识形态的驱使下造成六人死亡，该国国防部长将此次事件称为“恐怖袭击”。

paras.en: The dead are a man from the United Kingdom, a woman from Austria and four Polish nationals, according to regional official Krzysztof Jan Klęczar. The injured include visitors from Britain, Portugal, Russia, Germany and Austria, according to The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 据地区官员克日什托夫·扬·克勒查尔 (Krzysztof Jan Klęczar) 称，死者包括一名英国男子、一名奥地利女子和四名波兰公民。据美联社报道，受伤者包括来自英国、葡萄牙、俄罗斯、德国和奥地利的游客。

paras.en: St. Mary’s Basilica in the square paused its hourly trumpet call overnight in honor of the victims. It was the first time the historic church had done so since World War II.
paras.zh: 广场上的圣玛丽大教堂彻夜暂停了每小时一次的号角声，以纪念遇难者。这是二战以来这座历史悠久的教堂第一次这样做。

paras.en: The gunman, whom officials described as having “ultranationalistic” beliefs, is reported to have opened fire in Kraków’s Main Market Square. The midday attack was the country’s deadliest shooting in decades, while a policeman who confronted the gunman is in critical condition.
paras.zh: 据报道，这名枪手在克拉科夫的主要集市广场开枪，官员称其具有“超民族主义”信仰。中午的袭击是该国几十年来最严重的枪击事件，而与枪手对峙的一名警察情况危急。

paras.en: The suspect is being investigated on suspicion of murder in connection, Justice Minister Waldemar Żurek said Sunday on X, adding that he “acted with the aim of seriously intimidating a large number of people, making this a terrorist offence.”
paras.zh: 司法部长瓦尔德马·祖雷克 (Waldemar Żurek) 周日表示，嫌疑人因涉嫌谋杀而正在接受调查，并补充说，他“采取行动的目的是严重恐吓大量民众，使这起事件成为恐怖主义犯罪”。

paras.en: The same suspect faces a separate murder charge over killings in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyskie, Żurek said, a town 93 miles northeast of Kraków, where three of his relatives were found dead in his home.
paras.zh: 祖雷克说，同一名嫌疑人因在克拉科夫东北 93 英里的奥斯特罗维茨圣十字镇杀人而面临单独的谋杀指控，他的三名亲戚被发现死在他的家中。

paras.en: “Establishing all the circumstances of these tragic events, determining the full sequence of the perpetrator’s actions and securing evidence are currently the priorities of the investigation,” which is being led by terror offense specialists within the prosecutor’s office, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，“查明这些悲惨事件的所有背景，确定肇事者行为的全部顺序并获取证据是目前调查的首要任务”，调查由检察官办公室内的恐怖犯罪专家领导。

paras.en: Kraków prosecutor Eryk Stasielak said that the shooter was in critical condition and that victim autopsies are set to start Monday, according to PAP, a Polish news service.
paras.zh: 据波兰新闻机构 PAP 报道，克拉科夫检察官埃里克·斯塔西拉克 (Eryk Stasielak) 表示，枪手情况危急，受害者尸检将于周一开始。

paras.en: “Tomorrow we will be deciding the fate of the attacker, if he survives, because he remains in critical condition,” Stasielak said, according to a translation of the report.
paras.zh: 根据报告的译文，斯塔西拉克说：“明天我们将决定袭击者的命运，如果他还活着，因为他仍处于危急状态。”

paras.en: Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński did not name the suspect, identifying him only as a Polish national in his mid-20s from Ostrowiec Świętokrzyskie. He used an automatic rifle, Kierwiński said Saturday, describing him as having “ultranationalistic” views.
paras.zh: 内政部长 Marcin Kierwiński 没有透露嫌疑人的姓名，仅称他是来自奥斯特罗维茨圣十字省的 20 多岁的波兰国民。基尔温斯基周六表示，他使用的是自动步枪，并称他有“超民族主义”观点。

paras.en: “Everything indicates he was fascinated by far-right ideologies,” he said.
paras.zh: “一切都表明他对极右意识形态着迷，”他说。

paras.en: The suspect was shot by police at the scene and taken to the hospital around 3 p.m.
paras.zh: 下午3点左右，嫌疑人在现场被警察开枪射杀，并被送往医院。

paras.en: A man and two women later found dead in an apartment are believed to be the suspect’s parents and sister, according to Andrzej Fijołek, deputy inspector of Police National Headquarters.
paras.zh: 国家警察总部副巡视员安杰伊·菲霍莱克 (Andrzej Fijołek) 表示，后来在公寓里发现的一名男子和两名妇女死亡，据信是嫌疑人的父母和妹妹。

paras.en: The Interior Ministry announced two national days of mourning Sunday and Monday.
paras.zh: 内政部宣布周日和周一为两个全国哀悼日。

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV expressed his sadness in a message to the archbishop of Kraków on Sunday. The pope “implores the gift of Christian hope for the families overwhelmed by grief and joins with all those experiencing these days of mourning,” the message read, according to a translation.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世周日在给克拉科夫大主教的信中表达了他的悲伤。根据翻译，教皇“恳求为那些被悲伤压垮的家庭带来基督教希望的礼物，并与所有经历这些日子哀悼的人们一起”。

paras.en: Żurek, the justice minister, said early Sunday on social media that Senior Constable Jakub Kulik “is fighting for his life in hospital” after he confronted the shooter.
paras.zh: 司法部长祖雷克周日早些时候在社交媒体上表示，高级警员雅库布·库里克在与枪手对峙后“正在医院为自己的生命而战”。

paras.en: “One of his lungs is not functioning, and he needs every drop of blood he can get,” he posted on X.
paras.zh: 他在 X 上发帖称：“他的一个肺部无法正常工作，他需要得到每一滴血。”

paras.en: Police later said blood banks in Kraków were full and thanked those who donated.
paras.zh: 警方后来表示，克拉科夫的血库已满，并对献血者表示感谢。

paras.en: “Senior constable Jakub Kulik and senior constable Artur Moranski are true heroes,” Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said, referring to both officers.
paras.zh: “高级警官雅库布·库里克和高级警官阿图尔·莫兰斯基是真正的英雄，”波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克在谈到这两名警官时说道。

paras.en: Klęczar said that without “the efficient and selfless intervention” of the officers, “the number of victims could have been significantly higher.”
paras.zh: 克勒查尔说，如果没有警察“高效和无私的干预”，“受害者人数可能会大大增加”。

paras.en: “The condition of the two police officers remains serious,” Klęczar said Sunday. Kierwiński later said the two men had been brought out of comas.
paras.zh: “两名警察的情况仍然很严重，”克勒查尔周日表示。基尔文斯基后来说，两人已从昏迷中苏醒。

paras.en: Video on social media shows what appears to be an injured police officer firing at the gunman before he drops to his knees and rolls over onto his back. The officer, who did not appear to have backup nearby, struggles to reload his firearm and appears to be clutching his right arm.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上的视频显示，一名受伤的警察向枪手开枪，然后枪手跪倒在地，翻身仰面躺着。这名警官附近似乎没有后备人员，他正在努力重新装弹，并且似乎紧紧抓住自己的右臂。

paras.en: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said the U.K. government “deeply mourns the British national and other victims” who died.
paras.zh: 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德表示，英国政府“对遇难的英国国民和其他受害者深表哀悼”。

paras.en: “The U.K. stands resolutely in solidarity with the people of Poland,” he said.
paras.zh: “英国坚决与波兰人民站在一起，”他说。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also said Saturday that his country “stands in solidarity” with neighboring Poland, calling the shooting a “shocking crime.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基周六也表示，乌克兰与邻国波兰“站在一起”，称枪击事件是“令人震惊的犯罪”。

paras.en: The U.S. State Department said it was not aware of any American citizens harmed in the violence.
paras.zh: 美国国务院表示，目前尚不清楚有任何美国公民在暴力事件中受伤。

paras.en: “The profound depth of Poland’s shock at the horror of yesterday’s appalling mass murder in Krakow is truly remarkable to behold,” the U.S. ambassador to Poland, Tom Rose, said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯 (Tom Rose) 在 X 上发帖称：“波兰对昨天克拉科夫发生的骇人听闻的大屠杀感到震惊，着实令人震惊。”

paras.en: Noting how rare the incident was in an “extraordinarily safe” country like Poland, he added, “There’s something profoundly precious about being in a country where such evil remains so foreign to everyday life, where an entire nation recoils in horror at the mere thought of it, and where the depth of grief reveals the true goodness of its people.”
paras.zh: 他指出，这一事件在波兰这样一个“极其安全”的国家是多么罕见，他补充道，“在这样一个国家，这种邪恶对日常生活来说仍然如此陌生，整个国家一想到它就会感到恐惧，而悲痛的深度揭示了其人民的真正善良，这是非常宝贵的。”

paras.en: Part of Main Market Square in Kraków and surrounding streets reopened Sunday, but cordons remain while police carry out forensic work, the city has said in a statement.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫市在一份声明中表示，周日，克拉科夫主要集市广场的部分区域和周边街道重新开放，但在警方进行法医工作期间，警戒线仍然存在。

paras.en: Several makeshift memorials with flowers and candles appeared across the city Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日，全市各地出现了几个用鲜花和蜡烛搭建的临时纪念馆。

paras.en: Many of those caught up in the attack were tourists visiting the city.
paras.zh: 袭击事件中的许多人是到访这座城市的游客。

paras.en: Taylor Dorfmeister, 21, a student from Santa Cruz, California, studying in Italy who was visiting Poland, was in the square with his roommate when gunfire erupted. Dorfmeister said there was a delay before the crowd reacted and then everyone began to flee. He said he took shelter in a building.
paras.zh: 21 岁的泰勒·多夫梅斯特 (Taylor Dorfmeister) 是一名来自加利福尼亚州圣克鲁斯的学生，正在意大利留学，当时正在波兰访问，枪声爆发时，他和室友正在广场上。多夫迈斯特说，人群过了一段时间才做出反应，然后每个人都开始逃跑。他说他在一栋大楼里避难。

paras.en: “We ran up the stairs in the building to hide, and it was a dead end, which is when I was the most terrified, since the gunshots were [loud] and near,” Dorfmeister told NBC News.
paras.zh: 多夫梅斯特告诉 NBC 新闻：“我们跑上大楼的楼梯躲起来，那是一条死胡同，这是我最害怕的时候，因为枪声又大又近。”

paras.en: It sounded to Dorfmeister like the gunfire was coming from the first floor of the building where he hid. He was “fully prepared for the worst” based on the proximity of the noise, he said.
paras.zh: 多夫梅斯特听起来枪声像是从他藏身的大楼一楼传来的。他说，根据噪音的距离，他“做好了最坏的准备”。

paras.en: “This is it,” Dorfmeister thought. “Like, there’s nowhere to go, nowhere to hide.”
paras.zh: “就是这样，”多夫迈斯特想。 “就像，无处可去，无处可藏。”

paras.en: Marie-Ange Collaer was visiting with her family from Brussels.
paras.zh: 玛丽-安吉·科拉尔 (Marie-Ange Collaer) 与家人从布鲁塞尔来探望。

paras.en: “We literally ran for our lives and managed to hide from the bullets flying around,” she wrote on Facebook. “Lying on the floor in a shop like in a bad police movie whilst you hear bullets everywhere.”
paras.zh: 她在脸书上写道：“我们真的是拼命逃命，并设法躲避飞来的子弹。” “躺在商店的地板上，就像一部糟糕的警察电影中一样，你会听到到处都是子弹。”

paras.en: Collaer said that her family were shaky and “quite in shock” after they returned to their hotel and that everyone was grateful to be alive.
paras.zh: 科拉尔说，回到酒店后，她的家人都摇摇欲坠，“非常震惊”，每个人都庆幸自己还活着。

paras.en: “We saw a few that did not make it, true horror,” she wrote.
paras.zh: “我们看到了一些没有成功的人，真正的恐怖，”她写道。

paras.en: U.K. resident Neil Thaxton and his wife, Nicky, also survived the attack.
paras.zh: 英国居民尼尔·萨克斯顿和他的妻子尼基也在袭击中幸存。

paras.en: “We had just walked through the main square and heard the gunshots,” Thaxton wrote on Facebook. “We thought it was fireworks then people started running, we went into a gift shop and the staff took us in the back of the shop and locked the doors and turned the lights off.”
paras.zh: 萨克斯顿在脸书上写道：“我们刚刚走过主广场，就听到了枪声。” “我们以为那是烟花，然后人们开始逃跑，我们走进一家礼品店，工作人员把我们带到商店后面，锁上门并关掉灯。”

articles.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting multiple terror attacks, including planned attack against U.K. airbase
articles.author: Michael Kosnar

paras.en: Three men, including one already jailed in the U.S., were accused by U.S. authorities Tuesday of being Iran-supported operatives who plotted nearly 20 attacks on Jewish communities in Europe and the U.S., as well as a planned assault on a British air base used by the U.S. Air Force.
paras.zh: 三名男子，其中一名已在美国入狱，周二被美国当局指控为伊朗支持的特工，他们策划了近 20 起针对欧洲和美国犹太社区的袭击，并计划袭击美国空军使用的英国空军基地。

paras.en: Charges against Mohammad Al-Saadi, a dual Iranian-Iraqi national; Mohsen Mohajeri, an Iranian national; and Mohammad Ali Al-Hassani, an Iraqi national, were outlined in a superseding indictment unsealed in federal court in New York City.
paras.zh: 对拥有伊朗和伊拉克双重国籍的穆罕默德·萨阿迪 (Mohammad Al-Saadi) 的指控； Mohsen Mohajeri，伊朗国民；纽约市联邦法院公布的一份替代起诉书中概述了伊拉克国民穆罕默德·阿里·哈桑尼的情况。

paras.en: Only Al-Saadi — an alleged pro-Iranian terrorist who is believed to have plotted attacks across Europe, Canada and the U.S., as first reported by NBC News — is in custody.
paras.zh: 只有萨阿迪 (Al-Saadi) 被拘留，他是一名被指控亲伊朗的恐怖分子，据 NBC 新闻报道，据信他在欧洲、加拿大和美国策划了袭击事件。

paras.en: U.S. Attorney Jamie McDonald in New York said in a news release that Al-Saadi, who was arrested in the spring, continued to coordinate with his co-defendants in the days leading up to the attempted September terrorist plot at a British Royal Air Force Base in Fairford, where U.S. bombers and troops had been stationed.
paras.zh: 纽约美国检察官杰米·麦克唐纳 (Jamie McDonald) 在一份新闻稿中表示，今年春天被捕的萨阿迪在 9 月份在费尔福德英国皇家空军基地（美国轰炸机和部队曾驻扎在那里）未遂恐怖袭击阴谋之前的几天里，继续与他的同案被告进行协调。

paras.en: “As alleged, these defendants helped orchestrate a campaign of terror on behalf of terrorist organizations affiliated with Iran that targeted Jewish communities in Europe and the United States, and the British military base, RAF Fairford, housing American service members,” said McDonald, whose office is handling the case.
paras.zh: “据称，这些被告代表与伊朗有关联的恐怖组织帮助策划了一场恐怖活动，目标是欧洲和美国的犹太社区，以及居住着美国军人的英国皇家空军费尔福德基地，”负责处理此案的办公室的麦克唐纳说。

paras.en: “The threat presented by Iran and Iran-backed terrorist groups to America and our allies is not hypothetical — it is very real,” he added in the statement.
paras.zh: 他在声明中补充道：“伊朗和伊朗支持的恐怖组织对美国和我们的盟友构成的威胁不是假设的，而是非常真实的。”

paras.en: The new indictment offers fresh insight into an episode that has been shrouded in mystery for more than a month after five men were detained after midnight Sept. 27 on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offenses after three suspicious vans were spotted traveling toward the base in western England.
paras.zh: 新的起诉书为这一事件提供了新的视角。9月27日午夜后，三辆可疑货车被发现驶向英格兰西部基地，五名男子因涉嫌爆炸物和恐怖主义犯罪而被拘留，这个事件已经笼罩了一个多月的神秘面纱。

paras.en: The Justice Department indictment alleges that Al-Hassani paid associates to carry out surveillance of RAF Fairford in August and paid several people to move forward with the plot in September “by procuring vans and barrels of fuel, researching the purchase of chemical accelerants, including large quantities of potassium chloride, and purchasing metallic objects that could be used as explosive shrapnel.”
paras.zh: 司法部起诉书称，哈桑尼在 8 月份付钱给同事，让他们对英国皇家空军费尔福德进行监视，并在 9 月份付钱给几个人来推进阴谋，“通过采购货车和燃料桶，研究购买化学促进剂，包括大量氯化钾，以及购买可用作爆炸弹片的金属物体。”

paras.en: The group even made custom decals to give the vans the appearance that they were used by a fuel company and a swimming pool supply business, authorities say.
paras.zh: 当局称，该组织甚至定制了贴花，让这些货车看起来像是一家燃料公司和一家游泳池供应公司使用的。

paras.en: Al-Hassani is alleged to have then tasked the people to go to the base with the fuel when U.K. law enforcement took the men into custody.
paras.zh: 据称，当英国执法部门拘留这些人时，哈桑尼要求这些人携带燃料前往基地。

paras.en: Al-Saadi was helping direct the RAF Fairford plot while he was in a U.S. prison, according to the indictment. He made video and phone calls to his family members in Iraq, who are alleged to have passed coded messages to Al-Hassani and Mohajeri.
paras.zh: 起诉书称，萨阿迪在美国监狱期间帮助指挥了英国皇家空军费尔福德阴谋。他给在伊拉克的家人打电话和视频，据称他们向哈桑尼和莫哈杰里传递了密码信息。

paras.en: In a July call with his sister, Al-Saadi asked, “What are we doing about all our old work?” — a reference to terrorist activity — according to investigators.
paras.zh: 7 月份，萨阿迪在与妹妹的一次通话中问道：“我们对之前的工作做了什么？” ——据调查人员称，这是对恐怖活动的提及。

paras.en: His sister replied, “It isn’t cancelled,” investigators said.
paras.zh: 调查人员说，他的姐姐回答说：“它没有被取消。”

paras.en: The indictment alleges that the three men conspired to use a network of contacts in the United Kingdom to commit terrorist attacks on behalf of an Iran-aligned terrorist network, which included Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and Kata’ib Hizballah.
paras.zh: 起诉书称，这三人密谋利用在英国的联系网络，代表与伊朗结盟的恐怖网络实施恐怖袭击，该网络包括伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队和真主党旅。

paras.en: In June, Al-Saadi pleaded not guilty to charges that he plotted at least 18 attacks in Europe in retaliation for the U.S. and Israel’s war with Iran.
paras.zh: 6 月，萨阿迪对他在欧洲策划至少 18 起袭击事件以报复美国和以色列与伊朗的战争的指控表示不认罪。

paras.en: The U.S. government has designated Kata’ib Hizballah and the Revolutionary Guards as foreign terrorist organizations.
paras.zh: 美国政府已将真主党旅和革命卫队列为外国恐怖组织。

articles.title: Finnish ambassador welcomes attention after viral social media posts
articles.author: Niki Burnside

paras.en: In recent days, the Finnish Embassy has become something of a meme, but its ambassador does not mind at all.
paras.zh: 最近几天，芬兰大使馆已成为一种模因，但其大使却一点也不介意。

paras.en: "As long as it's positive and good and brings us more visibility to the work we do to bring Australia and Finland closer," Arto Haapea said.
paras.zh: 阿托·哈皮亚说：“只要它是积极的、好的，能让我们更多地了解我们为拉近澳大利亚和芬兰的距离所做的工作。”

paras.en: It all began when Mr Haapea fronted a video promoting a campaign encouraging singles to enter a competition where they could travel to the Nordic country and dine with others looking to date.
paras.zh: 这一切都始于哈皮亚先生在一段视频中宣传一项活动，鼓励单身人士参加一项比赛，他们可以前往北欧国家与其他想要约会的人一起用餐。

paras.en: Then, three days later, the embassy published another more hum-drum post informing the community it would be closed for a day for a team planning event.
paras.zh: 然后，三天后，大使馆又发布了另一篇更乏味的帖子，通知社区将关闭一天以进行团队规划活动。

paras.en: "That on the heels of the other post just went even more viral,"
paras.zh: “继另一篇帖子之后，这个帖子变得更加病毒式传播，”

paras.en: Each post now has about 80 million views, according to the ambassador, far surpassing anything the embassy has seen before on its Instagram page.
paras.zh: 据大使称，目前每条帖子的浏览量约为 8000 万次，远远超过大使馆之前在 Instagram 页面上看到的任何内容。

paras.en: Reaction to the first video was understandable to embassy staff — the somewhat tongue-in-cheek reel included lines such as "maybe the problem is not you, maybe it's your postcode".
paras.zh: 大使馆工作人员对第一个视频的反应是可以理解的——这段有点半开玩笑的视频包含诸如“也许问题不是你的，也许是你的邮政编码”之类的台词。

paras.en: "You've tried Tinder, you've tried Bumble, but have you tried Helsinki?" Mr Haapea asks in the video.
paras.zh: “你尝试过 Tinder，你尝试过 Bumble，但你尝试过赫尔辛基吗？”哈皮亚先生在视频中问道。

paras.en: But responses to the second post about the embassy's temporary closure took things to another level.
paras.zh: 但对第二条关于大使馆暂时关闭的帖子的回应将事情推向了另一个层面。

paras.en: "Bad day to be a Finnish embassy in Canberra enthusiast," one person commented.
paras.zh: “作为芬兰驻堪培拉大使馆的狂热爱好者，这真是糟糕的一天，”一位人士评论道。

paras.en: More notable commenters included the official Canberra Raiders account, which simply said: "Bugger".
paras.zh: 更值得注意的评论者包括堪培拉突袭者队的官方账户，该账户只是简单地说：“Bugger”。

paras.en: And travel company Contiki added its own thoughts, saying: "day's ruined now, cheers".
paras.zh: 旅游公司Contiki也添加了自己的想法，并表示：“现在一切都毁了，干杯”。

paras.en: Finland's embassy in the Czech Republic also chimed in:
paras.zh: 芬兰驻捷克共和国大使馆也附和道：

paras.en: "For anyone affected by this closure, the Embassy of Finland in Prague will be open as usual tomorrow."
paras.zh: “对于受此次关闭影响的任何人，芬兰驻布拉格大使馆明天将照常开放。”

paras.en: Mr Haapea said the team was amused by the reaction to the closure for their planning day, but their initial focus was work.
paras.zh: 哈皮亚先生表示，团队对计划日关闭的反应感到好笑，但他们最初的重点是工作。

paras.en: "We were all gathered outside of Canberra for a planning day with the team, and we just basically started laughing because we saw the memes and we thought they were hilarious," he said.
paras.zh: “我们都聚集在堪培拉郊外，与团队一起计划一天，我们基本上开始大笑，因为我们看到了这些表情包，我们认为它们很搞笑，”他说。

paras.en: "We decided just to carry on obviously with the planning day agenda, because we had lots of things to plan and sort of talk about with the team for next year."
paras.zh: “我们决定继续执行计划日议程，因为明年我们有很多事情要计划并与团队讨论。”

paras.en: He said 99 per cent of the online interaction had been positive and he hoped it would encourage people to visit their country, while also continuing to strengthen the relationship between Finland and Australia.
paras.zh: 他表示，99%的在线互动都是积极的，他希望这能鼓励人们访问自己的国家，同时继续加强芬兰和澳大利亚之间的关系。

paras.en: He said the goal was to "help more people discover Finland and know about Finland, be curious about what Finland has to offer".
paras.zh: 他表示，目标是“帮助更多人发现芬兰、了解芬兰、对芬兰所提供的一切感到好奇”。

paras.en: "And then we really didn't expect that to happen with the posting about the embassy closure for one day. But, we're also learning about algorithms and how they work,"
paras.zh: “然后我们真的没想到有一天有关关闭大使馆的帖子会发生这种情况。但是，我们也在学习算法及其工作原理，”

paras.en: The reasoning behind the singles campaign was to promote Finland's cuisine, Mr Haapea said.
paras.zh: 哈皮亚先生说，单身运动背后的原因是为了推广芬兰美食。

paras.en: The Finns eat a diet similar to that eaten in Tasmania, he said, including plenty of salmon.
paras.zh: 他说，芬兰人的饮食与塔斯马尼亚相似，其中包括大量鲑鱼。

paras.en: "The Finnish cuisine is quite innovative these days. It's not what it used to be maybe 20 years ago," he said.
paras.zh: “现在的芬兰美食非常创新。它已经不是 20 年前的样子了，”他说。

paras.en: "It's not like everyone has to walk out of Finland with a ring on their finger or a partner that they have found, quite the contrary.
paras.zh: “并不是每个人都必须带着戒指或找到的伴侣走出芬兰，恰恰相反。

paras.en: "The whole model is that they will have group dinners, so there will be eight international guests and two Finnish singles. So, it's more about getting to know people and enjoying the food and the company."
paras.zh: “整个模式是，他们将举行团体晚宴，因此将有八名国际客人和两名芬兰单身人士。因此，更多的是为了结识人们并享受食物和陪伴。”

paras.en: And, while an image circulating online that appears to show a huge queue of people outside the embassy is AI-generated, Mr Haapea said the interest in the embassy was not entirely a red herring.
paras.zh: 而且，虽然网上流传的一张似乎显示大使馆外排着长队的图片是人工智能生成的，但哈皮亚先生表示，对大使馆的兴趣并不完全是为了转移注意力。

paras.en: In addition to the overwhelming online response, some people are indeed stopping by.
paras.zh: 除了网上反应热烈之外，也确实有人驻足。

paras.en: "We've had small groups of visitors, like three or four or five at a time, and they've been just taking pictures," he said.
paras.zh: “我们有一小群游客，一次三四五人，他们只是拍照，”他说。

articles.title: The rebuild is on as Labuschagne makes shaky return to Shield cricket
articles.author: Simon Smale

paras.en: Marnus Labuschagne's return to first-class cricket following his axing from the Test team lasted 36 balls for Queensland in the Sheffield Shield on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 马努斯·拉布沙涅 (Marnus Labuschagne) 在被测试队淘汰后重返一流板球界，周三在谢菲尔德盾杯比赛中为昆士兰队打了 36 个球。

paras.en: Labuschagne made 12 runs before nicking off to Tasmania's Jake Doran off the bowling of Riley Meredith.
paras.zh: 拉布沙涅 (Labuschagne) 打出 12 分，然后接住莱利·梅雷迪思 (Riley Meredith) 的保龄球，将球分给塔斯马尼亚的杰克·多兰 (Jake Doran)。

paras.en: The 32-year-old's dismissal looked similar to so many of his recent failings at Test level, prodding on fourth stump without a hint of foot movement.
paras.zh: 这位 32 岁的球员的被罚下看起来与他最近在测试级别上的许多失败相似，在第四个树桩上没有任何脚部移动的迹象。

paras.en: Uniquely for Queensland's captain, this match means nothing — at least in the short-term.
paras.zh: 对于昆士兰队长来说，这场比赛毫无意义——至少在短期内是独一无二的。

paras.en: He's already been flung on the Test scrap heap, a dire run of form eventually hastening his demise from an Australian Test team that crushed England in last year's Ashes, but has won just two of its last five Tests against Bangladesh and South Africa, without claiming a series victory.
paras.zh: 他已经被扔进了测试废品堆，糟糕的状态最终加速了他在去年灰烬杯中击败英格兰的澳大利亚测试队的灭亡，但在过去五场对阵孟加拉国和南非的测试中只赢得了两次，没有取得系列赛胜利。

paras.en: Spectators didn't mind that though, and more than a handful had turned out to show support to their beleaguered skipper.
paras.zh: 不过，观众并不介意，不少人都出来支持他们陷入困境的船长。

paras.en: Those who arrived on time had to wait an hour and 20 minutes before Labuschagne came to the crease after Angus Lovell (18 off 60 balls) edged Beau Webster into the slips. The opener furiously smacked his bat after doing so much of the hard work on a pitch that offered plenty of zip.
paras.zh: 安格斯·洛弗尔（Angus Lovell，60 球中 18 球）将博·韦伯斯特 (Beau Webster) 逼入禁区后，那些准时到达的球员不得不等待 1 小时 20 分钟，拉布沙涅 (Labuschagne) 才来到了折痕处。在一个充满活力的球场上做了如此多的艰苦努力后，揭幕战球员猛烈地击打了球棒。

paras.en: Labuschagne's arrival was greeted with warm applause, the clapping briefly drowning out the incessant jackhammering of the building sites around the Gabba.
paras.zh: 拉布沙涅的到来受到了热烈的掌声，掌声短暂地盖过了加巴周围建筑工地不断的手提钻声。

paras.en: "Come on Marnus," one punter among the hundred or so faithful called out as he took his mark.
paras.zh: “来吧，马努斯，”一百名左右的忠实赌徒中的一名赌徒在记下自己的分数时喊道。

paras.en: Labuschagne wasted no time in getting into the thick of the action, crushing a square drive for four off the very first ball he faced from former Test teammate Webster.
paras.zh: 拉布沙涅立即投入到激烈的比赛中，在面对前测试队友韦伯斯特的第一个球时，他就以四分球的方式击球得分。

paras.en: A streaky edge past third slip off the bowling of Jackson Bird though, reiterated that Labuschagne's rebuild could be a process as drawn out as the redevelopment around the ground.
paras.zh: 不过，杰克逊·伯德(Jackson Bird)的保龄球以第三名的优势滑落，重申拉布沙涅的重建可能会像地面重建一样漫长。

paras.en: As good as his opening salvo was, the idiosyncrasies that all too often verged towards idiocies during his faltering stays in the middle during Test matches, were still there.
paras.zh: 尽管他的开场齐射很出色，但在测试赛中他在中场摇摇欲坠时经常近乎白痴的特质仍然存在。

paras.en: There was a wave of his hands here, a period of shadow-batting there that were as prevalent at the Gabba as they were in Gqeberha, where he scored 14 and 39 in Australia's innings defeat.
paras.zh: 这里有他的一挥手，那里有一段时间的影子击球，这在加巴和在格贝哈一样普遍，在澳大利亚的比赛中，他分别得到了 14 分和 39 分。

paras.en: As Bell got closer to the off-stump, Labuschagne's leaves became ever more flamboyant, a batting matador daring the bull to crash into his stumps.
paras.zh: 当贝尔越来越接近树桩外时，拉布沙涅的叶子变得越来越华丽，就像一个击球斗牛士敢于让公牛撞上他的树桩。

paras.en: He lasted until lunch, walking off with eight runs to his name.
paras.zh: 他一直坚持到午餐，并以八分的成绩离开。

paras.en: His demise came soon after the break when edged a delivery he didn't need to play at into the gloves of the keeper.
paras.zh: 中场休息后不久，他的一次传球被门将手套击中，而他并不需要将球传出。

paras.en: Labuschagne waited a moment at the crease, miffed at his dismissal, before trudging off.
paras.zh: 拉布沙涅在折痕处等了一会儿，对他被解雇感到恼火，然后拖着沉重的脚步离开了。

paras.en: Fortunately for him, it was far from a bumper day of scores around the country.
paras.zh: 对他来说幸运的是，这远非全国各地得分丰收的一天。

paras.en: Sam Konstas scored 24 and Kurtis Patterson a duck for New South Wales as they were bundled out for 204 against South Australia, while Marcus Harris managed just 15 on an MCG pitch that looked good for batting, given Peter Handscomb's century for Victoria.
paras.zh: 萨姆·康斯塔斯 (Sam Konstas) 拿下 24 分，科蒂斯·帕特森 (Kurtis Patterson) 为新南威尔士州队打进一球，他们在对阵南澳大利亚队的 204 场比赛中出局，而马库斯·哈里斯 (Marcus Harris) 在 MCG 球场上只得到 15 分，考虑到彼得·汉德斯科姆 (Peter Handscomb) 为维多利亚队打出的世纪球，这看起来很适合击球。

paras.en: It is far too soon after his return from South Africa to rectify any wrongs in his technique or banish the demons residing within his head.
paras.zh: 在他从南非回来后，现在就纠正他技术上的任何错误或驱逐他头脑中的恶魔还为时过早。

paras.en: As much as the hammering taking place outside the Gabba, the work to build Labuschagne back into a principle Test batter will take time.
paras.zh: 尽管敲击工作在加巴之外进行，但将拉布沙涅重新打造成主要测试击球手的工作还需要时间。

articles.title: More than 58,000 homes without power as storms hit parts of Qld

paras.en: More than 58,000 households are without power across south-east Queensland after several severe storms bringing destructive winds swept across the region.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州东南部发生几次强风暴，带来破坏性大风席卷整个地区，导致超过 58,000 个家庭断电。

paras.en: The majority of the power outages are in the Logan region, where more than 43,000 households are impacted.
paras.zh: 大部分停电发生在洛根地区，超过 43,000 个家庭受到影响。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Energex said a substation at Jimboomba, south of Brisbane, has been partially damaged by a storm and is affecting more than 9,000 properties in the Scenic Rim.
paras.zh: Energex 发言人表示，布里斯班南部 Jimboomba 的一座变电站已被风暴部分损坏，并影响了风景区 9,000 多处房产。

paras.en: Power has also been cut in the Scenic Rim, the Moreton Bay Region and the Gympie area.
paras.zh: Scenic Rim、莫顿湾地区和金皮地区的电力也被切断。

paras.en: A severe thunderstorm warning for destructive winds, giant hailstones and heavy rainfall was issued by the Bureau of Meteorology on Wednesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 周三下午，气象局发布了破坏性大风、巨型冰雹和强降雨的严重雷暴警报。

paras.en: The bureau said several severe storm cells had developed across south-east Queensland, with areas including the Brisbane CBD, Buperngary, Caboolture, Kilcoy and Mount Tamborine expected to see storm activity.
paras.zh: 该局表示，昆士兰州东南部已经形成了几个严重的风暴单元，布里斯班中央商务区、布彭加里、卡布尔彻、基尔科伊和坦伯林山等地区预计将出现风暴活动。

paras.en: Areas that could be affected over the next hour include Cleveland, Victoria Point, Ormiston, Peel Island and Brisbane Airport.
paras.zh: 未来一小时内可能受影响的地区包括克利夫兰、维多利亚角、奥米斯顿、皮尔岛和布里斯班机场。

articles.title: Meghan Markle's father cut off ankle monitor days after arrest, U.S. officials say

paras.en: Meghan Markle's father cut off ankle monitor days after arrest, U.S. officials say
paras.zh: 美国官员称，梅根·马克尔的父亲在被捕几天后切断了脚踝监视器

paras.en: Thomas Markle, 82, facing charges related to possession of child sexual abuse material
paras.zh: 托马斯·马克尔，82 岁，面临与持有儿童性虐待材料有关的指控

paras.en: Thomas Markle, the 82-year-old estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, cut an electronic monitoring device off his ankle, just days after his arrest for keeping child sexual abuse material in storage units in California, authorities said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 当局周二表示，苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根的 82 岁父亲托马斯·马克尔 (Thomas Markle) 的父亲托马斯·马克尔 (Thomas Markle) 因在加利福尼亚州的储藏室存放儿童性虐待材料而被捕，几天后，他从脚踝上割下了电子监控装置。

paras.en: Markle was in custody awaiting a hearing in federal court in Tampa, Florida, First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli said.
paras.zh: 美国检察官第一助理比尔·埃赛利 (Bill Essayli) 表示，马克尔已被拘留，等待佛罗里达州坦帕联邦法院的听证会。

paras.en: He was arrested shortly after he cut off the ankle bracelet at 1:45 a.m., Essayli said.
paras.zh: 埃萨利说，他于凌晨 1 点 45 分切断脚镯后不久被捕。

paras.en: Markle's arrest on Friday followed the seizure of approximately 78 items, including slides, film negatives and books that contained suspected child sexual abuse images in storage in the Los Angeles area, Essayli said.
paras.zh: Essayli 表示，马克尔于周五被捕，此前警方在洛杉矶地区查获了约 78 件物品，其中包括幻灯片、底片和书籍，其中包含涉嫌儿童性虐待的图像。

paras.en: During his arrest last week, he was taken from a senior care centre in Lakeland by ambulance. Hours later, a judge allowed Markle to be released on the condition that he be electronically monitored, which typically means wearing an ankle bracelet.
paras.zh: 上周被捕期间，他被救护车从莱克兰的一家高级护理中心带走。几小时后，法官允许马克尔获释，但条件是对他进行电子监控，这通常意味着戴上脚镯。

paras.en: The judge also ordered a mental competency exam and a report by Nov. 20.
paras.zh: 法官还下令在 11 月 20 日之前进行心理能力检查并提交报告。

paras.en: Markle's daughter, Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, married Prince Harry at Windsor Castle in 2018. They have two children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet. She is an American citizen and actor who starred in the U.S. television drama Suits.
paras.zh: 马克尔的女儿苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根于 2018 年在温莎城堡与哈里王子结婚。他们有两个孩子，阿奇王子和莉莉贝特公主。她是美国公民和演员，曾出演美国电视剧《金装律师》。

paras.en: Meghan 'deeply distressed' by allegations
paras.zh: 梅根对指控“深感痛苦”

paras.en: Meghan recently said she was "deeply distressed" by allegations that a collection of child sexual abuse images had been found at her father's former home. She also revealed that a letter containing "troubling allegations" about him had been sent to police in London in 2019.
paras.zh: 梅根最近表示，她对在她父亲的故居发现一系列儿童性虐待图片的指控感到“深感悲痛”。她还透露，一封包含有关他“令人不安的指控”的信已于 2019 年发送给伦敦警方。

paras.en: "It made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father and I was given assurances that these were being investigated," Meghan said of the letter. "I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications' distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children was for one reason: to protect them."
paras.zh: 梅根在谈到这封信时说：“这对我父亲提出了令人不安和不安的指控，我得到了这些指控正在接受调查的保证。” “我希望现在大家可以理解，尽管多年来某些媒体出版物歪曲事实，但我与父亲的任何距离以及我选择不允许他与我们的孩子接触的原因只有一个：保护他们。”

paras.en: Thomas Markle was living in the Philippines this year when he suffered a stroke and had his left leg amputated. That forced him to return to the U.S.
paras.zh: 托马斯·马克尔今年住在菲律宾，突然中风，左腿被截肢。这迫使他返回美国

paras.en: His arrest followed reports by The Sun, a British tabloid newspaper, that Meghan's half brother found a collection of child sexual abuse images while clearing out their father's home in the Philippines. That discovery led to information about two U.S. storage units in California, which Markle had rented since 2008.
paras.zh: 英国小报《太阳报》报道称，梅根同父异母的弟弟在清理父亲在菲律宾的家时发现了一系列儿童性虐待图片，随后他被捕。这一发现导致了有关位于加利福尼亚州的两个美国存储单元的信息，马克尔自 2008 年以来一直租用这些存储单元。

articles.title: 3 charged in U.S. with planning terror attacks, including alleged planned assault on British airbase

paras.en: 3 charged in U.S. with planning terror attacks, including alleged planned assault on British airbase
paras.zh: 3 人在美国被指控策划恐怖袭击，包括涉嫌计划袭击英国空军基地

paras.en: 1 suspect allegedly continued to co-ordinate U.K. attack after arrest months earlier, U.S. attorney says
paras.zh: 美国检察官称，一名嫌疑人在几个月前被捕后据称继续协调英国袭击

paras.en: Three men, including one already jailed in the United States, were accused by U.S. authorities Tuesday of being Iran-supported operatives who plotted nearly 20 attacks on Jewish communities in Europe and the U.S. as well as a planned assault on a British airbase used by the U.S. Air Force.
paras.zh: 三名男子，其中一名已在美国入狱，周二被美国当局指控为伊朗支持的特工，策划对欧洲和美国的犹太社区发动近 20 起袭击，并计划袭击美国空军使用的英国空军基地。

paras.en: Charges against Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi, a dual Iranian-Iraqi national; Mohsen Mohajeri, an Iranian national; and Mohammad Ali al-Hassani, an Iraqi national, were outlined in a superseding indictment unsealed in Manhattan federal court. Only al-Saadi is in custody.
paras.zh: 对拥有伊朗和伊拉克双重国籍的穆罕默德·巴克尔·萨阿德·达伍德·萨阿迪的指控； Mohsen Mohajeri，伊朗国民；曼哈顿联邦法院公布的一份替代起诉书中概述了伊拉克国民穆罕默德·阿里·哈桑尼的情况。只有萨阿迪被拘留。

paras.en: U.S. Attorney Jamie McDonald in New York said in a news release that al-Saadi, who was arrested in the spring, allegedly continued to co-ordinate with his co-defendants in the days leading up to the attempted September terrorist plot at a British Royal Air Force Base in Fairford, United Kingdom, where U.S. bombers and troops had been stationed.
paras.zh: 纽约美国检察官杰米·麦克唐纳 (Jamie McDonald) 在一份新闻稿中表示，今年春天被捕的萨阿迪据称在 9 月份在英国费尔福德英国皇家空军基地（美国轰炸机和部队驻扎地）未遂恐怖袭击阴谋前几天继续与他的同案被告进行协调。

paras.en: "These defendants helped orchestrate a campaign of terror on behalf of terrorist organizations affiliated with Iran that targeted Jewish communities in Europe and the United States, and the British military base, RAF Fairford, housing American service members," McDonald said. "The threat presented by Iran and Iran-backed terrorist groups to America and our allies is not hypothetical — it is very real."
paras.zh: 麦克唐纳说：“这些被告代表与伊朗有联系的恐怖组织帮助策划了一场恐怖活动，目标是欧洲和美国的犹太社区以及居住着美国军人的英国皇家空军费尔福德军事基地。” “伊朗和伊朗支持的恐怖组织对美国和我们的盟友构成的威胁不是假设的——而是非常真实的。”

paras.en: Attorney General Todd Blanche said: "Anyone who plans a terrorist plot on a military base housing American servicemembers will be prosecuted by the United States government."
paras.zh: 司法部长托德·布兰奇表示：“任何计划在美国军人军事基地实施恐怖阴谋的人都将受到美国政府的起诉。”

paras.en: The new indictment offers fresh insight into an episode that has been shrouded in mystery for more than a month after five men were detained after midnight on Sept. 27 on suspected explosives and terrorism offenses after three suspicious vans were spotted travelling toward the base in western England.
paras.zh: 新的起诉书为这一事件提供了新的视角。9月27日午夜后，三辆可疑货车被发现驶向英格兰西部基地，五名男子因涉嫌爆炸物和恐怖主义犯罪而被拘留，这一事件已经笼罩了一个多月的神秘面纱。

paras.en: A sixth suspect, a British-Iranian dual national, was arrested several days later. All the men were released on bail.
paras.zh: 第六名嫌疑人是一名英国和伊朗双重国籍的人，几天后被捕。所有男子均已获保释。

paras.en: - U.K. charges 2 men, accuses them of working on Iran's behalf in incident at airbase
paras.zh: - 英国指控两名男子在空军基地事件中为伊朗工作

paras.en: - Canada, U.K. allies vow action after RAF Fairford terror plot
paras.zh: - 加拿大和英国盟友誓言在英国皇家空军费尔福德恐怖阴谋发生后采取行动

paras.en: British authorities linked the incident to Tehran, and though Iran denied involvement, the arrests prompted the U.S. to withdraw its bombers that had been stationed there. The bombers were redeployed to their home bases in the United States.
paras.zh: 英国当局将这一事件与德黑兰联系起来，尽管伊朗否认参与其中，但逮捕行动促使美国撤回驻扎在那里的轰炸机。这些轰炸机被重新部署到美国的基地。

paras.en: RAF Fairford, located 160 kilometres west of London, has been used by American bombers during decades of conflicts in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 英国皇家空军费尔福德空军基地位于伦敦以西 160 公里处，在中东数十年的冲突中一直被美国轰炸机使用。

paras.en: According to the indictment, al-Saadi allegedly used coded language in communications with relatives from jail to direct that money be passed along to others who could carry out attacks.
paras.zh: 根据起诉书，萨阿迪据称在与狱中亲属的交流中使用了编码语言，以指示将资金转给其他可能实施袭击的人。

paras.en: The indictment alleged that the three men conspired together to use a network of contacts in the United Kingdom to commit terrorist attacks on behalf of an Iran-aligned terrorist network, which included the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and Kata’ib Hezbollah.
paras.zh: 起诉书称，这三人合谋利用在英国的联系网络，代表与伊朗结盟的恐怖网络实施恐怖袭击，该网络包括伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）和真主党旅。

paras.en: In June, al-Saadi pleaded not guilty to charges that he plotted at least 18 attacks in Europe in retaliation for the U.S. and Israel’s war with Iran. He called himself a "prisoner of war." He has been held without bail since. His lawyers did not immediately respond to requests for comment Tuesday on the latest development.
paras.zh: 6 月，萨阿迪对他在欧洲策划至少 18 起袭击事件以报复美国和以色列与伊朗的战争的指控表示不认罪。他称自己为“战俘”。此后他一直被关押，不得保释。他的律师周二没有立即回应就最新进展发表评论的请求。

paras.en: Both Kata’ib Hezbollah and Iran’s IRGC have been designated by the U.S. government as foreign terrorist organizations. U.S. prosecutors say Al-Saadi was a Kata’ib Hezbollah commander.
paras.zh: 卡塔布真主党和伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队都被美国政府认定为外国恐怖组织。美国检察官称萨阿迪是真主党旅指挥官。

articles.title: Slain cartel boss 'The General' provided Ryan Wedding with fake police ID to evade capture, U.S. alleges
articles.author: Thomas Daigle

paras.en: Slain cartel boss 'The General' provided Ryan Wedding with fake police ID to evade capture, U.S. alleges
paras.zh: 美国称，被杀的贩毒集团头目“将军”向瑞安·威丁提供了假警察身份证以逃避抓捕

paras.en: New charges give insight into how Canadian drug smuggler avoided arrest in Mexico for a decade
paras.zh: 新指控揭示了加拿大毒品走私者十年来如何在墨西哥逃避逮捕

paras.en: How did Ryan Wedding — the Canadian Olympic snowboarder turned international fugitive — manage to evade capture for a decade in Mexico?
paras.zh: 加拿大滑雪运动员瑞安·威丁 (Ryan Wedding) 转为国际逃犯，是如何在墨西哥逃亡十年的？

paras.en: U.S. federal charges announced in California on Tuesday gave part of the answer, providing new insight into two alleged accomplices accused of helping to protect Wedding by using tactics worthy of the Netflix series Narcos.
paras.zh: 周二在加利福尼亚州宣布的美国联邦指控给出了部分答案，为两名涉嫌共犯提供了新的见解，他们被指控使用 Netflix 连续剧《毒枭》中的策略来帮助保护婚礼。

paras.en: According to a grand jury indictment unsealed in Los Angeles, cartel leader Edgar Aaron Vazquez Alvarado gave Wedding and other co-conspirators a code word so cocaine loads would not be blocked by Mexican police and military personnel.
paras.zh: 根据在洛杉矶公布的大陪审团起诉书，贩毒集团头目埃德加·亚伦·巴斯克斯·阿尔瓦拉多给韦丁和其他同谋提供了一个暗号，这样墨西哥警察和军事人员就不会拦截可卡因装载量。

paras.en: What's more, Vazquez is accused of providing Wedding and co-conspirators with "authentic law enforcement credentials" that were manipulated to bear their own names, allowing Wedding and others to safely pass through security checkpoints in Mexico.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，巴斯克斯被指控向威丁及其同谋提供“真实的执法证件”，这些证件被操纵以冠上自己的名字，从而使威丁和其他人能够安全地通过墨西哥的安全检查站。

paras.en: U.S. prosecutors said Vazquez welcomed the Thunder Bay, Ont.-born Wedding into a club of organized crime leaders who received sensitive information, including details about arrest warrants and investigations.
paras.zh: 美国检察官表示，巴斯克斯欢迎这位出生于安大略省桑德贝的婚礼加入一个由有组织的犯罪头目组成的俱乐部，这些头目收到了敏感信息，包括有关逮捕令和调查的详细信息。

paras.en: The indictment, released Tuesday, said Vazquez charged Wedding a one-time initiation fee of $500,000 US to be allowed into the group, and an average monthly fee of $100,000 US.
paras.zh: 周二公布的起诉书称，巴斯克斯向 Wedding 收取了 50 万美元的一次性入会费，以及平均每月 10 万美元的费用。

paras.en: Mexico Security Minister Omar García Harfuch announced last week that 42-year-old Vazquez — known as "The General" — had been fatally shot in an operation involving Mexican security forces.
paras.zh: 墨西哥安全部长奥马尔·加西亚·哈富奇上周宣布，42 岁的巴斯克斯（被称为“将军”）在墨西哥安全部队参与的一次行动中被枪杀。

paras.en: His name was first publicly linked to Wedding a year ago when the U.S. Treasury Department announced sanctions against Vazquez and his companies for their ties to the Canadian. The department identified Vazquez as a former Mexican law enforcement officer with high-level connections.
paras.zh: 一年前，他的名字首次被公开与 Wedding 联系起来，当时美国财政部宣布对巴斯克斯及其公司与加拿大人的关系实施制裁。该部门确认巴斯克斯是一名与高层有联系的前墨西哥执法官员。

paras.en: Wedding, 45, allegedly ran a murderous drug-smuggling network that generated $1 billion US a year. The FBI said he fled to Mexico around the time he faced criminal charges in Montreal in 2015.
paras.zh: 45 岁的威丁涉嫌经营一个凶残的毒品走私网络，每年赚取 10 亿美元。 FBI 表示，2015 年他在蒙特利尔面临刑事指控时，他逃往墨西哥。

paras.en: Also known as Public Enemy, Wedding was arrested in Mexico in January and remains in U.S. custody. He has pleaded not guilty to a list of charges related to murder and drug trafficking. He is scheduled to stand trial in Los Angeles next year.
paras.zh: 威丁也被称为“公众之敌”，他于一月份在墨西哥被捕，目前仍被美国拘留。他对一系列与谋杀和贩毒有关的指控表示不认罪。他定于明年在洛杉矶接受审判。

paras.en: Suspect allegedly had ties to notorious cartels
paras.zh: 据称嫌疑人与臭名昭著的卡特尔有联系

paras.en: Also in Tuesday's news release, the U.S. Attorney's Office in L.A. identified "reputed street gang member" Roberto Gomez as another key facilitator in Wedding's ability to spend years on the run.
paras.zh: 同样在周二的新闻稿中，洛杉矶美国检察官办公室确认“著名的街头帮派成员”罗伯托·戈麦斯是威丁多年逃亡的另一关键推动者。

paras.en: Gomez, who went by the aliases Fat Boy and Rooster, allegedly cultivated relationships with people who had access to sensitive information from Mexican and U.S. law enforcement.
paras.zh: 戈麦斯的化名是“胖男孩”和“公鸡”，据称他与能够从墨西哥和美国执法部门获取敏感信息的人建立了关系。

paras.en: The prosecutor's office said the 51-year-old former L.A. resident also kept in touch with leaders of the Sinaloa and Jalisco New Generation cartels — two of Mexico's most notorious criminal syndicates, considered terrorist organizations by the U.S. and Canada.
paras.zh: 检察官办公室表示，这位 51 岁的前洛杉矶居民还与锡那罗亚州和哈利斯科州新一代贩毒集团的领导人保持联系，这是墨西哥最臭名昭著的两个犯罪集团，被美国和加拿大视为恐怖组织。

paras.en: Ryan Wedding is escorted off a plane in Ontario, Calif., in January, hours after his arrest in Mexico. (FBI)
paras.zh: 一月份，瑞安·威丁 (Ryan Wedding) 在墨西哥被捕几小时后，在加利福尼亚州安大略省被护送下飞机。 （联邦调查局）

paras.en: While Wedding was on the run, the FBI said he benefited from the protection of the Sinaloa Cartel, which was co-founded by infamous drug lord Joaquín (El Chapo) Guzmán. Further details of Wedding's purported arrangements in Mexico are only now beginning to trickle out.
paras.zh: 韦丁在逃期间，联邦调查局表示，他受益于锡那罗亚贩毒集团的保护，该贩毒集团是由臭名昭著的毒枭华金·古兹曼共同创立的。据称，婚礼在墨西哥的安排的更多细节现在才刚刚开始流出。

paras.en: "There were multiple attempts to capture Mr. Wedding, and in each of those attempts we were undermined," First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli told CBC News last week.
paras.zh: 美国联邦检察官第一助理比尔·埃赛利上周告诉加拿大广播公司新闻频道：“我们曾多次尝试抓捕威丁先生，但每次尝试都遭到破坏。”

paras.en: "He either was tipped off or was given a warning, and was somehow always able to evade us, just barely … and so it was our belief that he was getting help."
paras.zh: “他要么收到举报，要么收到警告，并且总是能够以某种方式逃避我们，只是勉强……所以我们相信他正在获得帮助。”

paras.en: U.S. authorities allege Gomez provided Wedding with sensitive information to evade capture, and also helped supply him with bulk drug shipments.
paras.zh: 美国当局指控戈麦斯向威丁提供敏感信息以逃避抓捕，并帮助他运送散装毒品。

paras.en: In one instance, prosecutors said Gomez attempted to broker the sale of 453.6 kilograms of methamphetamine to Wedding for $550,000 US in cryptocurrency.
paras.zh: 在一个案例中，检察官称戈麦斯试图以 55 万美元的加密货币向 Wedding 出售 453.6 公斤甲基苯丙胺。

paras.en: Gomez, who is listed as a fugitive living in Mexico, faces six charges, including drug offences and one count of attempting to transact and deal with a "specially designated narcotics trafficker."
paras.zh: 戈麦斯被列为居住在墨西哥的逃犯，面临六项指控，包括毒品犯罪和一项试图与“特别指定的毒品贩运者”进行交易和打交道的罪名。

paras.en: Ryan Wedding's alleged second-in-command, Canadian Andrew Clark, was arrested in Mexico in October 2024 in an operation involving Interpol and the Mexican navy. (Omar García Harfuch/Facebook)
paras.zh: 瑞安·威丁 (Ryan Wedding) 的二号人物加拿大人安德鲁·克拉克 (Andrew Clark) 于 2024 年 10 月在国际刑警组织和墨西哥海军参与的一次行动中在墨西哥被捕。 （奥马尔·加西亚·哈富奇/Facebook）

paras.en: The charges unsealed against Vazquez and Gomez add to a flurry of law enforcement activity over the past week in the Wedding case.
paras.zh: 针对巴斯克斯和戈麦斯的指控进一步加剧了过去一周在婚礼案件中的一系列执法活动。

paras.en: The FBI announced the arrest in Colombia last week of a Mexican judge accused of accepting $2 million US in bribes to free Wedding's alleged second-in-command, Andrew Clark.
paras.zh: 美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 上周宣布在哥伦比亚逮捕了一名墨西哥法官，他被控收受 200 万美元贿赂，以释放威丁的二号人物安德鲁·克拉克 (Andrew Clark)。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Mexican authorities are expected to auction off 61 rare and high-performance motorcycles seized last year from properties linked to Wedding. The FBI previously estimated the collection was worth $40 million US.
paras.zh: 周三，墨西哥当局预计将拍卖去年从与 Wedding 有关的财产中查获的 61 辆稀有高性能摩托车。 FBI 此前估计该藏品价值 4000 万美元。

paras.en: The U.S. treasury also announced sanctions against Iran-linked firms in the Toronto and Vancouver areas accused of helping Wedding launder billions of dollars in drug proceeds.
paras.zh: 美国财政部还宣布对多伦多和温哥华地区与伊朗有联系的公司实施制裁，这些公司被指控帮助婚礼洗钱数十亿美元的毒品收益。

paras.en: Also last week, a Wedding co-defendant described by U.S. authorities as the operator of a "high-end prostitution ring" in Mexico pleaded not guilty in L.A. to conspiracy to commit murder after she was extradited from Colombia.
paras.zh: 同样在上周，一名被美国当局描述为墨西哥“高端卖淫团伙”经营者的婚礼同案被告在从哥伦比亚引渡回洛杉矶后，对共谋谋杀罪不认罪。

paras.en: Prosecutors allege Carmen Yelinet Valoyes Florez used her network of commercial sex workers to help locate the target of a murder plot, a Canadian-born FBI witness.
paras.zh: 检察官指控卡门·叶琳特·瓦洛耶斯·弗洛雷斯 (Carmen Yelinet Valoyes Florez) 利用她的商业性工作者网络帮助找到谋杀阴谋的目标，即一名加拿大出生的联邦调查局 (FBI) 证人。

paras.en: Florez is also said to have introduced Wedding to his Colombian girlfriend.
paras.zh: 据说弗洛雷斯还把婚礼介绍给了他的哥伦比亚女友。

paras.en: CBC News senior reporter Thomas Daigle has extensively covered the case of Ryan Wedding. He can be reached by email at thomas.daigle@cbc.ca.
paras.zh: CBC 新闻高级记者 Thomas Daigle 广泛报道了 Ryan Wedding 的案件。您可以通过电子邮件 thomas.daigle@cbc.ca 与他联系。

articles.title: Controversial kinship: From colonial rule to the Holocaust?

paras.en: Racial hierarchy, dehumanization, concentration camps, settler expansion in the name of "living space," collective punishment and mass violence: At first glance, the continuities between colonial and Nazi violence appear obvious. In 1941, Nazi dictator Adolf Hitler himself compared Eastern Europe to "Germany's India" after the British colonial model, declaring that "like the English, we shall rule this empire with a handful of men."
paras.zh: 种族等级制度、非人化、集中营、以“生存空间”名义扩张定居者、集体惩罚和大规模暴力：乍一看，殖民暴力和纳粹暴力之间的连续性似乎很明显。 1941年，纳粹独裁者阿道夫·希特勒本人将东欧比作效仿英国殖民模式的“德国的印度”，宣称“我们将像英国人一样，用少数人统治这个帝国”。

paras.en: But the extent to which Nazism was shaped by the age of empire, and whether the two systems of violence can even be compared, remains the subject of intense debate. This is particularly true in Germany, where the fear is often expressed that any comparison risks relativizing or minimizing Nazi crimes, and particularly the Holocaust. Others have argued that the intense focus on the Nazi era has, at least in part, come at the expense of a meaningful reckoning with Germany's colonial history.
paras.zh: 但帝国时代在多大程度上塑造了纳粹主义，以及这两种暴力制度是否可以进行比较，仍然是激烈争论的话题。在德国尤其如此，人们经常担心任何比较都有可能使纳粹罪行（尤其是大屠杀）相对化或最小化。其他人则认为，对纳粹时代的强烈关注至少在一定程度上是以牺牲对德国殖民历史的有意义的清算为代价的。

paras.en: "I do think this is nonsense," says Stephan Malinowski, a Professor of Modern European History at the University of Edinburgh. "If it were true, then all other colonial countries who are not discussing the Holocaust, like Great Britain for example, or France or Spain or Portugal, they would then supposed to be very, very attentive to colonial crimes and to colonial history, which it seems to me is not the case."
paras.zh: “我确实认为这是无稽之谈，”爱丁堡大学现代欧洲史教授斯蒂芬·马林诺夫斯基说。 “如果这是真的，那么所有其他不讨论大屠杀的殖民地国家，例如英国、法国、西班牙或葡萄牙，他们就会非常非常关注殖民罪行和殖民历史，但在我看来，情况并非如此。”

paras.en: "Controversial Kinship: Colonial and National Socialist Violence," a new exhibition at the German Historical Museum in Berlin curated by Malinowski, does not aim to settle the debate but to tell its story.
paras.zh: 马林诺夫斯基在柏林德国历史博物馆策划了一场新展览“有争议的亲属关系：殖民地和国家社会主义的暴力”，其目的不是解决争论，而是讲述它的故事。

paras.en: The exhibition begins with a hippopotamus-hide whip used in African colonies displayed alongside a canister of Zyklon B, the poison used in Nazi gas chambers. The juxtaposition highlights the contrast between colonial violence and the industrialized mass murder of the Holocaust. Yet it also points to connections: Whips were used in Nazi concentration camps, while Fascist Italy deployed chemical weapons against civilians and soldiers during its invasion of Ethiopia (then Abyssinia) in 1935-36.
paras.zh: 展览首先展示了非洲殖民地使用的河马皮鞭，旁边展示了纳粹毒气室使用的齐克隆 B 毒药罐。这种并置凸显了殖民暴力与大屠杀的工业化大规模屠杀之间的对比。但它也指出了一些联系：纳粹集中营使用了鞭子，而法西斯意大利在 1935-36 年入侵埃塞俄比亚（当时的阿比西尼亚）期间对平民和士兵部署了化学武器。

paras.en: In the 1930s, anti-colonial thinkers from India to the Caribbean argued that colonialism and fascism were two sides of the same coin. "There is nothing new or original about the blustering exploits of Hitler and Mussolini," observed the Trinidadian journalist and Pan-Africanist George Padmore in 1938. "They have all been used before by the British in their efforts to obtain the subjection of less powerfully armed and more industrially backward people."
paras.zh: 20世纪30年代，从印度到加勒比地区的反殖民思想家认为，殖民主义和法西斯主义是同一枚硬币的两个侧面。 1938 年，特立尼达记者兼泛非主义者乔治·帕德莫尔 (George Padmore) 评论道：“希特勒和墨索里尼的令人震惊的功绩并没有什么新奇或原创之处。英国人以前都曾利用过这些功绩来征服武装力量较弱、工业较落后的人民。”

paras.en: European colonial rule was marked by the ruthless exploitation of people and resources, often enforced through extreme violence. In "The Origins of Totalitarianism" (1951), German-American philosopher Hannah Arendt argued that colonial territories served as laboratories for racial ideologies and practices of domination that could be applied beyond the legal constraints of Europe. Arendt described how these later "boomeranged" back into Europe and helped shape totalitarian politics in distinct and unprecedented form.
paras.zh: 欧洲殖民统治的特点是对人民和资源的残酷剥削，通常通过极端暴力来实施。在《极权主义的起源》（1951）中，德裔美国哲学家汉娜·阿伦特认为，殖民地领土是种族意识形态和统治实践的实验室，可以超越欧洲的法律限制。阿伦特描述了这些人后来如何“回旋”回到欧洲，并以独特且前所未有的形式帮助塑造极权主义政治。

paras.en: The Congo Free State, King Leopold II of Belgium's private colony from 1885 to 1908, became notorious for its extreme brutality, as colonial authorities used executions, amputations and sexual violence to ensure rubber production quotas were met. Forced labor was central to Nazi rule, with millions of Poles, Ukrainians, Russians and others from the Soviet Union, and Jews, subjected to exploitation and "Vernichtung durch Arbeit" ("extermination through work"). Within a few years, the regime mobilized around 13 to 14 million forced laborers, a scale comparable to the transatlantic slave trade over more than three centuries. The Nazis sought to extract value from their victims at every stage, confiscating their property, exploiting their labor, and even harvesting gold teeth and hair from the dead.
paras.zh: 刚果自由邦是比利时国王利奥波德二世在 1885 年至 1908 年间的私人殖民地，因其极端残暴而臭名昭著，殖民当局使用处决、截肢和性暴力来确保满足橡胶生产配额。强迫劳动是纳粹统治的核心，数百万波兰人、乌克兰人、俄罗斯人和其他苏联人以及犹太人遭受剥削和“Vernichtung durch Arbeit”（“通过工作灭绝”）。几年之内，该政权动员了大约 13 至 1400 万强迫劳工，这一规模相当于三个多世纪以来跨大西洋奴隶贸易的规模。纳粹在每个阶段都试图从受害者身上榨取价值，没收他们的财产，剥削他们的劳动力，甚至从死者身上获取金牙和头发。

paras.en: While racism underpinned both colonial empires and Nazism, Malinowski says the goals were different. The colonial powers tended to present assimilation as a path to advancement, forcing colonized people to adopt European culture, serve imperial interests, and suggesting that a select, educated few could gain opportunities at elite institutions such as Oxford or Cambridge. "This is definitely not something that the Nazi regime is offering to Poles or to Russians or let alone to Jews," added Malinowski.
paras.zh: 马林诺夫斯基表示，虽然种族主义是殖民帝国和纳粹主义的基础，但它们的目标是不同的。殖民列强倾向于将同化作为一种​​进步之路，迫使殖民地人民接受欧洲文化，为帝国利益服务，并建议少数受过教育的精选人可以在牛津或剑桥等精英机构获得机会。马林诺夫斯基补充道：“这绝对不是纳粹政权向波兰人或俄罗斯人提供的东西，更不用说向犹太人提供的东西了。”

paras.en: "In terms of violence, colonial violence was just as extreme as Nazi violence. But Nazi violence was annihilatory and exterminatory compared to colonial violence in the colonies," says Edward Kissi, a historian at the School of Interdisciplinary Global Studies at the University of South Florida. He points to the example of how, unlike European colonial powers in Africa, the Nazis pursued the elimination of Black-Germans or peoples of African descent in Germany through forced sterilization. "Even in racism, colonial color-based racism and colonial anti-Jewish sentiments were fundamentally different from what the Nazis pursued."
paras.zh: 南佛罗里达大学跨学科全球研究学院历史学家爱德华·基西说：“就暴力而言，殖民地暴力与纳粹暴力一样极端。但与殖民地的殖民暴力相比，纳粹暴力更具毁灭性和灭绝性。”他举了一个例子，与非洲的欧洲殖民国家不同，纳粹如何通过强制绝育来消灭德国的黑人德国人或非洲人后裔。 “即使在种族主义方面，殖民地基于肤色的种族主义和殖民反犹太情绪也与纳粹所追求的根本不同。”

paras.en: On October 2, 1904, German General Lothar von Trotha issued the "Vernichtungsbefehl" ("extermination order") following the Herero uprising in German South West Africa (present-day Namibia). Historians generally attribute the order to a combination of racial ideology, a desire to terrorize the population into submission, and efforts to secure colonial control over land, labor and resources. Between 1904 and 1908, an estimated 60,000 to 80,000 Herero (around 80% of the population) and 10,000 (around half the population) Nama died.
paras.zh: 1904 年 10 月 2 日，德国将军洛塔尔·冯·特罗塔 (Lothar von Trotha) 在德属西南非洲（今纳米比亚）发生赫雷罗起义后发布了“Vernichtungsbefehl”（“灭绝令”）。历史学家普遍将这种秩序归因于种族意识形态、恐吓人民屈服的愿望以及确保殖民对土地、劳动力和资源控制的努力的结合。 1904 年至 1908 年间，估计有 60,000 至 80,000 名赫雷罗人（约占人口的 80%）和 10,000 名纳马人（约占人口的一半）死亡。

paras.en: One area where the exhibition draws no direct parallel is the industrialized killing carried out in Nazi death camps such as Belzec, Sobibor, Treblinka, and Auschwitz-Birkenau. "Where the two things really diverge is the Holocaust and is the systematic mass murder of the European Jews and it's murder for the very purpose of murder," explains Malinowski. The deportation of around 1,800 Jews from the Greek islands of Rhodes and Kos in July 1944 illustrates how Nazi persecution often defied military or economic logic. Even after the war was effectively lost, the community was transported to Auschwitz, where most were murdered immediately upon arrival.
paras.zh: 展览没有直接对比的一个领域是在贝尔热茨、索比堡、特雷布林卡和奥斯威辛-比克瑙等纳粹死亡集中营进行的工业化屠杀。 “这两件事真正不同的是大屠杀，是对欧洲犹太人的系统性大规模谋杀，而且是为了谋杀而谋杀，”马林诺夫斯基解释道。 1944 年 7 月，大约 1,800 名犹太人被驱逐出希腊的罗德岛和科斯岛，这表明纳粹的迫害常常违背军事或经济逻辑。即使在战争实际上失败后，社区仍被送往奥斯威辛集中营，大多数人在抵达后立即被谋杀。

paras.en: The issue of the "singularity" of the Holocaust came to the fore during the 1980s "Historikerstreit" ("historians' dispute"). Historian Ernst Nolte argued that Nazism should be understood in the wider context of 20th-century political violence, and as a response to Bolshevik terror in particular. Critics accused him of downplaying German responsibility for Nazi crimes.
paras.zh: 大屠杀的“奇点性”问题在 20 世纪 80 年代的“Historikerstreit”（“历史学家之争”）中脱颖而出。历史学家恩斯特·诺尔特认为，纳粹主义应该在 20 世纪政治暴力的更广泛背景下理解，特别是作为对布尔什维克恐怖的回应。批评者指责他淡化了德国对纳粹罪行的责任。

paras.en: Since 2020, a renewed debate dubbed the "Historikerstreit 2.0" has focused on whether the Holocaust should be viewed as a unique reference point in German memory culture or be understood alongside the histories of colonialism, racism and empire. The dispute now is less about the legitimacy of comparison than about its implications.
paras.zh: 自2020年以来，一场被称为“Historikerstreit 2.0”的新辩论的焦点是，大屠杀是否应该被视为德国记忆文化中的一个独特参考点，还是应该与殖民主义、种族主义和帝国的历史一起理解。现在的争论与其说是关于比较的合法性，不如说是关于其含义。

paras.en: The mass murder of tens of thousands of the Herero and Nama during four years of German colonial rule is now regarded as the first genocide of the 20th-century. In 2016, Nama representatives walked out of talks after Germany's chief negotiator said what happened was "incomparable" to the Holocaust. The German government has since recognized the events as genocide "from today's perspective," but it has not yet accepted legal liability or agreed to pay formal reparations.
paras.zh: 德国殖民统治四年期间，数万名赫雷罗人和纳马人遭到大规模屠杀，现在被视为 20 世纪的第一起种族灭绝事件。 2016年，在德国首席谈判代表表示所发生的事情与大屠杀“无法相比”之后，纳马代表退出了谈判。德国政府“从今天的角度”承认这些事件是种族灭绝，但尚未承担法律责任或同意支付正式赔偿。

paras.en: Rethinking Germany's culture of remembrance
paras.zh: 重新思考德国的纪念文化

paras.en: Martinican intellectual Aimé Césaire argued in "Discourse on Colonialism" (1950) that Europe condemned under Nazism forms of violence it had long accepted in its colonies. The exhibition opens amid renewed debates over settler colonialism, the definition of genocide, and the meaning of "never again," sharpened by Nicaragua's case against Germany at the International Court of Justice over German support for Israel during the war in Gaza. These tensions are reflected in visitors' comments in the exhibition's epilogue, even though the exhibition itself does not address Israel or Palestine beyond a reference to Mohammed Amin al-Husseini, appointed Grand Mufti of Jerusalem in 1921.
paras.zh: 马提尼克知识分子艾梅·塞泽尔在《殖民主义话语》（1950）中指出，欧洲谴责其在其殖民地长期接受的纳粹主义暴力形式。展览开幕之际，关于定居者殖民主义、种族灭绝的定义以及“永不重演”含义的新一轮辩论正值尼加拉瓜因德国在加沙战争期间支持以色列而在国际法院针对德国的案件而加剧。这些紧张局势反映在展览尾声中参观者的评论中，尽管展览本身除了提到 1921 年被任命为耶路撒冷大穆夫提的穆罕默德·阿明·侯赛尼之外，并未涉及以色列或巴勒斯坦。

paras.en: Germany has unequivocally accepted responsibility for the Holocaust, which is front and center of the country's culture of remembrance. However, Kissi likens Germany's apparent reluctance to reckon with its colonial history to debates in the US over slavery, in Cambodia over the Khmer Rouge, and in Turkey over the Armenian genocide. According to him, Germany's contemporary identity cannot be fully understood without examining its colonial history and the ways the Nazis appropriated and transformed aspects of that legacy. "I think Germans and all other human beings who have experienced violent pasts and difficult pasts should be very careful not to delink or dissociate those facts from their present," Kissi said. "These are historical patterns. It is better to deal with these historical patterns and discomforts than to just fight them and then say this has absolutely nothing to do with German national identity."
paras.zh: 德国明确承认对大屠杀负有责任，这是该国纪念文化的前沿和中心。然而，基西将德国明显不愿正视其殖民历史的行为比作美国关于奴隶制、柬埔寨关于红色高棉以及土耳其关于亚美尼亚种族灭绝的辩论。他认为，如果不审视其殖民历史以及纳粹如何挪用和改造这一遗产的方式，就无法充分理解德国的当代身份。基西说：“我认为德国人和所有其他经历过暴力过去和困难过去的人应该非常小心，不要将这些事实与他们的现在脱钩或分离。” “这些都是历史模式。最好是处理这些历史模式和不适，而不是仅仅与之作斗争，然后说这与德国的民族认同完全无关。”

paras.en: "Controversial Kinship: Colonial and National Socialist Violence" is on show at the German Historical Museum until April 11, 2027.
paras.zh: “有争议的亲属关系：殖民地和国家社会主义暴力”在德国历史博物馆展出至 2027 年 4 月 11 日。

articles.title: British counterterrorism police arrest US soldier accused of spying on behalf of Russia

paras.en: A 41-year-old member of the US Army was arrested near Gloucester on Tuesday in England, the Metropolitan Police said in a statement.
paras.zh: 英国伦敦警察局在一份声明中称，周二，一名 41 岁的美国陆军成员在英格兰格洛斯特附近被捕。

paras.en: Authorities were searched two locations in the Gloucestershire region, police said, adding: "The country to which the allegations pertain is Russia."
paras.zh: 警方表示，当局搜查了格洛斯特郡地区的两个地点，并补充说：“指控所涉国家是俄罗斯。”

paras.en: US authorities, the US Military and the FBI were closely involved in the investigation, police said.
paras.zh: 警方表示，美国当局、美国军方和联邦调查局密切参与了调查。

paras.en: The man was in custody at a London police station, authorities said on Tuesday evening as the news emerged.
paras.zh: 周二晚间消息传出后，当局表示，该男子已被拘留在伦敦警察局。

paras.en: What did US and UK officials say about the arrest?
paras.zh: 美国和英国官员对此次逮捕有何评论？

paras.en: Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans, Senior National Coordinator for Counter Terrorism Policing called it a "significant arrest" as a result of "close collaboration between UK and US authorities."
paras.zh: 副助理专员、国家反恐警务高级协调员维姬·埃文斯 (Vicki Evans) 称这是“英国和美国当局密切合作”的“重大逮捕”。

paras.en: "The allegations are serious and our investigation is very much ongoing," Evans said.
paras.zh: 埃文斯说：“这些指控很严重，我们的调查正在进行中。”

paras.en: FBI Director Kash Patel said the case was of "utmost concern" to the US and its allies.
paras.zh: 联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔表示，美国及其盟国“最关注”此案。

paras.en: "While this investigation is continuing, I want to send a clear message — this FBI has no tolerance for anyone who breaks their oath to the United States and whose actions endanger our national security and that of our partners," Patel said. He also expressed thanks to UK investigators across various branches and the US Military Counterintelligence Command "for their outstanding work."
paras.zh: 帕特尔说：“在调查仍在继续的同时，我想发出一个明确的信息——联邦调查局不会容忍任何违背对美国誓言、危害我们和合作伙伴国家安全的人。”他还对英国各部门调查人员和美国军事反情报司令部“出色的工作”表示感谢。

paras.en: Brigadier General Sean Stinchon, the commanding general of US Army Counterintelligence Command also said the case demonstrated the "resolve of the counterintelligence community."
paras.zh: 美国陆军反情报司令部司令肖恩·斯廷琼准将也表示，此案展示了“反情报界的决心”。

paras.en: "The alleged conduct of a senior soldier, entrusted with sensitive information, is a sobering reminder that insider threats are real and persistent," Stinchon said.
paras.zh: 斯廷琼说：“一名被委托掌握敏感信息的高级士兵的行为令人警醒，提醒我们内部威胁是真实且持续的。”

paras.en: Busy area for US and UK military, intelligence communities
paras.zh: 美国和英国军事、情报部门的繁忙地区

paras.en: The area around Gloucestershire in the west of England, around two hours' drive from London, is home to several sensitive military and intelligence sites as well as outposts for various British and US companies with ties to the defense industry.
paras.zh: 英格兰西部格洛斯特郡周边地区距离伦敦约两小时车程，是多个敏感军事和情报站点的所在地，也是与国防工业有联系的多家英国和美国公司的前哨基地。

paras.en: RAF Fairford, which was in the news earlier this year amid a security scare at the vast airbase used by both UK and US planes, is not far southeast of Gloucester.
paras.zh: 英国皇家空军费尔福德机场位于格洛斯特东南部不远的地方，今年早些时候，由于英国和美国飞机使用的大型空军基地出现安全恐慌，该基地曾出现在新闻中。

paras.en: Gloucester's neighboring town, Cheltenham, is one the UK's intelligence hubs outside London. It is home to the headquarters of the country's signals intelligence agency GCHQ.
paras.zh: 格洛斯特的邻近城镇切尔滕纳姆是英国伦敦以外的情报中心之一。它是该国信号情报机构 GCHQ 的总部所在地。

articles.title: How AI worsens online violence against Middle East women

paras.en: It happens all the time, says Kholoud al-Ameri, an Iraqi journalist and the editor of a news website.
paras.zh: 伊拉克记者兼一家新闻网站的编辑霍卢德·阿梅里 (Kholoud al-Ameri) 表示，这种情况经常发生。

paras.en: "Female journalists here are often getting messages, and mostly from men," she explains. "They somehow find you online and then they say they just want to talk or they want to add you on Instagram or Facebook," says al-Ameri, who also heads a network of female journalists working on climate change stories. "Sometimes it's hard because the men say they're our readers and we don't want to discourage them. But I usually tell the women just to block these guys."
paras.zh: “这里的女记者经常收到信息，而且大部分来自男性，”她解释道。 “他们不知何故在网上找到了你，然后他们说他们只是想谈谈，或者他们想在 Instagram 或 Facebook 上添加你，”阿梅里说，她也是一个致力于气候变化报道的女记者网络的负责人。 “有时这很难，因为男人们说他们是我们的读者，我们不想阻止他们。但我通常告诉女人要阻止这些人。”

paras.en: Syrian activist Yaman Amer tells of similar experiences as a result of writing about women's rights online — she says she gets hundreds of critical comments. "When I talk about women's rights online in a patriarchal society, that's just how things are," Amer, who is studying to be a lawyer in Damascus, told DW. "Not that I accept it. Out of every thousand offensive comments, there's usually one or two that make me feel like I have to report them because they're particularly vile. As in, they're extremely vulgar or threatening. And then it's more than just harassment. It's on a whole other level, humiliating and degrading."
paras.zh: 叙利亚活动人士亚曼·阿米尔 (Yaman Amer) 讲述了在网上撰写有关妇女权利的文章后的类似经历，她说她收到了数百条批评评论。 “当我在网上谈论父权社会中的妇女权利时，事情就是这样，”正在大马士革学习成为一名律师的阿米尔告诉德国之声。 “并不是说我接受它。在每一千条攻击性评论中，通常有一两个让我觉得我必须举报它们，因为它们特别卑鄙。比如，它们非常粗俗或具有威胁性。而且这不仅仅是骚扰。这是在一个完全不同的层面上，羞辱和侮辱。”
