articles.title: South Carolina’s governor-elect holds first press conference at auto body shop
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Alan Wilson, South Carolina’s next governor, held his first press conference after the mid-term election at a West Columbia body shop where he worked his first job at 15, according to local media.
paras.zh: 据当地媒体报道，南卡罗来纳州下一任州长艾伦·威尔逊 (Alan Wilson) 在西哥伦比亚的一家车身修理厂举行了中期选举后的首次新闻发布会，他 15 岁时就在那里开始了第一份工作。

paras.en: The governor-elect said he worked at Reeley’s Auto Body shop as a car washer.
paras.zh: 这位当选州长说，他在里利汽车车身店担任洗车工。

paras.en: He told the media that the shop is symbolic.
paras.zh: 他告诉媒体，这家商店具有象征意义。

paras.en: “A shop like this is where you come to fix a car, repair a car, improve a car, and that’s really what this transition is about,” News19 reports Wilson as saying.
paras.zh: 据 News19 报道，威尔逊表示：“像这样的商店是你修理汽车、修理汽车、改进汽车的地方，这就是这次转变的真正目的。”

paras.en: He said his transition into the role is repairing and improving a governmental system that is “broken or damaged.”
paras.zh: 他表示，他的过渡是为了修复和改善“破碎或受损”的政府系统。

paras.en: Wilson, current Attorney General, said an audit of the state’s government will be his first course of action. This will include a public website that publishes government data for the general public.
paras.zh: 现任总检察长威尔逊表示，对州政府进行审计将是他的首要行动方针。这将包括一个向公众发布政府数据的公共网站。

paras.en: He also said he will ask lawmakers to give the governor the power to temporarily suspend the gas tax during price spikes. He added that the neighboring Georgia governor has this authority.
paras.zh: 他还表示，他将要求立法者赋予州长在价格上涨期间暂时停止征收汽油税的权力。他补充说，邻近的佐治亚州州长拥有这一权力。

paras.en: “I also understand that we rely on the gas tax to fund infrastructure projects and road construction,” News19 reports Wilson as saying. He adds that the power will need guardrails.
paras.zh: 据 News19 报道，威尔逊表示：“我还了解到，我们依靠燃油税来资助基础设施项目和道路建设。”他补充说，电力需要护栏。

paras.en: Improving roads and bridges has been a part of Wilson’s campaign platform.
paras.zh: 改善道路和桥梁一直是威尔逊竞选纲领的一部分。

paras.en: “As part of his Families First Audit Initiative, he will modernize the Department of Transportation, demand transparency, streamline project timelines, and make sure every region of the state benefits from long-overdue improvements,” Wilson’s campaign website says. “Wilson understands rural communities have different infrastructure needs than urban communities. But we can’t prioritize one over the other–they both need attention.”
paras.zh: 威尔逊的竞选网站称，“作为家庭优先审计计划的一部分，他将实现交通部的现代化，要求透明度，简化项目时间表，并确保该州的每个地区都从早该进行的改进中受益。” “威尔逊了解农村社区与城市社区的基础设施需求不同。但我们不能优先考虑其中一个——它们都需要关注。”

paras.en: Fox Carolina previously reported that lowering insurance premiums is a part of Wilson’s plan. This includes reforming the Department of Insurance to allow for public audits of rate increases. He’d also required the department to give quarterly updates to the governor’s office and yearly reports on major carriers to the public.
paras.zh: 福克斯卡罗莱纳州此前报道称，降低保险费是威尔逊计划的一部分。这包括改革保险部，以允许对费率上涨进行公开审计。他还要求该部门每季度向州长办公室提供最新情况，并向公众提供有关主要航空公司的年度报告。

paras.en: South Carolina’s insurance commissioner position is appointed by the governor.
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州的保险专员职位由州长任命。

articles.title: Hyundai recalls vehicles for software malfunction that disables airbag
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Hyundai has recalled 37,901 vehicles due to a software malfunction that disables the airbag, according to a National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) report.
paras.zh: 根据美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 的报告，现代汽车因软件故障导致安全气囊失效而召回了 37,901 辆汽车。

paras.en: The recall includes 2019-2022 Hyundai Veloster and 2019-2023 Hyundai Kona Electric models.
paras.zh: 此次召回包括 2019-2022 年款现代 Veloster 和 2019-2023 年款现代 Kona Electric 车型。

paras.en: “The subject vehicles are equipped with an Airbag Control Unit (ACU) that detects crash signals and commands deployment of the airbag(s) and seat belt pretensioner(s),” the recall states. ”Under certain driving conditions, data may become corrupted during routine writing to the ACU’s memory, causing the airbag malfunction indicator light (MIL) to illuminate and the airbag system to deactivate.”
paras.zh: 召回声明称：“受影响的车辆配备了安全气囊控制单元（ACU），可以检测碰撞信号并命令展开安全气囊和安全带预紧器。” “在某些驾驶条件下，数据在对 ACU 内存进行例行写入期间可能会损坏，导致安全气囊故障指示灯 (MIL) 亮起并且安全气囊系统停用。”

paras.en: A deactivated airbag system may not deploy the vehicle’s airbags during a crash, increasing the risk of injury to vehicle occupants.
paras.zh: 停用的安全气囊系统在发生碰撞时可能无法展开车辆的安全气囊，从而增加车辆乘员受伤的风险。

paras.en: “A system reboot or power interruption while the ACU is writing data to its internal memory may result in data corruption,” the report states.
paras.zh: 报告指出：“ACU 将数据写入内存时，系统重新启动或电源中断可能会导致数据损坏。”

paras.en: Hyundai started an investigation in August, 2024 after receiving an increase in airbag warning light warranty claims.
paras.zh: 现代汽车在收到安全气囊警告灯保修索赔增加后于 2024 年 8 月开始调查。

paras.en: The automaker worked with ACU supplier ZF Group to conduct a series of technical reviews of recovered parts. The reviews included focusing on fault-detection conditions and proposed replication methods.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商与 ACU 供应商采埃孚集团合作，对回收零件进行了一系列技术审查。审查的重点包括故障检测条件和提出的复制方法。

paras.en: The two companies also performed electrical stress testing and held multiple vehicle-level replication tests in 2025.
paras.zh: 两家公司还进行了电气压力测试，并在 2025 年进行了多次车辆级复制测试。

paras.en: By October 2026, Hyundai was updating its field data analysis and began finalizing its findings to date for review by its North America Safety Decision Authority (NASDA).
paras.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，现代汽车正在更新其现场数据分析，并开始最终确定迄今为止的调查结果，以供北美安全决策局 (NASDA) 审查。

paras.en: After reviewing the investigation findings, the company decided to conduct a safety recall, the report states.
paras.zh: 报告称，在审查调查结果后，该公司决定进行安全召回。

paras.en: As of November, Hyundai is aware of 331 unique incidents reported from October 2019 through September of this year.
paras.zh: 截至11月，现代汽车已知悉2019年10月至今年9月报告的331起独特事件。

paras.en: The report adds that no crashes, fires, or injuries have been related to this condition.
paras.zh: 报告补充说，目前还没有与这种情况相关的撞车、火灾或受伤事故。

paras.en: Owners are instructed to bring their vehicle to a Hyundai dealer for an ACU software update. The remedy will be offered at no cost to owners for all affected vehicles.
paras.zh: 车主应将车辆带到现代经销商处进行 ACU 软件更新。所有受影响车辆的车主将免费获得补救措施。

paras.en: NHTSA announced last week that it will invest $1.5 million to help states improve vehicle recall rates to keep roads safe.
paras.zh: NHTSA 上周宣布将投资 150 万美元帮助各州提高车辆召回率，以确保道路安全。

paras.en: “A vehicle with an open recall creates an avoidable hazard on our roads,” said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison in a news release. “By giving states the resources to flag open recalls when drivers register or renew their vehicles, we can keep dangerous cars off our roads and American families safe.”
paras.zh: NHTSA 局长乔纳森·莫里森 (Jonathan Morrison) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“公开召回的车辆对我们的道路造成了本可避免的危险。” “通过向各州提供资源，在司机注册或更新车辆时标记公开召回，我们可以让危险车辆远离我们的道路，并保证美国家庭的安全。”

paras.en: - “The development and execution of a reliable process to inform vehicle owners of any open safety recalls when registering their vehicles
paras.zh: - “制定并执行可靠的流程，在登记车辆时通知车主任何公开的安全召回

paras.en: - “Data-driven methods to measure recall completions
paras.zh: -“衡量召回完成情况的数据驱动方法

paras.en: - “Comprehensive reports outlining the methodologies and processes used so best practices can be shared.”
paras.zh: - “综合报告概述了所使用的方法和流程，以便共享最佳实践。”

paras.en: Morrison announced the funding during a “Recalls Next: Technological Innovation & Safety Recalls” event.
paras.zh: 莫里森在“下一步召回：技术创新与安全召回”活动中宣布了这笔资金。

paras.en: NHTSA learned during the Takata airbag recalls that convincing consumers to remedy a recall is complicated, he said. Researchers found some consumers were confused about what the recall meant or simply didn’t remember receiving the notices.
paras.zh: 他说，国家公路交通安全管理局在高田安全气囊召回事件中了解到，说服消费者对召回进行补救是很复杂的。研究人员发现，一些消费者对召回的含义感到困惑，或者根本不记得收到过通知。

paras.en: “That’s troubling, because it means they didn’t necessarily ignore a serious warning,” Morrison said. “Some didn’t internalize the danger at all. The notices didn’t convey to them that a defective inflator could rupture and send metal shrapnel toward their faces—even when the notices literally said as much. It didn’t resonate that they – or someone they loved – could die if they didn’t act—even when informed through multiple channels.”
paras.zh: 莫里森说：“这令人不安，因为这意味着他们不一定忽视严重警告。” “有些人根本没有意识到危险。通知并没有告诉他们，有缺陷的充气机可能会破裂，并将金属弹片射向他们的脸——即使通知上确实说了这么多。他们——或者他们所爱的人——如果不采取行动，可能会死亡——即使通过多种渠道告知，这并没有引起他们的共鸣。”

paras.en: NHTSA oversaw nearly 900 vehicle safety recalls affecting more than 29 million vehicles last year. The agency’s data shows 3-year-old vehicles have an average completion rate of 68%, while 15-year-old vehicles have an 18% completion rate.
paras.zh: 去年，NHTSA 监管了近 900 起车辆安全召回事件，影响了超过 2900 万辆汽车。该机构的数据显示，车龄3年的车辆平均完成率为68%，而车龄15年的车辆平均完成率为18%。

paras.en: “Surveys tell us that about four in 10 owners named inconvenience as a main reason for not completing a recall,” Morrison said. “That should be taken seriously.”
paras.zh: 莫里森说：“调查显示，大约十分之四的车主将不便视为未完成召回的主要原因。” “这应该被认真对待。”

paras.en: State motor vehicle agencies have been effective partners in amplifying research messaging, he said. He added that during the Takata recall, DMV letters sometimes produced repair rates two to three times higher than manufacturer notices alone.
paras.zh: 他说，国家机动车辆机构在扩大研究信息方面一直是有效的合作伙伴。他补充说，在高田召回期间，DMV 信件产生的维修率有时比制造商单独通知的维修率高出两到三倍。

paras.en: People recognize their DMV as an authoritative source of information that provides mail for critical transactional purposes linked to the ability to drive, Morrison said.
paras.zh: 莫里森说，人们将DMV视为权威信息来源，为与驾驶能力相关的关键交易目的提供邮件。

paras.en: “If somebody sees the DMV logo on an official piece of mail and doesn’t open it, their driver’s license or vehicle registration might expire, which is connected to their ability to work, run errands, take care of family, and generally participate in society,” he explained. “Registration renewal creates a natural opportunity to reach an owner with information that matters.”
paras.zh: “如果有人在官方邮件上看到 DMV 标志但没有打开它，他们的驾驶执照或车辆登记可能会过期，这与他们工作、办事、照顾家庭和普遍参与社会的能力有关，”他解释道。 “注册续订创造了一个自然的机会，可以向业主提供重要信息。”

paras.en: Morrison said NHTSA has also seen improvements in recall completions through other state avenues, such as Virginia’s EZPass toll collection system. The collaboration produced Takata recall completion rates eight to 10 times higher than comparable methods.
paras.zh: 莫里森表示，NHTSA 还发现其他州渠道（例如弗吉尼亚州的 EZPass 收费系统）的召回完成率有所提高。此次合作使高田召回完成率比同类方法高出 8 至 10 倍。

paras.en: A collaboration with a vehicle auction company also resulted in repairs on about 90% of vehicles traded in with open recalls, he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，与一家汽车拍卖公司的合作还导致约 90% 的公开召回车辆得到了维修。

paras.en: NHTSA also recently launched a bulk VIN lookup tool that allows users to check up to 100 VINs at once for open safety recalls, making searches easier for dealerships, fleet operators and others managing multiple vehicles, Morrison said.
paras.zh: 莫里森说，NHTSA 最近还推出了批量 VIN 查找工具，允许用户一次检查多达 100 个 VIN，以进行公开安全召回，从而使经销商、车队运营商和其他管理多辆车辆的其他人更容易进行搜索。

paras.en: The agency has opened a public docket for feedback on recalls. Comments will be accepted here through Dec. 5.
paras.zh: 该机构已公开征求有关召回的反馈意见。在此之前，我们将在 12 月 5 日之前接受评论。

articles.title: Schrader Adds Five OE Replacement TPMS Sensors
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.zh: 喜莱德 (Schrader) 宣布最新扩展其 OE 替代 TPMS 传感器产品组合，以涵盖较新的车辆应用。该公司宣布了五个新零件号：

paras.zh: - PN 29292：适用于 RAM 应用的 Schrader TPMS 传感器 Gen7 PAL Epsilon 夹钳。

articles.title: Free Webinar: Air Suspension Diagnostics in Action
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Knowing how air suspension systems work is one thing. Diagnosing electrical faults and making the right repairs is another. When fault codes, sensor readings, and system data point to different possibilities, how do you pinpoint the actual problem?
paras.zh: 了解空气悬架系统的工作原理是一回事。诊断电气故障并进行正确的维修是另一回事。当故障代码、传感器读数和系统数据指向不同的可能性时，您如何确定实际问题？

paras.en: • Topic: Real-World Air Suspension Diagnostics: From Fault to Repair
paras.zh: • 主题：现实世界的空气悬架诊断：从故障到维修

paras.en: • Time: 2:00 pm Eastern / 11:00 am Pacific
paras.zh: • 时间：东部时间下午 2:00 / 太平洋时间上午 11:00

paras.en: In this free technical training webinar sponsored by Arnott, you’ll see two real-world air suspension diagnostics performed step by step using a 2022 Ram 1500 and a 2017 Audi Q7. Building on foundational air suspension knowledge, we’ll demonstrate how to use fault codes, wiring diagrams, and live data to track down electrical issues, identify root causes, and determine the right repair.
paras.zh: 在这个由 Arnott 赞助的免费技术培训网络研讨会中，您将看到使用 2022 年 Ram 1500 和 2017 年奥迪 Q7 逐步执行的两次真实空气悬架诊断。基于基础空气悬架知识，我们将演示如何使用故障代码、接线图和实时数据来追踪电气问题、确定根本原因并确定正确的维修方案。

paras.en: Through both demonstrations, you’ll follow the diagnostic process from initial troubleshooting to repair verification, including analyzing sensor and valve data, tracing electrical faults, and performing post-repair leak tests. Walk away with a more structured approach to diagnosing air suspension problems and the confidence to verify your repairs.
paras.zh: 通过这两个演示，您将了解从初始故障排除到维修验证的诊断过程，包括分析传感器和阀门数据、跟踪电气故障以及执行维修后泄漏测试。使用更结构化的方法来诊断空气悬架问题，并有信心验证您的维修情况。

paras.en: • Step-by-step electrical troubleshooting and fault isolation
paras.zh: • 逐步电气故障排除和故障隔离

paras.en: • Identifying and interpreting air suspension fault codes
paras.zh: • 识别和解释空气悬架故障代码

paras.en: • Analyzing live sensor and valve data to pinpoint problems
paras.zh: • 分析实时传感器和阀门数据以查明问题

paras.en: • Verifying system operation and performing post-repair leak tests
paras.zh: • 验证系统运行并执行维修后泄漏测试

articles.title: How It’s Made – and Why I Can’t Stop Watching
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: I have a confession to make: I’m obsessed with How It’s Made.
paras.zh: 我要坦白：我对它的制作方式很着迷。

paras.en: If you’re unfamiliar with the TV series, it originally aired from 2001-2019, though it still lives on many different platforms. The show takes viewers inside factories and workshops to show how everyday products are manufactured. From tires and engine components to golf balls, pencils and potato chips, the show pulls back the curtain on the machines, materials and processes that make it all possible.
paras.zh: 如果您不熟悉这部电视剧，它最初于 2001 年至 2019 年播出，尽管它仍然存在于许多不同的平台上。该节目将观众带入工厂和车间，展示日常产品的制造过程。从轮胎和发动机部件到高尔夫球、铅笔和薯片，展览拉开了使这一切成为可能的机器、材料和工艺的帷幕。

paras.en: I’ve seen hundreds of episodes and I still can’t get enough of it. Like Zombieland, if How It’s Made is on TV, I’m stopping to watch.
paras.zh: 我已经看了几百集了，但仍然看不够。就像《僵尸乐园》一样，如果电视上播放《它是如何制作的》，我就会停下来观看。

paras.en: My wife, on the other hand, does not share my enthusiasm. While I’m glued to the television watching a machine turn a chunk of metal into a precision component, she’s wondering how anyone could find this entertaining. I’ve tried explaining the appeal, but apparently watching 20 minutes of automated manufacturing isn’t her idea of a great evening.
paras.zh: 另一方面，我的妻子并不认同我的热情。当我盯着电视看机器将一块金属变成精密部件时，她想知道怎么会有人觉得这很有趣。我试图解释这种吸引力，但显然观看 20 分钟的自动化制造并不是她心目中的美好夜晚。

paras.en: What fascinates me isn’t just how things are made. It’s the fact that someone had to figure out how to make them in the first place.
paras.zh: 让我着迷的不仅仅是事物的制作方式。事实上，首先必须有人弄清楚如何制作它们。

paras.en: Think about that for a moment. Somewhere along the line, someone looked at a problem, imagined a solution, designed a machine or process, tested it, made mistakes, adjusted the design and eventually figured out how to produce something consistently, efficiently and at scale.
paras.zh: 想一想。在这个过程中，有人审视了一个问题，设想了一个解决方案，设计了一台机器或流程，对其进行了测试，犯了错误，调整了设计，并最终弄清楚如何一致、高效和大规模地生产产品。

paras.en: Who thinks of this stuff? And how do they even begin?
paras.zh: 谁想到这个东西？他们是如何开始的呢？

paras.en: I find that kind of ingenuity incredible. Even something as ordinary as a tire represents years of engineering, experimentation and refinement. The materials, tread design, manufacturing equipment and quality-control processes all exist because somebody asked a question and set out to find the answer.
paras.zh: 我发现这种独创性令人难以置信。即使像轮胎这样普通的东西也代表着多年的工程、实验和改进。材料、胎面设计、制造设备和质量控制流程都是因为有人提出问题并开始寻找答案而存在的。

paras.en: That same curiosity belongs in the classroom and the service bay.
paras.zh: 同样的好奇心也存在于教室和服务区。

paras.en: The best automotive technicians don’t just know how to replace a failed component. They want to understand why it failed, how it works and what the engineers were trying to accomplish when they designed it.
paras.zh: 最好的汽车技术人员不仅仅知道如何更换故障部件。他们想了解它失败的原因、它是如何工作的以及工程师在设计它时想要实现的目标。

paras.en: And that’s where instructors play such an important role.
paras.zh: 这就是教练发挥如此重要作用的地方。

paras.en: Teaching a student how to perform a procedure is essential. But teaching that student to question, investigate and understand the reasoning behind the procedure is what builds a great technician.
paras.zh: 教学生如何执行程序至关重要。但教导学生质疑、调查和理解程序背后的推理才是培养优秀技术人员的关键。

paras.en: When an instructor explains why a particular sensor works the way it does, why a diagnostic test matters or how a system’s components interact, they’re doing more than preparing students to pass a certification exam. They’re helping develop the curiosity and problem-solving skills that will carry those students through their careers.
paras.zh: 当讲师解释为什么特定传感器会这样工作、为什么诊断测试很重要或者系统组件如何相互作用时，他们所做的不仅仅是为学生通过认证考试做准备。他们正在帮助培养学生的好奇心和解决问题的能力，从而帮助他们完成职业生涯。

paras.en: Today’s students will spend their working lives servicing vehicles filled with technology that continues to evolve. Some may eventually become the engineers, designers or innovators who develop the next generation of automotive systems. Others will be the technicians who figure out how to diagnose and repair those systems when something doesn’t work as intended.
paras.zh: 今天的学生将在他们的工作生涯中为充满不断发展技术的车辆提供服务。有些人最终可能成为开发下一代汽车系统的工程师、设计师或创新者。其他人将是技术人员，他们在系统出现问题时找出如何诊断和修复这些系统的方法。

paras.en: Either way, it starts with wanting to know how things work.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，首先要了解事物是如何运作的。

paras.en: Maybe that’s why I find How It’s Made so entertaining. Every episode reminds me that behind even the simplest product is a series of questions, challenges and solutions. And behind those solutions are people who refused to stop asking, “What if we tried this?”
paras.zh: 也许这就是为什么我觉得《它是如何制作的》如此有趣的原因。每一集都提醒我，即使是最简单的产品背后也存在一系列问题、挑战和解决方案。在这些解决方案背后，人们不断地问：“如果我们尝试一下会怎样？”

paras.en: That’s the kind of thinking we should encourage in every automotive classroom.
paras.zh: 这就是我们应该在每个汽车课堂中鼓励的思维方式。

paras.en: As for my wife, I don’t expect her to join me for a marathon of industrial manufacturing anytime soon. But the next time an episode shows how an automotive component is made, I’ll probably call her into the room anyway.
paras.zh: 至于我的妻子，我并不指望她很快就能和我一起参加工业制造的马拉松。但下次当一集展示汽车零部件是如何制造时，我可能会把她叫到房间里。

paras.en: Because seriously, how do people come up with this stuff?
paras.zh: 因为说真的，人们是怎么想出这个东西的？

articles.title: Autel Integrates Alldata Repair With MaxiSYS Tablets
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel U.S. and Alldata have partnered to connect Autel’s MaxiSYS diagnostic software with Alldata Repair on select MaxiSYS tablets. Alldata provides original equipment manufacturer (OEM) repair information. The integration connects vehicle fault codes with corresponding OEM diagnostic information, bringing scan results and repair procedures together on one screen, the companies said.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 和 Alldata 合作，将 Autel 的 MaxiSYS 诊断软件与指定 MaxiSYS 平板电脑上的 Alldata Repair 连接起来。 Alldata 提供原始设备制造商 (OEM) 维修信息。两家公司表示，该集成将车辆故障代码与相应的 OEM 诊断信息连接起来，将扫描结果和维修程序集中在一个屏幕上。

paras.en: Supported models include the MaxiSYS Ultra S2, MS919 S2 and MS909 S2. The integration also supports the MaxiSYS Ultra, MS919, MS909, Ultra ADAS and Ultra EV.
paras.zh: 支持的型号包括 MaxiSYS Ultra S2、MS919 S2 和 MS909 S2。该集成还支持 MaxiSYS Ultra、MS919、MS909、Ultra ADAS 和 Ultra EV。

paras.en: From a fault code in MaxiSYS, users can open the associated Alldata information for the selected vehicle. They can review OEM code descriptions, detection criteria, possible causes and diagnostic procedures.
paras.zh: 用户可以通过 MaxiSYS 中的故障代码打开所选车辆的关联 Alldata 信息。他们可以查看 OEM 代码描述、检测标准、可能的原因和诊断程序。

paras.en: A split-screen view displays MaxiSYS diagnostic results alongside Alldata. This allows technicians to consult factory instructions while viewing the fault they are investigating.
paras.zh: 分屏视图与 Alldata 一起显示 MaxiSYS 诊断结果。这使得技术人员可以在查看他们正在调查的故障时查阅工厂说明。

paras.en: Technicians can follow links within Alldata to related testing, removal and installation procedures, illustrations and service precautions.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以通过 Alldata 中的链接查看相关测试、拆卸和安装程序、插图和维修预防措施。

paras.en: The integration carries vehicle and fault-code information into the repair-information workflow, reducing the need for separate searches. It also helps technicians move from diagnosis to repair.
paras.zh: 该集成将车辆和故障代码信息纳入维修信息工作流程，从而减少单独搜索的需要。它还可以帮助技术人员从诊断转向修复。

paras.en: The integration also provides access to Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence, Alldata’s newest solution. It combines OEM repair information, real-world repair intelligence and AI-assisted insights in one diagnostic workflow, according to the company.
paras.zh: 该集成还提供对 Alldata 最新解决方案 Alldata Diagnostic Intelligence 的访问。据该公司称，它将 OEM 维修信息、现实世界的维修智能和人工智能辅助的见解结合在一个诊断工作流程中。

articles.title: Advics Offers More Aftermarket Brake Pads, Rotors
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Advics announced the availability of 56 new brake pad kit SKUs and three new disc brake rotor SKUs.
paras.zh: Advics 宣布推出 56 款新刹车片套件 SKU 和 3 款新盘式制动器转子 SKU。

paras.en: The 56 new ultra-premium brake pad kit SKUs provide approximately 62.8 million vehicles in operation (VIO) axle coverage in the U.S. and Canada. The expansion covers import models including Acura, Honda, Infiniti, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Hyundai and Kia applications.
paras.zh: 这 56 个全新超高级刹车片套件 SKU 为美国和加拿大约 6280 万辆运营车辆 (VIO) 提供车轴覆盖。此次扩展涵盖了讴歌、本田、英菲尼迪、马自达、三菱、日产、现代和起亚等进口车型。

paras.en: Advics is also expanding its ultra-premium disc brake rotor line with three new SKUs for Toyota and Lexus applications, providing approximately 858,000 VIO axle coverage in the U.S. and Canada.
paras.zh: Advics 还通过适用于丰田和雷克萨斯应用的三个新 SKU 扩展其超优质盘式制动器转子产品线，在美国和加拿大提供约 858,000 个 VIO 车轴覆盖范围。

paras.en: All three rotor SKUs are manufactured in the U.S.
paras.zh: 所有三个转子 SKU 均在美国制造。

articles.title: PennGrade Offers Gear Oil Fill Pouches
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn has introduced new 1-quart Precision Fill Pouches for its line of gear oils.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚一年级 | Brad Penn 为其齿轮油系列推出了新型 1 夸脱精密填充袋。

paras.en: According to the company, the pouch is designed to help reach tight and awkward fill locations where bottles can be difficult to maneuver. It features a precision-fill spout for greater control during gear oil changes and top-offs, the company added.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，该袋子的设计目的是帮助到达狭窄且尴尬的灌装位置，这些位置的瓶子很难操纵。该公司补充说，它具有精密加注嘴，可以在齿轮油更换和加注过程中实现更好的控制。

paras.en: The new pouch format is available for PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn Multi-Purpose “Classic” Gear Oil GL-4 SAE 80W-90, designed for many traditional manual transmissions and transaxles. The formulation is specifically suited for transmissions containing brass, bronze, copper and other soft-metal components, the company added.
paras.zh: 新的袋子格式可用于 PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn 多用途“经典”齿轮油 GL-4 SAE 80W-90，专为许多传统手动变速箱和变速驱动桥而设计。该公司补充说，该配方特别适用于含有黄铜、青铜、铜和其他软金属部件的变速箱。

paras.en: PennGrade 1 | Brad Penn Full Synthetic Limited Slip Gear Oils in SAE 75W-90 and SAE 75W-140 are also offered in the new pouches. These GL-5 formulations are designed for clutch-type limited slip differentials and demanding gear applications. The 75W-140 grade is specifically recommended for applications involving higher payloads and shock loading, the company notes.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚一年级 |新包装袋中还提供 SAE 75W-90 和 SAE 75W-140 的 Brad Penn 全合成限滑齿轮油。这些 GL-5 配方专为离合器式限滑差速器和要求苛刻的齿轮应用而设计。该公司指出，75W-140 等级特别推荐用于涉及更高有效载荷和冲击载荷的应用。

articles.title: Bosch Blue Disc Brake Rotors Line Announced
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Bosch Mobility Aftermarket announced the launch of its Bosch Blue disc brake rotors line.
paras.zh: 博世移动售后市场宣布推出博世蓝色盘式制动器转子系列。

paras.en: According to Bosch, the rotors feature the same composition, weight and vane design as OE parts. The company touts precise machining and high-quality casting to ensure reliable braking and a long lifespan, protective paint coatings on the hat and edge, and a non-directional finish for stopping performance.
paras.zh: 据博世称，转子的成分、重量和叶片设计与原厂部件相同。该公司吹捧精确的加工和高质量的铸造，以确保可靠的制动和较长的使用寿命，帽子和边缘上的保护性油漆涂层，以及用于停止性能的非定向表面处理。

paras.en: “Bosch Blue rotors were designed to give shop owners an everyday option that delivers quality, performance and value – helping end-customers get the most from their repair investment without sacrificing confident performance,” said Bobby Mathius, senior product marketing manager at Bosch Mobility Aftermarket. “With 830 total part numbers across the Bosch Blue disc brake rotors line, shop owners and technicians can confidently recommend and install Blue rotors for 95% of foreign and domestic vehicles currently on the road.”
paras.zh: 博世移动售后市场高级产品营销经理 Bobby Mathius 表示：“博世 Blue 转子旨在为店主提供质量、性能和价值的日常选择，帮助最终客户从维修投资中获得最大回报，同时又不牺牲自信的性能。” “博世 Blue 盘式制动器转子系列共有 830 个零件号，店主和技术人员可以自信地为目前在路上行驶的 95% 的外国和国内车辆推荐和安装 Blue 转子。”

articles.title: Diesel Prices Could Ease as Crude Oil Prices Drop
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: Wood Mackenzie estimated that roughly 20% of global refining capacity faces a growing risk of closure as demand for refined products approaches a peak. For fleets setting 2027 fuel budgets, the nearer-term U.S. diesel price outlook points to some relief. The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) projected that diesel prices would gradually ease as crude oil prices fall and fuel stocks begin to recover.
paras.zh: Wood Mackenzie 估计，随着成品油需求接近峰值，全球约 20% 的炼油产能面临着越来越大的关闭风险。对于制定 2027 年燃油预算的船队来说，美国近期柴油价格前景让人松了口气。美国能源信息署（EIA）预计，随着原油价格下跌和燃料库存开始恢复，柴油价格将逐渐回落。

paras.en: The national average for on-highway diesel was $6.29 per gallon on Nov. 2, down 6 cents from the previous week and up $2.54 from a year earlier, according to the EIA. The Gulf Coast averaged $5.91, while California averaged $8.08. That $2.17 spread shows how far a fleet’s fuel costs can diverge depending on where it fills up.
paras.zh: 根据 EIA 的数据，11 月 2 日全国公路柴油平均价格为每加仑 6.29 美元，比前一周下降 6 美分，比去年同期上涨 2.54 美元。墨西哥湾沿岸的平均价格为 5.91 美元，而加利福尼亚州的平均价格为 8.08 美元。 2.17 美元的价差表明，根据加油地点的不同，车队的燃油成本会有多大差异。

paras.en: In its Oct. 6 Short-Term Energy Outlook, the EIA projected national retail diesel would average $4.49 per gallon in 2027. That compares with a projected $5.19 for 2026. The 2027 estimate was 9 cents higher than the agency’s September forecast.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 6 日的短期能源展望中，EIA 预计 2027 年全国零售柴油平均价格为每加仑 4.49 美元。相比之下，2026 年的预测为每加仑 5.19 美元。2027 年的预测比该机构 9 月份的预测高出 9 美分。

paras.en: The forecast used data through Oct. 1 and assumed Middle East oil production and exports would recover over the forecast period. The EIA also warned that disruptions to crude oil flows could make near-term prices more volatile than its forecast suggests.
paras.zh: 该预测使用截至 10 月 1 日的数据，并假设中东石油生产和出口将在预测期内恢复。 EIA还警告称，原油流动中断可能导致近期价格波动超出其预测。

paras.en: Nationwide, the EIA expects stocks of distillate fuel, a category that includes diesel and heating oil, to stay below their 2021–2025 average through 2027. With less fuel in storage than usual, the agency expects wholesale diesel to command a larger-than-normal premium over crude oil. It projected that retail diesel would average above $4 per gallon in every quarter of 2027.
paras.zh: EIA 预计，在全国范围内，包括柴油和取暖油在内的馏分油库存到 2027 年将保持在 2021-2025 年平均水平以下。由于库存燃料比平常少，该机构预计批发柴油将比原油溢价高于正常水平。预计 2027 年每个季度零售柴油的平均价格将超过每加仑 4 美元。

paras.en: On the East Coast, distillate stocks were 32% below their five-year seasonal average in September 2026. The agency projected that regional stocks would remain 20% to 30% below average during the 2026–27 winter. The region relies on Gulf Coast shipments and imports to supplement local production. The agency expects tight global supplies to make it difficult for importers to rebuild regional stocks during heating season.
paras.zh: 在东海岸，2026 年 9 月的馏分油库存比五年季节性平均水平低 32%。该机构预计，2026-27 年冬季，地区库存仍将比平均水平低 20% 至 30%。该地区依靠墨西哥湾沿岸的运输和进口来补充当地生产。该机构预计，全球供应紧张将使进口商难以在取暖季节重建地区库存。

paras.en: What Refinery Closure Risk Means for Diesel
paras.zh: 炼油厂关闭风险对柴油意味着什么

paras.en: Wood Mackenzie also expects global refined product demand to rise from 105 million barrels per day in 2025 to 108 million in 2032 before declining. The firm expects gasoline demand to face sharper pressure from electric vehicle adoption, while diesel and jet fuel demand hold up better. The 2032 date marks the projected demand peak.
paras.zh: Wood Mackenzie 还预计，全球成品油需求将从 2025 年的 1.05 亿桶/日增至 2032 年的 1.08 亿桶/日，然后下降。该公司预计，由于电动汽车的采用，汽油需求将面临更大的压力，而柴油和航空燃油需求将保持更好的势头。 2032 年是预计的需求峰值。

paras.en: Exposure also varies by region and refinery. Wood Mackenzie identified large, complex U.S. Gulf Coast plants among the most competitive and flagged European assets as facing the greatest regional pressure. The outlook describes capacity at risk worldwide. The impact on U.S. diesel supply would depend on where capacity changes and which products those plants make.
paras.zh: 暴露程度也因地区和炼油厂而异。伍德麦肯兹将大型、复杂的美国墨西哥湾沿岸工厂列为最具竞争力的工厂，并将其标记为面临最大区域压力的欧洲资产。该展望描述了全球面临风险的产能。对美国柴油供应的影响将取决于产能变化的地点以及这些工厂生产的产品。

paras.en: Read the full article on fleetequipmentmag.com.
paras.zh: 请在 fancyequipmentmag.com 上阅读完整文章。

articles.title: Dorman Products Introduces Aluminum Oil Filter Housing
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Dorman Products Inc. continues expanding its aftermarket product offerings with repair solutions that address common failure points in original equipment parts. The company recently launched a new OE FIX engine oil filter housing (part number 926-611) for select Genesis, Hyundai and Kia vehicles.
paras.zh: Dorman Products Inc. 继续通过解决原始设备零件常见故障点的维修解决方案扩大其售后产品范围。该公司最近推出了一款新的 OE FIX 发动机机油滤清器外壳（零件号 926-611），适用于部分 Genesis、现代和起亚车辆。

paras.en: “Dorman continues to launch new innovations that expand the breadth of our product offerings and provide customers with improved solutions to common original equipment problems,” said Eric Luftig, Dorman’s President, Light Duty. “Our OE FIX products are designed to give technicians greater confidence that a repair will be completed right the first time, with a more durable solution that helps reduce the risk of repeat failures and costly comebacks. By continuing to identify common failure points and develop better repair solutions, we create new opportunities for our customers while helping them deliver greater value to the technicians and vehicle owners they serve.”
paras.zh: “多曼不断推出新的创新，扩大我们产品的广度，并为客户提供针对常见原始设备问题的改进解决方案，”多曼轻型业务总裁 Eric Luftig 表示。 “我们的 OE FIX 产品旨在让技术人员更有信心一次性完成维修，并提供更耐用的解决方案，有助于降低重复故障和成本高昂的修复风险。通过不断识别常见故障点并开发更好的维修解决方案，我们为客户创造了新的机会，同时帮助他们为所服务的技术人员和车主创造更大的价值。”

paras.en: Dorman Addresses Common Oil Filter Housing Failures
paras.zh: 多尔曼解决常见的机油滤清器外壳故障

paras.en: The original equipment oil filter housing on certain Genesis, Hyundai and Kia vehicles uses plastic that can warp. Prolonged exposure to heat and chemicals under the hood can cause the plastic to degrade. Over time, the housing can leak oil or crack.
paras.zh: 某些 Genesis、Hyundai 和 Kia 车辆上的原装机油滤清器外壳使用会变形的塑料。长时间暴露在引擎盖下的高温和化学物质中会导致塑料降解。随着时间的推移，外壳可能会漏油或破裂。

paras.en: Replacing the failed part with another original equipment housing can leave the vehicle vulnerable to the same failure.
paras.zh: 用另一个原始设备外壳更换故障部件可能会使车辆容易出现同样的故障。

paras.en: Dorman manufactures the 926-611 OE FIX replacement from high-pressure die-cast aluminum for a more durable repair. The housing includes the required mounting gaskets, premium seals, an oil filter element and an oil filter cap. These components provide technicians with everything needed for a complete installation.
paras.zh: Dorman 采用高压压铸铝制造 926-611 OE FIX 替换件，以实现更持久的维修。外壳包括所需的安装垫圈、优质密封件、机油滤清器滤芯和机油滤清器盖。这些组件为技术人员提供了完整安装所需的一切。

paras.en: Dorman engineered the product in the United States to precise specifications that help resist future leaks and provide reliable service.
paras.zh: 多尔曼在美国按照精确的规格设计了该产品，有助于防止未来的泄漏并提供可靠的服务。

paras.en: Company Expands Oil Filter Housing Portfolio
paras.zh: 公司扩大机油滤清器外壳产品组合

paras.en: The 926-611 builds on the performance of Dorman’s patented 926-959 aluminum oil filter housing. That product serves a wide range of Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Ram and Volkswagen vehicles.
paras.zh: 926-611 以 Dorman 获得专利的 926-959 铝制机油滤清器外壳的性能为基础。该产品广泛应用于克莱斯勒、道奇、吉普、公羊和大众汽车。

paras.en: Launched in 2023, the 926-959 has become one of the company’s most successful offerings.
paras.zh: 926-959 于 2023 年推出，已成为该公司最成功的产品之一。

paras.en: Dorman has expanded its portfolio of oil filter housings, adapters, coolers, assemblies and seals. The product line addresses common original equipment failure points and aims to help technicians avoid repeat repairs.
paras.zh: Dorman 扩大了其机油滤清器外壳、适配器、冷却器、组件和密封件的产品组合。该产品线解决了常见的原始设备故障点，旨在帮助技术人员避免重复维修。

paras.en: The new engine oil filter housing is among the Dorman OE FIX solutions featured in the company’s sixth OE FIX Guide. It joins the thousands of OE FIX solutions Dorman currently offers.
paras.zh: 新型发动机机油滤清器外壳是 Dorman OE FIX 解决方案之一，该解决方案是该公司第六份 OE FIX 指南中的特色内容。它加入了 Dorman 目前提供的数千种 OE FIX 解决方案。

paras.en: The guide highlights products with improved designs, time-saving features and cost-efficient repair options.
paras.zh: 该指南重点介绍了具有改进设计、节省时间的功能和具有成本效益的维修选项的产品。

articles.title: AI & the Aftermarket: AISIN’s Dwayne Bates
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the automotive aftermarket, creating new opportunities for manufacturers, distributors and other industry stakeholders. As adoption accelerates, industry leaders must evaluate the technology’s potential benefits, challenges and long-term implications.
paras.zh: 人工智能正在迅速改变汽车售后市场，为制造商、分销商和其他行业利益相关者创造新的机遇。随着采用的加速，行业领导者必须评估该技术的潜在优势、挑战和长期影响。

paras.en: AftermarketNews asked executives from leading manufacturers/suppliers about how their companies are using the technology, what problems they hope to solve and how they see AI impacting their business in the coming years. It is our pleasure to share their insights and, today, we hear from Dwayne Bates, president, AISIN Aftermarket & Service of America, Inc.
paras.zh: AftermarketNews 向领先制造商/供应商的高管询问了他们的公司如何使用该技术、他们希望解决哪些问题以及他们如何看待人工智能在未来几年对其业务的影响。我们很高兴分享他们的见解，今天，我们听到了爱信美国售后市场与服务公司总裁德韦恩·贝茨 (Dwayne Bates) 的发言。

paras.en: How is your company currently using artificial intelligence?
paras.zh: 贵公司目前使用人工智能的情况如何？

paras.en: Currently, we mainly use it to expedite and simplify research and data analysis and to create business presentations. It’s early—and we’re still learning—but we see AI being part of our future.
paras.zh: 目前，我们主要使用它来加快和简化研究和数据分析以及创建业务演示文稿。现在还为时尚早，我们仍在学习中，但我们认为人工智能是我们未来的一部分。

paras.en: What specific business challenges are you hoping to solve through AI?
paras.zh: 您希望通过人工智能解决哪些具体的业务挑战？

paras.en: If used correctly AI can be incorporated into the business flow and provide instant feedback on cost reduction options for multiple points in the order fulfillment process. It can be used to analyze every aspect of our daily operations and get data to a level never before possible so the speed of decisions will quicken bringing greater efficiency.
paras.zh: 如果使用得当，人工智能可以融入业务流程，并为订单履行流程中多个点的成本降低选项提供即时反馈。它可以用来分析我们日常运营的各个方面，并将数据提升到前所未有的水平，从而加快决策速度，从而提高效率。

paras.en: What are the biggest obstacles your company has encountered when implementing AI?
paras.zh: 贵公司在实施人工智能时遇到的最大障碍是什么？

paras.en: Security of data and intellectual property. It’s difficult to assure that our information is not being used in the cloud that assists other companies with competitive research about our company.
paras.zh: 数据和知识产权的安全。很难确保我们的信息不会在云中使用，以帮助其他公司对我们公司进行竞争性研究。

paras.en: Do you believe AI will change the competitive landscape of the aftermarket?
paras.zh: 您认为人工智能会改变售后市场的竞争格局吗？

paras.en: Yes, AI will allow for faster market analysis and, therefore, shorten the time to make decisions and launch new products. It will also be able to analyze consumer habits to a level never achieved before and allow us to fine-tune our offerings to fit more niche markets with less risk. Again, the decision horizon will shorten and those ready to move will profit.
paras.zh: 是的，人工智能将允许更快的市场分析，从而缩短决策和推出新产品的时间。它还将能够以前所未有的水平分析消费者习惯，并使我们能够微调我们的产品，以适应更多的利基市场，并降低风险。同样，决策期限将会缩短，那些准备采取行动的人将会受益。

paras.en: Looking ahead three to five years, where do you see AI having the greatest impact on the aftermarket?
paras.zh: 展望未来三到五年，您认为人工智能对售后市场影响最大的领域是什么？

paras.en: I see it helping with cataloging and identifying proper parts for vehicles. Also, search engines are using AI for everything now so the companies that get their products noticed through AI will be recommended more and be at the top of search results. AI will assist in streamlining processes and cutting costs. Companies that adopt it quickly and use it strategically will be able to control their pricing and attract more end user customers.
paras.zh: 我认为它有助于编目和识别适当的车辆零件。此外，搜索引擎现在正在将人工智能用于所有领域，因此通过人工智能使产品受到关注的公司将得到更多推荐，并位于搜索结果的顶部。人工智能将有助于简化流程和削减成本。快速采用并战略性使用它的公司将能够控制其定价并吸引更多的最终用户客户。

articles.title: Federated Auto Parts Launches Holiday Diecast Giveaway
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: To celebrate the holiday season, Federated Auto Parts is conducting its annual diecast giveaway. Five winners of a limited-edition Federated collectible will be announced each Friday on the Federated Facebook pages beginning Nov. 13, with the final winners announced on Dec. 11.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝节日，联邦汽车配件公司正在举办年度压铸赠品活动。从 11 月 13 日开始，Federated 限量版收藏品的五名获奖者将于每周五在 Federated Facebook 页面上公布，最终获奖者将于 12 月 11 日公布。

paras.en: “The holiday season is the perfect time to give back to our Facebook followers, and our annual diecast giveaway is one way we can show our appreciation,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “These limited-edition Federated collectibles are sure to be a hit with the winners, whether they add them to their collections, give them as stocking stuffers or keep them as a special holiday treat.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“节日季是回馈 Facebook 粉丝的最佳时机，每年的压铸赠品是我们表达谢意的一种方式。” “这些限量版联邦收藏品肯定会受到获奖者的欢迎，无论他们将它们添加到他们的收藏中，将它们作为圣诞礼物还是将它们作为特殊的节日礼物。”

paras.en: To enter for a chance to win, visit Federated Auto Parts and Federated Car Care on Facebook by Dec. 3 and click on the mobile link in the first post to complete the entry form. Participants can earn extra entries by sharing the contest with Facebook friends.
paras.zh: 要获得获奖机会，请于 12 月 3 日之前访问 Facebook 上的 Federated Auto Parts 和 Federated Car Care，然后单击第一篇文章中的移动链接来填写报名表。参与者可以通过与 Facebook 好友分享比赛来赚取额外的参赛资格。

articles.title: 'The first species we might be able to communicate with, interact with vocally, might be a bird': An animal researcher explains how she decoded birdsong
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Bird calls are far more than pleasant sounds in nature. They are complex forms of communication that can reveal how birds think, learn, cooperate and respond to their surroundings. From intricate songs used to attract mates to alarm calls that warn others of danger, vocalizations offer valuable clues about avian intelligence and social organization.
paras.zh: 鸟叫声不仅仅是自然界中悦耳的声音。它们是复杂的交流形式，可以揭示鸟类如何思考、学习、合作和对周围环境做出反应。从用于吸引配偶的复杂歌曲到警告其他人有危险的警报声，发声提供了有关鸟类智力和社会组织的宝贵线索。

paras.en: Julie Elie is an animal behavior researcher and associate project scientist at the University of California, Berkeley. She recently won the 2026 Coller Dolittle Challenge for Two-Way Interspecies Communication for her work in studying and deciphering zebra finch communication.
paras.zh: Julie Elie 是加州大学伯克利分校的动物行为研究员和副项目科学家。她最近因其在研究和破译斑胸草雀交流方面的工作而赢得了 2026 年科勒杜立特双向种间交流挑战赛。

paras.en: For more than a decade, Elie observed the social behavior of birds, recording thousands of sounds and using machine learning combined with behavioral experiments to decode specific calls.
paras.zh: 十多年来，埃利观察鸟类的社会行为，记录了数千种声音，并利用机器学习与行为实验相结合来解码特定的叫声。

paras.en: In this interview, Elie discusses how zebra finches learn and use vocalizations, what their calls reveal about intelligence and social relationships and how artificial intelligence (AI) contributed to decoding birdsong.
paras.zh: 在本次采访中，Elie 讨论了斑胸草雀如何学习和使用发声、它们的叫声揭示了智力和社会关系，以及人工智能 (AI) 如何有助于解码鸟鸣声。

paras.en: Dr Julie Elie is a computational neuroethologist who studies how social animals communicate. Her research combines behavioral experiments, neuroscience, and computational tools to reveal how animals produce communication sounds, what information they transmit in their vocalizations and how they perceive the meaning of vocalizations.
paras.zh: Julie Elie 博士是一位计算神经行为学家，研究社会性动物如何沟通。她的研究结合了行为实验、神经科学和计算工具，揭示动物如何产生交流声音、它们在发声中传递哪些信息以及它们如何感知发声的含义。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry: What made you study birds and birdsong?
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry：是什么让你研究鸟类和鸟鸣？

paras.en: Julie Elie: The beginning of my work with birds dates from my Ph.D. I've always been super interested in animal behavior in general. But I think as a young person, I was more attracted by animals that we relate more easily to, which are mammals, right? Dogs, cats, horses.
paras.zh: Julie Elie：我对鸟类的研究始于我的博士学位。我一直对动物的一般行为非常感兴趣。但我认为作为一个年轻人，我更容易被那些我们更容易产生共鸣的动物所吸引，这些动物是哺乳动物，对吗？狗、猫、马。

paras.en: I wanted to do a Ph.D. on animal behavior and, more specifically, on relationships between animals. I was interested in how animals interact with each other and what kind of social organization they establish.
paras.zh: 我想攻读博士学位。关于动物行为，更具体地说，关于动物之间的关系。我对动物如何相互作用以及它们建立什么样的社会组织感兴趣。

paras.en: [Someone suggested I] work on the zebra finch, and I said, "OK, I've never taken the time to really observe birds very well; might as well start now."
paras.zh: [有人建议我]研究斑胸草雀，我说，“好吧，我从来没有花时间真正很好地观察鸟类；不妨从现在开始。”

paras.en: I realized that it's difficult to observe birds because they're not close to you. They can fly wherever they want. When you are out and about in town, in the countryside, and you see birds, they're here, and then they're gone. You don't get to see a lot of their vocal interactions or a lot of their social interactions.
paras.zh: 我意识到观察鸟类很困难，因为它们离你不近。他们可以飞到任何他们想去的地方。当你在城镇、乡村外出时，你看到鸟儿，它们就在这里，然后就消失了。你看不到他们的很多声音互动或很多社交互动。

paras.en: So here I was, studying the zebra finch in cages where they were fully interacting with each other. And the question was, what kind of social organization do they have?
paras.zh: 所以我在这里研究笼子里的斑胸草雀，它们彼此充分互动。问题是，他们有什么样的社会组织？

paras.en: I realized quickly that they were not doing a dominance hierarchy [which was previously thought to be the case], but instead, the most important thing in their life was their partner. They were doing pair bonds, and that's the core of their social organization, [with] males and females pairing for life.
paras.zh: 我很快意识到，他们并没有实行统治等级制度（以前认为是这样），相反，他们生活中最重要的事情是他们的伴侣。他们正在建立配对关系，这是他们社会组织的核心，男性和女性终生配对。

paras.en: KHC: Why is it important to study birdsong, and what can it teach us about intelligence and behavior?
paras.zh: KHC：为什么研究鸟鸣很重要？它可以教会我们什么关于智力和行为的知识？

paras.en: JE: A level of complexity we were trying to understand was, what are the neural mechanisms that enable those birds to do this process of listening to something and copying it, and reproducing it, and doing a comparison between what they're producing and what they're hearing?
paras.zh: JE：我们试图理解的复杂程度是，使这些鸟类能够完成聆听、复制、复制以及比较它们所发出的声音和所听到的声音的过程的神经机制是什么？

paras.en: The zebra finch is a just-right middle ground level of cognitive ability that is interesting, where you see this pattern of copying vocalization and producing it. But you can look through the avian kingdom, and some species show more complex behaviors.
paras.zh: 斑胸草雀的认知能力恰到好处，很有趣，你可以看到这种复制发声并产生发声的模式。但你可以纵观鸟类王国，有些物种表现出更复杂的行为。

paras.en: We know that there are some species that are able to not only imitate their own vocalizations from their own species, their dad, but they're able to copy other species. So, here in California, for instance, a mockingbird is a bird that is really known to be able to reproduce a bunch of different sounds and is actually incorporating this in their vocalizations.
paras.zh: 我们知道，有些物种不仅能够模仿自己的物种（即它们的父亲）发出的声音，而且还能够复制其他物种的声音。例如，在加利福尼亚州，知更鸟是一种众所周知能够发出一系列不同声音的鸟，并且实际上将其融入到它们的发声中。

paras.en: Parrots are also well known for that because we have them as pets, and they're able to reproduce our own vocalizations as humans. This is kind of crazy, when you think about it, because they don't have the same vocal tract as we do. It's smaller, and they have a different system. I think a high cognitive level is when an animal is able to reproduce a sound that is not in their "native language," let's say, and use it for a goal. We do see this in parrots — they're able to ask you for something or even ask the dog to shut up sometimes, which is interesting. They're able to really use those vocalizations, such as "This is not mine, but I communicate with another species this way."
paras.zh: 鹦鹉也因此而闻名，因为我们把它们当作宠物，它们能够像人类一样复制我们自己的声音。仔细想想，这有点疯狂，因为他们的声道与我们不同。它更小，而且他们有不同的系统。我认为高认知水平是指动物能够再现非其“母语”的声音，并用它来实现目标。我们确实在鹦鹉身上看到了这一点——它们有时会向你要东西，甚至会要求狗闭嘴，这很有趣。他们能够真正使用这些发声，例如“这不是我的，但我用这种方式与另一个物种交流。”

paras.en: It shows you how smart they can be, and by studying vocal communication in animals, we are getting a window of what cognitive abilities they have and how the usage reveals their level of smartness.
paras.zh: 它向你展示了它们有多聪明，通过研究动物的声音交流，我们可以了解它们拥有哪些认知能力以及如何使用它们来揭示它们的聪明程度。

paras.en: KHC: Could you walk me through how you ended up decoding bird vocalizations?
paras.zh: KHC：您能向我介绍一下您最终是如何解码鸟类声音的吗？

paras.en: JE: I spent countless hours observing zebra finches, and I realized that I could progressively do a match between the social context and the acoustic characteristics of the sound produced. I could recognize these sounds and understand what they "mean."
paras.zh: JE：我花了无数时间观察斑胸草雀，我意识到我可以逐步将社会背景和所发出声音的声学特征进行匹配。我可以识别这些声音并理解它们的“含义”。

paras.en: It's like at home with your cat or dog: Within a couple of months, you figure out every time the cat is doing this kind of sound — "meow" — it means he wants to get out or he's hungry, or he wants to cuddle. Same thing with the dog. It's the same process, but instead of doing this with cats or dogs, I did this with birds and constituted the first acoustic dictionary of zebra finch calls.
paras.zh: 这就像在家里和你的猫或狗在一起一样：几个月之内，你就会发现每次猫发出这种声音——“喵”——这意味着他想出去，或者他饿了，或者他想拥抱。狗也一样。这是相同的过程，但我没有对猫或狗进行此操作，而是对鸟类进行了此操作，并构建了第一个斑胸草雀叫声声学词典。

paras.en: However, how do you know you are correct? That you correctly identified the sounds that correspond to the "words" in that species?
paras.zh: 然而，你怎么知道你是正确的呢？您正确识别了该物种中与“单词”相对应的声音？

paras.en: I thought that the best confirmation of whether I was right or not could only come from the zebra finches themselves. Up to now, nobody had found a way to systematically go through the vocal repertoire of an animal and confirm if each identified call type was indeed perceived as a word in that species' language.
paras.zh: 我认为，证明我的观点是否正确的最好证据只能来自斑胸草雀本身。到目前为止，还没有人找到一种方法来系统地检查动物的发声曲目，并确认每种识别出的叫声类型是否确实被视为该物种语言中的单词。

paras.en: To achieve this somewhat impossible discussion with a bird, we designed an operant conditioning experiment where the bird is asked to classify vocalizations that were previously recorded from other zebra finches. The game is simple and relies on two rules. The first one is that every day, only the recordings corresponding to one call type are rewarded by seeds, while the recordings from the other call types in the repertoire are not rewarded. The second rule is that the bird can interrupt recordings and skip to the next one whenever they want, like how you skip through songs on your favorite music app.
paras.zh: 为了实现与鸟类的这种有点不可能的讨论，我们设计了一个操作性条件反射实验，要求鸟类对之前从其他斑胸草雀录制的发声进行分类。游戏很简单，依赖两条规则。第一个是每天只有一种呼叫类型对应的录音会获得种子奖励，而曲目中其他呼叫类型的录音则不会获得奖励。第二条规则是，这只鸟可以随时中断录音并跳到下一个录音，就像您在最喜欢的音乐应用程序上跳过歌曲一样。

paras.en: The bird is placed in a cage that has a button or a little infrared sensor that it can activate with its beak. Each time it does so, the recording of a vocalization randomly drawn from the library of call types is played. Four out of five times, birds trigger the playback of a call type that will not give them access to seeds. Because they are slightly food deprived, they only really want to listen to the rewarded playback, so they interrupt the nonrewarded calls and only listen for the calls that are going to be rewarded.
paras.zh: 这只鸟被放在一个笼子里，笼子里有一个按钮或一个小红外传感器，它可以用喙激活。每次这样做时，都会播放从呼叫类型库中随机抽取的发声录音。五分之四，鸟类会触发播放某种叫声类型，而这种叫声类型不会让它们接触到种子。因为他们的食物稍微匮乏，所以他们只想听奖励的播放，所以他们会中断非奖励的呼叫，只听将要奖励的呼叫。

paras.en: Every day, the bird has to find out which call type or "word" is rewarded. They usually figure it out pretty rapidly and then start interrupting the playback of all the other call types. Using this task, we could test a different call type every dayIf they had not been able to do it, it would tell us that the call type we had identified was in fact not existing in their language. If they were able to do it — and spoiler alert, they were! — it meant that we had correctly identified that call type.
paras.zh: 每天，鸟儿都必须找出哪种叫声类型或“单词”会受到奖励。他们通常很快就能弄清楚，然后开始中断所有其他呼叫类型的播放。使用此任务，我们可以每天测试不同的调用类型。如果他们无法做到这一点，它会告诉我们，我们所识别的调用类型实际上在他们的语言中不存在。如果他们能够做到的话——剧透警告，他们做到了！ — 这意味着我们已经正确识别了该呼叫类型。

paras.en: The birds told us yes, basically — the organization that you're proposing is correct.
paras.zh: 鸟儿告诉我们是的，基本上——你提议的组织是正确的。

paras.en: But then we made a surprising discovery. We noticed that birds were making some rare and systematic mistakes. We wondered if these mistakes were coming from the acoustic similarity of the call types — how you might mistake, for instance, the word "glove" for "love" or "hurt" for "heart." Or if they were coming from the semantic similarity of the call types — you could maybe mistake "love" for "heart" if you are remembering about the general meaning of the rewarded word today, which is "love.".
paras.zh: 但后来我们有了一个惊人的发现。我们注意到鸟类犯了一些罕见的系统性错误。我们想知道这些错误是否源于呼叫类型的声音相似性——例如，您可能如何将“手套”一词误认为“爱”或将“伤害”误认为“心”。或者，如果它们来自呼叫类型的语义相似性，如果您还记得今天奖励词的一般含义，即“爱”，您可能会将“爱”误认为“心”。

paras.en: In that last case, it would mean that birds truly have an understanding of their call types' meaning. We found out that birds' errors could be better explained by the meaning [the semantic similarity] of the call types. That is a big discovery in the field of animal communication.
paras.zh: 在最后一种情况下，这意味着鸟类真正理解它们的叫声类型的含义。我们发现鸟类的错误可以通过叫声类型的含义[语义相似性]更好地解释。这是动物通讯领域的一个重大发现。

paras.en: KHC: Do you think we are headed toward actually being able to communicate with birds, or do you think it's more that we're still testing the waters and we still need to learn the rest of the language before we get there?
paras.zh: KHC：您认为我们是否正朝着真正能够与鸟类交流的方向发展，或者您是否认为我们仍在试水，并且在实现这一目标之前我们仍然需要学习其余的语言？

paras.en: JE: When we say "talking with birds," I think we need to understand that it's not going to be a language. Right now, I am studying the zebra finch; it doesn't mean that I would be able to communicate with a crow once I have a repertoire. So there's this component of when we talk about birds, there are many different species.
paras.zh: JE：当我们说“与鸟类交谈”时，我认为我们需要明白它不会是一种语言。现在，我正在研究斑胸草雀；这并不意味着一旦我掌握了全部技能就能够与乌鸦交流。所以当我们谈论鸟类时，有很多不同的物种。

paras.en: I think there's more traction in this particular part of the animal kingdom than in other parts, just because birds are really talkative. Birds use a lot of their vocalizations to communicate with each other. So because of that, I'm thinking that the first species we might be able to communicate with, interact with vocally, might be a bird, just because they are very talkative.
paras.zh: 我认为动物王国的这个特定部分比其他部分更有吸引力，只是因为鸟类真的很健谈。鸟类使用大量的发声来相互交流。因此，我认为我们能够与之交流、进行声音互动的第一个物种可能是鸟类，因为它们非常健谈。

paras.en: For now, I found all those words. But we need to understand how those words are [strung] together. So it's not necessarily the case that we need to understand the rules of the dynamic exchanges between individuals or how fast you're responding, but how you are responding and whether that makes sense or not.
paras.zh: 现在，我找到了所有这些词。但我们需要了解这些词是如何[串]在一起的。因此，我们不一定需要了解个体之间动态交流的规则或你的反应速度有多快，而是你如何反应以及这是否有意义。

paras.en: They [also] have [body] postures. They have specific displays at the same time they're producing the vocalizations. And if we really want to achieve full communication with another species, we need to get to that level.
paras.zh: 他们[也]有[身体]姿势。他们在发出声音的同时也会有特定的表现。如果我们真的想与另一个物种实现充分的交流，我们就需要达到那个水平。

paras.en: It's not tomorrow for sure, it's probably not next year, but I think in the range of 10 years we should get there. Especially with how fast the domains of AI and robotics are. I have some hope that we should be able to get to that point.
paras.zh: 确定不是明天，也可能不是明年，但我认为我们应该在 10 年内实现这一目标。尤其是人工智能和机器人领域的发展速度有多快。我希望我们能够达到这一目标。

paras.en: - 'They reliably chose the statistically more favorable option': A crow researcher explains how these winged geniuses process numbers, and what it could reveal about human math smarts
paras.zh: - “他们可靠地选择了统计上更有利的选项”：一位乌鸦研究人员解释了这些有翅膀的天才如何处理数字，以及它可以揭示人类数学智慧的什么

paras.en: - 'They would come in with a chord change': Composer Jim Nollman has collaborated with turkeys, kangaroo rats and whales. Now he's dropping 'Orcas' Greatest Hits.'
paras.zh: - “他们会改变和弦”：作曲家吉姆·诺尔曼与火鸡、袋鼠和鲸鱼合作。现在他正在放弃“Orcas”精选。

paras.en: - Photojournalist Steve Winter on his iconic Hollywood puma image, the illegal tiger trade and having a black panther knock on his door
paras.zh: - 摄影记者史蒂夫·温特谈他标志性的好莱坞美洲狮形象、非法老虎贸易以及黑豹来敲门

paras.en: KHC: Is there one takeaway you would want our readers to know about your work?
paras.zh: KHC：您希望我们的读者了解您的作品吗？

paras.en: JE: Just one. The most important thing for readers that are not specifically scientists is to realize that, by studying animal behavior more generally, researchers are discovering the intelligence of animals. This is opening our eyes to other species and realizing that we're not the only species that is intelligent on this planet.
paras.zh: 杰：只有一个。对于非科学家的读者来说，最重要的是要认识到，通过更广泛地研究动物行为，研究人员正在发现动物的智力。这让我们对其他物种大开眼界，并意识到我们并不是这个星球上唯一有智慧的物种。

paras.en: This is a lesson to us as another species on this planet, that we are not the only ones that are smart and we need to take this into account in how we are evolving.
paras.zh: 这对我们作为这个星球上的另一个物种来说是一个教训，我们并不是唯一聪明的人，我们需要在进化过程中考虑到这一点。

paras.en: We need to realize how we're affecting them and realize that they also have their own internal lives, and maybe we should start to respect them a little bit more.
paras.zh: 我们需要意识到我们如何影响他们，并意识到他们也有自己的内心生活，也许我们应该开始多尊重他们一点。

paras.en: Editor's note: Some of this interview was conducted via email as part of a follow-up conversation. The interview has been edited lightly for clarity and length.
paras.zh: 编者注：本次采访的部分内容是通过电子邮件进行的，作为后续对话的一部分。为了清晰和长度，采访经过了轻微编辑。

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: ZWO Seestar S30 Plus review
articles.author: Kimberley Lane

paras.en: There's much to enjoy about the Seestar S30 Plus. The image quality is great, it's easy to use, and it's compact and lightweight enough to take it anywhere. It's not quite as good as the more expensive S30 Pro, but it's a nice middle-ground option between the S30 and the S30 Pro that gives you a lot of features for the money.
paras.zh: Seestar S30 Plus 有很多值得欣赏的地方。图像质量极佳，易于使用，而且结构紧凑、重量轻，可以随身携带。它不如更昂贵的 S30 Pro 那么好，但它是 S30 和 S30 Pro 之间的一个不错的中间选择，为您提供了很多物有所值的功能。

paras.en: + Seestar app is reliable and easy to navigate
paras.zh: + Seestar 应用程序可靠且易于导航

paras.en: + All-in-one workflow from shooting to sharing
paras.zh: + 从拍摄到分享的一体化工作流程

paras.en: + 2K image quality is better than we expected
paras.zh: + 2K图像质量比我们预期的要好

paras.en: - Editing controls could be a little more responsive
paras.zh: - 编辑控件的响应速度可能会更快一些

paras.en: - Not suitable for smaller planetary nebulas
paras.zh: - 不适合较小的行星状星云

paras.en: Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best ones for you. Find out more about how we test.
paras.zh: 我们的专家评审员花费数小时测试和比较产品和服务，以便您可以选择最适合您的产品和服务。详细了解我们如何测试。

paras.en: ZWO has just released the newest member of its smart telescope range: the Seestar S30 Plus. This all-in-one smart telescope is designed for beginners and hobbyists who want an affordable way into astrophotography that won't leave you scratching your head, and lets you capture, process and share your images in one simple workflow. It sits between the Seestar S30 and S30 Pro, and is priced at $499 for its release.
paras.zh: ZWO 刚刚发布了其智能望远镜系列的最新成员：Seestar S30 Plus。这款一体化智能望远镜专为初学者和爱好者而设计，他们希望以一种经济实惠的方式进入天文摄影，不会让您摸不着头脑，并让您通过一个简单的工作流程捕获、处理和共享图像。它介于 Seestar S30 和 S30 Pro 之间，发布价格为 499 美元。

paras.en: With 2K image quality, a light pollution filter and a user-friendly interface, it's a smart telescope that anyone can enjoy, regardless of your experience level, and regardless of whether you're shooting from your city balcony or a dark sky site. Like the other models, it uses dual cameras to capture a wide range of subjects, including deep-sky objects with the telephoto camera, and constellations, star trails and the Milky Way with the wide-angle camera. It's lightweight and easy to travel with, and it even comes with a separate solar filter for solar imaging and eclipse time-lapses.
paras.zh: 它具有 2K 图像质量、光污染滤镜和用户友好的界面，是一款任何人都可以使用的智能望远镜，无论您的经验水平如何，也无论您是在城市阳台还是黑暗的天空现场拍摄。与其他型号一样，它使用双摄像头来捕捉广泛的拍摄对象，包括使用长焦相机拍摄深空物体，使用广角相机拍摄星座、星轨和银河系。它重量轻，易于携带，甚至还配备了单独的太阳滤镜，用于太阳成像和日食延时拍摄。

paras.en: We got our hands on an advance copy to test ahead of its release, so we put it through its paces on several different celestial subjects.
paras.zh: 我们拿到了一份预发版本，在发布前对其进行测试，因此我们在几个不同的天体主题上对其进行了测试。

paras.en: - Comes with carry case, tripod and solar filter
paras.zh: - 配有手提箱、三脚架和太阳能滤光片

paras.en: The Seestar S30 Plus is one of the smallest, most compact smart telescopes on the market, weighing just 3.63 pounds (1.65 kg) and measuring 8.3 x 5.5 x 3.2 inches (210 x 140 x 80 mm). Its sleek, matte white design looks identical to the other Seestar models (we compared it to our S30 Pro), except for the branding on the unit itself.
paras.zh: Seestar S30 Plus 是市场上最小、最紧凑的智能望远镜之一，重量仅为 3.63 磅（1.65 千克），尺寸为 8.3 x 5.5 x 3.2 英寸（210 x 140 x 80 毫米）。其时尚的哑光白色设计看起来与其他 Seestar 型号相同（我们将其与 S30 Pro 进行比较），除了设备本身的品牌之外。

paras.en: It comes in a padded soft carry case and includes a small tripod (although we always prefer to use our own), a solar filter, a 40-inch (1 meter) USB-A to USB-C charging cable, a removable shoulder strap for the carry case, and a quick-start guide. With its accessories and case, the whole setup weighs 4.89 pounds (2.22 kg).
paras.zh: 它配有一个带衬垫的软手提箱，包括一个小三脚架（尽管我们总是更喜欢使用自己的）、一个太阳能过滤器、一条 40 英寸（1 米）USB-A 至 USB-C 充电线、手提箱的可拆卸肩带和快速入门指南。连同配件和外壳，整个装置重 4.89 磅（2.22 千克）。

paras.en: On the unit itself, you'll find just one button, which powers it on, plus the USB-C port on the side. Super simple, although we'd have liked the USB-C port to be covered to prevent moisture or dust from getting in.
paras.zh: 在设备本身上，您只会发现一个用于启动设备的按钮，以及侧面的 USB-C 端口。超级简单，尽管我们希望遮盖 USB-C 端口以防止湿气或灰尘进入。

paras.en: The set-up process couldn't be easier. When you turn the telescope on, you'll hear a double beep and see the power button light up alongside the red dots on the black screen to indicate the battery level. Four dots mean the battery is full. The telescope will tell you when it's ready to connect, at which point you can sync it up to the app on your smartphone or tablet. To turn it off, you just select "Shutdown" in the app, which closes the arm and turns the unit off.
paras.zh: 设置过程再简单不过了。当您打开望远镜时，您会听到两声蜂鸣声，并看到电源按钮与黑色屏幕上的红点一起亮起，以指示电池电量。四个点表示电池已充满。望远镜会告诉您何时准备好连接，此时您可以将其同步到智能手机或平板电脑上的应用程序。要关闭它，您只需在应用程序中选择“关闭”，即可关闭手臂并关闭设备。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: It also features an anti-dew heater, which we've found works quite well in mild to moderate humidity. On a couple of our shoots, we noticed a tiny bit of condensation forming on the unit when the humidity was higher, so we wouldn't feel confident leaving it unsupervised for long periods on a particularly dewy evening. (We used the Clear Outside app to monitor the humidity levels.)
paras.zh: 它还具有防露加热器，我们发现它在轻度至中等湿度下工作得很好。在我们的几次拍摄中，我们注意到当湿度较高时，设备上会形成一点点凝结物，因此我们没有信心在一个特别露水的夜晚将其长时间无人监管。 （我们使用 Clear Outside 应用程序来监测湿度水平。）

paras.en: - A good amount of image editing controls, but we'd like a few more
paras.zh: - 大量的图像编辑控件，但我们想要更多

paras.en: - Educational and shows what's in the sky for your time and location
paras.zh: - 具有教育意义并显示您所在时间和地点的天空情况

paras.en: The Seestar App is user-friendly and easy to navigate, with just the right amount of controls: you have plenty of options to choose from but it doesn’t become overwhelming. The main Seestar page is where you'll likely spend most of your time, as this is where you can search for celestial objects to shoot, access your album, plan a shoot and read up on what objects Seestar recommends based on your time and location.
paras.zh: Seestar 应用程序用户友好且易于导航，控件数量恰到好处：您有大量选项可供选择，但不会变得令人不知所措。您可能会在 Seestar 主页面上花费大部分时间，因为在这里您可以搜索要拍摄的天体、访问相册、计划拍摄以及了解 Seestar 根据您的时间和位置推荐的天体。

paras.en: The Stargazing section is where you can select or search for the subject you want to shoot. You can use the search function to find a specific target or browse Tonight's Best, and you can also search through different types of subjects like galaxies, nebulas, clusters and more. From here, you can also select planets, track comets and photograph constellations using the wide camera.
paras.zh: 在观星部分，您可以选择或搜索要拍摄的主题。您可以使用搜索功能查找特定目标或浏览今晚最佳，还可以搜索不同类型的主题，例如星系、星云、星团等。从这里，您还可以使用广角相机选择行星、跟踪彗星和拍摄星座。

paras.en: Click on a subject and the app will display information about it, including its current altitude and coordinates, which help determine what time is best to shoot that particular object. It automatically applies the appropriate filters and settings, but you can override these if you want to.
paras.zh: 单击一个主题，应用程序将显示有关它的信息，包括其当前的高度和坐标，这有助于确定拍摄该特定物体的最佳时间。它会自动应用适当的过滤器和设置，但您可以根据需要覆盖这些过滤器和设置。

paras.en: There's very little to complain about when it comes to using the app. It has lots of information for beginners, so you don't need a ton of knowledge about the night sky, and everything is fairly self-explanatory. There were a couple of occasions when it failed to calibrate itself (for example, when we tried to locate the Pleiades, which had just risen above a tree), and other times when we chose a new target and it slewed the long way round instead of only having to move slightly. But otherwise, the app worked well.
paras.zh: 在使用该应用程序时几乎没有什么可抱怨的。它为初学者提供了大量信息，因此您不需要大量有关夜空的知识，而且一切都相当不言自明。有几次它无法自我校准（例如，当我们试图定位刚刚升到树上的昴宿星团时），还有一些时候，当我们选择一个新目标时，它会绕很远的距离而不是只需要轻微移动。但除此之外，该应用程序运行良好。

paras.en: The AI Enhance section has some good editing tools to bring out the best from your photos. You can reduce the stars, adjust the brightness, contrast, saturation and RGB curves, apply denoise and eliminate any satellite trails — although we'd love a dehaze slider to bring out some of the fainter nebulosity of certain objects. The sliders could do with being a little more responsive, especially the RGB curves, but overall, it does a pretty good job of editing your pictures to get a pleasing result.
paras.zh: AI 增强部分有一些很好的编辑工具，可以让您的照片发挥出最佳效果。您可以减少星星，调整亮度、对比度、饱和度和 RGB 曲线，应用降噪并消除任何卫星轨迹 - 尽管我们希望使用去雾滑块来显示某些物体的一些较微弱的星云。滑块的响应能力还可以提高一点，尤其是 RGB 曲线，但总的来说，它在编辑图片以获得令人满意的结果方面做得相当不错。

paras.en: - 160mm focal length perfectly suits larger apparent subjects
paras.zh: - 160mm 焦距完美适合较大的明显拍摄对象

paras.en: - Modest image resolution, but still pretty good
paras.zh: - 图像分辨率适中，但仍然相当不错

paras.en: We had about 10 days to test our review unit before its release, so we could only capture as much as the weather permitted in that time. We'll add more images to this review over the coming weeks. All our tests were conducted from our backyard in a Bortle 4 region, and captured before moonrise to eliminate as much light pollution as possible. Due to these time constraints, we aimed to capture our images for a total of 60 minutes each, although we'd have ideally aimed for longer in some cases.
paras.zh: 在发布之前，我们有大约 10 天的时间来测试我们的评测设备，因此我们只能在天气允许的情况下拍摄尽可能多的照片。我们将在未来几周内在此评论中添加更多图像。我们所有的测试都是在 Bortle 4 地区的后院进行的，并在月出之前拍摄，以尽可能消除光污染。由于时间限制，我们的目标是每张图像拍摄总共 60 分钟，尽管在某些情况下我们的理想目标是更长的时间。

paras.en: Now for the fun part — the images. The Seestar S30 Plus has a focal length of 160mm, which is advantageous for capturing large subjects like the Andromeda Galaxy, the North America Nebula and the Pleiades. Large emission nebulas are where it really shines; however, the focal length is too short to capture smaller apparent objects.
paras.zh: 现在是有趣的部分——图像。 Seestar S30 Plus的焦距为160mm，有利于拍摄仙女座星系、北美星云和昴宿星团等大型物体。大型发射星云才是它真正闪耀的地方；然而，焦距太短，无法捕捉较小的明显物体。

paras.en: For this review, we aimed to capture as many different types of objects as possible. All our images were edited in the Seestar app with, in some cases, a few minor tweaks in Lightroom. You also have the option to download the individual files to your computer to process them yourself in dedicated astrophotography software, which is advantageous if you're a more experienced user.
paras.zh: 在本次评测中，我们的目标是捕捉尽可能多的不同类型的物体。我们所有的图像都是在 Seestar 应用程序中编辑的，在某些情况下，在 Lightroom 中进行了一些细微的调整。您还可以选择将各个文件下载到计算机上，以便在专用的天文摄影软件中自行处理它们，如果您是经验丰富的用户，这将非常有利。

paras.en: Everyone's favorite star cluster, the Pleiades, was one of the first targets we wanted to capture. We could see the faint blue nebulosity after as little as 15 minutes of integration time, and it only improved over time. After 60 minutes, we had a really nice image and could easily bring out the blue haze via the editing tools in the app. However, we got a much more impressive result after tweaking our image a little further in Lightroom, bringing out even more haze and reflective dust.
paras.zh: 每个人最喜欢的星团，昴宿星团，是我们想要捕捉的第一个目标。经过短短 15 分钟的积分时间后，我们就可以看到微弱的蓝色星云，而且随着时间的推移，情况只会有所改善。 60 分钟后，我们得到了一张非常漂亮的图像，并且可以通过应用程序中的编辑工具轻松地呈现蓝色薄雾。然而，在 Lightroom 中进一步调整图像后，我们得到了更令人印象深刻的结果，带来了更多的雾霾和反射灰尘。

paras.en: The Andromeda Galaxy is a perfect target for the Seestar S30 Plus. It takes up a large portion of the frame, and with long integration times, it can reveal beautiful details in the faint outer arms. We shot for around an hour in our tests due to weather and time constraints, but we still got an impressive image. As we approached 60 minutes, there was a lot of cloud cover, and we noticed it struggling to stack images toward the end of the session, so we stopped the integration at 57 minutes.
paras.zh: 仙女座星系是 Seestar S30 Plus 的完美目标。它占据了框架的很大一部分，并且积分时间长，可以在微弱的外臂中展现出美丽的细节。由于天气和时间限制，我们在测试中拍摄了大约一个小时，但我们仍然得到了令人印象深刻的图像。当我们接近 60 分钟时，有很多云层，我们注意到在会话结束时很难堆叠图像，因此我们在 57 分钟时停止了集成。

paras.en: Andromeda is certainly going to be the most impressive galaxy for the Seestar visually, as most others will appear smaller in the frame and will need longer integration, so make sure you have a clear, dark night for it.
paras.zh: 仙女座星系无疑将成为 Seestar 视觉上最令人印象深刻的星系，因为大多数其他星系在画面中会显得更小，并且需要更长的整合时间，因此请确保您有一个晴朗、漆黑的夜晚。

paras.en: Large emission nebulas are where the Seestar S30 Plus thrives, and the North America Nebula is a great target. It covers the whole field of view, and the red hydrogen gas easily comes to the forefront of the image.
paras.zh: 大型发射星云是 Seestar S30 Plus 的优势所在，而北美星云是一个很好的目标。它覆盖了整个视野，红色氢气很容易就出现在图像的最前面。

paras.en: The Eastern Veil Nebula is another lovely target where you can bring out the beautiful red and turquoise hues in as little as 15 minutes, but longer integration times will yield brighter, more colorful results.
paras.zh: 东部面纱星云是另一个可爱的目标，您可以在短短 15 分钟内呈现出美丽的红色和绿松石色调，但更长的积分时间将产生更明亮、更丰富多彩的结果。

paras.en: Planetary nebulas are where you will see the limitations of the Seestar's 160mm focal length. Most planetary nebulas have a very small apparent size — we've previously captured the Dumbbell Nebula and Cocoon Nebula with our S30 Pro, and they were a tiny dot in the middle of the screen. We tried the Helix Nebula, and even though it's one of the largest apparent planetary nebulas, it's still fairly small on the Seestar S30 Plus. You can still get a decent image of it, but if you want to focus on imaging planetary nebulas, you'll need a bigger scope. Because it was very low in the sky and there was some interfering cloud, we stopped integration at 27 minutes.
paras.zh: 在行星状星云中，您将看到 Seestar 160 毫米焦距的局限性。大多数行星状星云的表观尺寸非常小——我们之前用 S30 Pro 捕捉到了哑铃星云和茧星云，它们是屏幕中间的一个小点。我们尝试了螺旋星云，尽管它是最大的明显行星状星云之一，但在 Seestar S30 Plus 上它仍然相当小。您仍然可以获得它的像样图像，但如果您想专注于行星状星云的成像，则需要更大的望远镜。由于天空很低，并且有一些干扰云，我们在 27 分钟时停止了积分。

paras.en: The Seestar S30 Plus is an affordable entry point into deep-sky astrophotography without the confusing settings and expensive setup. It's ideal for beginners, although more experienced users will likely want to upgrade to the superior image quality and extra features of the S30 Pro.
paras.zh: Seestar S30 Plus 是深空天文摄影的经济入门级产品，无需混乱的设置和昂贵的设置。它非常适合初学者，但更有经验的用户可能希望升级到 S30 Pro 的卓越图像质量和额外功能。

paras.en: Still, for under $500, we can't complain. Not only is the Seestar S30 Plus easy to navigate and use, but it teaches you about space in a fun and interactive way, and you don't need to spend hours stacking individual frames on your computer to process — although you still can do that if you want more control over your editing.
paras.zh: 不过，对于不到 500 美元的价格，我们没有什么可抱怨的。 Seestar S30 Plus 不仅易于导航和使用，而且还能以有趣的互动方式教您有关空间的知识，而且您无需花费数小时在计算机上堆叠单个帧进行处理 - 尽管如果您想更好地控制编辑，您仍然可以这样做。

paras.en: If you want a more traditional telescope
paras.zh: 如果您想要更传统的望远镜

paras.en: If the imaging aspect doesn't interest you, the Celestron StarSense Explorer range of telescopes connects to your phone to guide you around the sky, but you observe the cosmos through an eyepiece instead of capturing it on your phone.
paras.zh: 如果您对成像方面不感兴趣，星特朗 StarSense Explorer 系列望远镜可连接到您的手机，引导您在天空中游览，但您通过目镜观察宇宙，而不是在手机上捕捉宇宙。

paras.en: Read our full Celestron StarSense Explorer LT 70AZ review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的星特朗 StarSense Explorer LT 70AZ 评论

paras.en: Kimberley Lane, E-commerce writer for Live Science, has tested a wide range of optical equipment, reviewing camera gear from Sony, Canon, OM System and more. With over 6 years of photography experience, her skills span across landscape and seascape photography, wildlife, astrophotography and portrait work. Her photos have been featured in a number of national magazines, including Digital Camera World and Cosmopolitan. She has also contributed to our sister site Space.com and Tech Radar, and she regularly uses binoculars and telescopes to stargaze in the dark skies of South Wales.
paras.zh: Live Science 的电子商务撰稿人 Kimberley Lane 测试了多种光学设备，评测了索尼、佳能、OM System 等公司的相机设备。她拥有超过 6 年的摄影经验，技能涵盖风景和海景摄影、野生动物、天文摄影和肖像作品。她的照片曾出现在许多国家杂志上，包括《数码相机世界》和《Cosmopolitan》。她还为我们的姊妹网站 Space.com 和 Tech Radar 做出了贡献，她经常使用双筒望远镜和天文望远镜在南威尔士的黑暗天空中观察星空。

articles.title: Gravity can reconnect like the sun's magnetic field, a fresh look at Einstein's equations reveals
articles.author: Andrey Feldman

paras.en: Magnetic reconnection — the process behind the sun's most violent outbursts — may have a counterpart in gravity.
paras.zh: 磁重联——太阳最猛烈爆发背后的过程——可能与引力相对应。

paras.en: According to a new theoretical study, sheet-like structures in the gravitational field can break apart and reconnect in new arrangements, much like the magnetic field lines that unleash solar flares.
paras.zh: 根据一项新的理论研究，引力场中的片状结构可以分裂并以新的排列重新连接，就像释放太阳耀斑的磁场线一样。

paras.en: Built entirely on Albert Einstein's theory of general relativity, the study spells out when this "gravitational reconnection" can happen. It also offers a way to measure how fast the theoretical reconnection proceeds, and suggests a change to how gravity and matter trade energy. The process could even play a role in black hole collisions, the researchers suggest.
paras.zh: 这项研究完全建立在阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦的广义相对论的基础上，阐明了这种“引力重新连接”何时会发生。它还提供了一种测量理论上重新连接进行的速度的方法，并建议改变重力和物质交换能量的方式。研究人员表示，这一过程甚至可能在黑洞碰撞中发挥作用。

paras.en: Magnetic field lines are normally "frozen" into plasma — the hot, electrically charged gas that makes up stars — and carried along wherever it flows. The lines can be stretched and twisted, but not cut. Where this rule breaks down, they can snap and rejoin in a process called magnetic reconnection, releasing pent-up energy in explosive bursts such as solar flares.
paras.zh: 磁场线通常被“冻结”成等离子体——构成恒星的热带电气体——并被带到任何它流动的地方。线条可以拉伸和扭曲，但不能剪切。当这条规则被打破时，它们可以在称为磁重联的过程中断裂并重新结合，在太阳耀斑等爆炸性爆发中释放出被压抑的能量。

paras.en: "In plasma physics, reconnection has become an essential part of our understanding of how magnetic fields reorganize and exchange energy with matter," Luca Comisso, an astrophysicist at Columbia University and first author of the study, told Live Science via email. "Could something similar be true for gravity?"
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚大学天体物理学家、该研究的第一作者卢卡·科米索通过电子邮件告诉《生活科学》杂志：“在等离子体物理学中，重新连接已成为我们理解磁场如何重组以及与物质交换能量的重要组成部分。” “重力也有类似的情况吗？”

paras.en: "Gravity and magnetism describe very different aspects of nature, so there's no obvious reason to expect them to behave alike," Comisso said. "But when we express Einstein's equations in a particular mathematical form, some of the same principles that govern magnetic fields also emerge in gravity. We wanted to understand whether those similarities extended to reconnection itself."
paras.zh: 科米索说：“重力和磁力描述了自然的非常不同的方面，因此没有明显的理由期望它们表现相似。” “但是当我们以特定的数学形式表达爱因斯坦方程时，控制磁场的一些相同原理也出现在引力中。我们想了解这些相似性是否延伸到重新连接本身。”

paras.en: Comisso and study co-author Felipe Asenjo, a physicist at Adolfo Ibáñez University in Chile, used a mathematical framework known as the tetrad formulation. "Einstein's theory describes gravity through the geometry of space-time," Comisso explained. But in the tetrad formulation, "certain aspects of gravity can be expressed through quantities resembling electric and magnetic fields."
paras.zh: 科米索和研究合著者费利佩·阿森霍（智利阿道夫·伊巴涅斯大学的物理学家）使用了一种称为四分体公式的数学框架。 “爱因斯坦的理论通过时空几何来描述引力，”科米索解释道。但在四分体公式中，“重力的某些方面可以通过类似于电场和磁场的量来表达。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: In a prior study published in the journal Physical Review Letters earlier this year, the researchers applied this framework to gravity. That study suggested that gravitational fields can form two-dimensional structures called gravitational field sheets. Of the sheets' two dimensions, one stretches through space and the other through time — so each sheet is the trail a line leaves as time passes. A snapshot at any instant therefore catches each sheet as a line, akin to the field lines drawn around a magnet. And, like magnetic field lines frozen into a plasma, "under certain conditions, these sheets evolve without breaking or changing how they are connected," Comisso said.
paras.zh: 在今年早些时候发表在《物理评论快报》杂志上的一项研究中，研究人员将这一框架应用于重力。该研究表明，引力场可以形成称为引力场片的二维结构。在纸张的二维中，一个维度延伸于空间，另一个维度延伸于时间——因此每张纸都是一条线随着时间流逝留下的痕迹。因此，任何时刻的快照都会将每张纸视为一条线，类似于围绕磁铁绘制的磁力线。而且，就像冻结在等离子体中的磁力线一样，“在某些条件下，这些薄片会在不破坏或改变它们连接方式的情况下进化，”科米索说。

paras.en: In the new study, published Oct. 28 in the journal Physical Review D, the researchers found that this is not always the case. "Gravitational field sheets can break and reconnect in a different arrangement, much like magnetic field lines do in plasmas," Comisso said.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 28 日发表在《物理评论 D》杂志上的新研究中，研究人员发现情况并非总是如此。科米索说：“引力场片可以以不同的方式断裂和重新连接，就像等离子体中的磁力线一样。”

paras.en: The researchers showed that breaking the frozen-in rule doesn't, by itself, guarantee reconnection. Sometimes, the sheets merely slip relative to the flow that carries them, staying intact because they remain frozen into a different flow. Genuine reconnection happens only when no such alternative flow exists.
paras.zh: 研究人员表明，打破冻结规则本身并不能保证重新连接。有时，薄片只是相对于承载它们的流动滑动，保持完整，因为它们保持冻结成不同的流动。仅当不存在此类替代流时，才会发生真正的重新连接。

paras.en: "We also derived equations describing how quickly this reconnection can occur and how it can affect the transfer of energy and momentum," Comisso said. In general relativity, gravity and matter can trade energy and momentum, with only their combined total conserved. The study shows that reconnection changes the local rate of that exchange.
paras.zh: 科米索说：“我们还推导出了方程，描述了这种重新连接发生的速度以及它如何影响能量和动量的传递。”在广义相对论中，引力和物质可以交换能量和动量，只有它们的总和守恒。研究表明，重新连接会改变该交换的本地汇率。

paras.en: Reconnection also alters gravitational helicity, the gravitational counterpart of a quantity that measures how twisted and interlinked magnetic field lines are. Frozen-in sheets keep their helicity fixed, but reconnection can create or destroy it.
paras.zh: 重新连接还会改变引力螺旋度，引力螺旋度是衡量磁场线扭曲程度和相互关联程度的量的引力对应物。冻结的片材保持其螺旋度固定，但重新连接可以创建或破坏它。

paras.en: The findings don't require new physics. "Everything follows from Einstein's general relativity," Comisso said.
paras.zh: 这些发现不需要新的物理学。 “一切都遵循爱因斯坦的广义相对论，”科米索说。

paras.en: "Einstein developed his theory more than a century ago, and it has passed an extraordinary number of experimental tests," he added. "Yet even after more than a century, there are still new insights to be gained from those same equations."
paras.zh: “爱因斯坦在一个多世纪前提出了他的理论，并且已经通过了大量的实验测试，”他补充道。 “然而，即使在一个多世纪之后，仍然可以从这些相同的方程中获得新的见解。”

paras.en: What could trigger gravitational reconnection in nature remains an open question. Among the candidates the researchers suggested are the singularities thought to lurk at the hearts of black holes and the combined effect of gravitational ripples that are too small to track individually. Quantum effects linked to Hawking radiation — the faint glow that black holes are predicted to emit — could also play a part.
paras.zh: 自然界中什么会引发引力重新连接仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。研究人员提出的候选方案包括被认为潜伏在黑洞中心的奇点以及太小而无法单独追踪的引力波的综合效应。与霍金辐射（黑洞预计会发出的微弱光芒）相关的量子效应也可能发挥作用。

paras.en: "We're still at the beginning, but one of the most interesting possibilities is that gravitational reconnection could play a role in extreme events, such as the merger of two black holes or the collision of neutron stars," Comisso said. "These are environments where gravity is extremely strong and the geometry of spacetime changes dramatically."
paras.zh: 科米索说：“我们仍处于起步阶段，但最有趣的可能性之一是，引力重联可能在极端事件中发挥作用，例如两个黑洞的合并或中子星的碰撞。” “这些环境中的引力非常强，时空的几何形状发生了巨大的变化。”

paras.en: Such collisions send out ripples in space-time called gravitational waves, which detectors such as LIGO (the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory) have been recording since 2015. "We'd like to understand whether gravitational reconnection could contribute to transferring energy, and whether it might leave a recognizable signature in gravitational waves," Comisso added. "We don't know the answers yet, but these are questions that we can now begin to investigate."
paras.zh: 这种碰撞会在时空中发出称为引力波的涟漪，LIGO（激光干涉仪引力波天文台）等探测器自 2015 年以来一直在记录这种涟漪。“我们想了解引力重联是否有助于能量转移，以及它是否会在引力波中留下可识别的特征，”科米索补充道。 “我们还不知道答案，但我们现在可以开始调查这些问题。”

paras.en: Andrey got his B.Sc. and M.Sc. degrees in elementary particle physics from Novosibirsk State University in Russia, and a Ph.D. in string theory from the Weizmann Institute of Science in Israel. He works as a science writer, specializing in physics, space, and technology. His articles have been published in AdvancedScienceNews, PhysicsWorld, Science, and other outlets.
paras.zh: 安德烈获得了学士学位。和硕士学位俄罗斯新西伯利亚国立大学基本粒子物理学学士学位和博士学位。以色列魏茨曼科学研究所的弦理论博士。他是一名科普作家，专门研究物理、空间和技术。他的文章发表在 AdvancedScienceNews、PhysicsWorld、Science 和其他媒体上。
