articles.title: Voyager 1 Is the Farthest Human-Made Object in the Universe—and the Spacecraft Is About to Reach One Light-Day From Earth

paras.en: In 1977, Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida, with the aim of studying planets in the outer solar system. Almost half a century later, the twin spacecraft have long since achieved their original mission yet are still hurtling into the unknown. In fact, Voyager 1’s status as the farthest human-made object ever will soon be exemplified by an exceptional milestone: the probe is about to reach one light-day from Earth.
paras.zh: 1977年，旅行者一号和旅行者二号从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角发射升空，目的是研究太阳系外的行星。近半个世纪过去了，这对双胞胎飞船早已完成了最初的使命，但仍在向未知的方向飞驰。事实上，航海家一号作为有史以来最远的人造物体的地位很快就会通过一个非凡的里程碑得到体现：探测器即将到达距离地球一光日的地方。

paras.en: The spacecraft will achieve this astronomical record on November 18 at 5:16:07 a.m. Eastern time, at which point it will be 16.094 billion miles from our planet. That’s the distance light travels in 24 hours. (For context, it takes just over eight minutes, on average, for the sun’s light to reach Earth.)
paras.zh: 该航天器将于东部时间 11 月 18 日凌晨 5:16:07 实现这一天文记录，届时它将距离我们的星球 160.94 亿英里。这就是光在 24 小时内传播的距离。 （就上下文而言，太阳光平均需要八分钟多一点才能到达地球。）

paras.en: “I just never imagined [the mission] would last that long,” Linda Spilker, a planetary scientist at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), tells Science News’ Lisa Grossman. Spilker first joined the Voyager team just before the spacecraft launched, per the outlet, and is now the Voyager project scientist.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局喷气推进实验室 (JPL) 的行星科学家琳达·斯皮尔克 (Linda Spilker) 告诉《科学新闻》的丽莎·格罗斯曼 (Lisa Grossman)：“我只是没想到（这次任务）会持续那么久。”据报道，斯皮尔克在航天器发射前首次加入航海者团队，现在是航海者项目科学家。

paras.en: Voyager 1 took the famous image of Earth called Pale Blue Dot in 1990. The photo inspired astronomer Carl Sagan’s book Pale Blue Dot: A Vision of the Human Future in Space, in which he wrote, “Look at that dot. That’s here. That’s home. That’s us.”
paras.zh: 航行者一号于 1990 年拍摄了著名的地球照片，名为“淡蓝点”。这张照片启发了天文学家卡尔·萨根的著作《淡蓝点：人类太空未来的愿景》，他在书中写道：“看看那个点。那就是这里。那是家。那是我们。”

paras.en: Nothing special will happen to the spacecraft when it crosses the one-light-day boundary—the milestone is purely symbolic. And yet this symbolic event marks an extraordinary feat of science, technology and space exploration made possible by the Voyager team’s continuous problem-solving. The geriatric space probes are on their last legs, and mission scientists on Earth have had to find creative ways to preserve energy, including shutting down non-essential instruments.
paras.zh: 当航天器跨越一光日边界时，不会发生什么特别的事情——这一里程碑纯粹是象征性的。然而，这一具有象征意义的事件标志着科学、技术和太空探索的非凡壮举，而航海者号团队不断解决问题使之成为可能。老年太空探测器已经走到了最后的尽头，地球上的任务科学家必须找到创造性的方法来保存能量，包括关闭非必要的仪器。

paras.en: When the twin spacecraft launched nearly 50 years ago, they each had ten functioning instruments. Today, Voyager 1 has only two remaining: the magnetometer, which measures magnetic fields, and the plasma wave subsystem, which detects oscillations of charged particles. In April, the team turned off the spacecraft’s low-energy charged particles experiment, which measured the solar system and galaxy’s electrons, ions and cosmic rays. And in September, scientists turned off three Voyager 1 devices and swapped them with three alternatives that use less energy, according to a statement. The risky maneuver, nicknamed the “big bang,” had been previously completed on Voyager 2.
paras.zh: 近 50 年前，当这对双胞胎航天器发射时，它们各有十个正常运行的仪器。如今，航海家一号只剩下两个：测量磁场的磁力计和检测带电粒子振荡的等离子体波子系统。今年四月，该团队关闭了航天器的低能带电粒子实验，该实验测量了太阳系和星系的电子、离子和宇宙射线。据一份声明称，9 月份，科学家们关闭了三台 Voyager 1 设备，并将其更换为三种能耗更少的替代品。这项绰号为“大爆炸”的危险操作此前已在航行者二号上完成。

paras.en: The Voyager spacecraft are each powered by a “nuclear power plant on board” that utilizes decaying plutonium, Garry Hunt, an astrophysicist who was part of the original Voyager imaging team, tells Richard Speed on the Register’s “Kettle” podcast.
paras.zh: 原航海者号成像团队的天体物理学家加里·亨特 (Garry Hunt) 在 Register 的“Kettle”播客上告诉理查德·斯皮德 (Richard Speed)，航海者号航天器均由“船上核电站”提供动力，该核电站利用衰变的钚。

paras.en: But the plutonium supply is dwindling. “We’re losing several watts per year. There will come a time when the signal [from the probes] is literally so weak we can’t pick it up,” Hunt says, which might happen around 2035.
paras.zh: 但钚的供应正在减少。 “我们每年都会损失几瓦特。总有一天，[来自探测器的]信号会变得非常微弱，我们无法接收到它，”亨特说，这可能会在 2035 年左右发生。

paras.en: Scientists on Earth communicate with the Voyagers via radio signals transmitted and received by NASA’s Deep Space Network, an international array of huge antennas. Radio waves travel at the speed of light, so when Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth, it will take 24 hours for a message from scientists to reach the spacecraft and then another 24 hours for us to receive the probe’s answer.
paras.zh: 地球上的科学家通过美国宇航局深空网络（一个国际巨型天线阵列）发射和接收的无线电信号与航行者号进行通信。无线电波以光速传播，因此当旅行者一号到达距离地球一光日时，科学家发出的信息需要 24 小时才能到达航天器，然后我们又需要 24 小时才能收到探测器的答复。

paras.en: “If you want to say ‘hello’ to Voyager, you send your message, and then you go home, and you wait two days before you finally get a response,” Suzanne Dodd, Voyager project manager at JPL, says in the statement.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室 Voyager 项目经理苏珊娜·多德 (Suzanne Dodd) 在声明中表示：“如果你想向 Voyager 打招呼，你可以发送消息，然后回家，等待两天才能最终得到回复。”

paras.en: Dodd and her colleagues must deal with more than just energy- and distance-related issues, however. Like any old tech, sometimes the probe glitches without any explanation. Last month, for example, Voyager 1 suddenly went silent. On October 18 and 19, the Deep Space Network failed to receive two expected radio signals in a row. A following signal inexplicably came through on October 20, and there haven’t been any interruptions since, but NASA still doesn’t know what caused the communication issue, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 然而，多德和她的同事必须处理的不仅仅是与能源和距离相关的问题。与任何旧技术一样，有时探测器会出现故障且没有任何解释。例如，上个月，航海者一号突然陷入沉寂。 10月18日和19日，深空网络连续两次未能接收到预期的无线电信号。声明称，10 月 20 日莫名其妙地发出了以下信号，此后就没有出现任何中断，但 NASA 仍然不知道是什么原因导致了通信问题。

paras.en: Nonetheless, such lucky breaks as well as scientists’ perseverance have enabled both spacecraft to become interstellar travelers. Voyager 1 officially left the sun’s protective bubble in August 2012, and Voyager 2 crossed that historic boundary in November 2018. Each spacecraft carries a golden record, a phonograph record storing sounds and images from Earth in case it ever ends up in the hands of advanced extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这样的幸运和科学家的坚持使这两艘飞船成为了星际旅行者。航海家一号于 2012 年 8 月正式离开太阳的保护罩，航海家二号于 2018 年 11 月跨越了这一历史性边界。每艘航天器都携带一张黄金唱片，这是一张存储来自地球的声音和图像的留声机唱片，以防它最终落入先进的外星生命手中。

paras.en: “I was fortunate to be at the launch of Voyager 2,” science reporter Bob McDonald wrote for CBC Radio last year, highlighting how at the beginning of his reporting on the mission he was using a typewriter. “It is hard to fathom the distances in space and how long it takes to go anywhere, but it’s been a profound experience to actually feel how slow we are by watching myself grow old as we take our first baby steps among the stars.”
paras.zh: “我很幸运能够参加航行者 2 号的发射仪式，”科学记者鲍勃·麦克唐纳 (Bob McDonald) 去年为 CBC 广播电台写道，强调了他在报道任务开始时如何使用打字机。 “很难理解太空中的距离以及到达任何地方需要多长时间，但当我们在星空中迈出第一步时，看着自己变老，真正感受到我们是多么缓慢，这是一次深刻的经历。”

paras.en: To celebrate Voyager 1’s upcoming milestone, NASA is inviting space enthusiasts to participate in its “Shine Bright for Voyager’s Light-Day” event by shining the Morse code signal for V-G-R into the sky after sunset on November 17. You can use the agency’s automated flasher on your phone or follow their instructions for how to deliver the Morse code with a flashlight.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝航海家一号即将到来的里程碑，NASA 邀请太空爱好者参加“航海家光日闪耀”活动，在 11 月 17 日日落后将 V-G-R 的莫尔斯电码信号照射到天空中。您可以使用手机上该机构的自动闪光器，或按照他们的说明了解如何使用手电筒发送莫尔斯电码。

articles.title: This Adorable, Orphaned Baby Walrus Was Rescued by Two Researchers in Alaska. Now, He's Found a New Home in Florida

paras.en: A baby walrus left an orphan in Alaska has found a permanent home at SeaWorld Orlando after a days-long rescue mission and extensive rehabilitation period.
paras.zh: 经过几天的救援任务和广泛的康复期后，阿拉斯加的一只孤儿海象宝宝在奥兰多海洋世界找到了永久的家。

paras.en: On September 11, college student Violet Anniskett was conducting research on a remote beach in northwestern Alaska when she saw something completely unexpected between a pair of adult walrus carcasses: a lone calf, alive.
paras.zh: 9 月 11 日，大学生维奥莱特·安尼斯凯特 (Violet Anniskett) 在阿拉斯加西北部的一个偏远海滩进行研究时，在一对成年海象尸体之间看到了完全出乎意料的东西：一头孤独的小海象，还活着。

paras.en: “I was in shock,” she tells Ishani Desai at the New York Times. As part of an internship, she had been surveying the beach with Tony Fischbach, a wildlife biologist with the U.S. Geological Survey. The duo was looking for fresh Pacific walrus carcasses that they could sample to test for algal toxins to better understand the animals’ baseline levels.
paras.zh: “我很震惊，”她告诉《纽约时报》的伊沙尼·德赛。作为实习的一部分，她一直在与美国地质调查局野生动物生物学家托尼·菲施巴赫（Tony Fischbach）一起调查海滩。两人正在寻找新鲜的太平洋海象尸体，他们可以取样来测试藻类毒素，以更好地了解动物的基线水平。

paras.en: The researchers quickly requested approval to rehabilitate the roughly 5-month-old male calf—which they named Annautaq (pronounced “ah-NOW-tuq”), after Anniskett’s father—from the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) and the local Inupiaq community, which Anniskett is a member of.
paras.zh: 研究人员很快向美国鱼类和野生动物管理局 (USFWS) 以及 Anniskett 所属的当地 Inupiaq 社区请求批准恢复这只大约 5 个月大的雄性小牛，他们将其命名为 Annautaq（发音为“ah-NOW-tuq”），以 Anniskett 的父亲的名字命名。

paras.en: “It’s a big part of our culture that we harvest animals for subsistence living,” she tells Casey Grove at Alaska Public Media. “It was very important for us to ask the community first, and as soon as they decided as a whole, then we’re able to move forward with the steps of saving him through the SeaLife Center.”
paras.zh: “我们捕猎动物是为了维持生计，这是我们文化的重要组成部分，”她告诉阿拉斯加公共媒体的凯西·格罗夫。 “对我们来说，首先询问社区非常重要，一旦他们整体做出决定，我们就可以通过海洋生物中心采取措施拯救他。”

paras.en: Still, there were many steps to come. After receiving the proper permissions, the approximately 185-pound calf had to get to the Alaska SeaLife Center, the state’s only permanent marine mammal rehabilitation facility, more than 800 miles away in the southern city of Seward. Stormy weather conditions meant that they couldn’t move the hefty, little walrus for days, leaving the two researchers to care for Annautaq on their own as predators loomed large.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，还有许多步骤要做。在获得适当的许可后，这头大约 185 磅重的小牛必须到达阿拉斯加海洋生物中心，这是该州唯一的永久性海洋哺乳动物康复设施，位于 800 多英里外的南部城市苏厄德。暴风雨的天气条件意味着他们几天都无法移动这只又大又小的海象，这使得两名研究人员只能在捕食者逼近的情况下独自照顾阿纳塔克。

paras.en: “When we found him, a determined flock of gulls was intent on scavenging him. He was in immediate peril of suffering this fate had we not gotten approval to intervene. Two polar bears were also active on the island,” Fischbach says in a statement.
paras.zh: “当我们发现他时，一群坚定的海鸥一心要捕食他。如果我们没有得到批准进行干预，他将立即面临遭受这种命运的危险。岛上还有两只北极熊很活跃，”费施巴赫在一份声明中说。

paras.en: The two researchers guided Annautaq to an abandoned building that could shelter him from hungry onlookers and stayed there with him for nearly four days. Walrus calves rely solely on their mother’s milk, but Anniskett and Fischbach didn’t have any formula on hand. So, they fed him a mixture of honey and water, reports the Times.
paras.zh: 两名研究人员将阿纳塔克带到一栋废弃的建筑，在那里他可以躲避饥饿的旁观者，并在那里呆了近四天。海象幼崽完全依赖母乳，但安尼斯凯特和费施巴赫手头没有任何配方奶。据《泰晤士报》报道，他们给他喂了蜂蜜和水的混合物。

paras.en: There, the walrus cuddled with Fischbach in his sleeping bag. Anniskett was a bit fearful of the creature at first but eventually warmed up to him. And he struggled to go to sleep without one of them nearby.
paras.zh: 在那里，海象在费​​施巴赫的睡袋里依偎着他。安尼斯凯特一开始对这个生物有点害怕，但最终对他产生了兴趣。当他们不在身边时，他很难入睡。

paras.en: “I remember once he was falling asleep, and he kept trying to go to me, and I would move a little bit until he realized, and he just put his snout on my leg, kind of, and he fell asleep,” Anniskett tells Alaska Public Media. After that, she got up and moved behind Annautaq, but he suddenly opened his eyes.
paras.zh: “我记得有一次他睡着了，他一直试图走到我身边，我会移动一点，直到他意识到，他只是把鼻子放在我的腿上，然后他就睡着了，”安尼斯凯特告诉阿拉斯加公共媒体。说完，她起身走到了阿纳塔克的身后，但他却突然睁开了眼睛。

paras.en: “He looked and saw I wasn’t there. Then, he picked his head up and started going, ‘hoo, hoo,’” she says. “And then, he looked behind and saw me and just turned around and went back to sleep.”
paras.zh: “他看了看，发现我不在那儿。然后，他抬起头，开始‘呼呼’，”她说。 “然后，他回头看到了我，然后就转过身去睡觉了。”

paras.en: Annautaq finally made it to the local airport with the help of community members and researchers. He had to be moved into a heavy-duty kennel to board the plane—something he wasn’t a fan of.
paras.zh: 在社区成员和研究人员的帮助下，阿纳塔克最终抵达当地机场。他必须被搬进一个重型狗舍才能登机——这是他不喜欢的。

paras.en: “He was really upset, because he had no idea what we were doing with him,” Anniskett tells Alaska Public Media.
paras.zh: “他真的很沮丧，因为他不知道我们要对他做什么，”安尼斯凯特告诉阿拉斯加公共媒体。

paras.en: On September 14, the calf arrived at Alaska SeaLife Center dehydrated but overall in good condition. He had superficial wounds that were treated with antibiotics and anti-inflammatory medication, and then the hard work of rehabilitation started.
paras.zh: 9月14日，小牛抵达阿拉斯加海洋生物中心，虽然脱水，但总体状况良好。他的浅表伤口接受了抗生素和消炎药物治疗，然后开始了艰苦的康复工作。

paras.en: Pacific walrus calf care is quite demanding. The animals have one of the strongest and longest mother-child bonds of all pinnipeds, staying together for one to two years, according to the statement. For comparison, harbor seal pups stay with their mothers for about four to six weeks before venturing off on their own.
paras.zh: 太平洋海象幼崽的护理要求相当高。声明称，这些动物是所有鳍足类动物中母子关系最牢固、最长的动物之一，它们在一起可以生活一到两年。相比之下，斑海豹幼崽会和母亲待大约四到六周，然后才独自冒险。

paras.en: Because close social contact with their mother is so important, walrus calf caretakers essentially act as surrogates, providing around-the-clock physical contact, social interaction, feeding support and veterinary care.
paras.zh: 由于与母亲的密切社交接触非常重要，海象幼崽的看护者基本上充当代理人的角色，提供全天候的身体接触、社交互动、喂养支持和兽医护理。

paras.en: While Annautaq responded well to rehabilitation, USFWS determined that the calf could not be released into the wild because he would become so used to interacting with people. Experts chose SeaWorld Orlando as his permanent home, where he will serve as an ambassador for his species, according to a statement from the park. He’s now there receiving up to six bottle feedings per day and weighs around 250 pounds, per the Times.
paras.zh: 虽然阿纳塔克对康复反应良好，但美国鱼类和野生动物管理局决定不能将小牛放归野外，因为它会变得太习惯与人互动。根据公园的一份声明，专家选择奥兰多海洋世界作为他的永久住所，他将在那里担任其物种的大使。据《泰晤士报》报道，他现在每天要接受六次奶瓶喂养，体重约为 250 磅。

paras.en: This month, he cleared his quarantine period and is gradually being introduced to his herd. He recently met Uki, a 2-year-old walrus that was also rescued from Alaska. The two bopped noses through a protective barrier, marking the start of a new journey.
paras.zh: 本月，他结束了隔离期，并逐渐被引入到他的牛群中。他最近遇到了 Uki，一只同样从阿拉斯加获救的 2 岁海象。两人冲过一道防护屏障，标志着新旅程的开始。

articles.title: Dismantled to Survive the Nazi Blitz, Coventry Cathedral's Stained Glass Is 'a Medieval Jigsaw Puzzle.' Its 12,000 Fragments Are Now Digitized for Public View

paras.en: During World War II, the medieval stained glass of Coventry Cathedral was dismantled and hidden in crates to survive air raids. Now, an ambitious cataloging project has digitized roughly 12,000 fragments, making them publicly accessible for the first time in decades.
paras.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，考文垂大教堂的中世纪彩色玻璃被拆除并藏在板条箱中以抵御空袭。现在，一个雄心勃勃的编目项目已将大约 12,000 个片段数字化，使它们几十年来首次可供公众访问。

paras.en: On November 14, 1940, German bombers obliterated the cathedral, making it the only British cathedral destroyed during the Blitz. The glass survived, stashed in 30 wooden crates in the rectory cellars of a nearby village, remaining there until 1957. The red sandstone cathedral was eventually rebuilt and its old charred shell was preserved as a memorial to peace and reconciliation. But the windows were never reassembled.
paras.zh: 1940 年 11 月 14 日，德国轰炸机摧毁了大教堂，使其成为闪电战中唯一被摧毁的英国大教堂。玻璃幸存下来，被藏在附近村庄教区地窖的 30 个木箱中，一直保存到 1957 年。红砂岩大教堂最终得到重建，其古老烧焦的外壳被保留下来，作为和平与和解的纪念。但窗户从未重新组装过。

paras.en: As Coventry marks the 86th anniversary of the bombing, the World Monuments Fund (WMF) and cathedral curators have photographed and cataloged the fragile trove, launching a digital exhibition on the Bloomberg Connects app.
paras.zh: 在考文垂纪念爆炸事件 86 周年之际，世界纪念碑基金会 (WMF) 和大教堂策展人对这些脆弱的宝藏进行了拍摄和编目，并在 Bloomberg Connects 应用程序上推出了数字展览。

paras.en: “Coventry Cathedral’s collection of medieval stained glass, which includes exquisitely executed examples of 15th-century painting, is of international importance,” Laura Atkinson, a stained-glass conservator who led the cataloging, says in a statement. “Yet it has received little scholarly study. This project is a crucial step towards making the collection accessible to the public and securing the academic attention it merits.”
paras.zh: “考文垂大教堂收藏的中世纪彩色玻璃，其中包括精美的 15 世纪绘画作品，具有国际重要性，”负责编目的彩色玻璃管理员劳拉·阿特金森 (Laura Atkinson) 在一份声明中表示。 “然而，它很少受到学术研究。这个项目是向公众开放这些藏品并确保其应有的学术关注的关键一步。”

paras.en: The assemblage— Britain’s largest collection of loose medieval stained glass—dates largely to the 15th century. The fragments are attributed to John Thornton, one of medieval England’s master glaziers, famed for creating the Great East Window at York Minster.
paras.zh: 该组合是英国最大的散装中世纪彩色玻璃收藏，其历史可追溯至 15 世纪。 The fragments are attributed to John Thornton, one of medieval England’s master glaziers, famed for creating the Great East Window at York Minster.

paras.en: Coventry’s stained glass, the cathedral’s Reverend Canon Nitano Muller tells the BBC’s Lorna Bailey and Alec Blackman, is “akin to the glass that you’d find in Westminster Abbey or Canterbury Cathedral.”
paras.zh: 考文垂大教堂的牧师卡农·尼塔诺·穆勒 (Canon Nitano Muller) 告诉 BBC 的洛娜·贝利 (Lorna Bailey) 和亚历克·布莱克曼 (Alec Blackman)，考文垂的彩色玻璃“类似于威斯敏斯特教堂或坎特伯雷大教堂中的玻璃”。

paras.en: Surviving pieces depict scenes from the Passion of Christ, figures of the Apostles and various saints, as well as fanciful beasts and heraldic shields which bear monograms and rebuses. Particularly distinctive are donor portraits showing the ordinary lay men and women who funded the construction of the windows kneeling in prayer.
paras.zh: 幸存的作品描绘了基督受难的场景、使徒和各种圣人的人物，以及奇特的野兽和带有花押字和画线的纹章盾牌。特别引人注目的是捐助者的肖像，展示了资助建造窗户的普通男女男女跪下祈祷的样子。

paras.en: Producing such intricate depictions of jeweled robes, in particular, demanded remarkable technical prowess. “The medieval glazer has carefully scratched away the surface of the glass to create a hole and then they’ve inserted a colored piece of glass that will represent the jewel,” Atkinson tells the Guardian’s Esther Addley. “That would have taken a long, long time and had a high failure rate. This is incredibly expensive, high-end glass. This is the best stuff.”
paras.zh: 制作如此复杂的珠宝长袍描绘，需要非凡的技术实力。 “中世纪的玻璃工匠小心地刮掉玻璃表面，形成一个洞，然后插入一块代表宝石的彩色玻璃，”阿特金森告诉《卫报》的埃丝特·阿德利。 “这需要很长很长的时间，而且故障率很高。这是非常昂贵的高端玻璃。这是最好的东西。”

paras.en: The windows endured centuries of turmoil long before the 1940 air raids. Partially smashed during the 16th-century Reformation, surviving fragments were later pieced together into patchwork arrangements to adorn the apse and clerestory.
paras.zh: 早在 1940 年空袭之前，窗户就经历了几个世纪的动乱。 Partially smashed during the 16th-century Reformation, surviving fragments were later pieced together into patchwork arrangements to adorn the apse and clerestory.

paras.en: Dismantled for protection before the war, the salvaged glass became what Andrew Hines, head of heritage and interpretation at the cathedral, describes as “a medieval jigsaw puzzle,” per the Guardian. Although an initial conservation effort documented parts of the glass in 2012, the pieces remained divided across three separate storage rooms for more than a decade.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》报道，大教堂遗产和解说负责人安德鲁·海因斯 (Andrew Hines) 称，这些打捞出来的玻璃在战前被拆除以进行保护，成为“中世纪的拼图游戏”。尽管最初的保护工作在 2012 年记录了部分玻璃，但十多年来，这些碎片一直被分放在三个独立的储藏室中。

paras.en: During the latest phase, specialists transferred the collection into bespoke cabinets, logging tray numbers and capturing high-resolution photographs to create a digital database. The digital preview marks an early step in the cathedral’s broader Building Hope project, which seeks to preserve the cathedral’s ruins for generations.
paras.zh: 在最新阶段，专家将收藏品转移到定制橱柜中，记录托盘编号并拍摄高分辨率照片，以创建数字数据库。数字预览标志着大教堂更广泛的建筑希望项目的早期步骤，该项目旨在为几代人保护大教堂的废墟。

paras.en: “Coventry Cathedral’s medieval stained glass is a remarkable survivor,” Emma Sweeney, projects manager at WMF Britain, says in the statement. “Together, the ruins and the surviving glass tell a powerful story of resilience, with much still to be uncovered.”
paras.zh: “考文垂大教堂的中世纪彩色玻璃是一个了不起的幸存者，”WMF Britain 项目经理艾玛·斯威尼 (Emma Sweeney) 在声明中说道。 “废墟和幸存的玻璃共同讲述了一个关于复原力的强大故事，还有很多东西有待揭开。”

articles.title: Rocco’s Mini Mini Fridge Is Here (2026)
articles.author: Kat Merck

paras.en: If you've always coveted Rocco’s vintage-inspired beverage fridges but haven't been able to swing the $1,999-plus price tag, here's some news you might like: Today, the brand released the Mini Mini, a desktop version of its legendary mini fridge. It comes in Green, Graphite, Cream, and new Stainless Steel. (Only Stainless Steel is available right now.)
paras.zh: 如果您一直垂涎 Rocco 的复古风格饮料冰箱，但一直无法摆脱 1,999 美元以上的价格标签，这里有一些您可能会喜欢的消息：今天，该品牌发布了 Mini Mini，这是其传奇迷你冰箱的桌面版本。它有绿色、石墨色、奶油色和新型不锈钢材质。 （目前仅提供不锈钢材质。）

paras.en: We haven't tested it yet or even seen it in person, but Rocco says the Mini Mini can hold 12 standard 12-ounce cans and gets down to 41 degrees Fahrenheit. If you've ever tried other fridges of this size, you'll know this is an impressive stat. (Sorry, mini Frigidaire—you're cute but warm.) Rocco calls the Mini Mini “the first countertop fridge with real fridge standards.” It's got 360-degree ventilation with the refrigeration mechanics underneath the unit. That means it can sit flush against a wall, wherever that might be.
paras.zh: 我们还没有测试过它，甚至没有亲眼见过它，但 Rocco 说 Mini Mini 可以容纳 12 个标准 12 盎司罐头，温度可降至 41 华氏度。如果您曾经尝试过这种尺寸的其他冰箱，您就会知道这是一个令人印象深刻的统计数据。 （对不起，迷你冰箱——你很可爱但很温暖。）罗科称迷你迷你为“第一台符合真正冰箱标准的台面冰箱。”它具有 360 度通风，制冷机械装置位于装置下方。这意味着它可以与墙齐平放置，无论墙在哪里。

paras.en: The only note is that, unlike the larger fridges, like the Classic and the Essential, this Rocco does not have a smart-beverage recognition feature—it's just for looks and performance only.
paras.zh: 唯一需要注意的是，与 Classic 和 Essential 等大型冰箱不同，这款 Rocco 没有智能饮料识别功能——它只是为了外观和性能。

paras.en: It's available for $295, and while it’s not currently on sale, unlike the brand's larger fridges, you can get it for $50 off when you buy a full-sized Rocco Classic or Essential.
paras.zh: 它的售价为 295 美元，虽然目前尚未打折，但与该品牌的大型冰箱不同，当您购买全尺寸的 Rocco Classic 或 Essential 时，您可以享受 50 美元的折扣。

articles.title: Kitchen Gear From Our Place Is Steeply Discounted
articles.author: Louryn Strampe

paras.en: I’ll sing the praises of Our Place to anyone who will listen. I’ve tried most of its kitchenware, and I have yet to use a product I disliked. Not only do they perform well, but they’re all thoughtfully designed and look great in my kitchen. The only downside is that it can be spendy. Right now, Shop is offering 15 to 30 percent off a huge variety of Our Place kitchenware, and you can get an extra $60 off when you spend $100 or more. This is an excellent way to save on a gift for yourself or someone else.
paras.zh: 我会向任何愿意倾听的人歌颂我们的地方。我已经尝试过它的大部分厨具，但还没有使用过我不喜欢的产品。它们不仅性能良好，而且经过精心设计，在我的厨房里看起来很棒。唯一的缺点是它可能会很花钱。目前，Shop 提供多种 Our Place 厨具 15% 至 30% 的折扣，当您消费 100 美元或以上时，您还可以额外享受 60 美元的折扣。这是为自己或他人节省礼物的绝佳方式。

paras.en: For more home and kitchen deals, check our stories on the Best Black Friday Espresso and Coffee Maker Deals and this great Mustard Made home storage sale.
paras.zh: 有关更多家居和厨房优惠，请查看我们关于最佳黑色星期五浓缩咖啡和咖啡机优惠以及芥末制作家庭储物促销的故事。

paras.en: The Our Place Always Pan is my number-one kitchen sidekick. I use it nearly every single time I cook because it’s so versatile. The design works well for frying eggs and flipping pancakes, but it’s also deep enough for spaghetti sauce or a quick veggie stir-fry. The nontoxic nonstick coating is still holding up well, though it does stain a bit, which I don’t mind. It’s easy to clean, too. While I think it’s worth $95 regularly, you might want to pick up some accessories to hit that $100 threshold for an extra $60 off. I especially like the Spruce Steamer basket for frozen dumplings and the Egg Poacher to help me hit my protein macros.
paras.zh: Our Place Always Pan 是我的第一厨房助手。我几乎每次做饭都会用它，因为它用途广泛。该设计非常适合煎鸡蛋和煎饼，但它也足够深，适合意大利面酱或快速炒蔬菜。无毒的不粘涂层仍然保持良好，尽管它确实有点染色，我不介意。它也很容易清洁。虽然我认为它通常价值 95 美元，但您可能想购买一些配件以达到 100 美元的门槛，并额外享受 60 美元的折扣。我特别喜欢用于冷冻饺子的云杉蒸笼和帮助我达到蛋白质宏量的鸡蛋煮锅。

paras.en: I just started testing the Wonder Oven Pro, and I like it so much that I’m considering ditching my microwave. It takes a lot to make me like a countertop appliance given that my apartment kitchen is so tiny, but this sleek little machine has a myriad of functions, from roasting and broiling and baking to dehydrating and even a fancy steam infusion mode (which I have yet to try). The reheat mode is helping me actually eat my leftovers instead of leaving them to die in the fridge. The whole appliance is easy to clean, and the controls are pretty intuitive. If your rental’s appliances are subpar or you just want another multifunction kitchen doodad that works, this is an easy recommendation, especially at its sale price.
paras.zh: 我刚刚开始测试 Wonder Oven Pro，我非常喜欢它，以至于我正在考虑放弃我的微波炉。考虑到我的公寓厨房是如此之小，要让我像一台台面电器需要付出很大的努力，但这台时尚的小机器具有无数的功能，从烘烤、烧烤、烘烤到脱水，甚至还有一种奇特的蒸汽注入模式（我还没有尝试过）。再加热模式可以帮助我真正吃掉剩菜，而不是让它们在冰箱里等死。整个设备很容易清洁，而且控制也非常直观。如果您租用的电器质量不佳，或者您只是想要另一个实用的多功能厨房小玩意，那么这是一个简单的推荐，尤其是其售价。

articles.title: ‘We Have to Take Over’: Far-Right Extremists Want to Seize Control of the GOP
articles.author: David Gilbert

paras.en: On Election Day last week, white nationalist Nick Fuentes urged his supporters on X to “get out and vote Democrat today.” The post racked up over 12 million views. Hours later, in the wake of the Democratic sweep, Fuentes took credit for the victory. “We did it again” he wrote on Telegram, later calling the phenomenon “the Groyper Effect,” a reference to the nickname given to his followers.
paras.zh: 上周的选举日，白人民族主义者尼克·富恩特斯 (Nick Fuentes) 在 X 上敦促他的支持者“今天就出去投票给民主党”。该帖子的浏览量已超过 1200 万次。几个小时后，民主党大获全胜，富恩特斯将胜利归功于自己。他在 Telegram 上写道：“我们又这么做了”，后来将这种现象称为“格罗伊珀效应”，这是指他的追随者给他起的绰号。

paras.en: In recent days, Fuentes has claimed the election results are an opportunity for him and his allies on the far-right.
paras.zh: 最近几天，富恩特斯声称选举结果对他和他的极右翼盟友来说是一个机会。

paras.en: “Let the Democrats rule, see how that goes,” Fuentes said during a livestream last week. “There will come a time when the far left will terrorize people, and they're going to push all of them into the arms of the right. Who's going to fight the far left? Only the far-right. This is why we have to take over the right wing now.”
paras.zh: “让民主党统治吧，看看进展如何，”富恩特斯在上周的直播中说道。 “总有一天，极左派会恐吓人们，他们会把所有人推入右派的怀抱。谁来对抗极左派？只有极右派。这就是为什么我们现在必须接管右翼。”

paras.en: In another livestream last week, Fuentes added a warning to the GOP leadership: “It’s our party now … You need to cooperate with us… Groypers are open for business. It has [to] be America First—and if it's not, we'll do it again for the enemy.”
paras.zh: 在上周的另一场直播中，富恩特斯向共和党领导层发出了警告：“现在是我们的政党了……你们需要与我们合作……Groypers 是开放的。它必须是美国第一，如果不是，我们将为敌人再次这样做。”

paras.en: A WIRED review of comments from white supremacist, Christian nationalist, and other far-right groups in the wake of the midterm results shows much of the same. While the groups are uniformly attacking Trump’s failure to prioritize white, Christian American values, they also believe that this sudden shift to the left will result in a backlash that will see more people embrace far-right groups and ideologies.
paras.zh: 《连线》杂志对中期结果公布后白人至上主义者、基督教民族主义者和其他极右团体的评论进行了审查，结果显示出大致相同的结果。尽管这些团体一致攻击特朗普未能优先考虑白人、基督教美国价值观，但他们也认为，这种突然向左的转变将导致反弹，导致更多人接受极右团体和意识形态。

paras.en: “Many prominent figures in racist extremist movements have taken to declaring the MAGA movement dead since midterm elections, claiming that the results validate their previous criticisms of the Trump administration and opens new opportunities for their movements to push disaffected voters toward their ideological beliefs,” Jared Holt, senior researcher at Open Measures, tells WIRED.
paras.zh: 开放措施高级研究员贾里德·霍尔特告诉《连线》杂志：“自中期选举以来，种族主义极端主义运动中的许多知名人士都开始宣布 MAGA 运动死亡，声称选举结果证实了他们之前对特朗普政府的批评，并为他们的运动提供了新的机会，将心怀不满的选民推向他们的意识形态信仰。”

paras.en: While some of the Republican party’s extremist candidates were rejected during the elections last week, many did win their elections.
paras.zh: 虽然一些共和党的极端主义候选人在上周的选举中被拒绝，但许多人确实赢得了选举。

paras.en: The Institute for Research and Education on Human Rights tracked 535 candidates running in statewide races who were members of at least one far-right Facebook group. The researchers found that of the 476 races that had been called by last Friday, 338 of those candidates were victorious, representing a 71 percent win rate (the vast majority of these races saw GOP incumbents retain their seats). In Florida, for example, 34-year-old citrus farmer Marshall Rawson, who attended the Unite the Right rally in Charlottesville in 2017, easily defeated his Democrat opponent in the state’s 10th District State House race.
paras.zh: 人权研究与教育研究所追踪了 535 名参加全州竞选的候选人，他们至少是一个极右 Facebook 群组的成员。研究人员发现，在上周五宣布的 476 场竞选中，有 338 名候选人获胜，胜率达到 71%（其中绝大多数竞选中共和党现任议员保住了席位）。例如，在佛罗里达州，34 岁的柑橘种植者马歇尔·罗森 (Marshall Rawson) 参加了 2017 年在夏洛茨维尔举行的“团结右翼”集会，并在该州第十区州议会选举中轻松击败了民主党对手。

paras.en: Many states also passed ballot measures that could further far-right agendas, including anti-transgender rules, onerous voter ID laws, and anti-immigrant measures.
paras.zh: 许多州还通过了可能进一步推进极右议程的投票措施，包括反变性规则、繁琐的选民身份法和反移民措施。

paras.en: “Arizona, Colorado, Nebraska, and Washington approved bans on trans athletes in female sports, so girls in Washington State, for instance, will now have to go through a genital exam or pass a DNA test before they can participate in youth sports,” Devin Burghart, executive director with IREHR, said on Friday during a briefing with reporters.
paras.zh: “亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州、内布拉斯加州和华盛顿州批准了跨性别运动员参加女性体育运动的禁令，因此，例如，华盛顿州的女孩现在必须经过生殖器检查或通过 DNA 测试才能参加青少年体育运动，”IREHR 执行董事德文·伯格哈特 (Devin Burghart) 周五在向记者通报情况时表示。

paras.en: The success of these ballot measures were celebrated by extremists groups as evidence that Americans wanted that the current GOP could not deliver.
paras.zh: 这些投票措施的成功受到极端主义团体的庆祝，认为这是美国人希望当前共和党无法实现的证据。

paras.en: The Proud Boys, the street-fighting group that Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency operations made largely redundant in recent years, were optimistic following the losses. “The ultimate rebuke of the current Republican establishment was citizens voting them out of office then doing their job for them by passing ballot measures on issues the Republicans should have already handled,” the Cape Fear Proud Boys wrote in their Telegram channel.
paras.zh: “骄傲男孩”是一个街头斗殴组织，近年来移民和海关执法机构的行动基本上使其不再存在，但他们对损失感到乐观。 “对当前共和党建制派的最终谴责是公民投票让他们下台，然后通过对共和党应该已经处理的问题通过投票措施来为他们做他们的工作，”开普菲尔骄傲男孩在他们的 Telegram 频道中写道。

paras.en: “What this signals to me is even in those places where they lost, they're getting 41-47 percent of the vote [so] there's still a mass base to try to be mobilized,” Chuck Tanner, research director at IREHR, said during the briefing. “That's the lesson that some of these groups are taking out of it, is that there's still that mass base.”
paras.zh: IREHR 研究主任查克·坦纳 (Chuck Tanner) 在简报会上表示：“这向我传达的信号是，即使在那些他们输掉的地方，他们也获得了 41-47% 的选票，因此仍然有群众基础需要动员起来。” “这就是其中一些团体从中吸取的教训，那就是仍然有群众基础。”

paras.en: And it is the existence of this base, extremist groups claim, leaves the Republican Party vulnerable to takeover from the inside.
paras.zh: 极端主义团体声称，正是这个基础的存在，使得共和党容易受到内部接管。

paras.en: “Now is the time, if you're a nationalist, to start looking at moving on the Republican Party where you live,” Warren Balogh, a white supremacist from Pittsburgh who attended the Unite the Right rally in Charlottesville in 2017, wrote on his Telegram channel. “And by that I mean, organizing your guys and going in to do a hostile takeover.”
paras.zh: “如果你是一名民族主义者，现在是时候开始考虑向你所居住的共和党采取行动了，”来自匹兹堡的白人至上主义者沃伦·巴洛 (Warren Balogh) 在他的 Telegram 频道上写道，他参加了 2017 年在夏洛茨维尔举行的团结右翼集会。 “我的意思是，组织你的人并进行敌意收购。”

paras.en: “This may be the best thing that has happened to the Republican party in a half-century,” the Cape Fear Proud Boys declared in a post on Telegram days after the election. “Now you will learn to placate us, or you will continue to fail. Understand this: You’re going to run people we like and you’re going to do what we say.”
paras.zh: “这可能是共和党半个世纪以来发生的最好的事情，”选举几天后，开普菲尔骄傲男孩在 Telegram 上发帖宣称。 “现在你要学会安抚我们，否则你将继续失败。明白这一点：你将管理我们喜欢的人，你将按照我们所说的去做。”

paras.en: But other extremists appear less inclined to wait until the next general election in 2028, preferring a more direct takeover.
paras.zh: 但其他极端分子似乎不太愿意等到 2028 年下一次大选，而是更喜欢更直接的接管。

paras.en: "I'm not saying that we will win through democracy, I'm just saying we'll win,” Joel Webbon, a Christian nationalist pastor said last week in a video posted online after the election. Webbon and fellow far-right pastors, as well as guest speaker and noted conspiracy theorist Alex Jones, are set to meet at a conference in Texas this week where attendees will discuss, in at least one talk, “battle plans” for “Christian nationalists on the right to be able to seize power.”
paras.zh: “我并不是说我们会通过民主获胜，我只是说我们会获胜，”基督教民族主义牧师乔尔·韦本(Joel Webbon)上周在选举后发布在网上的视频中说道。韦邦和其他极右翼牧师，以及特邀演讲者和著名阴谋理论家亚历克斯·琼斯将于本周在德克萨斯州举行的一次会议上会面，与会者将在至少一次演讲中讨论“右翼基督教民族主义者夺取权力的战斗计划”。

paras.en: Experts WIRED spoke to said they have not yet seen any explicit calls for violence from the far-right groups they are tracking, but some figures are already looking ahead of January 3, when Congress is set to certify the midterm election results.
paras.zh: 《连线》杂志采访的专家表示，他们尚未看到他们正在追踪的极右翼团体发出任何明确的暴力呼吁，但一些人士已经在展望 1 月 3 日的情况，届时国会将确认中期选举结果。

paras.en: Far-right activist and pardoned January 6 rioter Jake Lang, however, is planning an event in DC on January 3. It is unclear how many people are planning to attend, but one of the Christian nationalist pastors listed by Lang as an official speaker has already said he won’t be speaking.
paras.zh: 然而，极右活动家、1 月 6 日被赦免的骚乱者杰克·朗 (Jake Lang) 计划于 1 月 3 日在华盛顿特区举办一场活动。目前尚不清楚计划参加的人数，但被朗列为官方发言人的基督教民族主义牧师之一已经表示他不会发言。

paras.en: Lang, who spent last weekend disrupting a cat convention that he thought was a furry convention, did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 朗上周末扰乱了一场他认为是毛茸茸的大会的猫大会，他没有回应置评请求。

articles.title: 49ers to trade for Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen

paras.en: Nov. 10 (UPI) -- The San Francisco 49ers agreed to trade for Indianapolis Colts veteran wide receiver Keenan Allen, a league source told UPI on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日（UPI）——周二，一位联盟消息人士告诉 UPI，旧金山 49 人队同意交易印第安纳波利斯小马队老将外接手基南·艾伦 (Keenan Allen)。

paras.en: Allen will head to the 49ers in exchange for a sixth-round pick in the 2027 NFL Draft. The 34-year-old must pass a physical to complete the transaction.
paras.zh: 艾伦将前往 49 人队，以换取 2027 年 NFL 选秀中的第六轮选秀权。这位34岁的球员必须通过体检才能完成交易。

paras.en: Allen would enter a 49ers' wide receivers room that has been ravaged by injuries. Mike Evans missed the last two games due to rib and Achilles injuries. Fellow 49ers starter Deebo Samuel missed the last three games with a hamstring injury.
paras.zh: 艾伦将进入49人队饱受伤病困扰的外接手室。迈克·埃文斯因肋骨和跟腱受伤缺席了过去两场比赛。 49人队首发球员迪博·塞缪尔因腿筋受伤缺席了过去三场比赛。

paras.en: Brandin Cooks, Jacob Cowing, Demarcus Robinson and Jordan Watkins are the other wide receivers on the 49ers roster.
paras.zh: Brandin Cooks、Jacob Cowing、Demarcus Robinson 和 Jordan Watkins 是 49 人队名单上的其他外接手。

paras.en: Watkins played the most snaps (56) among 49ers wide receivers in their win over the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday in Santa Clara, Calif. Robinson (37) and Cooks (32) were the second- and third-most deployed 49ers wide receivers in Week 9. Cowing and KhaDarel Hodge, who was called up from the practice squad, played 18 and 12 offensive snaps, respectively.
paras.zh: 周日在加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉战胜拉斯维加斯突袭者队的比赛中，沃特金斯在 49 人队外接手中打了最多的接球手（56 次）。罗宾逊（37 次）和库克斯（32 次）是第 9 周中部署最多的 49 人队外接手中第二和第三位。考因和从训练队征召的卡达雷尔·霍奇分别打了 18 次和 12 次进攻抢断。

paras.en: Watkins hauled in four catches for a team-high 86 yards and a score in the win.
paras.zh: 沃特金斯完成四次接球，取得全队最高的 86 码，并取得胜利。

paras.en: Allen's departure wouldl leave the Colts with Laquon Treadwell, Josh Downs, Anthony Gould, Ashton Dulin and Deion Burks at wide receiver. Mecole Hardman, Quez Watkins and Nick Westbrook-Ikhine are the Colts' practice squad wide receivers.
paras.zh: 艾伦的离开将使小马队留下外接手拉昆·特雷德韦尔、乔什·唐斯、安东尼·古尔德、阿什顿·杜林和迪昂·伯克斯。梅科尔·哈德曼、奎兹·沃特金斯和尼克·威斯布鲁克-伊克因是小马队练习队的外接手。

paras.en: Allen caught 40 passes for 351 yards and a score over eight appearances this season for the Colts. The six-time Pro Bowl selection signed a one-year, $3.3 million contract in August.
paras.zh: 艾伦本赛季为小马队出场 8 次，接球 40 次，推进 351 码，取得进球。这位六次入选职业碗的选手在八月签署了一份为期一年、价值 330 万美元的合同。

paras.en: The Colts (2-7) will host the Miami Dolphins (1-7) at 1 p.m. EST Sunday in Indianapolis. The 49ers (7-1) will play the Dallas Cowboys (4-5) at 4:25 p.m. Sunday in Arlington, Texas.
paras.zh: 小马队 (2-7) 将在下午 1 点迎战迈阿密海豚队 (1-7)。美国东部时间周日在印第安纳波利斯。 49 人队 (7-1) 将在下午 4:25 迎战达拉斯牛仔队 (4-5)。周日在德克萨斯州阿灵顿。

articles.title: House Republicans choose Rep. Jim Jordan as new leader

paras.en: Nov. 10 (UPI) -- House Republicans elected Rep. Jim Jordan on Tuesday to serve as the next House Republican leader after losing control of the chamber in next year's Congress.
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日（UPI）——众议院共和党人周二选举众议员吉姆·乔丹（Jim Jordan）在失去明年国会众议院控制权后担任下一任众议院共和党领袖。

paras.en: The representative from Ohio faced current House Republican leader Rep. Steve Scalise of Louisiana in the election. Current House Speaker Mike Johnson chose not to seek re-election to a leadership position after last week's major losses to Democrats.
paras.zh: 这位来自俄亥俄州的代表在选举中面对的是现任众议院共和党领袖、路易斯安那州众议员史蒂夫·斯卡利斯(Steve Scalise)。现任众议院议长迈克·约翰逊在上周输给民主党后选择不寻求连任领导职位。

paras.en: NBC News and ABC News reported that only those who will be part of the new Congress in January were eligible to vote, not those retiring or ousted in last week's election.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻和 ABC 新闻报道称，只有那些将在一月份加入新国会的人才有资格投票，而那些在上周选举中退休或被驱逐的人则没有资格投票。

paras.en: Jordan was first elected to represent Ohio's 4th congressional district in 2007. He serves as chairman of the House Judiciary Committee and its Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government. He's also on the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform and its subcommittees -- health care, benefits and administrative rules; and government operations.
paras.zh: 乔丹于2007年首次当选为俄亥俄州第四国会选区的代表。他担任众议院司法委员会及其联邦政府武器化小组委员会的主席。他还是监督和政府改革委员会及其下属委员会的成员——医疗保健、福利和行政规则；和政府运作。

paras.en: Scalise has served as House majority leader since January 2023 and before that was Republican whip from 2014 until 2023. He's a member of the Committee on Energy and Commerce and sits on three subcommittees -- communication and technology, energy and power, and oversight and investigations.
paras.zh: 斯卡利斯自 2023 年 1 月起担任众议院多数党领袖，此前从 2014 年至 2023 年担任共和党党鞭。他是能源和商业委员会的成员，并担任三个小组委员会的成员：通信和技术、能源和电力以及监督和调查。

articles.title: U.S. moves military aircraft from British air base amid Iranian threat

paras.en: Nov. 10 (UPI) -- The United States moved more than a dozen military aircraft from an air base in Britain following reports of a possible threat from Iran, officials said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日（UPI）——官员们周二表示，在有报道称可能存在来自伊朗的威胁后，美国从英国的一个空军基地撤走了十几架军用飞机。

paras.en: At least eight aerial refueling tankers and three Osprey aircraft departed RAF Mildenhall in Suffolk, eastern England, on Monday, NBC News reported.
paras.zh: 据美国全国广播公司新闻报道，至少八架空中加油机和三架鱼鹰飞机周一从英格兰东部萨福克的皇家空军米尔登霍尔起飞。

paras.en: The tankers, including Boeing KC-135 Stratotankers, were relocated to military installations in Germany and Spain. One tanker was moved to the Glasgow Prestwick Airport area in Scotland.
paras.zh: 这些加油机，包括波音 KC-135 Stratotankers，被转移到德国和西班牙的军事设施。一艘油轮被转移到苏格兰格拉斯哥普雷斯蒂克机场地区。

paras.en: The Osprey aircraft were transferred to nearby RAF Lakenheath.
paras.zh: 鱼鹰飞机被转移到附近的英国皇家空军拉肯希思基地。

paras.en: A U.S. official confirmed the movements and said the base was operating under "enhanced force protection measures." The official declined to describe the nature of the threat.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员证实了这一动向，并表示该基地正在“加强部队保护措施”下运作。该官员拒绝描述威胁的性质。

paras.en: "We take proactive measures to ensure our aircraft, our people, and our installations remain safe and secure," the official told NBC News.
paras.zh: 这位官员告诉 NBC 新闻：“我们采取积极措施，确保我们的飞机、人员和设施保持安全。”

paras.en: RAF Mildenhall was placed under Force Protection Condition Charlie, the second-highest security alert level used by the U.S. military.
paras.zh: 英国皇家空军米尔登霍尔空军基地被置于查理部队保护状态下，这是美国军方使用的第二高安全警报级别。

paras.en: British officials said there was no immediate threat to the base or surrounding communities, The Guardian reported.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》报道，英国官员表示，基地或周边社区没有立即受到威胁。

paras.en: The British Ministry of Defense declined to comment on the movements, saying military aircraft regularly relocate according to operational needs.
paras.zh: 英国国防部拒绝对这些行动发表评论，称军用飞机根据作战需要定期转移。

paras.en: The latest redeployment comes weeks after the United States withdrew B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford following a suspected security incident linked to Iran.
paras.zh: 最近一次重新部署是在美国因涉​​嫌与伊朗有关的安全事件而从英国皇家空军费尔福德撤回 B-1 轰炸机几周后进行的。

paras.en: Five men were detained Sept. 27 after three suspicious vans were spotted traveling toward the base.
paras.zh: 9 月 27 日，三辆可疑货车被发现驶向基地，五名男子被拘留。

paras.en: Two men were later charged under Britain's National Security Act in connection with alleged assistance to Iranian intelligence.
paras.zh: 两名男子后来根据英国国家安全法被指控涉嫌协助伊朗情报。

paras.en: Iran has denied involvement in plots against British military installations. But the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps previously warned that bases used to launch attacks against Iran could be considered legitimate military targets.
paras.zh: 伊朗否认参与针对英国军事设施的阴谋。但伊斯兰革命卫队此前警告称，用于对伊朗发动袭击的基地可以被视为合法的军事目标。

paras.en: State Secretary Marco Rubio said Monday that Washington had taken steps to protect American diplomatic personnel overseas following reports of Iranian threats.
paras.zh: 国务卿马可·卢比奥周一表示，在接到伊朗威胁的报道后，华盛顿已采取措施保护美国海外外交人员。

paras.en: President Donald Trump downplayed the likelihood of renewed U.S. military strikes against Iran.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统淡化了美国再次对伊朗发动军事打击的可能性。

paras.en: "Iran militarily is effectively over," Trump told reporters.
paras.zh: 特朗普对记者说：“伊朗的军事行动实际上已经结束。”

articles.title: LISA of BLACKPINK to Release New Song ‘Leave With Me’ as ‘Always Lalisa’ Doc Heads to Streaming
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: LISA of BLACKPINK‘s documentary, Always Lalisa, and its end-credits song, “Leave With Me,” both finally have a release date on streaming services.
paras.zh: BLACKPINK 纪录片《Always Lalisa》中的 LISA 及其片尾曲《Leave With Me》终于在流媒体服务上确定了发行日期。

paras.en: As announced Tuesday (Nov. 10), the K-pop star will release her Sue Kim-directed film — which chronicled LISA’s life as she navigated her first year focusing on solo projects away from her girl group — on YouTube Premium on Nov. 18. That same day, “Leave With Me” will finally drop after fans first heard it during the end credits when Always Lalisa was in theaters.
paras.zh: 正如周二（11 月 10 日）宣布的那样，这位韩国流行歌星将于 11 月 18 日在 YouTube Premium 上发布她由 Sue Kim 执导的电影，该电影记录了 LISA 在离开女团后专注于个人项目的第一年的生活。同一天，粉丝们在《Always Lalisa》上映时在片尾字幕中首次听到这首歌后，《Leave With Me》最终将上映。

paras.en: The movie first premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September, shortly after Always Lalisa‘s destination on YouTube Premium was announced. Following the TIFF premiere, it opened in theaters and IMAX in October.
paras.zh: 就在《Always Lalisa》登陆 YouTube Premium 的消息公布后不久，这部电影于 9 月在多伦多国际电影节上首次首映。 TIFF 首映后，该片于 10 月在影院和 IMAX 影院上映。

paras.en: “Forging her own path, particularly in the Western music market, brings new pressures, relentless scrutiny and the challenge of redefining herself on her own terms,” a synopsis of the doc reads. “Intimate, emotional and revealing, Always Lalisa captures an artist at a crossroads, documenting a year of risk, reinvention and self-discovery as LISA begins to define not only her next chapter, but the woman and artist she wants to become.”
paras.zh: “开辟自己的道路，尤其是在西方音乐市场，会带来新的压力、无情的审查以及按照自己的方式重新定义自己的挑战，”该文件的摘要中写道。 “《Always Lalisa》亲密、情感丰富、富有启发性，捕捉到了一位处于十字路口的艺术家的身影，记录了 LISA 一年来的冒险、重塑和自我发现，她不仅开始定义她的下一个篇章，而且开始定义她想成为的女性和艺术家。”

paras.en: The White Lotus alum is now gearing up to play six November shows at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas for her Viva La Lisa residency. She’s currently fresh off the release of her Press Play EP, which featured lead single “SaWaDiKa” and debuted at No. 35 on the Billboard 200. Her debut solo LP, Alter Ego — which LISA made and released during her time away from BLACKPINK in 2025, as chronicled in her documentary — reached No. 7 on the albums chart.
paras.zh: 这位白莲花校友现在正准备在拉斯维加斯凯撒宫斗兽场举办 11 月的六场演出，以参加她的 Viva La Lisa 驻场演出。她目前刚刚发行了她的 Press Play EP，其中主打单曲“SaWaDiKa”首次亮相就在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第 35 位。她的首张个人 LP《Alter Ego》（正如她的纪录片中所记录的那样，是 LISA 在 2025 年离开 BLACKPINK 期间制作并发行的）在专辑排行榜上排名第七。

articles.title: Looking Ahead: A Release Calendar of Upcoming Albums in 2026
articles.author: Anna Chan

paras.en: Keeping track of all the upcoming releases from favorite artists can sometimes be a bit of a challenge. It’s not unusual for musicians to tease an album, then reveal a release date, only for the LP to be delayed for one reason or another (in some cases, multiple times), often without a new release date attached. Then there are albums that are announced mere days before they drop!
paras.zh: 跟踪最喜欢的艺术家的所有即将发布的作品有时可能是一个挑战。对于音乐家来说，先调侃一张专辑，然后透露发行日期，结果LP却因为这样或那样的原因被推迟（在某些情况下，多次），而且通常没有附加新的发行日期，这种情况并不罕见。还有一些专辑在发售前几天就宣布了！

paras.en: But we’ve got you! Musicians from across genres started teasing new projects and announcing album release dates for the new year as it barely started. And like the last several trips around the sun, we’re keeping a calendar to keep track of all the notable releases of the year.
paras.zh: 但我们有你！新年刚刚开始，来自不同流派的音乐家就开始酝酿新项目，并宣布新年专辑的发行日期。就像最近几次绕太阳旅行一样，我们保留了一个日历来跟踪今年所有值得注意的发布。

paras.en: One of the most highly anticipated releases was Hilary Duff’s Luck…or Something — her first album in 10 years — which dropped in February. The singer-actress first announced her return to music in September, when she revealed a new label deal with Atlantic Records, as well as new music and a docuseries that will follow her musical comeback.
paras.zh: 最受期待的专辑之一是希拉里·达芙 (Hilary Duff) 的《Luck…or Something》——她 10 年来的第一张专辑——于二月份发行。这位歌手兼女演员在九月份首次宣布重返音乐界，当时她透露了与大西洋唱片公司的新厂牌协议，以及她音乐回归后将推出的新音乐和系列纪录片。

paras.en: BTS also gave its ARMY news to celebrate just days after the new year kicked off. On Jan. 4, the K-pop supergroup revealed that its highly anticipated next album — which comes after the members took a yearslong break as a group to complete mandatory duties for the South Korean military and focus on solo ventures — would arrive in March.
paras.zh: 新年开始几天后，BTS 还发布了 ARMY 新闻来庆祝。 1 月 4 日，这个韩国流行音乐超级组合透露，其备受期待的下一张专辑将于 3 月发行，这张专辑是在成员们集体休息一年以完成韩国军队的强制性职责并专注于个人事业之后推出的。

paras.en: Not to be outdone, fellow K-pop supergroup BLACKPINK also announced its own new music in early January, with DEADLINE dropping in February. (Then in August, three of the ladies announced solo projects to arrive this year!)
paras.zh: 韩国流行超级组合 BLACKPINK 也不甘示弱，也在 1 月初宣布了自己的新音乐，截止日期将在 2 月确定。 （然后在八月，三位女士宣布了今年的个人项目！）

paras.en: Harry Styles then followed up BLACKPINK’s announcement the next day with his own album reveal. The pop superstar’s fourth studio album made its debut in March.
paras.zh: 第二天，Harry Styles 继 BLACKPINK 宣布之后发布了他自己的专辑。这位流行巨星的第四张录音室专辑于三月首次亮相。

paras.en: As winter moved into spring, women superstars not only teased, but announced highly anticipated albums. Among them? Madonna, Olivia Rodrigo and Ariana Grande, with all three projects arriving before the end of July.
paras.zh: 随着冬去春来，女明星们不仅调侃，还宣布了备受期待的专辑。他们之中？麦当娜 (Madonna)、奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 和阿丽亚娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande)，这三个项目均将于 7 月底前推出。

paras.en: As September rolled around, some big names in rock released their projects. Among them are Anthrax and Rage Against the Machine’s Tom Morello, while October will anticipate an album by Nickelback, as well as iconic industrial band Ministry, who returns with its final album. And before the end of the month, Miley Cyrus returned with Bass Persuades.
paras.zh: 随着九月的到来，一些摇滚界的大腕发布了他们的项目。其中包括 Anthrax 和 Rage Against the Machine 的 Tom Morello，而 Nickelback 将于 10 月推出专辑，标志性工业乐队 Ministry 也将携最后一张专辑回归。月底前，麦莉·赛勒斯 (Miley Cyrus) 携 Bass Persuades 回归。

paras.en: But the biggest surprise was yet to come. Taylor Swift revealed on Sept. 22 that she had a new song titled “Patient Zero” coming before the end of the month. Less than 24 hours later, she surprised Swifties with the news that not only was there a new track coming, but The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore, featuring not just one new song, but four.
paras.zh: 但最大的惊喜尚未到来。泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 于 9 月 22 日透露，她将在月底前推出一首名为“零号病人”的新歌。不到 24 小时后，她让 Swifties 惊讶地发现，不仅有一首新歌即将推出，而且《The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore》不仅收录了一首新歌，还收录了四首新歌。

paras.en: As fall swept in with a chill, the anticipation was hot … for Grand Theft Auto 6. The highly anticipated video game announced that there would be two music releases: a soundtrack featuring the likes of Cardi B, Travis Scott, Keith Richards, Rauw Alejandro, Morgan Wallen and more. On top of that, Justice had helmed the score. Both would arrive before year’s end.
paras.zh: 随着秋天的寒意袭来，人们对《侠盗猎车手 6》的期待越来越高。这款备受期待的视频游戏宣布将推出两首音乐：由 Cardi B、Travis Scott、Keith Richards、Rauw Alejandro、Morgan Wallen 等人主演的原声带。最重要的是，正义掌控了比分。两者都将在年底前到达。

paras.en: That’s just several of the big releases of 2026. To help you stay on top of it all, we’ve organized this calendar chronologically by month and week, and have also included a section for albums that have been announced, but do not yet have a release date.
paras.zh: 这只是 2026 年的几个重大发行。为了帮助您掌握所有信息，我们按月和周按时间顺序组织了此日历，并且还包含已宣布但尚未确定发行日期的专辑的部分。

paras.en: Keep checking back for the latest 2026 album release dates!

articles.title: Drake Says He ‘Probably’ Won’t Perform This Rihanna Collab at His Shows Anymore
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: Drake is expected to hit the road for a world tour in 2027, but the OVO faithful shouldn’t expect him to perform his “Take Care” collaboration with Rihanna anymore.
paras.zh: Drake 预计将于 2027 年踏上世界巡演之路，但 OVO 的忠实粉丝不应再指望他会再与 Rihanna 合作表演“Take Care”。

paras.en: Drizzy joined Trainwreckstv’s Kick livestream over the weekend, which found him singing along to “Take Care,” but he assured fans this is “probably” the only place they’d hear him perform lyrics from the top 10 Billboard Hot 100 hit again.
paras.zh: Drizzy 周末参加了 Trainwreckstv 的 Kick 直播，他跟着唱了《Take Care》，但他向粉丝保证，这“可能”是他们再次听到他演唱 Billboard Hot 100 前 10 名歌曲歌词的唯一地方。

paras.en: “This the only performance you’re getting of this song probably, but s–t, welcome to Trainwreckstv, baby,” he said. “Oh my God, man.”
paras.zh: “这可能是你对这首歌的唯一表演，但是，欢迎来到 Trainwreckstv，宝贝，”他说。 “天哪，伙计。”

paras.en: “Take Care” landed on Drake’s 2011 classic album of the same name, and the Rihanna-assisted track reached No. 7 on the Hot 100 in 2012. According to Complex, Drizzy hasn’t performed the cut since 2017.
paras.zh: 《Take Care》收录在 Drake 2011 年的同名经典专辑中，这首由蕾哈娜 (Rihanna) 协助的歌曲在 2012 年热门 100 强单曲中排名第七。 据 Complex 报道，Drizzy 自 2017 年以来就没有表演过这首歌曲。

paras.en: Drake and Ri have enjoyed a fruitful partnership over the years. After being linked romantically in the first half of the 2010s, they also teamed up for Hot 100 No. 1 hits such as “What’s My Name?” and “Work” as well as “Too Good.”
paras.zh: Drake 和 Ri 多年来一直保持着富有成效的合作关系。在 2010 年代上半叶恋爱之后，他们还联手制作了《我叫什么名字？》等热门 100 首热门歌曲。和“工作”以及“太好了”。

paras.en: However, their relationship has deteriorated over the course of the last decade, as Drake has been clashing with Ri’s partner, A$AP Rocky, whom she shares three children; it has only further fractured any chance of reconciliation.
paras.zh: 然而，他们的关系在过去十年中不断恶化，因为德雷克一直与 Ri 的伴侣 A$AP Rocky 发生冲突，她与她育有三个孩子；它只会进一步破坏和解的机会。

paras.en: Rocky caught strays from Drake during the latter’s war with Kendrick Lamar on Drizzy’s three-part “Family Matters” diss track. The Harlem native sent shots in Drake’s direction on tracks such as Don’t Be Dumb‘s “Stole Ya Flow” as well as We Still Don’t Trust You‘s “Show of Hands,” and J. Cole’s “Ruby Rosary.”
paras.zh: 在德雷克 (Drake) 与肯德里克·拉马尔 (Kendrick Lamar) 的战争期间，洛基 (Rocky) 在 Drizzy 的三部分“Family Matters” diss 曲目中发现了德雷克 (Drake) 的踪迹。这位哈莱姆本地人在 Don’t Be Dumb 的“Stole Ya Flow”、We Still Don't Trust You 的“Show of Hands”和 J. Cole 的“Ruby Rosary”等曲目中向 Drake 的方向发出了镜头。

paras.en: The Mob frontman also addressed his disdain for Drake in a January interview with Apple Music, but clarified it’s “not real smoke” between them. “This thing between us it’s not real smoke, but I just don’t f–k with him,” Rocky said at the time. “We was once friends. I feel like it’s over females. I feel like he wasn’t happy and he expressed that.”
paras.zh: 这位 Mob 主唱在一月份接受 Apple Music 采访时也表达了他对 Drake 的蔑视，但澄清说他们之间“并非真正的烟雾”。 “我们之间的事情不是真正的烟雾，但我只是不和他在一起，”洛基当时说道。 “我们曾经是朋友。我觉得女性已经结束了。我觉得他不高兴，他表达了这一点。”

paras.en: He continued: “I think at some certain point and everyone getting older and you supposed to be moving on. For you to be picking at a female, that’s soft to me. I didn’t put out music for me to say something back and I finally did say something back to a few people. I do think that s–t is petty. It’s enough money, fame, women, spotlights to go around. We not really tripping off nothing. Is it real smoke? It could never be. That ain’t real smoke.”
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“我认为在某个时刻，每个人都在变老，你应该继续前进。你对女性挑剔，这对我来说很温柔。我没有放音乐让我回嘴，但我最终还是对一些人回话了。我确实认为这很琐碎。有足够的金钱、名誉、女人、聚光灯来四处走动。我们并不是真的什么都不会绊倒。这是真正的烟雾吗？它永远不会是。那不是真的。抽烟。”

paras.en: Fans also have speculated that Drizzy was throwing shade in Rihanna’s direction on For All the Dogs‘ “Fear of Heights.”
paras.zh: 粉丝们还猜测，Drizzy 为 For All the Dogs 的《恐高症》（For All the Dogs）的方向蒙上了阴影。

paras.en: “Why they make it sound like I’m still hung up on you/ That could never be,” he sings on the 2023 track. “Gyal can’t ruin me/ Better him than me, better it’s not me/ I’m anti, I’m anti/ Yeah, and the sex was average with you/ Yeah, I’m anti ’cause I had it with you/ OK, I’m auntie like your daddy sister/ Auntie like a family picture/ And I had way badder b—hes than you, TBH/ Yeah, that man, he still with you, he can’t leave you/ Y’all go on vacation, I bet it’s Antilles.”
paras.zh: “为什么他们听起来我仍然对你念念不忘/那永远不可能，”他在 2023 年的歌曲中唱道。 “Gyal 不能毁了我/他比我更好，最好不是我/我反对，我反对/是的，性爱对你来说很一般/是的，我反对因为我和你在一起/好吧，我是像你爸爸姐姐一样的阿姨/像全家福一样的阿姨/而且我比你更糟糕，说实话/是的，那个男人，他仍然和你在一起，他不能离开你/你们大家去度假吧，我打赌那是安的列斯群岛。”

paras.en: When Drake is back outside for his first North American run since 2023, he probably won’t be performing his “Work” collab with Rihanna either.
paras.zh: 当 Drake 重返户外进行他自 2023 年以来的首次北美跑步时，他可能也不会与蕾哈娜 (Rihanna) 合作表演“工作”。

paras.en: “I don’t sing this song anymore. You can sing it for me,” Drake told the crowd at a Tampa Bay show in February 2024.
paras.zh: “我不再唱这首歌了。你们可以唱给我听，”Drake 在 2024 年 2 月坦帕湾的一场演出中对观众说道。

articles.title: James Dean Biopic Casts ‘Half Man’ Actor Mitchell Robertson as Star’s Purported Gay Lover (Exclusive)
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: A planned biopic focusing on James Dean‘s personal life has found its co-lead.
paras.zh: 一部聚焦詹姆斯·迪恩个人生活的传记片已找到联合主演。

paras.en: Mitchell Robertson, the Scottish actor known for a breakout performance on Netflix’s Half Man, has been cast in writer-director Guy Guido’s indie film One Hand Tied, The Hollywood Reporter has learned. Robertson will play the star’s close friend and UCLA roommate Bill Bast and joins Brandon Flynn, who was previously announced as playing Dean.
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》获悉，苏格兰演员米切尔·罗伯逊 (Mitchell Robertson) 因在 Netflix 的《半人》(Half Man) 中的突破性表演而闻名，他将出演编剧兼导演盖伊·吉多 (Guy Guido) 的独立电影《单手绑》(One Hand Tied)。罗伯逊将饰演这位明星的密友和加州大学洛杉矶分校的室友比尔·巴斯特，并与此前宣布饰演迪恩的布兰登·弗林一起出演。

paras.en: Formerly known as Willie and Jimmy Dean, One Hand Tied adapts Bast’s 2006 memoir, Surviving James Dean. In his book, Bast described meeting Dean at the UCLA theater program at the age of 19 and wrote that the two men became roommates, close friends and eventually lovers. Bast claimed they kept their fling private to avoid hurting Dean’s career while the rising star had relationships with female stars, with Bast remaining hopeful that he and Dean would soon live together again.
paras.zh: 《One Hand Tied》原名威利和吉米·迪恩，改编自巴斯特 2006 年的回忆录《幸存的詹姆斯·迪恩》。巴斯特在书中描述了 19 岁时在加州大学洛杉矶分校戏剧项目中与迪恩的相遇，并写道，两人成为室友、亲密朋友，最终成为恋人。巴斯特声称，他们将这段恋情保密是为了避免损害迪恩的事业，而这位后起之秀的明星与女明星都有关系，巴斯特仍然希望他和迪恩很快就能再次同居。

paras.en: Five years after meeting Bast, Dean died in a car accident in 1955 at the age of 24, with two of his signature films, Rebel Without a Cause and Giant, released posthumously. His only movie released before his death was 1955’s East of Eden, which is back in the zeitgeist following the recent release of Netflix’s limited series that also adapts John Steinbeck’s novel.
paras.zh: 认识巴斯特五年后，迪恩于 1955 年因车祸去世，享年 24 岁，他的两部代表作《无因的反叛》和《巨人》在死后上映。他生前上映的唯一一部电影是 1955 年的《伊甸之东》，继最近上映的 Netflix 限定剧（同样改编自约翰·斯坦贝克的小说）之后，该片又重新回到了时代精神。

paras.en: Guido’s script is set from the first meeting between Bill Bast and Dean to the actor’s death on Sept. 30, 1955. Guido spoke to Bast in 2011, four years before his death at age 84. The film will focus on Bast and Dean navigating their evolving relationship and Bast coming to terms with being gay during the 1950s.
paras.zh: 吉多的剧本从比尔·巴斯特和迪恩第一次见面到迪恩于 1955 年 9 月 30 日去世。吉多在 2011 年与巴斯特进行了交谈，四年后他去世，享年 84 岁。这部电影将重点讲述巴斯特和迪恩如何处理他们不断发展的关系，以及巴斯特在 20 世纪 50 年代接受自己是同性恋的故事。

paras.en: Producers include Steven J. Wolfe, known for such projects as (500) Days of Summer, and Flavia Amon, who spent 21 years at Fox Searchlight. Wolfe and Guido are continuing to cast the remaining roles, including the prominent part of Bast’s mother, Beatrice. Guido previously directed the Hulu feature Madonna and the Breakfast Club.
paras.zh: 制片人包括因《夏日的 500 天》等项目而闻名的史蒂文·J·沃尔夫 (Steven J. Wolfe) 和在福克斯探照灯 (Fox Searchlight) 工作了 21 年的弗拉维娅·阿蒙 (Flavia Amon)。沃尔夫和吉多正在继续挑选剩下的角色，其中包括巴斯特母亲比阿特丽斯的重要角色。吉多此前曾执导过 Hulu 专题片《麦当娜与早餐俱乐部》。

paras.en: Guido has heard a mixture of reactions from the public in the time since THR first broke the news about the feature. “James Dean has been romanticized and mythologized for more than 70 years, and I think people have become very attached to a particular image of him: the rebellious, brooding, heterosexual heartthrob with a cigarette dangling from his mouth,” he tells THR. “For some, the suggestion that his sexuality may have been more complex than that challenges a fantasy they’ve held onto for decades. But others are genuinely excited by the possibility of seeing a more layered, vulnerable and more dimensional James Dean — someone who wasn’t necessarily confined to the identity Hollywood created for him. And that’s what really interests me. I’m not looking to completely redefine him, but I am looking to explore the human being who existed beyond the mythology.”
paras.zh: 自从 THR 首次爆料有关该功能的消息以来，Guido 听到了公众的不同反应。 “70 多年来，詹姆斯·迪恩一直被浪漫化和神话化，我认为人们已经非常迷恋他的一个特定形象：叛逆、沉思、嘴里叼着香烟的异性恋万人迷，”他告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “对于一些人来说，他的性取向可能比这更复杂，这挑战了他们几十年来一直坚持的幻想。但另一些人则真正感到兴奋，因为有可能看到一个更有层次、更脆弱、更有维度的詹姆斯·迪恩——一个不一定局限于好莱坞为他创造的身份的人。这才是我真正感兴趣的地方。我并不是想完全重新定义他，而是想探索神话之外存在的人。”

paras.en: Robertson played the younger version of Jamie Bell’s character in Half Man and can soon be seen in the BBC drama Counsels. “The moment I saw him in Half Man, I knew he was the one,” says Guido. “I was looking for vulnerability and an innate likability, but also strength. Bill lived in a time that was hostile to anyone even perceived as gay, yet he sustained a five-year roller-coaster relationship with James Dean. That takes resilience.”
paras.zh: 罗伯逊在《半人》中扮演了杰米·贝尔年轻版的角色，很快就可以在 BBC 电视剧《律师》中看到。 “当我在《半人》中看到他的那一刻，我就知道他就是那个人，”吉多说。 “我在寻找脆弱性和与生俱来的可爱性，但也有力量。比尔生活在一个对任何人都充满敌意的时代，甚至被认为是同性恋，但他与詹姆斯·迪恩维持了五年过山车般的关系。这需要韧性。”

paras.en: For his part, Robertson notes, “Guy has crafted a beautifully tender script that steps past the image of the icon and brings to life the human behind it. Through Bill’s eyes, we see James Dean before his name was in lights, before the famous red jacket with the upturned collar. We see him flawed, ambitious and, ultimately, as a young man bursting with love for his friend.”
paras.zh: 罗伯逊指出，“盖伊精心设计了一个美丽而温柔的剧本，超越了偶像的形象，让其背后的人栩栩如生。通过比尔的眼睛，我们看到詹姆斯·迪恩在他的名字出现在灯光下之前，在著名的翻领红色夹克之前。我们看到他有缺陷，雄心勃勃，最终，作为一个对他的朋友充满爱的年轻人。”

paras.en: Wolfe says of Robertson’s audition, “His performance was so beautiful and authentic, it felt as if I were watching dailies from the actual production. I can’t imagine anyone more fitting and worthy of this role.”
paras.zh: 沃尔夫在谈到罗伯逊的试镜时说道：“他的表演如此美丽和真实，感觉就像我在观看实际制作的样片。我无法想象还有谁比他更适合、更配得上这个角色。”

paras.en: Flynn’s previous credits include True Detective, 13 Reasons Why and The Parenting. He makes his Broadway debut this fall with Here There Are Blueberries.
paras.zh: 弗林之前的作品包括《真探》、《十三个原因》和《育儿》。今年秋天，他将在百老汇首演《Here There Are Blueberry》。

paras.en: Robertson is represented by Taylor Jefferson at The Artists Partnership and Maryam Hunwick at Hunwick Associates.
paras.zh: 罗伯逊的代表是 The Artists Partnership 的 Taylor Jefferson 和 Hunwick Associates 的 Maryam Hunwick。

articles.title: Ezra Sosa Reflects on “Bittersweet” ‘DWTS’ Elimination, Working With Julia Stiles and Who He Wants to Win Season 35 (Exclusive)
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Ezra Sosa completed his third season as a Dancing With the Stars professional dancer last Tuesday. He and Julia Stiles were eliminated from season 35, but Sosa is more than content with how things played out.
paras.zh: 上周二，埃兹拉·索萨完成了他作为与星共舞职业舞者的第三个赛季。他和朱莉娅·斯蒂尔斯在第 35 季中被淘汰，但索萨对事情的发展感到非常满意。

paras.en: “I feel very content with my season with Julia,” he tells The Hollywood Reporter. “I’m just gonna miss her.”
paras.zh: “我对与朱莉娅在一起的这一季感到非常满意，”他告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我只是会想念她。”

paras.en: Sosa joined the DWTS pro cast two years ago when he was partnered with Anna Delvey, and infamously was eliminated first from the show’s 33rd season. From there, he partnered with Olympic gold medalist Jordan Chiles and finished in third place during last year’s season 34.
paras.zh: 索萨两年前加入了 DWTS 职业演员阵容，当时他与安娜·德尔维 (Anna Delvey) 搭档，但臭名昭著的是在该剧第 33 季中首先被淘汰。此后，他与奥运会金牌得主乔丹·奇利斯搭档，并在去年的第 34 赛季中获得第三名。

paras.en: Sosa is a star on-and-off the ballroom floor, being regarded as one of the first pros to reintroduce the online audience to DWTS alongside Rylee Arnold. Now, after capping off his third season with movie star Stiles, Sosa has more than an understanding on what it takes to be a pro; he embodies the essence of what it means to be a DWTS professional dancer, possessing the dance skills and social media savviness needed to lead the show.
paras.zh: Sosa 是舞厅内外的明星，被认为是第一批与 Rylee Arnold 一起向在线观众重新引入 DWTS 的职业选手之一。现在，在与电影明星斯泰尔斯一起结束了他的第三个赛季后，索萨不仅了解了如何成为一名职业选手，而且还了解了如何成为一名职业选手。他体现了 DWTS 专业舞者的精髓，拥有领导表演所需的舞蹈技巧和社交媒体悟性。

paras.en: Below, Sosa exclusively chats with THR after he and Stiles’ season 35 elimination, breaks down how their 10 Things I Hate About You cast reunion came about, how he manages the growing fan criticism about the show, and who he’s rooting for the win the Len Goodman mirrorball trophy.
paras.zh: 下面，索萨在他和斯泰尔斯第 35 季被淘汰后接受了《THR》独家采访，详细分析了他们的《我讨厌你的十件事》演员重聚是如何发生的、他如何应对粉丝对这部剧日益增长的批评，以及他支持谁赢得伦·古德曼镜球奖杯。

paras.en: What have the past few days been like for you post elimination?
paras.zh: 淘汰后的这几天你过得怎么样？

paras.en: It’s very interesting, because I’m a very single girly, so I feel like the only relationships I do defer to are the ones that I’ve maintained throughout the show. The day after [being eliminated] just feels like a breakup. That’s literally the only way to describe it.
paras.zh: 这很有趣，因为我是一个非常单身的女孩，所以我觉得我唯一尊重的关系就是我在整个节目中维持的关系。 [被淘汰]后的第二天感觉就像分手了。从字面上看，这是描述它的唯一方法。

paras.en: I feel very content with my season with Julia. Like, yes, we could have made it farther, but also, we had such strong moments. I’m just gonna miss her. I feel like that first day [after being eliminated,] we got our tattoos, we said our goodbyes. It was a very bittersweet day, but also was a nice day to reflect on the whole season.
paras.zh: 我对与朱莉娅一起度过的赛季感到非常满意。就像，是的，我们本可以走得更远，但同时，我们也有过如此强烈的时刻。我只是会想念她。我觉得（被淘汰后）第一天，我们就纹了纹身，我们告别了。这是苦乐参半的一天，但也是反思整个赛季的好日子。

paras.en: Now, after each season, you have this tradition of getting a tattoo. Why is it important for you to continue that tradition?
paras.zh: 现在，每个季节过后，你都会有纹身的传统。为什么延续这一传统对您来说很重要？

paras.en: I feel like it just happened to become a tradition. I feel like with Anna Delvey, I wanted to have fun with the bit, and with Jordan [Chiles], she already has tattoos, so I feel like it was a comment, “OK, let’s get tattoos.” And the same with Julia, but actually Julia wanted to do it because she is a fan of the show and a fan of mine, so I feel like it was part of her dream inspo to be on Dancing With the Stars and get matching tattoos with me. I feel like that’s really cool to even say and do.
paras.zh: 我觉得这恰好成为了一种传统。我觉得和安娜·德尔维在一起，我想玩得开心，而和乔丹[智利]在一起，她已经有纹身了，所以我觉得这是一条评论，“好吧，让我们纹身吧。”朱莉娅也一样，但实际上朱莉娅想这么做，因为她是这个节目的粉丝，也是我的粉丝，所以我觉得参加与星共舞并与我一起纹身是她梦想的一部分。我觉得说起来和做起来都非常酷。

paras.en: I also feel like it’s a great way to find closure within your season, but also have something to remember the season. I’m very passionate about every single season I’ve been on as a pro, so for me, it’s a way to be proud of the work that I did.
paras.zh: 我也觉得这是在你的赛季中找到结束的好方法，但也有一些值得记住的赛季。我对作为职业球员参加的每个赛季都充满热情，所以对我来说，这是为我所做的工作感到自豪的一种方式。

paras.en: You penned such a beautiful tribute in honor of Julia. Can you open up about what was different about this season with Julia?
paras.zh: 你为朱莉娅写下了如此美丽的敬意。你能谈谈这一季与朱莉娅的不同之处吗？

paras.en: Julia is a class act. I’ve never met someone with such star power like Julia. She still is a superstar, but at the height of her career, that was a time in Hollywood that wasn’t on social media, so it was very interesting to collaborate with her on so many different things, including social media. It really was so special.
paras.zh: 朱莉娅是一位一流的演员。我从未见过像朱莉娅这样拥有如此明星影响力的人。她仍然是一位超级巨星，但在她职业生涯的鼎盛时期，那是好莱坞没有社交媒体的时期，所以与她在许多不同的事情上合作非常有趣，包括社交媒体。真的很特别。

paras.en: This is your third season on the show, but you have really tapped into the professional part of the word “professional dancer”. What has it been like growing as a pro these past three seasons? It feels like you have a nail on what it means to be a pro dancer in the new era of Dancing With the Stars.
paras.zh: 这是你在节目中的第三季，但你确实充分利用了“专业舞者”这个词的专业部分。在过去的三个赛季中，作为一名职业球员的成长有何感受？感觉就像你已经掌握了在与星共舞的新时代成为一名职业舞者意味着什么。

paras.en: Well, thank you so much. That means a lot. For me, it’s ultimately about catering the best experience for your partner. Throughout every partnership I’ve had, I’ve also adapted and changed because I am a person that’s constantly learning and growing. With every single partner — and I mean every partner I’ve had — I’ve taken little life lessons that have adjusted the way I look at life, the way I look at dance, and I think that’s a beautiful part of being a reoccurring thing on Dancing With the Stars.
paras.zh: 嗯，非常感谢。这意味着很多。对我来说，最终的目的是为您的伴侣提供最好的体验。在我的每一次合作中，我也不断适应和改变，因为我是一个不断学习和成长的人。与每一个舞伴——我的意思是我拥有的每一个舞伴——我都学到了一些人生课程，这些课程调整了我看待生活的方式，我看待舞蹈的方式，我认为这是在《与星共舞》中反复出现的美好部分。

paras.en: I never want to be the same person every single season, so it’s cool to see how I went from unhinged Anna to completely 180 with Julia, giving all this nostalgia in the world. With Julia, she taught me so, so much about, I mean, professionalism is a light way to say it, but she is a true professional.
paras.zh: 我不想每一季都变成同一个人，所以很高兴看到我如何从精神错乱的安娜变成了和朱莉娅完全 180 度，给世界带来了所有的怀旧之情。与朱莉娅一起，她教会了我很多关于专业精神的知识，我的意思是，专业精神是一种轻松的表达方式，但她是一位真正的专业人士。

paras.en: Can you clarify; were you part-time living in New York and flying back-and-forth for the shows in L.A.?
paras.zh: 你能澄清一下吗？您是在纽约兼职居住并往返于洛杉矶观看演出吗？

paras.en: Yeah, so it depends on the week. Some weeks we had to be in L.A., like the group dance, we obviously wanted to be here. I loved the fact that Julia just wanted to be with her kids and family [in New York]. I feel like that was a really big thing for her to do the show. I feel like she kind of felt bad for me to be flying back and forth, but I told her, “Whatever is going to give you more ease every single day, I will gladly bend my back for you,” because again, it’s all about their experience on the show.
paras.zh: 是的，所以这取决于星期。有几周我们必须在洛杉矶，就像集体舞会一样，我们显然想来这里。我喜欢朱莉娅只想与她的孩子和家人（在纽约）在一起。我觉得这对她来说是一件非常重要的事情。我觉得她对我来来回回的飞行感到有点难过，但我告诉她，“无论什么能让你每天更轻松，我都会很乐意为你弯腰，”因为再说一次，这都是关于他们在节目中的经历。

paras.en: That had to have been a huge part of the season for you guys, going back and forth and having to travel. Why do you think that wasn’t highlighted on the show? Because fans online [somewhat] knew, but it wasn’t really showcased in your story on the show.
paras.zh: 对于你们来说，这一定是这个赛季的重要组成部分，来来回回，不得不旅行。您认为为什么节目中没有强调这一点？因为网上的粉丝[在某种程度上]知道，但并没有真正在你的节目故事中展示出来。

paras.en: (Laughs.) I’m honestly not sure. I don’t really know what production, like what their motives are. But I definitely feel like when it came to those weeks [when we were traveling] for us specifically, Julia and I, it was more important to talk about the intention of the dance or what we wanted to talk about in our package that week. And majority of times, it didn’t really necessarily come to us [talking about] traveling back and forth.
paras.zh: （笑）老实说我也不确定。我真的不知道他们的生产是什么，他们的动机是什么。但我绝对觉得，对于我们（朱莉娅和我）来说（当我们旅行时），更重要的是谈论舞蹈的意图或我们在那周的包裹中想要谈论的内容。大多数时候，我们并不一定会谈论来回旅行。

paras.en: You choreographed two numbers this season that honored these two major movies. What was that experience like choreographing those numbers in honor of these movies?
paras.zh: 本季你编排了两段节目来纪念这两部主要电影。为了纪念这些电影而编排这些数字是一种怎样的体验？

paras.en: A moment I’ll never forget is at the end of her dedication performance, just seeing her reunited with the 10 Things I Hate About You cast. I remember sitting there, full body chills, and just thinking to myself, Oh, this is for sure my peak. There’s nothing that can top this. But even for someone like me who was a huge fan of those movies, it was so important to have so much care behind those two pieces. Ultimately, they became some of my favorite routines that I’ll ever have the chance to perform on Dancing With the Stars, and in general. It’s really cool to be a part of something that I think the ballroom will never forget for years to come.
paras.zh: 我永远不会忘记的那一刻是在她的奉献表演结束时，看到她与《我讨厌你的十件事》演员们重聚。我记得坐在那里，全身发冷，心想，哦，这肯定是我的巅峰。没有什么可以超越这一点。但即使对于像我这样的电影超级粉丝来说，在这两部电影背后付出如此多的关怀也是非常重要的。最终，它们成为我最喜欢的一些套路，我将有机会在《与星共舞》中表演这些套路。能够成为舞厅未来几年永远不会忘记的事情的一部分真是太酷了。

paras.en: Whose idea was that to do the 10 Things I Hate About You cast reunion? Was it you? Was it Julia? Was production?
paras.zh: 《我讨厌你的十件事》演员重聚是谁出主意的？是你吗？是朱莉娅吗？是生产的吗？

paras.en: It was Julia. Production opened up Dedication Night so the person [being paid tribute in the dance] could have been passed. It was really important to us to do this dedication performance, not just to Heath, but to that time of her life and filming 10 Things I Hate About You, but we had to think of a person that kind of tied it in. And they’re like, “Were there writers?” I’m looking at her, I was like, “Was there someone in the cast?” She goes, “It has to be the whole cast.” And from there, she started working. She started reaching out to everybody, and Joseph Gordon-Levitt said yes. After that, everyone kind of fell into place.
paras.zh: 是朱莉娅。制作开启了奉献之夜，这样[在舞蹈中受到致敬]的人就可以被通过。对我们来说，进行这场奉献表演非常重要，不仅是为了希斯，还为了她生命中的那段时光，以及拍摄《我讨厌你的十件事》，但我们必须想到一个能将这一切联系起来的人。他们会问，“有编剧吗？”我看着她，心里想：“演员中有没有人？”她说：“必须是全体演员。”从那时起，她开始工作。她开始联系每个人，约瑟夫·高登-莱维特答应了。之后，大家就都各就各位了。

paras.en: Are you able to share what song you would have performed to for Grammy night?
paras.zh: 你能分享一下你会在格莱美之夜表演哪首歌吗？

paras.en: It was going to be an Adele song. We were very excited about it because she notoriously doesn’t really clear much [of her music for usage], so it was truly an honor for us to get that clearance. The rumba would have been such a beautiful routine, but you know, just wasn’t in the cards for us. And I’m sure everything happens for a reason.
paras.zh: 这将是一首阿黛尔的歌。我们对此感到非常兴奋，因为众所周知，她并没有真正清除太多[她的音乐的使用]，所以我们真的很荣幸获得许可。伦巴本来是一个非常美妙的例行公事，但你知道，这对我们来说是不可能的。我确信一切的发生都是有原因的。

paras.en: What do you think was your favorite number you and Julia performed?
paras.zh: 你认为你和朱莉娅最喜欢表演的曲目是哪一首？

paras.en: It’s hard just to pick one, but I think personally, the “Jenny from the Block” routine was such a fun routine, such a great way to get Julia accustomed to the ballroom. But also, like, should there have been jazz in that routine? Absolutely, but [it was fun] just to do something for the millennials. Like, the intention of it wasn’t necessarily for the ballroom, it was like a love letter for all the millennials. That was a really fun idea to come up with. We were originally supposed to do another style that week, and we were gonna reference her movie Save the Last Dance that week.
paras.zh: 很难选择一个，但我个人认为，“来自街区的珍妮”例程非常有趣，是让朱莉娅习惯舞厅的好方法。但同时，那个例行公事中应该有爵士乐吗？当然，但是[这很有趣]只是为千禧一代做点什么。就像，它的目的不一定是为了舞厅，它就像一封写给所有千禧一代的情书。这是一个非常有趣的想法。我们原本应该那周做另一种风格，那周我们要参考她的电影《拯救最后一支舞》。

paras.en: There’s just so many eyes on DWTS right now, and with that comes a lot of criticisms and conversations about the show. Is there any conversation in particular that has been sparked this season that has particularly stood out to you?
paras.zh: 现在有很多人关注 DWTS，随之而来的是对该节目的大量批评和讨论。本季引发的任何对话对您来说特别引人注目吗？

paras.en: I definitely feel like everyone loves their opinions on Dancing With the Stars, and we, of course, being a public show, wed allow it and we love it, and we love hearing the audiences’ reactions to the show. But there has been a part of the season that kind of felt a little bit heavier, and maybe it’s because the pros are too lethal at their jobs. I feel like the expectation when it comes to delivering these numbers is just extra high, and that pressure was definitely felt this season amongst everyone in the cast.
paras.zh: 我绝对觉得每个人都喜欢他们对与星共舞的看法，当然，我们作为一个公共节目，我们允许它，我们喜欢它，我们喜欢听到观众对节目的反应。但本赛季的某些时候，感觉有点沉重，也许是因为职业选手在他们的工作中太致命了。我觉得在提供这些数字方面的期望非常高，而且本赛季演员阵容中的每个人都感受到了这种压力。

paras.en: But in a weird way, when it came to all the outside noise, and this is, I feel like, the silver lining between it all, it brought us closer together behind the scenes. I can confidently say we have not been this close. All the pros have rehearsals at seven in the morning, and you think seven in the morning with your coworkers is your biggest nightmare, but it is genuinely one thing that I look forward to every single week. We all just get to recap our weeks, and there’s no other person that can relate to what we go through than each other.
paras.zh: 但以一种奇怪的方式，当谈到所有外界噪音时，我觉得这就是这一切之间的一线希望，它让我们在幕后更加紧密地联系在一起。我可以自信地说我们还没有如此接近。所有职业选手都在早上七点进行排练，你认为早上七点和你的同事在一起是你最大的噩梦，但这确实是我每周都期待的一件事。我们都只是回顾一下这几周的经历，没有人比彼此更能理解我们所经历的事情。

paras.en: So I feel like yes, the outside noise has been a little bit louder, and it has their opinions, and yes, those things are very hard for us to deal with because it is a stress that all of us go through on the show. It’s kind of beautiful to see how it genuinely did bring us all together.
paras.zh: 所以我觉得是的，外界的噪音有点大，有他们的意见，是的，这些事情对我们来说很难处理，因为这是我们所有人在节目中都要经历的压力。看到它如何真正将我们大家聚集在一起真是太美好了。

paras.en: How early do you start preparation for tour?
paras.zh: 你多久开始准备旅行？

paras.en: Actually, pretty early. I think we have 10 days off between season [35] ends and the tour [prep] starts. It’s very important to make sure when we go out there on the road, the show is absolutely spectacular. So our rehearsal process is a pretty long process, but I also think it’s long so it’s less harder on our bodies. I’m really excited for tour. It’s gonna be so awesome. All arenas, Madison Square Garden, sold out.
paras.zh: 其实还蛮早的我想我们在赛季 [35] 结束和巡演 [准备] 开始之间有 10 天的休息时间。确保当我们外出时，演出绝对壮观，这一点非常重要。所以我们的排练过程是一个相当长的过程，但我也觉得时间长所以对我们的身体来说不那么困难。我对巡演感到非常兴奋。这将会非常棒。麦迪逊广场花园的所有场馆均已售罄。

paras.en: Now that you are eliminated, who are you rooting for to win the mirrorball?
paras.zh: 既然你被淘汰了，你支持谁赢得镜子球呢？

paras.en: It’s no shade to the male celebrities on the show because they’re absolutely great; I’m a queen, so I’m gonna be supporting my girls. I feel like being in the group dance with Tatyana [Ali], Amber [Glenn] and Maura [Higgins] — and obviously, we felt like this [reaches arm out] with Jenna Dewan, like, You’re with us! You’re with the girlies! — it was nice to see all of them bond together and have shared, similar experiences on the show. After that, I’m like, girl, I’m rooting for you all. I’m rooting for all my girlies, but I still have much love for the male celebrities on the show.
paras.zh: 这对节目中的男明星来说并不逊色，因为他们绝对很棒。我是女王，所以我会支持我的女儿们。我感觉就像和塔蒂亚娜（阿里）、安布尔（格伦）和莫拉（希金斯）一起参加集体舞——显然，我们感觉就像和珍娜·迪万（伸出手臂）一样，就像，你和我们在一起！你和少女们在一起！ - 很高兴看到他们所有人在节目中团结在一起并分享相似的经历。在那之后，我想，女孩，我支持你们所有人。我支持我所有的女孩，但我仍然很喜欢节目中的男明星。

paras.en: Season 35 of DWTS airs Tuesdays at 8 p.m., simulcasting across ABC and Disney+, and streaming the next day on Hulu. Read all of THR‘s DWTS coverage here.
paras.zh: DWTS 第 35 季每周二晚上 8 点在 ABC 和 Disney+ 同步播出，并于次日在 Hulu 上直播。请在此处阅读 THR 的所有 DWTS 报道。

articles.title: JoBe Cerny, Actor, Director and Voice of the Pillsbury Doughboy, Dies at 78
articles.author: Mike Barnes

paras.en: JoBe Cerny, who voiced the playful Pillsbury Doughboy in commercials and appeared in films including Somewhere in Time, My Best Friend’s Wedding and Road to Perdition, has died. He was 78.
paras.zh: 乔比·塞尔尼 (JoBe Cerny) 去世，他曾在广告中为顽皮的皮尔斯伯里面团小子配音，并出演过《时光倒流》、《我最好朋友的婚礼》和《毁灭之路》等电影。他78岁了。

paras.en: Cerny lived in Grayslake, Illinois, and died Oct. 30, his family announced. He had battled Alzheimer’s disease.
paras.zh: 塞尔尼的家人宣布，他住在伊利诺伊州格雷斯莱克，于 10 月 30 日去世。他曾与阿尔茨海默病作斗争。

paras.en: For more than 30 years, Cerny owned and operated Cerny/American Creative Recording Studio in the River North neighborhood of Chicago. His company completed thousands of projects, including commercials, features and audiobooks.
paras.zh: 30 多年来，塞尔尼在芝加哥的北河社区拥有并经营塞尔尼/美国创意录音室。他的公司完成了数千个项目，包括广告、专题片和有声读物。

paras.en: One of his finest accomplishments was directing a 98-hour dramatized audio production of the New King James Version of the Bible called The Word of Promise that featured more than 500 actors, among them Jim Caviezel as Jesus, Marisa Tomei as Mary Magdalene, Richard Dreyfuss as Moses, Gary Sinise as David, Jason Alexander as Joseph, Max von Sydow as Noah, Jon Voight as Abraham, Luke Perry as Judas and Marcia Gay Harden as Esther.
paras.zh: 他最出色的成就之一是导演了一部时长 98 小时的戏剧音频作品《新钦定本圣经》，名为《应许之言》，由 500 多名演员主演，其中吉姆·卡维泽饰演耶稣，玛丽莎·托梅饰演抹大拉的玛利亚，理查德·德莱福斯饰演摩西，加里·辛尼斯饰演大卫，杰森·亚历山大饰演约瑟夫，马克斯·冯·西多饰演诺亚，乔恩·沃伊特饰演亚伯拉罕，卢克·佩里饰演犹大，马西娅·盖伊·哈登饰演以斯帖.

paras.en: Cerny also converted episodes of CBS’ The Twilight Zone into radio programing and wrote new installments for a podcast series.
paras.zh: 塞尔尼还将哥伦比亚广播公司的《暮光之城》的剧集改编成广播节目，并为播客系列编写了新的部分。

paras.en: Cerny succeeded Paul Frees and Jeff Bergman as the high-pitched voice of the Pillsbury Co.’s cheerful Pillsbury Doughboy, who giggled when poked in the belly (he played the lovable Poppin’ Fresh character until about 2020).
paras.zh: 塞尔尼接替保罗·弗里斯和杰夫·伯格曼，为皮尔斯伯里公司的皮尔斯伯里面团小子（Pillsbury Doughboy）高亢地配音，当被戳到肚子时，皮尔斯伯里面团小子会咯咯地笑（他在 2020 年左右之前一直扮演可爱的 Poppin’ Fresh 角色）。

paras.en: “I’ve gone through phases over the years,” he said in a 2007 interview. “Sometimes [Pillsbury gets] a new executive. One guy said, ‘You know, I’ve always hated the voice of the Doughboy. And that’s you. I’m gonna do everything I can to not let the Doughboy talk anymore.’
paras.zh: “I’ve gone through phases over the years,” he said in a 2007 interview. “有时（皮尔斯伯里）会任命一位新高管。一个人说，‘你知道，我一直讨厌面团男孩的声音。那就是你。我会尽一切努力不让面团男孩再说话。’

paras.en: “This was about seven years ago. That guy lost his job. He got fired the next year and a whole floor of people got fired with him. And then the next year I talked twice as much to make up for it.”
paras.zh: “那是大约七年前的事了。那个人丢了工作。第二年他被解雇了，一整层楼的人也和他一起被解雇了。然后第二年我说了两倍的话来弥补。”

paras.en: He also portrayed without dialogue “The Cheer Man” (also known as the “Silent Demonstrator”) in commercials for Procter & Gamble’s Cheer detergent and got killed “thousands of times” as bugs in Raid spots.
paras.zh: 他还在宝洁公司的 Cheer 洗涤剂广告中以无对白的方式扮演“欢呼者”（也称为“沉默的示威者”），并在 Raid 地点作为虫子被杀死“数千次”。

paras.en: Cerny was born on Dec 5, 1947, in Cicero, Illinois. His parents, Joe and Bea, combined their names for their son’s first name.
paras.zh: 塞尔尼 1947 年 12 月 5 日出生于伊利诺伊州西塞罗。他的父母乔和比亚将他们的名字组合起来作为儿子的名字。
