articles.title: How to Expand Reliable, Flexible Access to Space
articles.author: Exolaunch

paras.en: The space industry launched more rockets into orbit last year than ever before, yet satellite operators are confronting an unexpected problem: There still aren’t enough rides to go around.
paras.zh: 去年，航天工业向轨道发射的火箭数量比以往任何时候都要多，但卫星运营商却面临着一个意想不到的问题：仍然没有足够的运载火箭可供绕行。

paras.en: And increasingly, the shortage isn’t simply about the number of rockets.
paras.zh: 而且，短缺问题越来越不仅仅与火箭数量有关。

paras.en: Satellite companies want launches to more orbital destinations, with more regularity and aboard a wider range of vehicles. Instead, much of the industry has come to depend on a relatively small number of frequently launched rockets that often go to similar orbits. That’s left some companies and their spacecraft waiting months or years for a suitable ride.
paras.zh: 卫星公司希望以更多的规律性和更广泛的运载工具向更多的轨道目的地发射卫星。相反，该行业的大部分公司已经开始依赖数量相对较少、经常发射且通常进入相似轨道的火箭。这使得一些公司和他们的航天器需要等待数月或数年才能获得合适的飞行。

paras.en: “Demand is crazy,” said Robert Sproles, chief executive of Exolaunch, a Berlin-based broker of global launch services that has put 912 satellites into orbit during 51 separate launch events. “The demand curve is so much steeper than the supply curve.”
paras.zh: “需求太疯狂了”，Exolaunch 首席执行官罗伯特·斯普罗尔斯 (Robert Sproles) 表示。Exolaunch 是一家总部位于柏林的全球发射服务经纪商，已在 51 次独立发射活动中将 912 颗卫星送入轨道。 “需求曲线比供给曲线陡峭得多。”

paras.en: The squeeze comes despite a historic expansion in launch activity. Data from the FAA shows the agency licensed 187 launches in fiscal year 2026. That’s up from less than 100 a decade earlier and governments are pushing for still more. The Trump administration has called for U.S. spaceports to support more than 1,000 launches and reentries annually by 2030.
paras.zh: 尽管发射活动出现了历史性的扩张，但这种挤压还是出现了。 Data from the FAA shows the agency licensed 187 launches in fiscal year 2026. That’s up from less than 100 a decade earlier and governments are pushing for still more.特朗普政府呼吁美国太空港到 2030 年每年支持 1000 多次发射和重返大气层。

paras.en: But raw launch numbers obscure a problem that is becoming increasingly important as the space economy grows. A rocket going to the wrong orbit at the wrong time isn’t necessarily useful to a satellite operator.
paras.zh: 但原始发射数据掩盖了一个随着太空经济增长而变得越来越重要的问题。火箭在错误的时间进入错误的轨道对于卫星运营商来说不一定有用。

paras.en: All of that is turning choice, not just capacity, into one of the launch industry’s biggest constraints.
paras.zh: 所有这些都使选择（而不仅仅是容量）成为发射行业最大的限制之一。

paras.en: In order to truly close the gap between supply and demand, Sproles said, space transportation companies must also increase the diversity of available launches.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯表示，为了真正缩小供需差距，航天运输公司还必须增加可用发射的多样性。

paras.en: “Yes, we need to meet demand. But we also need to make sure we’re putting that demand in the right places,” he said. “We need to recognize what types of launches are best for what types of missions, and we need to make sure those types of launches are available when the launch customer needs them.”
paras.zh: “是的，我们需要满足需求。但我们还需要确保将需求放在正确的地方，”他说。 “我们需要认识到哪种类型的发射最适合哪种类型的任务，并且我们需要确保在发射客户需要时可以使用这些类型的发射。”

paras.en: Market research firm Novaspace reports that the global space economy reached a valuation of $626 billion in 2025. Citing “consolidation, integration, and closer institutional alignment around security, resilience, and operational performance,” it forecasts annual growth of 5.5% through 2034 — at which point it predicts the global space economy will be worth over $1 trillion.
paras.zh: 市场研究公司 Novaspace 报告称，到 2025 年，全球太空经济估值将达到 6260 亿美元。该公司援引“围绕安全、弹性和运营绩效的整合、一体化和更紧密的机构协调”，预测到 2034 年年增长率将达到 5.5%，届时全球太空经济价值将超过 1 万亿美元。

paras.en: Markets that large are not monolithic, Sproles said, which means the industry needs multiple launch providers operating regularly across different orbital regimes.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯表示，这么大的市场并不是单一的，这意味着该行业需要多个发射提供商在不同的轨道制度上定期运营。

paras.en: “If you rewind to, say, 2016, there was more launch diversity in the market at that time than there is today. There was not more capacity, but there was a wider variety of vehicles that you could reliably gain access to,” Sproles said. The reasons for that decline in launch diversity includes changes in technology, geopolitics, and supply chains since the COVID-19 pandemic, all of which have led to the concentration of launch capacity in a small number of highly active launch providers.
paras.zh: “如果你回顾一下，比如说， 2016年，当时市场上的产品发布多样性比今天更多。没有更多的容量，但您可以可靠地使用更多种类的车辆，” Sproles说。发射多样性下降的原因包括自新冠肺炎疫情以来技术、地缘政治和供应链的变化，所有这些都导致发射能力集中在少数高度活跃的发射供应商身上。

paras.en: But that variety is necessary, Sproles argues, because launch customers want to be able to optimize for when they can launch, where they need to go, and how much it will cost.
paras.zh: 但斯普罗尔斯认为，这种多样性是必要的，因为发布客户希望能够针对何时发布、需要去哪里以及需要花费多少进行优化。

paras.en: Consider the two most prolific launch providers today: SpaceX — whose Falcon 9 vehicle is optimized for large commercial constellations, human spaceflight, and heavy commercial rideshares — and Rocket Lab, whose Electron vehicle favors small satellites and CubeSats that require custom orbital planes.
paras.zh: 考虑一下当今两家最多产的发射供应商： SpaceX--其猎鹰9号运载火箭针对大型商业星座、载人航天和重型商业拼车进行了优化--和火箭实验室，其电子运载火箭青睐需要定制轨道飞机的小型卫星和立方体卫星。

paras.en: “You could not come up with two more different vehicles both in terms of performance and commercial offerings, which just goes to show you that the industry is as hungry for choice as it is for capacity,” Sproles said.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯说：“在性能和商业产品方面，你不可能再推出两种不同的车辆，这只会向你表明，该行业对选择的渴望与对容量的渴望一样。”

paras.en: In today’s launch market, rideshare services are a foundation of the space industry. “Rideshare is appropriate when your schedule is flexible enough to align with when a planned rideshare is launching, and when you have enough orbital wiggle room to go where the masses want to go,” Sproles said. “Basically, it makes sense when you have less rigid mission constraints.”
paras.zh: 在当今的发射市场中，拼车服务是航天工业的基础。斯普罗尔斯说：“当你的日程安排足够灵活，能够与计划中的共享出行启动时间保持一致，并且你有足够的轨道回旋空间去大众想去的地方时，共享出行就是合适的。” “基本上，当你的任务限制不那么严格时，这是有意义的。”

paras.en: But as missions become more complex and bespoke, one size doesn’t fit all. Rideshare alternatives are needed, including shared launches — where launches are conceived from the outset with multiple customers in mind, instead of one customer’s mission piggybacking haphazardly onto another’s — and dedicated launches, wherein a customer procures an entire launch that’s customized to their unique schedule, destination, and payload, Sproles said
paras.zh: 但随着任务变得更加复杂和定制化，一种方法并不适合所有人。斯普罗尔斯表示，需要共享出行的替代方案，包括共享发射——从一开始就考虑到多个客户的情况来构思发射，而不是一个客户的任务随意地搭载在另一个客户的任务上——以及专用发射，其中客户购买根据其独特的时间表、目的地和有效载荷定制的整个发射。

paras.en: Exolaunch points to four planned missions that underscore the benefits of launch diversity:
paras.zh: Exolaunch 指出了四项计划任务，强调了发射多样性的好处：

paras.en: - In 2027, the company will conduct a mid-inclination rideshare mission aboard Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ H3 rocket. It will be the company’s first launch from Japan.
paras.zh: - 2027年，该公司将搭乘三菱重工的H3火箭执行中倾角拼车任务。这将是该公司首次在日本推出。

paras.en: - In late 2027 and 2028, respectively, Exolaunch will launch its Exo-1 and Exo-2 missions aboard two dedicated SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets procured exclusively for an anchor customer that in both instances will use approximately 40% of the launch vehicle; Exolaunch will sell the remaining 60% to other customers seeking a rideshare model.
paras.zh: - 分别于 2027 年末和 2028 年，Exolaunch 将利用专为主要客户采购的两枚专用 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射 Exo-1 和 Exo-2 任务，在这两种情况下，该客户将使用约 40% 的运载火箭； Exolaunch 将把剩余的 60% 出售给其他寻求拼车模式的客户。

paras.en: - In late 2028, Exolaunch will serve as the launch co-integrator for the Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment-Continuity (GRACE-C) mission that is a joint effort of the German Space Agency’s German Aerospace Center (DLR) and NASA. The company will provide a custom structure with which to secure the mission’s payload inside a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket that DLR and NASA had already secured for their launch; in return, DLR and NASA will allow it to provide the rocket’s unused capacity to other customers.
paras.zh: - 2028 年末，Exolaunch 将作为重力恢复和气候实验连续性 (GRACE-C) 任务的发射联合集成商，该任务是德国航天局德国航空航天中心 (DLR) 和 NASA 的共同努力。该公司将提供一种定制结构，用于将任务有效载荷固定在 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭内，DLR 和 NASA 已经为发射做好了准备；作为回报，德国航天中心和美国宇航局将允许其向其他客户提供火箭未使用的容量。

paras.en: The first eight launches for Exolaunch in 2026 took place across four different launch vehicles from three continents. By securing capacity across a diverse portfolio of launch vehicles, inclinations, and spaceports, Sproles said, Exolaunch gives launch customers not only more predictable access to orbit, but also increased flexibility with regard to cost, schedule, and orbital destination.
paras.zh: 2026 年 Exolaunch 的前八次发射是通过来自三大洲的四种不同的运载火箭进行的。 Sproles 表示，通过确保各种运载火箭、倾角和太空港的容量，Exolaunch 不仅为发射客户提供了更可预测的进入轨道的机会，而且还提高了成本、时间表和轨道目的地方面的灵活性。

paras.en: Sproles ultimately envisions a future where customers can launch at any time and to any orbit without ever having to consider available launch vehicles or schedules — just as manufacturers in other industries can ship their products knowing that there’s always a container ship, train, or truck available to transport them.
paras.zh: Sproles 最终设想的未来是，客户可以在任何时间、任何轨道发射火箭，而无需考虑可用的运载火箭或时间表，就像其他行业的制造商可以运送他们的产品一样，因为他们知道总有集装箱船、火车或卡车可以运输它们。

paras.en: “The ideal situation is that customers don’t have to think about what the vehicle is or when it’s going because there’s always an option to get to the desired orbit at the time when their satellite is manufactured,” Sproles said.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯说：“理想的情况是，客户不必考虑车辆是什么或何时行驶，因为在制造卫星时总是可以选择到达所需的轨道。”

paras.en: That future is in the hands of launch companies.
paras.zh: 这个未来掌握在发射公司手中。

paras.en: “We have multiple launch providers who have shown they can launch rockets. Now, we need those launchers to launch. We need them operating reliably at cadence, and we need them going to multiple orbits. They can do it. We just need them to execute.”
paras.zh: “我们有多家发射提供商已经证明他们可以发射火箭。现在，我们需要这些发射器来发射。我们需要它们以节奏可靠地运行，我们需要它们进入多个轨道。他们可以做到。我们只需要他们执行。”

articles.title: ESCAPADE on its way to Mars after Earth flybys
articles.author: Jeff Foust

paras.en: WASHINGTON — Two NASA smallsats are headed toward Mars after completing flybys of Earth nearly a year after their launch.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——美国宇航局的两颗小型卫星在发射近一年后完成了对地球的飞越，目前正飞往火星。

paras.en: The second of two Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers, or ESCAPADE, spacecraft, nicknamed Gold, flew by Earth at about 6 a.m. Eastern Nov. 9, coming within about 1,050 kilometers of Earth. That took place a little more than 48 hours after the first ESCAPADE spacecraft, Blue, made a similar flyby at an altitude of about 1,600 kilometers.
paras.zh: 两艘逃逸与等离子体加速与动力学探索者号（ESCAPADE）航天器中的第二艘，绰号“黄金”，于 11 月 9 日东部时间早上 6 点左右飞过地球，距离地球约 1,050 公里。这发生在第一艘 ESCAPADE 太空船 Blue 号在大约 1,600 公里高度进行类似飞越 48 小时多一点后。

paras.en: During both flybys, the Rocket Lab-built spacecraft fired their engines, using a principle called the Oberth effect to maximize the performance of the maneuver. It was the first time a NASA spacecraft used such a powered flyby to go to Mars.
paras.zh: 在两次飞越过程中，火箭实验室制造的航天器都启动了发动机，利用奥伯特效应原理来最大限度地提高机动性能。这是美国宇航局航天器首次使用这种动力飞越火星。

paras.en: “This is the first time NASA has used a powered Earth flyby to propel a spacecraft toward Mars, and we’ve now executed this maneuver twice, flawlessly, in just two days,” Asal Naseri, acting associate flight director in NASA’s heliophysics division, said in an agency statement.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局太阳物理部门代理飞行副主任阿萨尔·纳塞里（Asal Naseri）在一份机构声明中表示：“这是美国宇航局第一次使用动力飞越地球来推动航天器飞向火星，我们现在已经在短短两天内完美地执行了两次这种机动。”

paras.en: ESCAPADE is taking a nontraditional approach to going to Mars. Rather than launch during short windows that open roughly every two years, ESCAPADE launched last November on the second flight of Blue Origin’s New Glenn. The two spacecraft loitered around the Earth-sun L-2 Lagrange point for nearly a year before swinging around Earth in a final maneuver before heading to Mars.
paras.zh: ESCAPADE 正在采取一种非传统的方式前往火星。 ESCAPADE 并没有在大约每两年开放一次的短暂窗口期间发射，而是于去年 11 月在蓝色起源公司 New Glenn 的第二次飞行中发射。这两艘航天器在地球-太阳 L-2 拉格朗日点周围徘徊了近一年，然后在前往火星之前进行最后一次绕地球摆动。

paras.en: That trajectory was developed by Advanced Space as a means of opening up Mars mission launch opportunities outside of traditional windows. “This method provides the flexibility to launch almost anytime and then use Earth’s gravity to get a boost to Mars, rather than waiting every two years to launch there directly when the planets are aligned,” said Jeff Parker of Advanced Space in a statement.
paras.zh: 该轨道由 Advanced Space 开发，作为在传统窗口之外开辟火星任务发射机会的一种手段。高级太空公司的杰夫·帕克在一份声明中表示：“这种方法提供了几乎随时发射的灵活性，然后利用地球引力来推动火星，而不是每两年等待一次，当行星对齐时直接发射到火星。”

paras.en: That approach, though, required a precise burn by each spacecraft’s main engine as they flew by Earth. “These burns were critical in the same way a Mars orbit insertion burn is,” Rob Lillis, principal investigator for ESCAPADE, said during a Nov. 9 meeting of the Mars Exploration Program Analysis Group. “I’m happy to report that they went well. They were executed perfectly.”
paras.zh: 然而，这种方法需要每艘航天器飞过地球时其主发动机进行精确燃烧。 ESCAPADE 首席研究员 Rob Lillis 在 11 月 9 日的火星探索计划分析小组会议上表示：“这些烧伤的重要性与火星轨道插入烧伤的重要性相同。” “我很高兴地报告，他们进展顺利。他们被完美地执行了。”

paras.en: The maneuvers put both spacecraft on trajectories to Mars, arriving two days apart in September 2027. Each spacecraft will perform an 11-minute burn of its main engine to go into orbit around Mars, later maneuvering into its planned science orbit.
paras.zh: 此次演习使两艘航天器都沿着飞往火星的轨道，于 2027 年 9 月抵达，相隔两天。每艘航天器都将对其主发动机进行 11 分钟的燃烧，以进入火星轨道，随后机动进入其计划的科学轨道。

paras.en: The two spacecraft will study space weather at Mars, examining how the solar wind interacts with the planet’s magnetosphere and atmosphere. The spacecraft will first perform those observations in the same orbit, separated from each other by up to 30 minutes to measure variations in space weather over time. They will later shift into separate orbits, with one spacecraft focusing on the incoming solar wind and the other on the effects on Mars.
paras.zh: 这两艘航天器将研究火星的太空天气，研究太阳风如何与火星磁层和大气层相互作用。该航天器将首先在同一轨道上进行这些观测，轨道之间的间隔最多为 30 分钟，以测量空间天气随时间的变化。随后，它们将转移到不同的轨道，其中一艘航天器专注于传入的太阳风，另一艘则关注对火星的影响。

paras.en: ESCAPADE is the last surviving mission of a NASA program called SIMPLEx, or Small Innovative Missions for Planetary Exploration, intended to support low-cost planetary science missions. NASA selected ESCAPADE for development in 2019 alongside two other SIMPLEx missions, the Janus asteroid flyby spacecraft and the Lunar Trailblazer orbiter.
paras.zh: ESCAPADE 是 NASA 计划 SIMPLEx（即行星探索小型创新任务）中最后一个幸存的任务，旨在支持低成本的行星科学任务。 NASA 选择在 2019 年开发 ESCAPADE 以及另外两项 SIMPLEx 任务：“杰纳斯”小行星飞越航天器和“月球开拓者”轨道飞行器。

paras.en: However, NASA canceled Janus in 2023 after delays in the launch of the Psyche asteroid mission, on which Janus was a rideshare, prevented it from carrying out its planned asteroid flybys. Lunar Trailblazer malfunctioned shortly after its launch in February 2025, and NASA formally ended the mission five months later after efforts to recover it were unsuccessful.
paras.zh: 然而，NASA 于 2023 年取消了 Janus，原因是 Janus 共享乘车的 Psyche 小行星任务发射延迟，导致其无法执行计划中的小行星飞越任务。月球开拓者号于 2025 年 2 月发射后不久就发生故障，五个月后，美国宇航局在回收努力失败后正式结束了这次任务。

paras.en: Two previous cubesat-class SIMPLEx missions, LunaH-Map and Q-PACE, also failed after their launches. NASA, citing budget pressures, has not solicited proposals for new SIMPLEx missions and has not stated any plans to do so for the foreseeable future.
paras.zh: 之前的两次立方体卫星级 SIMPLEx 任务 LunaH-Map 和 Q-PACE 在发射后也失败了。 NASA 以预算压力为由，尚未征求有关新 SIMPLEx 任务的建议，也没有表示在可预见的未来有任何这样做的计划。

articles.title: Kratos and Seagate Space Partner to Advance Mobile Offshore Launch Capabilities for National Security Missions
articles.author: Seagate Space

paras.en: SAN DIEGO, CA, November 10, 2026 – Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc., a technology company in defense, national security, and global markets, today announced a long-term agreement with Seagate Space for use of the company’s first Gateway offshore launch platform. The agreement supports Kratos’ planned first mission from the platform in 2027, with multiple additional launches anticipated in each subsequent year.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，2026 年 11 月 10 日 – 国防、国家安全和全球市场的技术公司 Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. 今天宣布与 Seagate Space 达成长期协议，使用该公司的首个 Gateway 海上发射平台。该协议支持 Kratos 计划于 2027 年在该平台执行首次任务，预计随后每年还会进行多次发射。

paras.en: The partnership aligns Kratos’ experience delivering real, mission-relevant products and systems, including hypersonic test vehicles, rocket systems, propulsion technologies, target vehicles, and launch services, with Seagate Space’s modular, mobile offshore platform infrastructure. The Gateway series vessels are designed to provide flexible sea-based platforms to complement traditional land-based launch sites and test ranges.
paras.zh: 此次合作将 Kratos 提供真实任务相关产品和系统（包括高超音速测试飞行器、火箭系统、推进技术、目标飞行器和发射服务）的经验与 Seagate Space 的模块化移动海上平台基础设施结合起来。 Gateway系列船舶旨在提供灵活的海基平台，以补充传统的陆基发射场和测试场。

paras.en: The announcement coincides with Seagate Space’s execution of its first Gateway platform construction contract, advancing into physical construction and toward future operational readiness.
paras.zh: 这一公告恰逢 Seagate Space 执行其第一份 Gateway 平台建设合同，推进物理建设并为未来的运营做好准备。

paras.en: “Kratos’ agreement with Seagate Space creates an important new pathway for supporting our customers’ evolving launch and test requirements,” said Dave Carter, President of Kratos Defense & Rocket Support Services. “We are focused on delivering affordable, responsive, and mission-critical solutions. Gateway has the potential to provide our customers with additional launch flexibility, expanded operating locations, and responsive access to mission-relevant test environments.”
paras.zh: Kratos 国防与火箭支持服务总裁 Dave Carter 表示：“Kratos 与 Seagate Space 达成的协议为支持客户不断变化的发射和测试需求开辟了一条重要的新途径。” “我们专注于提供经济实惠、响应迅速且关键任务的解决方案。Gateway 有潜力为我们的客户提供额外的启动灵活性、扩大的运营地点以及对任务相关测试环境的响应式访问。”

paras.en: Seagate Space’s Gateway platform is being developed as a modular and mobile offshore system to support government and commercial launch, testing, and recovery missions. Its maritime mobility can provide mission planners with added flexibility in launch geometry, range access, and scheduling while reducing dependence on fixed terrestrial infrastructure.
paras.zh: Seagate Space 的 Gateway 平台正在开发为模块化移动海上系统，以支持政府和商业发射、测试和回收任务。其海上机动性可以为任务规划者提供发射几何、范围访问和调度方面的更大灵活性，同时减少对固定地面基础设施的依赖。

paras.en: Kratos plans to use the Gateway platform initially in support of defense-related launch and target missions. The companies expect their collaboration to establish a foundation for expanded offshore mission operations as demand grows for hypersonic testing, ballistic-missile targets, responsive launch capabilities, and other national security relevant missions.
paras.zh: 奎托斯计划首先使用网关平台来支持与国防相关的发射和目标任务。随着高超音速测试、弹道导弹目标、响应发射能力和其他国家安全相关任务的需求不断增长，两家公司希望通过合作为扩大海上任务运营奠定基础。

paras.en: “From the beginning, our vision has been to make access to space as open as the ocean itself,” said Sean Fortener, President, Chief Operating Officer and Co-Founder of Seagate Space. “Partnering with Kratos and moving our first Gateway platform into construction represents a major step towards making that vision a reality. Kratos brings real mission requirements and decades of defense experience, and Seagate Space is bringing the maritime infrastructure to support them. With our first build contract signed, we are putting steel behind the vision and moving closer to delivering a capability the industry needs.”
paras.zh: “从一开始，我们的愿景就是让太空进入像海洋本身一样开放，”Seagate Space 总裁、首席运营官兼联合创始人 Sean Fortener 说道。 “与 Kratos 合作并将我们的第一个 Gateway 平台投入建造，是实现这一愿景的重要一步。Kratos 带来了真正的任务要求和数十年的防御经验，而 Seagate Space 则带来了海事基础设施来支持它们。随着我们签署的第一份建造合同，我们正在将钢铁置于愿景背后，并更接近提供行业所需的能力。”

paras.en: Kratos has internally invested in rapidly developing and fielding affordable systems for demanding national security missions. Kratos’ approach is based on the belief that affordability is a technology: designing proven, leading-edge products and systems from the outset for rapid production, operational deployment, and scalable manufacturing.
paras.zh: 奎托斯在内部投资快速开发和部署负担得起的系统，以满足要求严格的国家安全任务。 Kratos 的方法基于这样的信念：可负担性是一项技术：从一开始就设计经过验证的领先产品和系统，以实现快速生产、运营部署和可扩展制造。

paras.en: “Kratos is committed to being first to market with affordable, mission-focused technologies that address the urgent requirements of the United States and its allies,” said Eric DeMarco, Kratos President and CEO. “This partnership with Seagate Space supports that strategy by creating an additional option for our customers to conduct critical launch and test missions. Sea-based launch infrastructure can provide flexibility, responsiveness, and operational choice—capabilities increasingly important to national security missions.”
paras.zh: Kratos 总裁兼首席执行官埃里克·德马科 (Eric DeMarco) 表示：“Kratos 致力于率先向市场推出价格实惠、以任务为中心的技术，以满足美国及其盟国的迫切需求。” “与 Seagate Space 的合作伙伴关系为我们的客户提供了执行关键发射和测试任务的额外选择，从而支持了这一战略。海基发射基础设施可以提供灵活性、响应能力和操作选择，这些能力对国家安全任务越来越重要。”

paras.en: The companies will continue to advance Gateway through construction, integration, and operational-readiness activities in preparation for Kratos’ first planned mission in 2027.
paras.zh: 两家公司将继续通过建设、集成和运营准备活动推进 Gateway，为 Kratos 于 2027 年执行的首次计划任务做好准备。

paras.en: About Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc.
paras.zh: 关于克雷托斯防御与安全解决方案公司

paras.en: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: KTOS) is a technology, products, system and software company addressing the defense, national security, and commercial markets. At Kratos, affordability is a technology, and Kratos makes true internally funded research, development, capital and other investments, to rapidly develop, produce and field affordable solutions that address our customers’ mission critical needs and requirements. For more information, visit www.KratosDefense.com and follow Kratos on LinkedIn and X.
paras.zh: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：KTOS）是一家致力于国防、国家安全和商业市场的技术、产品、系统和软件公司。在 Kratos，经济实惠是一项技术，Kratos 进行真正的内部资助研究、开发、资本和其他投资，以快速开发、生产和部署经济实惠的解决方案，以满足客户的关键任务需求和要求。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.KratosDefense.com 并在 LinkedIn 和 X 上关注 Kratos。

paras.en: Seagate Space is space’s maritime partner: reinventing offshore launch, optimizing recovery, and innovating for emerging logistics needs. The company’s cutting-edge designs enable rapid, cost-effective development of offshore launch assets that can operate without the constraints of traditional land-based ranges. Seagate Space is a spARK Labs by ARK Invest member company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida. Learn more at www.seagatespace.com and follow on LinkedIn.
paras.zh: Seagate Space 是太空的海事合作伙伴：重塑海上发射、优化回收并针对新兴物流需求进行创新。该公司的尖端设计能够快速、经济高效地开发海上发射资产，这些资产可以在不受传统陆基射程限制的情况下运行。 Seagate Space 是 spARK Labs by ARK Invest 的成员公司，总部位于佛罗里达州圣彼得堡。如需了解更多信息，请访问 www.seagatespace.com 并关注 LinkedIn。

articles.title: NASA Scientists Show How Gravitational Waves Can Reveal New Worlds

paras.en: The LISA (Laser Interferometer Space Antenna) observatory, now in development, will detect gravitational waves, the tiny ripples in space-time caused by orbiting masses. Now two studies led by NASA astrophysicists show in new detail how LISA could reveal a new and unique population of exoplanets — worlds beyond our solar system — throughout our galaxy.
paras.zh: 目前正在开发中的 LISA（激光干涉仪空间天线）天文台将探测引力波，即由轨道质量引起的时空微小涟漪。现在，由 NASA 天体物理学家领导的两项研究以新的细节展示了 LISA 如何揭示整个银河系中一群新的、独特的系外行星（太阳系之外的世界）。

paras.en: “The most common source for LISA is expected to be double white dwarf systems, which are binaries composed of white dwarfs in tight orbits,” said Casey McGrath, a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County and NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland. “If an exoplanet also orbits within one of these systems, its presence becomes imprinted on the gravitational wave signal in a way we’ll be able to uncover.”
paras.zh: “LISA 最常见的来源预计是双白矮星系统，它们是由紧轨道上的白矮星组成的双星，”马里兰大学巴尔的摩县分校和美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心（马里兰州格林贝尔特）的博士后研究员凯西·麦格拉思（Casey McGrath）说。 “如果一颗系外行星也在这些系统之一内运行，那么它的存在就会以我们能够发现的方式印在引力波信号上。”

paras.en: Two papers published Tuesday in The Astrophysical Journal detail the findings. The first, authored solely by McGrath, examines the detection method and determines the planet masses and orbital periods where it would work best. The second paper, by McGrath and coauthors, investigates how such planets could be confirmed using NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope.
paras.zh: 周二在《天体物理学杂志》上发表的两篇论文详细介绍了这些发现。第一篇由麦格拉思单独撰写，研究了探测方法并确定了其最有效的行星质量和轨道周期。麦格拉斯和合著者的第二篇论文研究了如何使用美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜确认此类行星。

paras.en: The possibility of detecting exoplanets around LISA double white dwarf systems was first proposed by Japanese astronomer Naoki Seto in 2008.
paras.zh: 日本天文学家濑户直树于2008年首次提出探测LISA双白矮星系统周围系外行星的可能性。

paras.en: Led by ESA (European Space Agency), the LISA mission is slated for launch in the mid-2030s. As a collaborative partner, NASA is contributing the telescopes, other critical hardware, and engineering and scientific support as part of its mission to better understand how the universe works.
paras.zh: LISA 任务由 ESA（欧洲航天局）领导，计划于 2030 年代中期发射。作为合作伙伴，美国宇航局正在提供望远镜、其他关键硬件以及工程和科学支持，作为其更好地了解宇宙如何运作的使命的一部分。

paras.en: The LISA detection method is similar to one called radial velocity that uses light and is already employed to find exoplanets around nearby stars. As a planet orbits, its gravity tugs on its host star, imparting a small reflex motion, or wobble, onto it. This wobble causes the star’s spectrum to oscillate, with spectral lines shifting from redder wavelengths as the star moves away from us to bluer ones as the star moves toward us. The shift is due to a phenomenon called the Doppler effect.
paras.zh: LISA 探测方法类似于一种利用光的径向速度探测方法，已用于寻找附近恒星周围的系外行星。当行星绕轨道运行时，它的引力会拉扯其主恒星，从而对其产生微小的反射运动或摆动。这种摆动会导致恒星的光谱发生振荡，当恒星远离我们时，光谱线会从较红的波长转变为当恒星靠近我们时的较蓝的波长。这种转变是由于一种称为多普勒效应的现象造成的。

paras.en: “Something similar occurs with gravitational waves,” said Scott Noble, a theoretical astrophysicist at NASA Goddard and a coauthor on the confirmation paper. “By themselves, double white dwarfs will emit gravitational waves at a nearly continuous frequency. Add a sufficiently massive planet to the system, and its presence causes the binary to experience reflex motion, adding a Doppler modulation to the gravitational signal.”
paras.zh: “引力波也会发生类似的情况，”美国宇航局戈达德中心的理论天体物理学家、确认论文的合著者斯科特·诺布尔说。 “双白矮星本身会以几乎连续的频率发射引力波。在系统中添加一颗足够大的行星，它的存在会导致双星系统经历反射运动，从而为引力信号添加多普勒调制。”

paras.en: For LISA, this modulation will appear as sidebands, secondary signals at both higher and lower frequencies than the primary one.
paras.zh: 对于 LISA，这种调制将显示为边带，即比主信号频率更高和更低的辅助信号。

paras.en: McGrath likens the situation to modern radio communication, where some of the energy of a main radio carrier frequency goes into forming sidebands at adjacent upper and lower frequencies that carry messages (like voices or music). For gravitational waves, the sidebands carry messages about the presence of a planet.
paras.zh: 麦格拉思将这种情况比作现代无线电通信，其中主无线电载波频率的一些能量在相邻的较高和较低频率处形成边带，以承载消息（如语音或音乐）。对于引力波，边带携带有关行星存在的信息。

paras.en: White dwarfs are the Earth-sized remnants of stars like the Sun. While exoplanets have been detected around a few isolated white dwarfs, none have yet been found around a binary white dwarf, which means the LISA detections would represent a distinct new exoplanet population.
paras.zh: 白矮星是太阳等恒星的地球大小的残余物。虽然在一些孤立的白矮星周围检测到了系外行星，但在双白矮星周围尚未发现任何行星，这意味着 LISA 检测将代表一个独特的新系外行星群体。

paras.en: Astronomers estimate that our Milky Way galaxy contains 10 million double white dwarf systems with orbital periods of less than an hour, which generate gravitational waves in the right range for LISA to find. They expect LISA will resolve about 10,000 individual systems, as well as around 100 mixed binaries — with white dwarfs, neutron stars, or black holes — orbiting in similar periods.
paras.zh: 天文学家估计，我们的银河系包含 1000 万个双白矮星系统，其轨道周期不到一小时，这些系统会产生 LISA 发现的正确范围内的引力波。他们预计 LISA 将解析大约 10,000 个单独的系统，以及大约 100 个混合双星——其中包括白矮星、中子星或黑洞——在相似的周期内运行。

paras.en: “Once LISA captures its first exoplanet detections, it will be critical for us to validate some of them,” said Mary Anne Limbach, an assistant research scientist at the University of Michigan and a co-author on the confirmation paper. “These joint detections will allow us to establish that the gravitational signals correspond to genuine planets rather than false positives.”
paras.zh: 密歇根大学助理研究科学家、确认论文的合著者玛丽·安妮·林巴赫 (Mary Anne Limbach) 表示：“一旦 LISA 捕获到第一批系外行星探测结果，我们验证其中的一些数据将至关重要。” “这些联合探测将使我们能够确定重力信号对应于真正的行星而不是误报。”

paras.en: The team described a new method for confirming these planets by taking advantage of the Webb telescope’s infrared sensitivity. A planet in a double white dwarf system produces a larger portion of infrared light than what’s expected from the stars themselves. Webb’s instruments can easily detect this infrared excess out to a distance of at least 500 light-years.
paras.zh: 该团队描述了一种利用韦伯望远镜的红外灵敏度来确认这些行星的新方法。双白矮星系统中的行星产生的红外光比恒星本身产生的红外光要多。韦伯的仪器可以轻松检测到至少 500 光年之外的这种红外线。

paras.en: Using this technique for a test case system at this distance, the researchers find that Webb could detect an exoplanet about five times Jupiter’s mass, while LISA could detect a sub-Jupiter exoplanet under ideal circumstances.
paras.zh: 使用这种技术在这个距离的测试用例系统中，研究人员发现韦伯可以探测到质量约为木星五倍的系外行星，而LISA可以在理想情况下探测到亚木星系外行星。

paras.en: The LISA observatory will consist of a trio of spacecraft following Earth as it orbits the Sun. They will form a vast triangular array stretching 1.6 million miles (2.5 million kilometers) on each side. Each spacecraft will include two telescopes that will use infrared laser beams to simultaneously transmit and receive signals between adjacent spacecraft. Through these telescopes, the spacecraft will measure miniscule changes — smaller than the width of a helium atom — in their relative distances, the signals of passing gravitational waves.
paras.zh: LISA 天文台将由三个跟随地球绕太阳运行的航天器组成。它们将形成一个巨大的三角形阵列，每边延伸 160 万英里（250 万公里）。每个航天器将包括两个望远镜，它们将使用红外激光束在相邻航天器之间同时传输和接收信号。通过这些望远镜，航天器将测量它们相对距离的微小变化（小于氦原子的宽度），即通过引力波的信号。

paras.en: Gravitational waves were predicted by Albert Einstein’s 1916 general theory of relativity and first detected by ground-based observatories in 2015. The waves form whenever massive objects accelerate, such as two stars in orbit around each other. They travel through space-time, moving at the speed of light, and are unaffected by objects they encounter along the way. These properties make them a valuable tool for probing the cosmos.
paras.zh: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦 (Albert Einstein) 1916 年的广义相对论预言了引力波，并于 2015 年首次被地面天文台探测到。只要大质量物体加速，例如彼此绕轨道运行的两颗恒星，引力波就会形成。它们穿越时空，以光速移动，并且不受沿途遇到的物体的影响。这些特性使它们成为探测宇宙的宝贵工具。

paras.en: Additional NASA contributions to the mission include the laser system, devices to manage the buildup of electric charge on the proof masses, data analysis for identifying and characterizing individual gravitational wave sources, and additional scientific and engineering expertise.
paras.zh: NASA 对此次任务的其他贡献包括激光系统、管理质量块上电荷积累的设备、用于识别和表征单个引力波源的数据分析，以及其他科学和工程专业知识。

paras.en: To learn more about the LISA mission, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关 LISA 使命的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: NASA to Welcome Expedition 74 Astronauts Home at Space Center Houston
articles.author: Wendy K. Avedisian

paras.en: NASA will welcome home the Expedition 74 crew during a public event at Space Center Houston following their return from a long-duration mission aboard the International Space Station.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 将在休斯敦航天中心举行的公共活动中欢迎远征 74 号机组人员从国际空间站执行长期任务归来。

paras.en: NASA astronauts Jessica Meir, Jack Hathaway, and Chris Williams; ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Sophie Adenot; and Roscosmos cosmonauts Sergey Kud‑Sverchkov and Sergei Mikaev will share mission highlights at 6 p.m. CST Tuesday, Nov. 17, at NASA Johnson Space Center’s visitor center. An awards ceremony recognizing key mission contributors will follow the presentation.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局宇航员杰西卡·梅尔、杰克·海瑟薇和克里斯·威廉姆斯； ESA（欧洲航天局）宇航员索菲·阿德诺；俄罗斯航天局宇航员谢尔盖·库德·斯维尔奇科夫 (Sergey Kud‑Sverchkov) 和谢尔盖·米卡耶夫 (Sergei Mikaev) 将于下午 6 点分享任务亮点。 CST 11 月 17 日星期二，NASA 约翰逊航天中心游客中心。演讲结束后将举行表彰关键任务贡献者的颁奖典礼。

paras.en: The astronauts will be available for media interviews before the event. Media may request an in-person interview no later than 5 p.m. Monday, Nov. 16, by emailing the JSC Newsroom at jsc-newsroom@mail.nasa.gov.
paras.zh: 宇航员将在活动前接受媒体采访。媒体可在下午 5 点之前要求进行现场采访。 11 月 16 日星期一，发送电子邮件至 JSC 新闻室：jsc-newsroom@mail.nasa.gov。

paras.en: Williams, Kud‑Sverchkov, and Mikaev launched aboard the Soyuz MS-28 spacecraft from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan on Nov. 27, 2025. The trio returned to Earth on July 26, making a parachute-assisted landing southeast of Dzhezkazgan, Kazakhstan. The crew was in space for 241 days, orbiting the Earth 3,856 times and traveling more than 102 million miles. The mission was the first for Williams and Mikaev and the second for Kud-Sverchkov.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯、库德-斯维尔奇科夫和米卡耶夫于 2025 年 11 月 27 日搭乘联盟号 MS-28 航天器从哈萨克斯坦拜科努尔航天发射场发射升空。三人于 7 月 26 日返回地球，在哈萨克斯坦杰兹卡兹甘东南部进行降落伞辅助着陆。宇航员在太空中停留了 241 天，绕地球运行 3,856 圈，行程超过 1.02 亿英里。这是威廉姆斯和米卡耶夫的第一次任务，库德-斯维尔奇科夫的第二次任务。

paras.en: Meir, Hathaway, and Adenot launched aboard a Dragon spacecraft on Feb. 13 as part of NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. After more than seven months aboard the space station, Meir, Hathaway, and Adenot safely splashed down on Oct. 8 in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 2 月 13 日，作为 NASA SpaceX Crew-12 任务的一部分，梅尔、海瑟薇和阿德诺乘坐龙飞船从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站的 40 号航天发射场发射升空。在空间站上呆了七个多月后，梅尔、海瑟薇和阿德诺于 10 月 8 日安全降落在洛杉矶海岸附近的太平洋上。

paras.en: During their 237-day mission, the four crew members traveled more than 100 million miles and completed more than 3,792 orbits around Earth. The mission was the second for Meir and the first for Hathaway and Adenot. Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev also flew as part of Crew-12 but is unavailable for the event.
paras.zh: 在为期 237 天的任务中，四名宇航员飞行了超过 1 亿英里，绕地球运行了超过 3,792 圈。这是梅厄的第二次任务，也是海瑟薇和阿德诺的第一次任务。俄罗斯航天局宇航员安德烈·费德亚耶夫 (Andrey Fedyaev) 也曾作为 Crew-12 的一员飞行，但无法参加此次活动。

paras.en: The Expedition 74 crew dedicated more than 1,400 hours to scientific research and technology demonstrations aboard the International Space Station. Its work advanced in-space manufacturing by testing metal and tissue 3D-printing technologies and supported human health studies examining the effects of long-duration spaceflight. Research included blood flow studies, assessments of piloting capabilities under changing gravitational conditions, and activation of a new compact exercise system. The crew also evaluated life-support and environmental systems critical to future exploration missions under NASA’s Artemis program.
paras.zh: Expedition 74 宇航员在国际空间站上投入了 1,400 多个小时进行科学研究和技术演示。其工作通过测试金属和组织 3D 打印技术来推进太空制造，并支持研究长期太空飞行影响的人类健康研究。研究包括血流研究、重力条件变化下的驾驶能力评估以及新型紧凑运动系统的激活。机组人员还评估了对美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯计划未来探索任务至关重要的生命支持和环境系统。

paras.en: In addition, the crew members conducted pharmaceutical research to crystalize proteins for cancer medications, advance tumor targeting treatments, and grow stem cells for therapeutics. They cared for the first set of plants studied outside of curated systems, upgraded an instrument used to advance our understanding of matter and develop new quantum technologies, managed visiting spacecraft, and performed essential maintenance to support the continued operation of the orbiting laboratory.
paras.zh: 此外，船员们还进行了药物研究，以结晶癌症药物的蛋白质、推进肿瘤靶向治疗以及培养用于治疗的干细胞。他们照顾在策划系统之外研究的第一组植物，升级了用于增进我们对物质的理解并开发新量子技术的仪器，管理访问航天器，并进行必要的维护以支持轨道实验室的持续运行。

paras.en: Beyond research and operational achievements, Expedition 74 engaged students and audiences around the world through live educational events, outreach activities, and the sharing of stunning imagery that highlights the importance of scientific discovery and international collaboration in space.
paras.zh: 除了研究和运营成果之外，Expedition 74 还通过现场教育活动、外展活动以及分享令人惊叹的图像来吸引世界各地的学生和观众，这些图像强调了太空中科学发现和国际合作的重要性。

paras.en: For more than 26 years, people have lived and worked continuously aboard the International Space Station, advancing scientific knowledge and making research breakthroughs not possible on Earth. The space station helps NASA understand and overcome the challenges of human spaceflight, expand commercial opportunities in low Earth orbit, and build on the foundation for long-duration missions to the Moon, as part of the Artemis program, and to Mars.
paras.zh: 26 年多来，人们在国际空间站上持续生活和工作，推进科学知识进步，取得地球上不可能的研究突破。该空间站帮助美国宇航局了解和克服载人航天的挑战，扩大近地轨道的商业机会，并为长期月球任务（作为阿尔忒弥斯计划的一部分）和火星任务奠定基础。

paras.en: Learn more about International Space Station research and operations at:
paras.zh: 了解有关国际空间站研究和运营的更多信息：

paras.en: anna.c.schneider@nasa.gov / shaneequa.y.vereen@nasa.gov
paras.zh: anna.c.schneider@nasa.gov / shaneequa.y.vereen@nasa.gov

articles.title: NASA Invites Media, Public to Join Voyager 1 One-Light Day Activities
articles.author: Gerelle Q. Dodson

paras.en: Launched nearly 50 years ago in 1977, NASA’s Voyager 1 on Wednesday, Nov. 18 will have traveled one light-day from Earth, which is more than 16 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers). Voyager 1 is the most distant human-made object, and any light from Earth would take 24 hours to reach the spacecraft. NASA will highlight this historic milestone with two events.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 航海者一号于 1977 年发射，距今已近 50 年，于 11 月 18 日星期三发射，距离地球一光日，距离超过 160 亿英里（259 亿公里）。旅行者一号是最遥远的人造物体，任何来自地球的光线都需要 24 小时才能到达该航天器。美国宇航局将通过两件事来强调这一历史性的里程碑。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Nov. 17, NASA invites the world to participate in “Shine Bright for Voyager’s Light-Day” by creating a symbolic wave of golden light encircling the planet after sunset. NASA has created a website that enables smart phones and tablets to flash “VGR”, Voyager’s call sign, in morse code.
paras.zh: 11 月 17 日星期二，美国宇航局 (NASA) 邀请全世界参与“航海者之光日”活动，在日落后创造一波象征性的金色光波环绕地球。 NASA 创建了一个网站，使智能手机和平板电脑能够以莫尔斯电码闪烁“VGR”（航行者号的呼号）。

paras.en: For more information about how to participate in “Shine Bright for Voyager Light-Day,” visit:
paras.zh: 有关如何参加“Shine Bright for Voyager Light-Day”的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: Everyone is encouraged to capture photos or videos of their light-day signal and share it on social platforms, tagging @NASA.
paras.zh: 我们鼓励每个人拍摄他们的光日信号的照片或视频，并在社交平台上分享，并标记@NASA。

paras.en: On Thursday, Nov. 19 at 12 p.m. EST (9 a.m. PST), NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) in Southern California will host a moderated discussion with mission members and NASA leadership about the status of Voyager 1 and 2, the unique science the twin probes continue to gather in interstellar space, and the challenges of keeping the spacecraft operating for so long over such vast distances. A Q&A with media and other audience members will follow. In addition, there also will be a preview of the upcoming NASA+ Voyager documentary, planned for release in 2027 for the mission’s 50th anniversary.
paras.zh: 11 月 19 日星期四中午 12 点美国东部标准时间（太平洋标准时间上午 9 点），美国宇航局位于南加州的喷气推进实验室 (JPL) 将与任务成员和美国宇航局领导层举行一场主持讨论，讨论航海者 1 号和航海者 2 号的状态、双探测器在星际空间中持续收集的独特科学知识，以及让航天器在如此遥远的距离上长时间运行所面临的挑战。随后将与媒体和其他观众进行问答。此外，还将预览即将上映的 NASA+ Voyager 纪录片，计划于 2027 年上映，庆祝该任务 50 周年。

paras.en: The event will take place in NASA JPL’s von Kármán Auditorium, where JPL hosted Voyager briefings during the spacecraft’s grand tour of the outer planets.
paras.zh: 该活动将在美国宇航局喷气推进实验室的冯·卡门礼堂举行，喷气推进实验室在航天器外行星的盛大旅行期间在此举办了航行者号简报会。

paras.en: - Nicky Fox, associate administrator, Science Mission Directorate, Washington
paras.zh: - Nicky Fox，华盛顿科学任务理事会副管理员

paras.en: - Jonathan Lunine, chief scientist, NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Southern California, and professor of planetary science, Caltech
paras.zh: - Jonathan Lunine，美国宇航局南加州喷气推进实验室首席科学家、加州理工学院行星科学教授

paras.en: - Suzanne Dodd, Voyager project manager, NASA JPL
paras.zh: - Suzanne Dodd，NASA JPL 航行者项目经理

paras.en: - Kareem Badaruddin, Voyager mission manager, NASA JPL
paras.zh: - Kareem Badaruddin，NASA JPL 航行者号任务经理

paras.en: - Jamie Rankin, Voyager deputy project scientist, Princeton University
paras.zh: - Jamie Rankin，普林斯顿大学 Voyager 项目副科学家

paras.en: U.S. media interested in attending the event in person must RSVP by Monday, Nov. 16 to Josh Smooha at: josh.smooha@jpl.nasa.gov. To be considered for onsite credentials, foreign national media must RSVP no later than Thursday, Nov. 12. Media interested in participating virtually must RSVP no later than two hours before the event. NASA’s media accreditation policy is available online.
paras.zh: 有兴趣亲自参加该活动的美国媒体必须在 11 月 16 日星期一之前回复 Josh Smooha，电子邮件地址：josh.smooha@jpl.nasa.gov。为了获得现场证书，外国媒体必须在 11 月 12 日星期四之前回复。有兴趣参与虚拟活动的媒体必须在活动前两小时之前回复。 NASA 的媒体认证政策可在线获取。

paras.en: For almost half a century, the agency’s Voyager mission has blazed a trail through space. Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 were designed to explore the outer planets by taking advantage of a planetary alignment that occurs once every 176 years. Voyager 1 entered interstellar space in 2012. Following a different trajectory, Voyager 2 entered in 2018. Both spacecraft continue to provide unique scientific observations of the environment beyond the heliosphere, the protective bubble created by the Sun.
paras.zh: 近半个世纪以来，该机构的航行者号任务在太空中开辟了一条道路。航海者 1 号和航海者 2 号旨在利用每 176 年一次的行星排列来探索外行星。航海者 1 号于 2012 年进入星际空间。航海者 2 号沿着不同的轨迹于 2018 年进入星际空间。这两个航天器继续对日光层（太阳产生的保护气泡）之外的环境提供独特的科学观测。

paras.en: Managed by Caltech in Pasadena, California, NASA JPL built and operates the Voyager spacecraft. NASA’s Deep Space Network, also managed by NASA JPL, enables communication with the distant probes. The Voyager mission is funded by NASA’s Heliophysics Division at NASA Headquarters in Washington.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局喷气推进实验室由位于加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的加州理工学院管理，建造并运营航海家号航天器。美国宇航局的深空网络也由美国宇航局喷气推进实验室管理，可以与遥远的探测器进行通信。航行者号任务由位于华盛顿美国宇航局总部的美国宇航局太阳物理学部门资助。

paras.en: For more information about NASA’s Voyager mission, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 NASA 航行者号任务的更多信息，请访问：

paras.zh: abbey.a.interrante@nasa.gov / karen.c.fox@nasa.gov

articles.title: When deaths go uncounted: WHO flags dangerous blind spots in Africa’s health data

paras.en: When deaths go uncounted: WHO flags dangerous blind spots in Africa’s health data
paras.zh: 当死亡人数未被统计时：世卫组织指出非洲卫生数据中的危险盲点

paras.en: The study by the World Health Organization (WHO) finds that many countries on the continent are facing challenges, including in recording deaths and collecting and interpreting health information.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）的研究发现，非洲大陆许多国家都面临挑战，包括记录死亡人数以及收集和解释健康信息。

paras.en: “When we do not know why people are dying, which children are missing essential services or where communities face the greatest health risks, we may overlook the very people who need our attention most,” said Dr. Mohamed Janabi, WHO regional director for Africa.
paras.zh: 世卫组织非洲区域主任穆罕默德·贾纳比博士说：“当我们不知道人们为何死亡、哪些儿童缺少基本服务或哪些社区面临最大的健康风险时，我们可能会忽视最需要我们关注的人。”

paras.en: The report was launched at the First African Health Data Forum which opened in the Kenyan capital Nairobi on Tuesday, bringing together health ministers, senior officials and other stakeholders.
paras.zh: 该报告是在周二于肯尼亚首都内罗毕开幕的首届非洲健康数据论坛上发布的，各国卫生部长、高级官员和其他利益相关者齐聚一堂。

paras.en: Of the 40 countries assessed, fewer than half – 19 – reported that authorities are notified of at least eight in 10 deaths. Just over half, 21, record a cause for at least eight in 10 of the deaths that are registered.
paras.zh: 在接受评估的 40 个国家中，不到一半（19 个）报告称，当局接到通知的死亡人数中，每 10 例中至少有 8 例死亡。在登记的死亡人数中，有超过一半（即 21 岁）记录了至少十分之八的死亡原因。

paras.en: Many countries also struggle to make sense of the data they do collect. Fewer than half (43 per cent) have enough capacity to analyse health data at the level of clinics and hospitals, and only one in four can check its quality there.
paras.zh: 许多国家也很难理解他们收集的数据。不到一半（43％）的人有足够的能力在诊所和医院层面分析健康数据，并且只有四分之一的人可以在那里检查其质量。

paras.en: The report also found that many countries are still at the early stages of developing the systems and capacities required to produce reliable health information.
paras.zh: 报告还发现，许多国家仍处于开发提供可靠卫生信息所需的系统和能力的早期阶段。

paras.en: Major challenges include governance and finance, with only 18 per cent of countries reporting having a dedicated budget for health information systems. Other weaknesses centre around coordination, routine data-quality checks and availability of trained professionals.
paras.zh: 主要挑战包括治理和财务，据报告，只有 18% 的国家拥有用于卫生信息系统的专门预算。其他弱点集中在协调、例行数据质量检查和训练有素的专业人员的可用性方面。

paras.en: Yet governments have made significant progress. The WHO Africa Region comprises 47 countries and the majority, 43, have adopted a digital platform for collecting and reporting routine health information.
paras.zh: 然而各国政府已经取得了重大进展。世卫组织非洲区域由 47 个国家组成，其中大多数国家（43 个）已采用数字平台来收集和报告常规健康信息。

paras.en: Countries are making strides, such as Nigeria, where health authorities in Bauchi state used vaccination data and community-level information to identify children who had missed routine vaccinations.
paras.zh: 一些国家正在取得进展，例如尼日利亚，包奇州卫生当局利用疫苗接种数据和社区信息来识别错过常规疫苗接种的儿童。

paras.en: The First African Health Data Forum runs through Thursday, providing an opportunity for participants to review the report’s findings, share experiences and identify solutions.
paras.zh: 第一届非洲健康数据论坛将于周四举行，为参与者提供了审查报告结果、分享经验和确定解决方案的机会。

paras.en: Discussions will also examine how digital health, artificial intelligence (AI) and other innovations can strengthen health information systems and support healthcare services.
paras.zh: 讨论还将探讨数字健康、人工智能 (AI) 和其他创新如何加强健康信息系统并支持医疗保健服务。

paras.en: Dr. Hillary Kipruto, a WHO technical officer, noted how AI has impacted healthcare.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织技术官员 Hillary Kipruto 博士指出了人工智能如何影响医疗保健。

paras.en: “The power for diagnostics has leapfrogged,” he told UN News, while analysis would have taken months to complete but a report can now be generated with a click of a button.
paras.zh: 他告诉《联合国新闻》：“诊断能力已经实现跨越式发展”，虽然分析需要数月时间才能完成，但现在只需点击一个按钮即可生成报告。

paras.en: “We cannot run away from it, but we have to make sure that there are enabling legislation and frameworks which allows us to responsibly use AI,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们无法逃避它，但我们必须确保有有利的立法和框架，使我们能够负责任地使用人工智能，”他说。

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: South Sudan’s first elections loom amid rising violence

paras.en: Security Council LIVE: South Sudan’s first elections loom amid rising violence
paras.zh: 安理会直播：南苏丹首次选举在暴力升级中迫在眉睫

paras.en: With South Sudan just six weeks away from its first national elections since independence, the Security Council meets in New York Tuesday amid deepening political uncertainty and worsening violence. Ambassadors are expected to press for an inclusive process and credible polls, while civilians bear the brunt of fighting, hunger and displacement.
paras.zh: 距离南苏丹独立以来的首次全国选举仅剩六周时间，安理会周二在纽约召开会议，政治不确定性不断加深，暴力事件不断恶化。各国大使预计将敦促包容性进程和可信的民意调查，而平民则首当其冲地遭受战斗、饥饿和流离失所。

paras.en: - Elections are set for 22 December, the first since independence in 2011
paras.zh: - 选举定于 12 月 22 日举行，这是 2011 年独立以来的首次选举

paras.en: - President Salva Kiir dissolved the transitional government in September and removed all vice-presidents, including the detained Riek Machar
paras.zh: - 萨尔瓦·基尔总统于9月解散了过渡政府，并罢免了所有副总统，包括被拘留的里克·马查尔

paras.en: - Clashes in Upper Nile state have displaced more than 35,000 people
paras.zh: - 上尼罗州的冲突已导致超过 35,000 人流离失所

paras.en: - 2.5 million people face emergency hunger, and 73,300 face catastrophe
paras.zh: - 250万人面临紧急饥饿，73,300人面临灾难

paras.en: - Three peacekeepers were killed in an ambush in Jonglei in August
paras.zh: - 八月，三名维和人员在琼莱州的一次伏击中丧生

articles.title: COP31: Energy transition takes centre stage as countries map path beyond fossil fuels

paras.en: COP31: Energy transition takes centre stage as countries map path beyond fossil fuels
paras.zh: COP31：随着各国规划超越化石燃料的道路，能源转型成为焦点

paras.en: The global energy transition took centre stage on the second day of COP31, as countries explored how to move away from fossil fuels, accelerate clean energy and overcome financial and infrastructure barriers standing in the way.
paras.zh: 全球能源转型成为 COP31 第二天的焦点，各国探讨如何摆脱化石燃料、加速清洁能源并克服阻碍的金融和基础设施障碍。

paras.en: - Beyond fossil fuels: Brazil presents a roadmap for the energy transition as the UN chief warns of the cost of continued dependence.
paras.zh: - 超越化石燃料：联合国秘书长警告持续依赖化石燃料的代价，巴西提出了能源转型路线图。

paras.en: - An electric future: Türkiye pushes its 35-by-35 initiative to accelerate global electrification.
paras.zh: - 电力未来：土耳其推动 35×35 计划以加速全球电气化。

paras.en: - The missing pieces: Outdated or missing power grids and costly financing threaten to slow the clean energy transition.
paras.zh: - 缺失的部分：过时或缺失的电网以及昂贵的融资可能会减缓清洁能源转型。

paras.en: Energy and Transport Day at COP31 got off to a somewhat ironic start on Tuesday. With world leaders descending on Antalya and security tightened, roads were clogged, buses packed and journeys to the venue stretched for hours.
paras.zh: 周二，第 31 次缔约方大会能源和运输日的开局有点讽刺。随着世界领导人齐聚安塔利亚，安全措施加强，道路堵塞，公共汽车挤满人，前往会场的旅程延长了几个小时。

paras.en: The chaos outside, however, did little to overshadow the bigger challenge being tackled inside: transforming how the world produces and uses energy, and ending its dependence on fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 然而，外部的混乱并没有掩盖内部正在解决的更大挑战：改变世界生产和使用能源的方式，并结束对化石燃料的依赖。

paras.en: Three years after countries agreed in Dubai (COP28) to transition away from coal, oil and gas, Brazil, COP30 lead, presented a roadmap aimed at turning that promise into reality.
paras.zh: 各国在迪拜（COP28）同意放弃煤炭、石油和天然气的三年后，COP30牵头的巴西提出了一份旨在将这一承​​诺变为现实的路线图。

paras.en: “It’s long past time to stop treating the transition away from fossil fuels as taboo or intractable,” UN Secretary-General António Guterres said at the launch of Brazil’s COP30 initiative setting out how countries can transition away from fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在巴西 COP30 倡议启动仪式上表示：“早就该停止将摆脱化石燃料的转变视为禁忌或棘手的事情了。”该倡议阐述了各国如何摆脱化石燃料。

paras.en: But he also had a warning: fossil fuel dependence is not just bad for the climate. It is becoming an increasingly expensive liability.
paras.zh: 但他也发出警告：依赖化石燃料不仅对气候有害。它正在成为一项日益昂贵的负债。

paras.en: Since the current escalation in the Middle East began, the European Union alone has paid more than €100 billion in additional fossil fuel import costs, he said, while petrol and diesel prices have surged across 130 countries.
paras.zh: 他表示，自当前中东局势升级以来，仅欧盟就额外支付了超过 1000 亿欧元的化石燃料进口成本，而 130 个国家的汽油和柴油价格也大幅上涨。

paras.en: “Changing suppliers will not eliminate this exposure. Disruption anywhere drives up prices everywhere.”
paras.zh: “更换供应商并不能消除这种风险。任何地方的中断都会推高各地的价格。”

paras.en: First released on 3 November and formally presented today at COP31, Brazil's roadmap seeks to turn the global commitment to move away from fossil fuels into national plans.
paras.zh: 巴西路线图于 11 月 3 日首次发布，并于今日在 COP31 上正式提出，旨在将全球摆脱化石燃料的承诺转化为国家计划。

paras.en: The challenge looks different from one country to another. Oil and gas producers must prepare for declining revenues and changes to jobs and industries, while countries dependent on imported fuels need to develop alternatives that can reduce their exposure to volatile energy markets.
paras.zh: 每个国家面临的挑战都不同。石油和天然气生产商必须为收入下降以及就业和行业变化做好准备，而依赖进口燃料的国家则需要开发替代品，以减少能源市场波动的风险。

paras.en: Both face the difficult task of securing the investment, infrastructure and international support needed to make the transition possible.
paras.zh: 两者都面临着确保转型所需的投资、基础设施和国际支持的艰巨任务。

paras.en: Ana Toni, CEO of Brazil’s COP30 Presidency, said the roadmap examines three interconnected challenges: fossil fuel demand, production and supply, and the economic consequences of moving away from them.
paras.zh: 巴西 COP30 主席国首席执行官安娜·托尼 (Ana Toni) 表示，该路线图审查了三个相互关联的挑战：化石燃料需求、生产和供应，以及摆脱这些挑战的经济后果。

paras.en: It also offers countries indicators to assess their readiness, identify obstacles and plan next steps, alongside proposals for greater international cooperation.
paras.zh: 它还为各国提供了评估其准备情况、查明障碍和规划下一步行动的指标，以及加强国际合作的建议。

paras.en: “Start now from wherever you are. Start now. Don’t wait,” she urged.
paras.zh: “从现在开始，无论你身在何处。现在就开始。不要等待，”她敦促道。

paras.en: The roadmap is voluntary and not new binding climate agreement.
paras.zh: 该路线图是自愿的，而不是新的具有约束力的气候协议。

paras.en: Secretary-General Guterres nevertheless called on countries to produce national plans with clear timelines and financing needs, and to demonstrate measurable progress by 2028.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，古特雷斯秘书长仍呼吁各国制定具有明确时间表和融资需求的国家计划，并在 2028 年之前展示可衡量的进展。

paras.en: The roadmap was one of several energy initiatives showcased during the day.
paras.zh: 该路线图是当天展示的几项能源举措之一。

paras.en: COP31 host Türkiye has its own ambition: to increase electricity’s share of global energy consumption from just over 20 per cent today to 35 per cent by 2035.
paras.zh: COP31 主办国土耳其也有自己的雄心：到 2035 年，将电力在全球能源消耗中的份额从目前的略高于 20% 提高到 35%。

paras.en: The 35-by-35 Global Electrification Pledge sounds technical, but the idea is familiar: more electric buses instead of diesel, more homes heated without gas and more factories running on electricity.
paras.zh: 35×35全球电气化承诺听起来很技术性，但这个想法很熟悉：更多电动巴士代替柴油，更多家庭不用天然气取暖，更多工厂依靠电力运行。

paras.en: To deliver its full climate benefits, the power must increasingly come from clean sources.
paras.zh: 为了充分发挥气候效益，电力必须越来越多地来自清洁能源。

paras.en: Another major topic at COP31 is the electricity grid, the vast network of power lines, cables and substations that carry electricity from where it is produced to homes, businesses and industries.
paras.zh: COP31 的另一个主要议题是电网，这是一个由输电线、电缆和变电站组成的庞大网络，将电力从生产地输送到家庭、企业和工业。

paras.en: For example, imagine building a solar farm capable of powering thousands of homes, only to discover there is no way to deliver the electricity.
paras.zh: 例如，想象一下建造一个能够为数千个家庭供电的太阳能发电厂，却发现无法提供电力。

paras.en: That is already happening, according to Dario Liguti, from the UN Economic Commission for Europe (UN-ECE).
paras.zh: 联合国欧洲经济委员会 (UN-ECE) 的达里奥·利古蒂 (Dario Liguti) 表示，这种情况已经发生。

paras.en: Mr. Liguti explained to UN News that around 2,500 gigawatts of power generation and other energy projects are awaiting grid connections worldwide.
paras.zh: Liguti 先生向《联合国新闻》解释说，全球约有 2,500 吉瓦的发电和其他能源项目正在等待并网。

paras.en: Some facilities cannot connect at all. Others must cut production because electricity networks cannot accommodate the power.
paras.zh: 有些设施根本无法连接。其他人必须削减产量，因为电网无法容纳电力。

paras.en: “Two things: increase the quantity of the grid and increase its quality,” he explained, calling for millions of kilometres of new transmission lines and upgrades to existing infrastructure.
paras.zh: “有两件事：增加电网的数量并提高其质量，”他解释道，并呼吁修建数百万公里的新输电线路并对现有基础设施进行升级。

paras.en: And while the global energy crisis has exposed the risks of fossil fuel dependence, as the UN chief warned, Mr. Liguti sees an upside.
paras.zh: 正如联合国秘书长警告的那样，尽管全球能源危机暴露了依赖化石燃料的风险，但利古蒂先生看到了好处。

paras.en: “What is driving this crisis [is] driving a larger penetration of a huge investment in renewable energy…Why? Because renewable energy helps energy security because it's domestic. You don't need to import oil; you don't need to import gas.”
paras.zh: “推动这场危机的原因是推动对可再生能源进行巨额投资……为什么？因为可再生能源有助于能源安全，因为它是国内的。你不需要进口石油；你不需要进口天然气。”

paras.en: Solar and wind projects can also be built relatively quickly, he added. But their success ultimately depends on whether the electricity can reach the people who need it.
paras.zh: 他补充说，太阳能和风能项目也可以相对较快地建设。但他们的成功最终取决于电力能否到达需要它的人们手中。

paras.en: Cheaper technology, expensive transition
paras.zh: 更便宜的技术，昂贵的转型

paras.en: Solar and wind power have become dramatically cheaper over the past decade, but for many developing countries, the upfront investment remains a major obstacle.
paras.zh: 过去十年来，太阳能和风能的成本大幅降低，但对于许多发展中国家来说，前期投资仍然是一个主要障碍。

paras.en: Olli-Pekka Kuusela, a researcher at the United Nations University World Institute for Development Economics Research (UNU-WIDER), told UN News that poorer countries often face much higher borrowing costs, making clean energy projects difficult to finance even when the technology is competitive.
paras.zh: 联合国大学世界发展经济研究所（UNU-WIDER）研究员奥利-佩卡·库塞拉（Olli-Pekka Kuusela）告诉《联合国新闻》，较贫穷的国家往往面临更高的借贷成本，这使得清洁能源项目即使在技术具有竞争力的情况下也难以融资。

paras.en: “With the cleaner technologies, like solar and wind, the upfront investment costs can be a bit significant,” he told UN News. “That’s why having access to capital and having the cost of capital being reasonable is very important.”
paras.zh: “采用太阳能和风能等清洁技术，前期投资成本可能会有点高，”他告诉联合国新闻。 “这就是为什么获得资金和合理的资金成本非常重要。”

paras.en: Development banks could help by offering lower-interest loans. But for Mr. Kuusela, the opportunity goes beyond replacing fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 开发银行可以通过提供低息贷款来提供帮助。但对于库塞拉先生来说，机遇不仅仅在于替代化石燃料。

paras.en: In sub-Saharan Africa, more than half a billion people still lack electricity. Bringing reliable power to communities could support new industries, manufacturing, better services and electric public transport.
paras.zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，超过 5 亿人仍然缺电。为社区提供可靠的电力可以支持新产业、制造业、更好的服务和电动公共交通。

paras.en: And there is another challenge: making electricity systems resilient to climate change itself.
paras.zh: 还有另一个挑战：使电力系统能够适应气候变化本身。

paras.en: In Zambia, where Mr. Kuusela has conducted research, severe drought reduced hydropower production, leading to blackouts and electricity rationing. Expanding solar power and strengthening connections with neighbouring countries could help avoid similar disruptions in the future.
paras.zh: 在库塞拉先生进行研究的赞比亚，严重干旱减少了水力发电，导致停电和电力配给。扩大太阳能发电并加强与邻国的联系可能有助于避免未来出现类似的破坏。

paras.en: The issue is also on the UN’s radar, with its Global Grids Accelerator seeking to unlock investment in electricity networks and speed up their expansion and modernization.
paras.zh: 这个问题也引起了联合国的关注，其全球电网加速器寻求释放对电力网络的投资并加速其扩张和现代化。

paras.en: Follow the latest developments from COP31 through our new podcast, Talk & Action, and our special daily coverage of the conference.
paras.zh: 通过我们的新播客、Talk & Action 以及我们对会议的每日特别报道，关注 COP31 的最新进展。

articles.title: Hill insists Ferrari should back 'extraordinary' Hamilton over Leclerc

paras.en: Ferrari should back 'extraordinary' Lewis Hamilton over Charles Leclerc as number one driver, Damon Hill tells Sky Sports' The F1 Show
paras.zh: 达蒙·希尔告诉天空体育，法拉利应该支持“非凡”的刘易斯·汉密尔顿而不是查尔斯·勒克莱尔作为第一车手

paras.en: Catch up on all the major talking points from the Sao Paulo GP by listening to the latest episode of The F1 Show podcast; Damon Hill and Anthony Davidson join Simon Lazenby to discuss Ferrari's issues, Mercedes' completing their title double, and Lando Norris' victory in Brazil
paras.zh: 收听最新一集的 The F1 Show 播客，了解圣保罗大奖赛的所有主要话题；达蒙·希尔和安东尼·戴维森与西蒙·拉赞比一起讨论法拉利的问题、梅赛德斯完成双冠王以及兰多·诺里斯在巴西的胜利

paras.en: Former Formula 1 world champion Damon Hill has insisted Ferrari should back the "extraordinary" Lewis Hamilton over his team-mate Charles Leclerc if they want to have a chance of winning next year's drivers' title.
paras.zh: 前一级方程式世界冠军达蒙·希尔坚持认为，如果法拉利想要有机会赢得明年的车手冠军，他们应该支持“非凡”的刘易斯·汉密尔顿而不是他的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔。

paras.en: Ferrari's handling of their drivers came under increased scrutiny earlier this month following the Mexico City Grand Prix when a first-lap clash between Hamilton and Leclerc, running in first and second respectively at the time, cost the Italian team a likely one-two, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen going on to win the race.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，墨西哥城大奖赛结束后，法拉利对车手的处理受到了越来越多的关注，当时分别排名第一和第二的汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔在第一圈发生冲突，导致意大利车队可能以二比二的比分落败，而红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘最终赢得了比赛。

paras.en: Hamilton, who had started on pole and led on the approach to the first corner, was highly critical of Leclerc after the race for what he perceived to be an overly aggressive approach against a team-mate. Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur also expressed his displeasure at the incident.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿从杆位发车并在进入第一个弯道时领先，他在赛后对勒克莱尔提出了严厉批评，因为他认为勒克莱尔对队友采取了过于激进的做法。法拉利车队领队弗莱德·瓦塞尔也对这一事件表示不满。

paras.en: - F1 2026 Calendar | F1 2026 Standings | F1 Gossip Column
paras.zh: - F1 2026 日历 | F1 2026 积分榜 | F1八卦专栏

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: The seven-time world champion said any issues he had with Leclerc had been "squashed" following a conversation at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, which came the weekend after the race in Mexico.
paras.zh: 这位七届世界冠军表示，在墨西哥比赛结束后的周末，在圣保罗大奖赛上进行交谈后，他与勒克莱尔之间的任何问题都已被“解决”。

paras.en: Hill, the 1996 world champion, wrote on social media following the race in Mexico that Italian squad should make Hamilton their number one driver for the 2027 season and that "Lewis will deliver for Ferrari if they back him 100 per cent."
paras.zh: 1996 年世界冠军希尔在墨西哥比赛结束后在社交媒体上写道，意大利车队应该让汉密尔顿成为 2027 赛季的头号车手，并且“如果法拉利 100% 支持刘易斯，他将为他做出贡献。”

paras.en: Appearing on the latest episode of Sky Sports' The F1 Show following the triple-header of races, Hill explained his position.
paras.zh: 希尔在三场比赛结束后出现在天空体育的最新一集《F1 秀》中，解释了他的立场。

paras.en: "They [Ferrari] have invested all this in Lewis, they've got him on board, he is a massive name in the sport," the 1996 world champion said.
paras.zh: 这位 1996 年世界冠军说道：“他们（法拉利）在刘易斯身上投入了一切，他们让他加入了球队，他是这项运动中的大人物。”

paras.en: "If they have a competitive car next year, they could win the Drivers' Championship and the Constructors' Championship, and I can't see how they're going to win it if they have two drivers currently behaving the way they do, if Charles is constantly racing against Lewis like that.
paras.zh: “如果他们明年拥有一辆有竞争力的赛车，他们就可以赢得车手冠军和车队冠军，如果他们有两名车手目前的表现方式，如果查尔斯不断地与刘易斯比赛，我不知道他们将如何赢得冠军。

paras.en: "So, you have to make a decision as a team principal how you're going to enter into the fray. And I think it makes sense to me to put all your eggs behind Lewis.
paras.zh: “所以，作为球队负责人，你必须决定如何加入这场战斗。我认为把你所有的鸡蛋都放在刘易斯身上是有意义的。

paras.en: "You've got him there anyway. You've gone through all the pain and the investment to get him there. It would be a huge story, clearly. His eighth world title is just sitting there.
paras.zh: “无论如何，你已经把他带到了那里。你经历了所有的痛苦和投资才让他到达那里。显然，这将是一个巨大的故事。他的第八个世界冠军就在那里。

paras.en: "Now Charles might say, well, this is totally unfair, you know, I've been here longer. But yes, you have been there longer, but look at the results.
paras.zh: “现在查尔斯可能会说，好吧，这完全不公平，你知道，我在这里呆的时间更长了。但是，是的，你在那里呆的时间更长了，但是看看结果。

paras.en: "Lewis has got a valid point, which is he's there to make them win as a team, not just be a Ferrari driver."
paras.zh: “刘易斯的观点是有道理的，那就是他的存在是为了让他们作为一个团队获胜，而不仅仅是作为一名法拉利车手。”

paras.en: 'Hamilton has rebuilt himself after being crushed by 2021 title loss'
paras.zh: “汉密尔顿在经历了 2021 年冠军失利的打击后已经重建了自己”

paras.en: After claiming the most recent of his seven titles in 2020, Hamilton was controversially denied a record eighth triumph as he lost out to Max Verstappen at the final race of the 2021 season.
paras.zh: 在 2020 年获得七个冠军中的最新一个后，汉密尔顿在 2021 赛季的最后一场比赛中输给了马克斯·维斯塔潘，从而饱受争议地剥夺了创纪录的第八个冠军头衔。

paras.en: That coincided with a drop-off in performance for the Mercedes team that Hamilton had won six of his seven titles with, which ultimately played a part in the Brit deciding to make a blockbuster switch to Ferrari for the 2025 season.
paras.zh: 与此同时，汉密尔顿赢得了七个冠军中的六个的梅赛德斯车队的表现出现下滑，这最终促使英国人决定在 2025 赛季大举转投法拉利。

paras.en: Hamilton's last campaign with Mercedes and first with Ferrari suggested he was on the decline as he was outperformed by former team-mate George Russsell and then Leclerc, but he has returned to form in 2026.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿在梅赛德斯的最后一个赛季以及在法拉利的第一个赛季表明他的状态正在下滑，因为他的表现被前队友乔治·拉塞尔和勒克莱尔超越，但他在 2026 年恢复了状态。

paras.en: With the all-new cars for this season appearing to better suit him, Hamilton claimed his first grand prix victory for Ferrari in Barcelona to reignite hope he could once more contend for the title.
paras.zh: 随着本赛季的全新赛车似乎更适合他，汉密尔顿在巴塞罗那为法拉利赢得了首场大奖赛胜利，重新点燃了他再次争夺冠军头衔的希望。

paras.en: Leclerc, who spent just one season at Sauber before joining Ferrari as a 21-year-old, has claimed nine grand prix wins across his eight campaigns with the Italian team.
paras.zh: 勒克莱尔在 21 岁加入法拉利之前只在索伯效力过一个赛季，在代表意大利车队的八个赛季中赢得了九场大奖赛胜利。

paras.en: Hill added: "I think there's a gravitas that Lewis has. I mean, don't forget what he was like last year. He was crushed.
paras.zh: 希尔补充道：“我认为刘易斯有一种庄严的感觉。我的意思是，不要忘记他去年的样子。他被压垮了。

paras.en: "He's been crushed since Abu Dhabi, in effect, you know, in 2021. He's been fighting his way back. He's performed incredibly well this year, much better than I thought, considering I thought it was going to be very difficult, but he's rebuilt himself.
paras.zh: “自阿布扎比以来，他一直被压垮，实际上，你知道，在 2021 年。他一直在奋力反击。今年他的表现非常好，比我想象的要好得多，考虑到我认为这会非常困难，但他已经重建了自己。”

paras.en: "He is an extraordinary individual. And I think he has, and he's got pole positions and won races this year in a Ferrari. Who would have said that was possible last year?
paras.zh: “他是一个非凡的人。我认为他做到了，今年他驾驶法拉利获得了杆位并赢得了比赛。去年谁会说这是可能的呢？

paras.en: "And I think we need to settle this in the team because there's a political problem in that team. For me, it seems like there's factions within the team that are shooting for one side or the other.
paras.zh: “我认为我们需要在球队中解决这个问题，因为球队中存在政治问题。对我来说，球队内部似乎有一些派系在为一方或另一方射击。

paras.en: "You can't have that if you're going to be an effective competitor against the Red Bulls, McLaren and Mercedes."
paras.zh: “如果你想成为红牛、迈凯伦和梅赛德斯的有效竞争对手，你就无法拥有这一点。”

paras.en: Davidson: Number one status has to be earned
paras.zh: 戴维森：必须赢得头号地位

paras.en: Sky Sports F1 pundit Anthony Davidson, appearing on The F1 Show alongside Hill, questioned whether Hamilton has earned number one status over Leclerc at Ferrari.
paras.zh: 天空体育 F1 评论员安东尼·戴维森 (Anthony Davidson) 与希尔一起出现在《F1 秀》上，质疑汉密尔顿是否在法拉利赢得了超越勒克莱尔的第一地位。

paras.en: Hamilton is fourth in the 2026 drivers' standings, a place ahead of Leclerc with just 12 points separating the pair.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿在 2026 年车手积分榜上排名第四，领先勒克莱尔，两人仅相差 12 分。

paras.en: Davidson compared the situation to that of Verstappen at Red Bull, where the four-time world champion has long received preferential treatment over his team-mates.
paras.zh: 戴维森将这种情况与红牛队的维斯塔潘进行了比较，这位四届世界冠军长期以来一直比他的队友受到更优惠的待遇。

paras.en: Davidson said: "Do you think, though, with Red Bull, that it's not like they give Max better equipment? He has, without question, earned that status in the team through his dominance of lap times alone.
paras.zh: 戴维森说道：“但是，你认为红牛并没有为马克斯提供更好的装备吗？毫无疑问，他仅通过单圈时间的统治地位就赢得了车队中的地位。”

paras.en: "And it's pretty much every time. A bit like [Michael] Schumacher did against either [Rubens] Barrichello or [Felipe] Massa or [Eddie] Irvine.
paras.zh: “而且几乎每次都是如此。有点像[迈克尔]舒马赫对阵[鲁本斯]巴里切罗或[费利佩]马萨或[埃迪]欧文。

paras.en: "It was just every time he is unbeatable. And you earn that. You have to earn that status.
paras.zh: “每次他都是无与伦比的。这是你应得的。你必须赢得这种地位。

paras.en: "I'm not comfortable with the fact, thinking of Charles, the speed he had particularly last year. I wouldn't be comfortable with the fact if you just say the number one in the team is Lewis and Charles, no matter where he is, you finish behind.
paras.zh: “我对这个事实感到不满意，想到查尔斯，特别是去年他的速度。如果你只是说队中的第一是刘易斯和查尔斯，那么无论他在哪里，你都会落后，我不会对这个事实感到满意。”

paras.en: "That doesn't sit easy with me. I think to a certain degree, you have to earn that status in the team."
paras.zh: “这对我来说并不容易。我认为在某种程度上，你必须在团队中赢得这种地位。”

articles.title: U.S. moves military aircraft from British base amid Iran threats
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: LONDON — The United States has moved military aircraft from an airbase in the United Kingdom amid threats from Iran.
paras.zh: 伦敦——在伊朗的威胁下，美国已将军用飞机从英国的一个空军基地撤出。

paras.en: A U.S. official confirmed to NBC News that several military aircraft had left RAF Mildenhall as the security posture there had increased.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员向 NBC 新闻证实，随着英国皇家空军米尔登霍尔机场的安全态势加强，几架军用飞机已离开该机场。

paras.en: They were operating under “enhanced force protection measures,” the official said. They would not speculate on the exact nature of the threat that appears to have led to ramped up security.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示，他们是在“强化的部队保护措施”下行动的。他们不会猜测似乎导致安全升级的威胁的确切性质。

paras.en: At least eight air refueling tankers and three Ospreys left the base in Suffolk, eastern England, on Monday, flight tracking data showed.
paras.zh: 航班跟踪数据显示，至少八架空中加油机和三架鱼鹰于周一离开英格兰东部萨福克的基地。

paras.en: Some of the tankers, Boeing KC-135 Stratotankers, were relocated to airbases in Germany and Spain, with one moved to the area of Glasgow Prestwick Airport in Scotland. The Ospreys were moved to nearby RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk.
paras.zh: 部分波音 KC-135 Stratotankers 加油机被转移到德国和西班牙的空军基地，其中一架转移到苏格兰格拉斯哥普雷斯蒂克机场地区。鱼鹰被转移到萨福克郡附近的英国皇家空军拉肯希思基地。

paras.en: It comes weeks after the U.S. withdrew bombers from another base in Britain, RAF Fairford, after police foiled a suspected terror plot linked to Iran. The U.S. has used bases in the U.K. to strike the Islamic Republic.
paras.zh: 几周前，警方挫败了一起与伊朗有关的疑似恐怖阴谋，美国从英国皇家空军费尔福德基地撤出了轰炸机。美国利用英国的基地袭击伊斯兰共和国。

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal was first to report on this week’s movements and said the evacuation came following a threat from Iran, citing people familiar with the matter. It said the exact nature of the threat was not yet known and remained under discussion by U.S. officials.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》率先报道了本周的动向，并援引知情人士的话称，此次撤离是在伊朗发出威胁后进行的。声明称，威胁的确切性质尚不清楚，美国官员仍在讨论中。

paras.en: “We take proactive measures to ensure our aircraft, our people, and our installations remain safe and secure,” a U.S. official told NBC News.
paras.zh: 一名美国官员告诉 NBC 新闻：“我们采取积极措施，确保我们的飞机、人员和设施保持安全。”

paras.en: “U.S. Air Force aircraft rotate between installations and operating locations for a variety of reasons including training and real world requirement,” a U.S. European Command official said. “U.S. military aircraft are hosted in accordance with access, basing, and overflight agreements with our Allies and partners. Due to operations security, we will not provide further information on movement of assets,” the European Command official added.
paras.zh: 美国欧洲司令部一名官员表示：“出于训练和现实需求等多种原因，美国空军飞机在设施和作战地点之间轮换。” “美国军用飞机的驻留是根据我们与盟国和合作伙伴之间的准入、基地和飞越协议进行的。出于行动安全考虑，我们不会提供有关资产流动的进一步信息，”欧洲司令部官员补充道。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the U.K.’s Ministry of Defense said it does “not routinely comment on the activity of other nations.”
paras.zh: 英国国防部发言人表示，英国国防部“不会经常对其他国家的活动发表评论”。

paras.en: “Aircraft and other assets move regularly according to operational requirements,” the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “飞机和其他资产根据运营要求定期移动，”发言人说。

paras.en: It comes weeks after the U.S. pulled aircraft from RAF Fairford following reports of a possible Iranian drone attack, two U.S. officials previously told NBC News. That move came in the wake of an investigation into a possible planned terrorist attack at that base, located in Gloucestershire.
paras.zh: 两名美国官员此前告诉 NBC 新闻，几周前，有报道称伊朗可能发动无人机袭击，美国从英国皇家空军费尔福德空军基地撤出飞机。此举是在对位于格洛斯特郡的该基地可能策划的恐怖袭击进行调查之后做出的。

paras.en: Five men were detained on Sept. 27 after three suspicious vans were spotted traveling toward RAF Fairford. Other arrests followed and two men were charged under the National Security Act.
paras.zh: 9 月 27 日，三辆可疑货车被发现驶向英国皇家空军费尔福德机场，五名男子被拘留。随后又逮捕了其他人，并根据《国家安全法》对两名男子提出指控。

paras.en: The incident, which attracted huge international attention, remains largely unexplained although British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the activity was likely to have been coordinated in Iran.
paras.zh: 尽管英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，这一事件很可能是在伊朗协调的，但这一事件引起了国际社会的广泛关注，但很大程度上仍无法解释。

paras.en: Though Tehran has denied involvement in any plot against RAF Fairford, its powerful Revolutionary Guard warned in July that any base used to launch attacks against Iranian territory was a legitimate target.
paras.zh: 尽管德黑兰否认参与了任何针对皇家空军费尔福德的阴谋，但其强大的革命卫队在 7 月警告称，任何用于对伊朗领土发动袭击的基地都是合法目标。

paras.en: Iran has vowed retaliation for any renewal of the American-Israeli war against it and has threatened to expand its response beyond the Middle East.
paras.zh: 伊朗誓言将对美国和以色列再次发动的战争进行报复，并威胁要将其反应范围扩大到中东以外的地区。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that Washington had addressed concerns around reported threats from Tehran against American diplomats overseas by “moving people away from the threat.”
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一表示，华盛顿已经通过“让人们远离威胁”来解决有关德黑兰针对美国海外外交官的威胁的担忧。

paras.en: “Obviously, we’re always worried about the safety and security of our personnel and their families overseas,” Rubio said. “And so, when we see anything that could pose a potential threat beyond a certain threshold, we’re going to address it.”
paras.zh: 卢比奥说：“显然，我们一直担心海外人员及其家人的安全。” “因此，当我们看到任何可能构成超过一定阈值的潜在威胁时，我们将予以解决。”

paras.en: Citing new “momentum” in negotiations to end the war, President Donald Trump on Monday downplayed the prospect of new U.S. attacks.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周一援引结束战争谈判的新“势头”，淡化了美国发动新袭击的可能性。

paras.en: “Iran militarily is effectively over,” Trump said following a meeting with Qatar’s Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani.
paras.zh: 特朗普在与卡塔尔总理谢赫·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·阿勒萨尼会面后表示，“伊朗军事实际上已经结束”。

paras.en: Further U.S. attacks “won’t be necessary” at this point, but Washington remains “locked and loaded” should circumstances change, Trump told reporters at the White House.
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫对记者表示，美国目前“没有必要”发动进一步的袭击，但如果情况发生变化，华盛顿仍将“锁定并上膛”。

articles.title: Senior U.S. Army soldier arrested in U.K. on suspicion of working with Russian intelligence
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: LONDON — A senior U.S. Army soldier was arrested in the U.K. on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence, British police said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 伦敦——英国警方周二表示，一名美国陆军高级士兵因涉嫌协助俄罗斯情报而在英国被捕。

paras.en: The 41-year-old man was arrested “as part of an investigation by Counter Terrorism Policing” near the city of Gloucester, in the west of England, London’s Metropolitan Police said in a statement, adding that he remained in custody at a police station in the British capital.
paras.zh: 伦敦大都会警察局在一份声明中表示，这名 41 岁男子在英格兰西部格洛斯特市附近“作为反恐警务调查的一部分”被捕，并补充说他仍被拘留在英国首都的一个警察局。

paras.en: He was arrested on suspicion of offences under sections 1 and 3 of the National Security Act, the statement said. These relate to obtaining or disclosing protected information and assisting a foreign intelligence service.
paras.zh: 声明称，他因涉嫌触犯《国家安全法》第1条和第3条而被捕。这些涉及获取或披露受保护的信息以及协助外国情报部门。

paras.en: “The country to which the allegations relate is Russia,” the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“这些指控所涉及的国家是俄罗斯。”

paras.en: FBI Director Kash Patel was quoted in the statement as saying that the arrest was “important” and “involves allegations of espionage, which is of the utmost concern to the United States and our allies.”
paras.zh: 声明援引联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔的话说，这次逮捕“重要”，“涉及间谍活动指控，这是美国和我们的盟友最关心的问题”。

paras.en: The FBI, he added, “has no tolerance for anyone who breaks their oath to the United States and whose actions endanger our national security and that of our partners.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，联邦调查局“不会容忍任何违背对美国的誓言以及其行为危及我们和合作伙伴国家安全的人。”

paras.en: Brig. Gen. Sean Stinchon, the commanding general of U.S. Army Counterintelligence Command was also quoted in the police statement.
paras.zh: 双桅船。警方声明中还引用了美国陆军反情报司令部司令肖恩·斯廷钦将军的话。

paras.en: “The alleged conduct of a senior solider, entrusted with sensitive information, is a sobering reminder that insider threats are real and persistent,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“一名被委托掌握敏感信息的高级士兵的行为令人警醒，提醒我们内部威胁是真实且持续的。”

paras.en: “This case demonstrates the strength of our partnerships and the resolve of the counterintelligence community,” he added. “I am grateful to the U.K. and the FBI for their professionalism and teamwork throughout this investigation.”
paras.zh: 他补充说：“此案展示了我们合作伙伴关系的力量以及反情报界的决心。” “我感谢英国和联邦调查局在整个调查过程中的专业精神和团队合作。”

paras.en: Calling the allegations “very serious,” Deputy Assistant Commissioner Vicki Evans, Britain’s senior national coordinator for counter terrorism policing, said the “investigation is very much ongoing.”
paras.zh: 英国反恐警务高级国家协调员、副助理专员维琪·埃文斯 (Vicki Evans) 称这些指控“非常严重”，并表示“调查正在进行中”。

paras.en: The investigation is not linked to any other ongoing counter terror operations, the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称，此次调查与任何其他正在进行的反恐行动无关。

paras.en: But the arrests comes at a time of heightened tensions around the threat from hostile states, with British security services saying Russia and Iran have both used proxies to commit crimes on U.K. soil.
paras.zh: 但此次逮捕行动正值敌对国家威胁引发的紧张局势加剧之际，英国安全部门表示，俄罗斯和伊朗都曾利用代理人在英国境内实施犯罪。

paras.en: Officials in the U.K. have said proxies linked to Iran have been behind a string of arsons and other attacks in Britain and other countries, many of them targeting the Jewish community and intended to sow fear.
paras.zh: 英国官员表示，与伊朗有关的代理人是英国和其他国家一系列纵火和其他袭击事件的幕后黑手，其中许多袭击针对犹太社区，旨在散布恐惧。

articles.title: IVF patient fears Catholic takeover will affect quest to become a mum
articles.author: Ben Clifford

paras.en: Women going through IVF are worried about what Calvary Health Care's takeover of two private hospitals in Newcastle means for their care.
paras.zh: 接受体外受精的女性担心 Calvary Health Care 接管纽卡斯尔的两家私立医院对她们的护理意味着什么。

paras.en: The Catholic provider has confirmed it will not allow IVF, elective abortions, voluntary assisted dying or gender reassignment surgeries for religious reasons if its takeover bid is successful.
paras.zh: 这家天主教提供商已确认，如果收购成功，将不允许出于宗教原因进行试管受精、选择性堕胎、自愿协助死亡或变性手术。

paras.en: The sale is still subject to a NSW government-issued hospital licence and a ruling by the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission.
paras.zh: 此次出售仍需获得新南威尔士州政府颁发的医院许可证以及澳大利亚竞争和消费者委员会的裁决。

paras.en: Hayley Denniss always wanted to start a family, but being single and living with three chronic health conditions has not made the process easy.
paras.zh: 海莉·丹尼斯 (Hayley Denniss) 一直想组建家庭，但由于单身且患有三种慢性疾病，这个过程并不容易。

paras.en: On October 29, about four years after she began her "gruelling" IVF journey, Ms Denniss went through her third egg collection at Newcastle Private Hospital.
paras.zh: 10 月 29 日，丹尼斯女士开始“艰苦的”试管受精之旅大约四年后，在纽卡斯尔私立医院进行了她的第三次卵子采集。

paras.en: Moments before she was due to be anaesthetised for the procedure, she was told the future of IVF services at the hospital was in doubt.
paras.zh: 在她即将接受手术麻醉之前，她被告知医院试管受精服务的未来存在疑问。

paras.en: "The nurse said to me, 'I'm not sure what you're going to do after this, because Calvary don't believe in IVF,'" Ms Denniss said.
paras.zh: “护士对我说，‘我不知道你在这之后要做什么，因为加略山不相信体外受精，’”丹尼斯女士说。

paras.en: "Then I'm being wheeled into a theatre and have to wait until I wake up to process that."
paras.zh: “然后我就被推进剧院，必须等到我醒来才能处理这个问题。”

paras.en: Catholic provider Calvary Health Care is hoping to take over 14 hospitals across the country by the end of the month, after embattled provider Healthscope went into receivership last year.
paras.zh: 继陷入困境的医疗服务提供商 Healthscope 去年进入破产管理程序后，天主教医疗服务提供商 Calvary Health Care 希望在本月底之前接管全国 14 家医院。

paras.en: Six of those are in NSW, including the Newcastle and Hunter Valley private hospitals.
paras.zh: 其中六家位于新南威尔士州，包括纽卡斯尔和猎人谷的私立医院。

paras.en: Calvary follows a Catholic code of ethics and has confirmed it will not allow IVF collections, elective abortions, voluntary assisted dying or gender reassignment procedures at any hospital it acquires.
paras.zh: Calvary 遵循天主教道德准则，并已确认其收购的任何医院都不允许进行试管受精、选择性堕胎、自愿协助死亡或性别重置手术。

paras.en: Ms Denniss said her latest retrieval was one of the most successful yet, but the uncertainty about future collections and continuity of care has left her feeling uneasy.
paras.zh: 丹尼斯女士说，她最近的检索是迄今为止最成功的检索之一，但未来收藏和护理连续性的不确定性让她感到不安。

paras.en: "It's kind of hit me for six," she said.
paras.zh: “这对我来说是六分的打击，”她说。

paras.en: "I'm having this elevated happiness … but then I'm like, 'Do I get to finish off that success?'
paras.zh: “我感到无比幸福……但后来我想，‘我能完成这个成功吗？’

paras.en: Hunter IVF operates adjacent to Newcastle Private and uses the hospital's operating theatres to complete egg collections and carry out surgical sperm procedures.
paras.zh: Hunter IVF 毗邻纽卡斯尔私立医院，利用医院的手术室完成卵子采集并进行精子外科手术。

paras.en: The service, which has been in operation for more than 20 years, has told its clients the business is here to stay.
paras.zh: 这项服务已经运营了 20 多年，它告诉客户，这项业务将继续存在。

paras.en: "We're working really hard with alternate providers at the moment to ensure that there's no interruption to care," Hunter IVF doctor and fertility specialist Veronica Knight said.
paras.zh: 亨特体外受精医生兼生育专家维罗妮卡·奈特 (Veronica Knight) 表示：“我们目前正在与替代提供者非常努力地合作，以确保护理不会中断。”

paras.en: Calvary has no ownership over Hunter IVF's embryo lab or clinic, but questions remain about where surgical procedures would take place.
paras.zh: Calvary 对 Hunter IVF 的胚胎实验室或诊所没有所有权，但关于外科手术将在哪里进行的问题仍然存在。

paras.en: "Egg collection procedures and embryo transfers are all very time-sensitive," Dr Knight said.
paras.zh: “卵子采集程序和胚胎移植都对时间非常敏感，”奈特博士说。

paras.en: "Ideally those all need to happen on one site so the clinicians can move between those activities quickly."
