paras.en: The review, known as the universal periodic review, is meant to be just that: universal. Each state is reviewed every four to five years by fellow member states. The aim is to ensure that every country, however powerful, undergoes a peer review of its human rights record.
paras.zh: 这项审查被称为普遍定期审查，其意义就在于：普遍。每个州每四到五年接受一次其他成员国的审查。目的是确保每个国家，无论多么强大，其人权记录都接受同行审查。

paras.en: As well as diplomats from countries under review, civil society groups are allowed to submit evidence too. Several made the trip to Geneva, led by the American Civil Liberties Union.
paras.zh: 除了受审查国家的外交官外，民间社会团体也可以提交证据。一些人在美国公民自由联盟的带领下前往日内瓦。

paras.en: Jamil Dakwar, the ACLU's human rights director, told journalists that the current U.S. administration was continuing to violate human rights "unabashed," citing the treatment of immigrants, student protesters and the LGBTQ community as examples.
paras.zh: 美国公民自由联盟 (ACLU) 人权主任贾米尔·达克瓦尔 (Jamil Dakwar) 告诉记者，现任美国政府“毫不掩饰”地继续侵犯人权，并以对待移民、学生抗议者和 LGBTQ 群体的方式为例。

paras.en: Dakwar said the U.N. must hold the U.S. accountable, warning that the Trump administration wanted to "dismantle human rights." In a written response, the State Department pointed out that Washington had already formally withdrawn from the U.N. Human Rights Council, accusing it of "pushing anti-American rhetoric."
paras.zh: 达克瓦尔表示，联合国必须追究美国的责任，并警告特朗普政府想要“废除人权”。美国国务院在书面回应中指出，华盛顿已正式退出联合国人权理事会，指责其“推行反美言论”。

paras.en: In fact, leaving the council, which has 47 elected members, does not mean the U.S. can easily get out of the review process, which is obligatory for all 193 U.N. member states. Human rights groups see Washington's stance as part of a pattern of disengagement and even active opposition to multilateral organizations, pointing to U.S. sanctions on the International Criminal Court and the decision to leave the World Health Organization.
paras.zh: 事实上，退出拥有47个民选成员的安理会并不意味着美国可以轻易摆脱联合国所有193个成员国都必须遵守的审查程序。人权组织将华盛顿的立场视为脱离甚至积极反对多边组织模式的一部分，指出美国对国际刑事法院的制裁以及退出世界卫生组织的决定。

paras.en: So what happens now? The U.N. has few sanctions against a country that does not cooperate with the review process. Israel skipped one review back in 2013 in protest at what it said was anti-Israel bias, but returned nine months later after the U.N. rescheduled. Until today's no-show by the U.S., no country has ever failed to turn up twice.
paras.zh: 那么现在会发生什么呢？联合国对不配合审查程序的国家几乎没有制裁。以色列在 2013 年跳过了一次审查，以抗议其所谓的反以色列偏见，但在联合国重新安排时间后九个月后又返回了。直到今天美国缺席之前，没有哪个国家两次缺席。

paras.en: Rights groups would like the U.N. to hold the review anyway, and take evidence about alleged violations in the U.S. Member states had already drawn up a list of questions for Washington's diplomats, including questions about the use of the death penalty and restrictions on abortion.
paras.zh: 人权组织希望联合国无论如何都进行审查，并就美国境内涉嫌违法行为获取证据。会员国已经向华盛顿外交官列出了一份问题清单，包括有关使用死刑和限制堕胎的问题。

paras.en: But U.N. insiders fear that holding the review when there is no one to answer those questions could set a risky precedent. Even authoritarian regimes such as North Korea take part in the review process. If the U.N. allows a review to go ahead without U.S. participation, it could encourage other member states to stay away, too, leaving rights groups to present their evidence, as one put it, "in a vacuum."
paras.zh: 但联合国内部人士担心，在无人回答这些问题的情况下进行审查可能会开创一个危险的先例。甚至像朝鲜这样的独裁政权也参与了审查过程。如果联合国允许在没有美国参与的情况下进行审查，它可能会鼓励其他成员国也远离，从而让人权组织“在真空中”提出证据，正如有人所说。

paras.en: For now, the U.N. has decided to postpone tricky deliberations about how to react until early next year. In the meantime, a process regarded as a last resort for the victims of human rights violations is not available to U.S. citizens. It is, one rights activist said in Geneva, "a crisis of accountability."
paras.zh: 目前，联合国已决定将有关如何应对的棘手审议推迟到明年初。与此同时，美国公民无法利用被视为侵犯人权受害者最后手段的程序。一位人权活动人士在日内瓦表示，这是“一场问责危机”。

articles.title: Vikings acquire Kirk Cousins from Raiders who turn to Fernando Mendoza as their starting QB

paras.en: Kirk Cousins is the new starting quarterback for the Minnesota Vikings after the team agreed with the Las Vegas Raiders to acquire the player that previously played six seasons in the Twin Cities.
paras.zh: 柯克·考辛斯 (Kirk Cousins) 成为明尼苏达维京人队的新首发四分卫，球队与拉斯维加斯突袭者队达成协议，收购了这位曾在双城打过六个赛季的球员。

paras.en: So, Kirk Cousins ... once and future Vikings quarterback.
paras.zh: 所以，柯克·考辛斯……曾经也是未来的维京人四分卫。

paras.en: The Vikings are sending a third-round pick to the Raiders in exchange for Cousins with the idea of making him their starter immediately. The club is expected to promote Cousins ahead of both Kyler Murray, who is currently nursing a hamstring injury, and Carson Wentz, who was wildly ineffective in a Monday night loss to the Buffalo Bills.
paras.zh: 维京人队正在向突袭者队送出一个第三轮选秀权，以换取考辛斯，并希望他立即成为首发球员。俱乐部预计会在凯勒·穆雷（目前正在治疗腿筋伤势）和卡森·温茨（在周一晚上输给布法罗比尔队的比赛中表现不佳）之前提拔考辛斯。

paras.en: Cousins, who played for the Vikings from 2018 through 2023 – including two years under current coach Kevin O'Connell – is familiar with much of what the Vikings do on offense, so his arrival in Minneapolis should be as close to seamless as can be expected for any quarterback being traded to a new team in November.
paras.zh: 考辛斯曾在 2018 年至 2023 年为维京人队效力，包括在现任教练凯文·奥康奈尔 (Kevin O'Connell) 的带领下效力了两年，他熟悉维京人队在进攻方面的大部分做法，因此他来到明尼阿波利斯应该会像任何在 11 月份被交易到新球队的四分卫一样顺利。

paras.en: This move at the NFL's trade deadline on Tuesday, also has enormous ramifications for the Raiders beyond the compensation they're getting for the deal.
paras.zh: 周二 NFL 交易截止日期前的这一举动，除了他们从交易中获得的补偿之外，还对突袭者队产生了巨大的影响。

paras.en: It means that Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 overall selection in the 2026 draft, is expected to become the Raiders starter as soon as this week against the Seattle Seahawks.
paras.zh: 这意味着2026年选秀状元费尔南多·门多萨有望最快在本周对阵西雅图海鹰队的比赛中成为突袭者队的首发球员。

paras.en: Mendoza getting his NFL regular-season debut against the defending Super Bowl champions is quite the way to start a career but the rookie has been sitting behind Cousins so far this season and the Raiders obviously felt he was ready to take the next step in his development.
paras.zh: 门多萨在 NFL 常规赛首秀对阵超级碗卫冕冠军，这无疑是开启他职业生涯的最佳方式，但这位新秀本赛季到目前为止一直落后于考辛斯，突袭者队显然认为他已经准备好迈出下一步的发展。

paras.en: So, the Vikings are getting what they believe to be quarterback upgrade in Cousins and the Raiders are getting draft pick compensation and the start of Mendoza's career clock.
paras.zh: 因此，维京人队在考辛斯身上得到了他们认为的四分卫升级，而突袭者队则得到了选秀补偿和门多萨职业生涯的开始。

paras.en: But here's a warning to Vikings fans: the Kirk Cousins experience is a roller-coaster ride. There are a lot of ups and a lot of downs.
paras.zh: 但这里要向维京人球迷发出警告：柯克·考辛斯的经历就像坐过山车一样。有很多的起起落落。

paras.en: This season, Cousins has had four games in which he threw three touchdown passes in compiling 20 TDS and eight interceptions overall.
paras.zh: 本赛季，考辛斯有四场比赛传出 3 次达阵，总共完成 20 次 TDS 和 8 次拦截。

paras.en: But there are also games in which Cousins reminds why the Vikings were comfortable letting him depart to the Atlanta Falcons in 2024. Last weekend against the San Francisco 49ers, Cousins threw three interceptions.
paras.zh: 但也有一些比赛，考辛斯提醒了为什么维京人队愿意让他在 2024 年前往亚特兰大猎鹰队。上周末对阵旧金山 49 人队的比赛中，考辛斯完成了 3 次拦截。

paras.en: The Vikings see this as a necessary move because while they have a championship-caliber defense, their quarterback spot has been a mess, making winning with any consistency very difficult.
paras.zh: 维京人队认为这是一个必要的举措，因为虽然他们拥有冠军级别的防守，但他们的四分卫位置却很混乱，使得保持稳定的胜利变得非常困难。

paras.en: The Vikings can blame only themselves for their problems because they've been mismanaging their quarterback situation for some time.
paras.zh: 维京人队的问题只能归咎于他们自己，因为他们一段时间以来对四分卫的情况管理不善。

paras.en: The team's quarterback problems seemingly began in the 2025 offseason, when Sam Darnold was not re-signed after his breakthrough 2024 season. He signed with Seattle and became a Super Bowl champion the following February.
paras.zh: 球队的四分卫问题似乎始于2025年休赛期，当时萨姆·达诺德在2024年赛季取得突破后没有续约。他与西雅图签约并于次年二月成为超级碗冠军。

paras.en: The Vikings for all intents and purposes handed their starting job to J.J. McCarthy because he was the team's first-round pick in 2024, but he missed five games with a high-ankle sprain, later suffered a hand fracture, and finished with uneven production.
paras.zh: 出于所有意图和目的，维京人队将他们的首发位置交给了 J.J.麦卡锡因为他是球队2024年的首轮新秀，但他因高位脚踝扭伤缺席了五场比赛，后来又遭遇手部骨折，最终表现参差不齐。

paras.en: Minnesota came back this offseason with something of a quarterback competition between McCarthy and newly acquired Kyler Murray.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达州在今年休赛期回归，麦卡锡和新收购的凯勒穆雷之间展开了一场四分卫竞争。

paras.en: Murray, more experienced and with a history of producing, predictably won the quarterback job over McCarthy but what happened next was curious.
paras.zh: 穆雷经验更丰富，有着丰富的经验，不出所料地击败了麦卡锡赢得了四分卫的位置，但接下来发生的事情令人好奇。

paras.en: The Vikings demoted McCarthy to being their No. 3 quarterback instead of making him the backup. That signaled the club, and particularly O'Connell, was effectively done with the former first-round pick.
paras.zh: 维京人队将麦卡锡降级为他们的三号四分卫，而不是让他担任替补。这标志着俱乐部，尤其是奥康奈尔，已经有效地完成了前首轮选秀权的任务。

paras.en: McCarthy was eventually traded to the New York Giants who wanted him because they lost starter Jaxson Dart to injury and replacement Jameis Winston played inconsistently in his place. Now, McCarthy is the starter for a New York team in the playoff hunt.
paras.zh: 麦卡锡最终被交易到纽约巨人队，纽约巨人队想要他，因为他们因伤失去了先发球员贾克森·达特，而替补球员杰梅斯·温斯顿在他的位置上表现不稳定。现在，麦卡锡是纽约队争夺季后赛的先发球员。

paras.en: And the Vikings have seen their expectations of Murray go largely unmet. Murray suffered a concussion in the regular-season opener, injured his hamstring last week, and presided over an offense that ranked near the bottom of the league.
paras.zh: 维京人队对穆雷的期望很大程度上没有得到满足。穆雷在常规赛揭幕战中遭遇脑震荡，上周腿筋受伤，并主持了一场排名接近联盟垫底的进攻。

paras.en: None of that mattered as the 4 p.m. ET trade deadline loomed and the Vikings turned to Cousins, whose job is to upgrade a Vikings' offense that has been in search of a starter since he left in 2024.
paras.zh: 这些都不重要了，因为下午 4 点已经过去了。 ET 交易截止日期迫在眉睫，维京人队转向了考辛斯，他的工作是升级维京人队的进攻，自从他 2024 年离开以来，维京人队一直在寻找首发球员。

articles.title: No. 2 Duke faces No. 5 Michigan State in State Farm Champions Classic showdown tonight

paras.en: College Basketball has returned to action this season, and while most schools are playing inferior opponents, we do finally have a few ranked matchups. This is pretty much what happens every season. Most schools play lower-level clubs so they can get some easy wins out of the way, figure out their offense, and make adjustments before the Thanksgiving tournaments. Tonight, we have the State Farm Champions Classic, featuring two of the best in the country: Michigan State vs. Duke.
paras.zh: 大学篮球本赛季恢复了比赛，虽然大多数学校都在对阵实力较差的对手，但我们终于有了一些排名赛。这几乎是每个赛季都会发生的事情。大多数学校都会与低级别的俱乐部比赛，这样他们就可以轻松获胜，弄清楚自己的进攻方式，并在感恩节比赛之前做出调整。今晚，我们将举行州立农场冠军经典赛，其中有全国最好的两场比赛：密歇根州立大学对阵杜克大学。

paras.en: Michigan State comes into the game with a ranking of fifth in the nation, and at least part of that is due to its returning players. Jeremy Fears Jr. has been one of the better guards in college sports and is the catalyst for this team. He makes this team go, and in two games, he has led the team in scoring. It isn't much scoring at just 12 points per game, but either way, he still leads the team. Coen Carr is an athletic forward who thrives on defense and rebounding. Their tenacity will set the tone for Michigan State all season.
paras.zh: 密歇根州立大学以全国第五的排名进入比赛，这至少部分归功于其回归的球员。小杰里米·菲尔斯 (Jeremy Fears Jr.) 是大学运动中最好的后卫之一，也是这支球队的催化剂。他让这支球队前进，并且在两场比赛中，他带领球队得分。虽然场均只有 12 分，得分不算多，但无论如何，他仍然是球队的领头羊。科恩·卡尔是一名运动型前锋，擅长防守和篮板。他们的坚韧将为密歇根州立大学整个赛季定下基调。

paras.en: The Spartans are 2-0 for the season, but they haven't played anyone of substance. They beat Quinnipiac by 37 points in the season opener, and they beat Toledo by 30 points in the next game. Now they face a true test. The question will be how well some of the newer guys play. Jasiah Jervis led the team in scoring in their last game, and Ethan Taylor is a 7-footer who will cause headaches for everyone. Overall, the team has some depth, consistency, height, and high-motor guys. They should have a chance against anyone in the nation.
paras.zh: 斯巴达人队本赛季战绩为 2 胜 0 负，但他们没有打出任何实质性的比赛。他们在赛季揭幕战中以37分击败昆尼皮亚克队，在下一场比赛中以30分击败托莱多队。现在他们面临着真正的考验。问题是一些新人的表现如何。贾西亚·杰维斯（Jasiah Jervis）在上一场比赛中领先全队得分，而伊桑·泰勒（Ethan Taylor）是一位让所有人头疼的7英尺高手。总体而言，球队拥有一些深度、稳定性、身高和高机动性的球员。他们应该有机会对抗全国任何人。

paras.en: Duke is the second-ranked team in the nation, and they are pretty much the same story as every year. In the past two seasons, they had Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, and Cameron Boozer come in and leave their program. Both seasons ended without a National Championship, but both seasons were successful. The Blue Devils don't have the top-ranked player in the nation this season, but they do have Joaquim Boumtje-Boumtje and Cameron Williams, who are 6'11" or taller.
paras.zh: 杜克大学是全国排名第二的球队，他们每年的情况几乎都是一样的。在过去的两个赛季中，他们有库珀·弗拉格、康·克努佩尔和卡梅伦·布泽尔加入并退出他们的节目。两个赛季都没有获得全国冠军，但两个赛季都取得了成功。蓝魔队本赛季没有全国排名第一的球员，但他们有若阿金·布姆特耶-布姆特耶和卡梅隆·威廉姆斯，他们的身高都在 6 英尺 11 英寸或更高。

paras.en: There is some serious height on this team in general. There are three guys more than seven feet tall, and two others who are 6'10" or taller. Not many teams can compete with that interior presence. And, even if they can, Duke has an advantage in being able to continuously rotate in tall players to keep a fresh one out there while the other team has to play with a fatigued player. Caleb Foster will still orchestrate the offense. I do like the combination of new talent and returning players for Duke.
paras.zh: 总的来说，这支球队有一些严重的身高。其中三名球员身高超过 7 英尺，另外两名身高 6 英尺 10 英寸或更高。没有多少球队可以与这样的内线球员竞争。而且，即使他们可以，杜克大学也有一个优势，能够不断轮换高个子球员，以保持新鲜的球员，而另一支球队必须与疲惫的球员一起比赛。凯莱布·福斯特仍然会精心策划进攻。我确实喜欢杜克大学新秀和回归球员的组合。

paras.en: This game will take place at the United Center tonight in Chicago. This is a significantly shorter trip for the Spartans than it is for the Blue Devils, so it may feel like more of a home game for Michigan State. The height will be a bit of a problem for Michigan State, especially foul trouble comes into play. The United Center is known for being a tough place to shoot, and I still feel like the total is too high, so I'll take a half unit on the under and a half unit on the Spartans +7.5.
paras.zh: 这场比赛将于今晚在芝加哥联合中心举行。对于斯巴达人来说，这次旅行比蓝魔队要短得多，所以这可能更像是密歇根州立大学的主场比赛。对于密歇根州立大学来说，身高会是一个问题，尤其是犯规问题。联合中心球馆以拍摄难度大而闻名，我仍然觉得总数太高，所以我会在斯巴达人+7.5 上取半个单位。

paras.en: For more sports betting information and plays, follow David on X/Twitter: @futureprez2024
paras.zh: 欲了解更多体育博彩信息和玩法，请在 X/Twitter 上关注 David：@futureprez2024

articles.title: Peltola widens narrow Alaska Senate lead over Sullivan as counting continues

paras.en: Alaska's still too-close-to-call Senate race is expected to deliver another batch of ballot results Tuesday night after Monday's latest ballot drop expanded Democratic nominee Mary Peltola's lead over incumbent Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan to 2,517 first-choice votes.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加参议员竞选仍势均力敌，预计周二晚将公布另一批投票结果，此前周一最新的投票结果将民主党候选人玛丽·佩尔托拉(Mary Peltola)对现任共和党参议员丹·沙利文(Dan Sullivan)的领先优势扩大至2,517张第一选择票。

paras.en: Still current as of Tuesday midday ET, Peltola stands at 48.6% (106,321 votes) to Sullivan’s 47.5% (103,804) in the ranked-choice voting system that will kick in if neither candidate gets across the 50% threshold.
paras.zh: 截至美国东部时间周二中午，在排名选择投票系统中，佩尔托拉的得票率仍为 48.6%（106,321 票），而沙利文的得票率为 47.5%（103,804 票），如果没有候选人超过 50% 的门槛，该系统就会启动。

paras.en: The controversial race, punctuated by the "Decoy Dan" scheme exposed by The New York Times, has Republican Gerald Heikes at 2.2% (4,865) and independent Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. at 1.7% (3,651 votes). Roughly 75–76% of the expected vote is in, with tens of thousands of early, absentee and questioned ballots still to be counted.
paras.zh: 这场备受争议的竞选以《纽约时报》曝光的“诱饵丹”计划为标志，共和党人杰拉尔德·海克斯 (Gerald Heikes) 得票数为 2.2%（4,865 票），独立人士小丹尼尔·沙利文 (Daniel J. Sullivan Jr.) 得票数为 1.7%（3,651 票）。大约 75-76% 的预期选票已完成，数以万计的提前选票、缺席选票和问题选票仍有待清点。

paras.en: "After every vote is counted, it is clear that Mary Peltola will be elected Alaska’s next United States Senator," Peltola campaign manager Cheryl Bruce wrote in a statement Tuesday morning after that past tranche of votes.
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉竞选经理谢丽尔·布鲁斯（Cheryl Bruce）周二上午在完成过去一批选票后的一份声明中写道：“每张选票都清点完毕后，很明显玛丽·佩尔托拉将当选阿拉斯加州的下一任美国参议员。”

paras.en: "Mary won today’s votes by a margin of 68-30, reflecting major support in key areas from Anchorage and Chevak. This overwhelming margin further strengthens Mary’s path to victory, and Mary is looking forward to continuing her relentless fight to lower costs and put Alaska first in the United States Senate after all votes are counted."
paras.zh: “玛丽以 68 比 30 的优势赢得了今天的选票，反映了安克雷奇和切瓦克在关键领域的大力支持。这种压倒性的优势进一步加强了玛丽的胜利之路，玛丽期待着继续为降低成本而不懈奋斗，并在所有选票清点后将阿拉斯加放在美国参议院的首位。”

paras.en: The Monday drop added nearly 5,000 ballots and marked a shift from the razor-thin 637-vote Peltola edge that had held for days after Election Day.
paras.zh: 周一的下跌增加了近5000张选票，标志着选举日后数天举行的637票的佩尔托拉边缘的转变。

paras.en: The incumbent Sullivan and President Donald Trump have both suggested if Peltola does not get to 50% of the vote and ranked-choice voting (RCV) goes to rounds two or three that the Republican would absorb secondary voting strength in the system.
paras.zh: 现任沙利文和唐纳德特朗普总统都建议，如果佩尔托拉没有获得50 ％的选票，排名投票（ RCV ）进入第二轮或第三轮，共和党将在系统中吸收次要投票力量。

paras.en: Under Alaska’s system, if no candidate reaches a majority of first-choice votes, the lowest finisher is eliminated and ballots transfer according to voters’ rankings until one candidate surpasses 50%. Right now, that would be the other Dan Sullivan, which might help Peltola break 50%.
paras.zh: 在阿拉斯加的制度下，如果没有候选人获得过半数的第一选择选票，则排名最低的候选人将被淘汰，并根据选民的排名进行选票转移，直到一名候选人超过 50%。现在，另一个丹·沙利文可能会帮助佩尔托拉突破 50%。

paras.en: Official RCV tabulation is scheduled for Nov. 18, after the overseas absentee deadline.
paras.zh: 官方 RCV 统计定于 11 月 18 日，即海外缺席截止日期之后。

paras.en: The slow pace matches the timeline Gov. Mike Dunleavy described in a Sunday interview. He called the state’s process "very confusing" and "a slow system," pointing to significant ballot dumps expected Friday, Nov. 13, and Wednesday, Nov. 18.
paras.zh: 这种缓慢的节奏与州长迈克·邓利维(Mike Dunleavy)在周日采访中描述的时间表相符。他称该州的流程“非常混乱”且“系统缓慢”，并指出预计 11 月 13 日星期五和 11 月 18 日星期三将出现大量选票抛售。

paras.en: Dunleavy has also continued an investigation into the "Decoy Dan" candidacy of Daniel J. Sullivan Jr., which some Republicans allege was intended to siphon votes from the incumbent; the governor has said the Division of Elections and the Department of Justice are reviewing related questions.
paras.zh: 邓利维还继续对小丹尼尔·J·沙利文（Daniel J. Sullivan Jr.）的“诱饵丹”候选人资格进行调查，一些共和党人声称此举旨在从现任总统手中夺取选票；州长表示，选举司和司法部正在审查相关问题。

paras.en: "We're still in the process of bringing in votes and counting votes," Dunleavy said Sunday. "And we are in the midst of investigations as to determine if there was any wrongdoing, especially anything that might resemble perjury or, you know, a misrepresentation of individual's intent on how they wanted their candidacy to be placed on the ballot."
paras.zh: “我们仍在收集选票和计票，”邓利维周日表示。 “我们正在进行调查，以确定是否存在任何不当行为，特别是任何可能类似于伪证的行为，或者，你知道，歪曲个人希望如何将自己的候选人资格列入选票的意图。”

paras.en: Other statewide races remain fluid on the same ballot count:
paras.zh: 其他全州竞选在相同的选票数上仍然不稳定：

paras.en: - Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins leads the open governor’s race at 49.6% of the vote, compared to Republican Bernadette Wilson at just 28.9%.
paras.zh: - 民主党人乔纳森·克莱斯·汤姆金斯 (Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins) 在公开州长竞选中以 49.6% 的得票率领先，而共和党人伯纳黛特·威尔逊 (Bernadette Wilson) 的得票率仅为 28.9%。

paras.en: - Rep. Nick Begich, R-Alaska, holds a clear first-choice edge at 49.19% in the U.S. House race.
paras.zh: - 阿拉斯加州共和党众议员尼克·贝吉奇 (Nick Begich) 在美国众议院竞选中以 49.19% 的优势明显占据第一选择优势。

paras.en: - Ballot Measure 2, which would repeal open primaries and ranked-choice voting, trails with roughly 52.3% voting "no" against repeal to keep the system in place for future elections.
paras.zh: - 投票措施 2 将废除公开初选和排名选择投票，但大约 52.3% 的人投票反对废除，以在未来的选举中保留该制度。

paras.en: Democrats have won control of the Senate for the final two years of President Donald Trump's final term, holding a 54-44 edge with both Alaska and the Mississippi Senate races still too close to call. Democrat Scott Colom leads incumbent Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, R-Miss., by about 2,500 votes (49.08%-48.81 %).
paras.zh: 民主党在唐纳德·特朗普总统最后一个任期的最后两年赢得了参议院的控制权，以 54 比 44 的优势赢得了阿拉斯加州和密西西比州参议院的选情。民主党人斯科特·科洛姆 (Scott Colom) 领先现任密西西比州共和党参议员辛迪·海德·史密斯 (Cindy Hyde-Smith) 约 2,500 票（49.08%-48.81%）。

paras.en: If Democrats win both those seats, their party would hold a 56-44 edge in the upper chamber, having gone 9-0 in seats flipped in these midterms.
paras.zh: 如果民主党赢得这两个席位，他们的政党将在上议院以 56 比 44 的优势占据优势，而在中期选举中，他们的席位翻转的比分是 9 比 0。

articles.title: Russian naval aggression prompts new defensive initiative with ‘beer-drinking nations’
articles.author: Dan Sabbagh in Oslo

paras.en: Russian naval activity around the UK has increased by 41% in the first nine months of the year, a British defence minister has said, as the Royal Navy announced plans to step up a 10-country maritime defensive effort in response.
paras.zh: 英国国防部长表示，今年前 9 个月，俄罗斯在英国周边的海军活动增加了 41%，英国皇家海军宣布计划加强 10 个国家的海上防御行动作为回应。

paras.en: Luke Pollard, the minister for defence readiness, described the figure as “a huge increase”, justifying a new drone and warship initiative from “the alliance of beer-drinking nations” – the UK, the Netherlands and the Baltic and Nordic countries.
paras.zh: 防务部长卢克·波拉德(Luke Pollard)将这一数字描述为“巨大的增长”，证明了“啤酒国家联盟”——英国、荷兰、波罗的海和北欧国家——发起新的无人机和军舰倡议的合理性。

paras.en: The plan is for sea drones from the UK and other countries to be able to work interchangeably with warships from countries across the Northern Navies Initiative at a time when the number of British frigates is falling.
paras.zh: 该计划的目的是让英国和其他国家的海上无人机能够在英国护卫舰数量下降的情况下与北方海军倡议国家的军舰互换工作。

paras.en: “The model that we want is where British autonomy [drones] can be teamed with a British warship or a Danish warship or a Norwegian warship and can hand that autonomy off to an allied nation’s warship,” Pollard said.
paras.zh: 波拉德说：“我们想要的模式是，英国自主[无人机]可以与英国军舰、丹麦军舰或挪威军舰合作，并将这种自主权交给盟国的军舰。”

paras.en: A future Royal Navy would combine warships and drones “because that would increase our lethality”, Pollard said, sidestepping a debate about the number of UK frigates – which could drop from 12 in 2021 to three by 2030.
paras.zh: 波拉德表示，未来的皇家海军将把军舰和无人机结合起来，“因为这会增加我们的杀伤力”，他回避了有关英国护卫舰数量的争论——英国护卫舰数量可能会从 2021 年的 12 艘减少到 2030 年的 3 艘。

paras.en: Last month, the cross-party defence select committee warned that the navy risked failing to deter Russian aggression in the seas around the UK because of shortfalls in the number and availability of warships and submarines.
paras.zh: 上个月，跨党派国防特别委员会警告称，由于军舰和潜艇的数量和可用性不足，英国海军可能无法阻止俄罗斯在英国周边海域的侵略。

paras.en: Pollard blamed the Conservatives for capacity shortfalls, accusing them of cutting budgets and delaying investment when they were in government. “Now, because of the decisions taken 10, 15 years ago, we have fewer ships and fewer submarines than I would like available,” the minister said.
paras.zh: 波拉德将能力不足归咎于保守党，指责他们在执政期间削减预算并推迟投资。 “现在，由于 10、15 年前做出的决定，我们拥有的船只和潜艇比我想要的要少，”部长说。

paras.en: An extra £10bn a year allocated to defence in 2030 by the chancellor, John Healey, in October’s budget means that the UK could “send a clear demand signal to industry”, the minister said, to help tackle the Russian threat.
paras.zh: 英国财政大臣约翰·希利在 10 月份的预算中表示，到 2030 年，每年额外拨款 100 亿英镑用于国防，这意味着英国可以“向工业界发出明确的需求信号”，以帮助应对俄罗斯的威胁。

paras.en: However, since the budget announcement, there have been no major defence spending announcements, with the UK sticking to the defence investment plan announced in June and fully funded in the budget. That included a £1.5bn investment in sea drones over four years.
paras.zh: 然而，自预算公布以来，没有重大国防开支公告，英国坚持6月份宣布的国防投资计划，并在预算中全额拨款。其中包括四年内对海上无人机投资 15 亿英镑。

paras.en: Russian spy ships, such as the Yantar, have been sailing near UK waters this year trying to obtain “an increased picture of our critical national infrastructure”, Pollard said, as well as “mapping our undersea cables”.
paras.zh: 波拉德说，“扬塔尔”号等俄罗斯间谍船今年一直在英国水域附近航行，试图获得“我们关键国家基础设施的详细信息”，以及“绘制我们的海底电缆地图”。

paras.en: Its frigates have also been active in the North Sea and the Channel throughout 2026, often escorting oil tankers and other trade vessels, and at one point firing shots near a pleasure yacht south of the Isle of Wight in June.
paras.zh: 整个2026年，其护卫舰也一直活跃在北海和英吉利海峡，经常护送油轮和其他贸易船只，并曾于6月在怀特岛以南的一艘游艇附近开枪。

paras.en: Oil tankers linked to Russia remained active, though were now often “sailing around the UK” to avoid coming through the Channel, Pollard said, after the seizure of one Russia-linked tanker, the Smyrtos, in the same month as the shooting incident.
paras.zh: 波拉德表示，在枪击事件发生的同一个月，一艘与俄罗斯有关的油轮“斯米尔托斯”号被扣押后，与俄罗斯有关的油轮仍然活跃，但现在经常“绕英国航行”以避免通过英吉利海峡。

paras.en: The minister insisted that, if necessary, the Royal Navy was “ready to fight tonight”, even though it took three weeks for the UK to send a destroyer to Cyprus in the spring after the UK base at Akrotiri was struck by a drone fired by an Iranian proxy.
paras.zh: 这位部长坚称，如有必要，皇家海军“已做好今晚战斗的准备”，尽管在英国阿克罗蒂里基地被伊朗代理人发射的无人机袭击后，英国花了三周时间才在春季向塞浦路斯派遣了一艘驱逐舰。

paras.en: Russia’s northern fleet, based in the Barents Sea, retains “a really formidable undersea presence”, Pollard said, adding that Moscow had continued to invest in it throughout the Ukraine war as a means of threatening the UK.
paras.zh: 波拉德说，驻扎在巴伦支海的俄罗斯北方舰队保留了“真正强大的水下存在”，并补充说，莫斯科在整个乌克兰战争期间继续对其进行投资，作为威胁英国的手段。

paras.en: The minister was speaking at the navy’s International Sea Power conference held on the Prince of Wales aircraft carrier in Oslo. Sailing the warship to Norway was “a really important deterrent signal that we stand ready to defend every single inch of Nato territory”, he said.
paras.zh: 这位部长是在奥斯陆威尔士亲王号航空母舰上举行的海军国际海上力量会议上发表讲话的。他说，将军舰驶往挪威是“一个非常重要的威慑信号，表明我们已准备好保卫北约的每一寸领土”。

paras.en: A further £90m will be spent on underwater drones and sensors to monitor the Greenland-Iceland-UK gap for Russian submarine activity, considered to be a strategic choke point in what the navy describes as the “high north”.
paras.zh: 另外9000万英镑将用于水下无人机和传感器，以监测格陵兰岛-冰岛-英国之间的俄罗斯潜艇活动间隙，该间隙被认为是海军所称的“高北地区”的战略瓶颈。

paras.en: Ukraine has used cheap sea drones to destroy about a third of Russia’s Black Sea fleet, forcing it to relocate from Sevastopol in occupied Crimea to Novorossiysk, on the eastern Black Sea.
paras.zh: 乌克兰使用廉价的海上无人机摧毁了俄罗斯约三分之一的黑海舰队，迫使其从被占领的克里米亚的塞瓦斯托波尔转移到黑海东部的新罗西斯克。

paras.en: The former head of the country’s military, Valerii Zaluzhnyi, now Ukraine’s ambassador to the UK, said the increasingly complex use of sea drones meant that “it is likely that the world’s navies are on the verge of the most radical transformation since the rise of torpedo technology”.
paras.zh: 该国前军方首脑、现任乌克兰驻英国大使瓦莱里·扎卢日尼表示，海上无人机的使用日益复杂，意味着“世界海军很可能正处于自鱼雷技术兴起以来最彻底的变革的边缘”。

articles.title: Britain willing to discuss paying into EU to join electricity market, says minister
articles.author: Sally Weale and Kiran Stacey

paras.en: Britain is willing to discuss paying towards infrastructure schemes in poorer parts of the EU in return for access to the European electricity market, according to the minister in charge of renegotiating the bilateral relationship.
paras.zh: 负责重新谈判双边关系的部长表示，英国愿意讨论为欧盟较贫困地区的基础设施计划付费，以换取进入欧洲电力市场的机会。

paras.en: Hamish Falconer, the cabinet minister in charge of EU talks, told the Guardian he was sure the two sides would discuss the issue after this month’s summit, as ministers look to deepen ties with the union over the next few years.
paras.zh: 负责欧盟谈判的内阁部长哈米什·福尔科纳 (Hamish Falconer) 告诉《卫报》，他确信双方将在本月的峰会后讨论这一问题，因为部长们希望在未来几年深化与欧盟的关系。

paras.en: Andy Burnham, the prime minister, has said he wants a much closer relationship with the EU in the future, even raising the possibility of rejoining as a full member. But while senior figures in Brussels have said they are keen to discuss such an idea, they also want to see the UK begin to start paying for access to the European schemes it says it wants.
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示，他希望未来与欧盟建立更密切的关系，甚至提高以正式成员身份重新加入的可能性。不过，尽管布鲁塞尔的高级人士表示他们热衷于讨论这一想法，但他们也希望看到英国开始为进入其声称想要的欧洲计划付费。

paras.en: This weekend five European leaders welcomed the UK’s desire to join the European electricity market, but said Britain would have to pay into a so-called “cohesion fund” in order to do so.
paras.zh: 本周末，五位欧洲领导人对英国加入欧洲电力市场的愿望表示欢迎，但表示英国必须向所谓的“凝聚基金”付费才能实现这一目标。

paras.en: While UK officials say they do not accept the link between the electricity reforms and cohesion fund, the minister admitted the UK would enter into talks about additional contributions.
paras.zh: 尽管英国官员表示他们不接受电力改革与凝聚基金之间的联系，但部长承认英国将就额外捐款进行谈判。

paras.en: “We have not accepted that principle,” Falconer said. “I understand that that’s what the European Union have asked for, but the UK government hasn’t accepted. Again, this is something no doubt we will discuss.”
paras.zh: “我们还没有接受这一原则，”福尔科纳说。 “我知道这是欧盟所要求的，但英国政府还没有接受。同样，这无疑是我们将讨论的事情。”

paras.en: Falconer has said he hopes next week’s keenly anticipated EU-UK summit “will go some real distance in undoing some of the harm that Brexit has done”. Negotiators hope to sign deals on food and drink, carbon emissions and youth mobility.
paras.zh: 法尔科纳表示，他希望下周备受期待的欧盟-英国峰会“能够在消除英国脱欧造成的一些伤害方面取得真正的进展”。谈判代表希望签署有关食品和饮料、碳排放和青年流动性的协议。

paras.en: Any move to bring Britain into the EU electricity market, however, is likely to prove controversial. The EU cohesion fund promotes economic development in poorer regions in the bloc and UK officials will be cautious about any deal in which British taxpayers’ money could be spent on infrastructure projects in central and eastern Europe.
paras.zh: 然而，任何让英国进入欧盟电力市场的举措都可能会引起争议。欧盟凝聚力基金促进欧盟较贫困地区的经济发展，英国官员将对任何将英国纳税人的钱用于中欧和东欧基础设施项目的交易持谨慎态度。

paras.en: Falconer was, however, clear that the UK would be keen to join a future EU defence fund. Last year, negotiations on Britain’s entry into the EU’s €150bn (£125bn) defence fund collapsed after a dispute over the UK’s contribution.
paras.zh: 然而，福尔科纳明确表示，英国将热衷于加入未来的欧盟国防基金。去年，由于英国的出资存在争议，英国加入欧盟 1500 亿欧元（1250 亿英镑）国防基金的谈判破裂。

paras.en: The UK had been seeking to join the first round of the EU’s Security Action for Europe (Safe) fund, a low-interest loan scheme that is part of the EU’s push to grow defence spending by €800bn.
paras.zh: 英国一直在寻求加入欧盟欧洲安全行动（Safe）基金的第一轮，这是一项低息贷款计划，是欧盟推动国防开支增加8000亿欧元的一部分。

paras.en: EU officials suggested an entry fee of up to €6bn, significantly higher than the administrative fee the government had anticipated, and talks collapsed. “I think it’s a real shame that the UK was not part of that scheme,” Falconer said on Monday.
paras.zh: 欧盟官员建议收取高达60亿欧元的入会费，远高于政府预期的行政费，谈判破裂。福尔科纳周一表示：“我认为英国没有参与该计划真是太遗憾了。”

paras.en: “The terms on which we were asked to join were clearly not terms that we could agree and I think that’s a shame – and I think lots of our friends in the EU think it was a shame … so I hope there is an opportunity for a Safe2 and one in which the UK could join on reasonable terms.”
paras.zh: “我们被要求加入的条款显然不是我们可以同意的条款，我认为这是一种耻辱——我认为我们在欧盟的很多朋友都认为这是一种耻辱……所以我希望有一个机会，让英国能够以合理的条件加入Safe2。”

paras.en: Falconer also said he hoped negotiators would agree a youth mobility scheme ready for the 20 November summit, though there have been crucial sticking points over demands for home tuition fees for EU students at UK universities.
paras.zh: 法尔科纳还表示，他希望谈判代表能够就一项为 11 月 20 日峰会做好准备的青年流动计划达成一致，尽管在英国大学向欧盟学生收取家庭学费的要求方面存在关键症结。

paras.en: The Guardian reported last week that the UK was prepared to spend up to £450m a year to give EU students discounted university tuition fees, if Brussels allowed Britain access to the Made in Europe industrial programme.
paras.zh: 英国《卫报》上周报道称，如果布鲁塞尔允许英国加入“欧洲制造”工业计划，英国准备每年花费高达 4.5 亿英镑为欧盟学生提供大学学费折扣。

paras.en: “Obviously I understand that there are a number of member states who would like to see it made easier for EU students to come to the UK and have lower fees than they currently pay if they want to go to British universities,” Falconer said on Monday.
paras.zh: 福尔科纳周一表示：“显然，我理解许多成员国希望看到欧盟学生更容易来到英国，并且如果他们想去英国大学，学费比他们目前支付的费用更低。”

paras.en: “But that is outside of the common understanding so it will require a different set of arrangements than were envisaged when these negotiations started. Clearly it’s something that on the EU side there’s real interest, so we are engaging in that discussion but I can’t comment in detail on the negotiations.”
paras.zh: “但这超出了共识，因此需要一套与谈判开始时设想的不同的安排。显然，欧盟方面确实对此感兴趣，所以我们正在参与讨论，但我无法对谈判进行详细评论。”

paras.en: Falconer was firmly positive about the UK’s return next year to the Erasmus+ student exchange scheme, which the UK left under Boris Johnson’s Brexit deal in 2020, and will be open not just to universities but also to schools and colleges.
paras.zh: 法尔科纳对英国明年重返伊拉斯谟+学生交换计划持坚定乐观态度，该计划是英国在 2020 年鲍里斯·约翰逊脱欧协议下留下的，该计划不仅向大学开放，也向学校和学院开放。

paras.en: “I hope around the start of the summit we will be opening applications for British young people to put themselves right in the heart of Europe,” he said, rejecting Nigel Farage’s criticisms of Erasmus and the youth mobility scheme as opening the door to uncontrolled immigration.
paras.zh: 他说：“我希望在峰会开始时，我们将为英国年轻人开放申请，让他们置身于欧洲的中心。”他驳斥了奈杰尔·法拉奇对伊拉斯谟和青年流动计划的批评，称其为不受控制的移民打开了大门。

paras.en: “People understand that it is a good thing for our young people to be able to travel widely in Europe, to be able to study, to have the kind of exchanges that make such a big difference to people’s lives.
paras.zh: “人们明白，对于我们的年轻人来说，能够在欧洲广泛旅行、能够学习、能够进行对人们的生活产生巨大影响的交流是一件好事。

paras.en: “I think honestly Nigel Farage is being a big old grinch about this. This is in the interests of our young people and he should give his head a bit of a wobble, I think.”
paras.zh: “老实说，我认为奈杰尔·法拉奇在这件事上是个老怪人。这符合我们年轻人的利益，我认为他应该摇摇头。”

articles.title: Falkland Islanders face ‘devastating consequences’ if Argentina blocks oil project, says UK
articles.author: Daniel Boffey in Hamburg

paras.en: The people of the Falkland Islands face “devastating consequences” if Argentina is successful in blocking development of its offshore oilfield, the attorney general for England and Wales has told an international tribunal.
paras.zh: 英格兰和威尔士总检察长告诉国际法庭，如果阿根廷成功阻止其海上油田的开发，福克兰群岛人民将面临“毁灭性后果”。

paras.en: Ellie Reeves, representing the British government at a hearing of the international tribunal for the law of the sea (Itlos), said billions of pounds vital to the future of the British overseas territory would be lost.
paras.zh: 代表英国政府出席国际海洋法法庭（Itlos）听证会的埃莉·里夫斯（Ellie Reeves）表示，对英国海外领土的未来至关重要的数十亿英镑将会损失。

paras.en: Reeves accused Argentina of surreptitiously seeking to pursue its longstanding sovereignty claims over the south Atlantic islands through an application to the tribunal, which is sitting over two days in Hamburg.
paras.zh: 里夫斯指责阿根廷通过向法庭提出申请，暗中寻求对南大西洋岛屿长期存在的主权主张，该法庭在汉堡进行了两天的审理。

paras.en: Argentina is seeking a provisional ruling suspending the drilling for oil before further arbitration over the future of the project, which it claims poses an environmental risk.
paras.zh: 阿根廷正在寻求临时裁决，暂停石油钻探，然后对该项目的未来进行进一步仲裁，阿根廷声称该项目构成环境风险。

paras.en: Reeves told the tribunal: “In reality, what Argentina opposes is hydrocarbon activities for the economic benefit of the Falkland Islanders. What it wants is to take control of those resources for itself.”
paras.zh: 里夫斯告诉法庭：“事实上，阿根廷反对的是为了福克兰群岛人民的经济利益而进行的碳氢化合物活动。它想要的是自己控制这些资源。”

paras.en: Argentina claims Britain’s approval of the Sea Lion project is in breach of a 1976 UN resolution calling on both parties to desist from unilateral action on the islands until the sovereignty dispute is settled.
paras.zh: 阿根廷声称英国对海狮项目的批准违反了1976年联合国的一项决议，该决议呼吁双方在主权争端得到解决之前停止对这些岛屿采取单方面行动。

paras.en: Buenos Aires wants to force a commitment from the UK that it will “stop the drilling”, in order to “preserve the present situation” before a settlement over the oilfield.
paras.zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯希望迫使英国承诺“停止钻探”，以便在油田问题达成解决之前“维持现状”。

paras.en: After raising Argentina’s “armed invasion” of the islands in 1982, which she told the tribunal led to “loss of life and military occupation”, Reeves said the Falkland Islanders had a right to exploit their own natural resources, adding that a tribunal that ruled over the law of the seas had no place in settling a sovereignty dispute.
paras.zh: 里夫斯在提出阿根廷1982年对群岛的“武装入侵”后表示，福克兰群岛居民有权开发自己的自然资源，并补充说，管辖海洋法的法庭无权解决主权争端。她告诉法庭，这导致了“人员伤亡和军事占领”。

paras.en: Reeves said that suspension of the drilling, which is due to start in March next year, would kill off the Sea Lion project.
paras.zh: 里夫斯表示，原定于明年三月开始的钻探暂停将终止“海狮”项目。

paras.en: “The provisional measures sought by Argentina would prevent the people of the Falkland Islands from developing their natural resources as they are entitled to do so, pursuant to their fundamental right to self-determination,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“阿根廷寻求的临时措施将阻止福克兰群岛人民开发其自然资源，因为他们有权根据基本自决权这样做。”

paras.en: “The measures sought would have devastating consequences for the Falklands people. They risk losing billions of pounds in money, which is essential for the islands’ economic development.”
paras.zh: “所寻求的措施将对福克兰群岛人民造成毁灭性后果。他们面临着损失数十亿英镑资金的风险，而这对群岛的经济发展至关重要。”

paras.en: Sir Michael Wood KC, who also spoke on behalf of the UK, said the tribunal could lose member states should it overreach by issuing “provisional” measures that should be used only in exceptional circumstances.
paras.zh: 也代表英国发言的迈克尔·伍德·KC爵士表示，如果仲裁庭过度采取只应在特殊情况下使用的“临时”措施，那么它可能会失去成员国。

paras.en: Asked whether the UK would abide by the tribunal’s ruling, Reeves told the Guardian that she respected the institution but that she would not “get ahead” of the decisions.
paras.zh: 当被问及英国是否会遵守仲裁庭的裁决时，里夫斯告诉《卫报》，她尊重该机构，但她不会“领先”裁决。

paras.en: Speaking earlier on Tuesday, Mario Oyarzábal, chief legal adviser to Argentina’s ministry of foreign affairs, had told the tribunal that the 3,600 inhabitants of the Falkland Islands, had no right to the resources around the south Atlantic archipelago.
paras.zh: 周二早些时候，阿根廷外交部首席法律顾问马里奥·奥亚扎瓦尔 (Mario Oyarzábal) 告诉法庭，福克兰群岛的 3,600 名居民无权获得南大西洋群岛周围的资源。

paras.en: Oyarzábal said: “[Argentina] respects the interests of the inhabitants of the islands and their way of life as enshrined in the Argentine constitution … What these British citizens do not have is a right to decide to which state the islands belong …
paras.zh: 奥亚扎瓦尔说：“[阿根廷]尊重阿根廷宪法所规定的群岛居民的利益及其生活方式……这些英国公民没有权利决定这些岛屿属于哪个国家……

paras.en: “These resources belong to the Argentine people. Some 46 million of them including the 1,247 inhabitants born on the islands whose interests will be duly taken into account.”
paras.zh: “这些资源属于阿根廷人民。其中约 4,600 万人，包括出生在这些岛屿上的 1,247 名居民，他们的利益将得到适当考虑。”

paras.en: He said Argentina was ready to negotiate “all aspects of the question” of the Falkland Islands, which are known as the Malvinas in Argentina, “including the present aggravation of the dispute caused by the UK”.
paras.zh: 他表示，阿根廷已准备好就福克兰群岛（阿根廷称为马尔维纳斯群岛）的“问题的所有方面”进行谈判，“包括目前由英国引起的争端加剧”。

paras.en: He accused the UK of refusing to enter talks over the islands while pushing forward on the exploitation of its natural resources in a way that would entrench the status quo.
paras.zh: 他指责英国拒绝就这些岛屿进行谈判，同时以巩固现状的方式推进对其自然资源的开采。

paras.en: Oyarzábal claimed that the oil money from the drilling would “finance the very military base and presence that sustains the UK’s de facto control of the territory”.
paras.zh: 奥亚扎瓦尔声称，钻探所得的石油资金将“为维持英国对该领土实际控制的军事基地和存在提供资金”。

paras.en: Argentina’s case is that provisional measures to suspend the drilling are urgent. The Sea Lion project in the North Falkland basin, led by the Israeli firm Navitas and its British partner, Rockhopper, will start drilling in March and oil will be extracted from 2028 and continue for 35 years. It has the potential to double the islands’ GDP per capita to a cumulative uplift of £8bn over the lifetime of the project. The UK government asked why an application to Itlos had only been made in recent months amid increasingly bellicose rhetoric.
paras.zh: 阿根廷的情况是，暂停钻探的临时措施刻不容缓。由以色列公司 Navitas 及其英国合作伙伴 Rockhopper 牵头的北福克兰盆地的 Sea Lion 项目将于 3 月开始钻探，石油将从 2028 年开始开采，持续 35 年。它有可能使岛屿的人均 GDP 翻一番，在项目生命周期内累计增加 80 亿英镑。英国政府质问，为何近几个月来，在好战言论日益激烈的情况下，才向伊特洛斯提出申请。

paras.en: Argentina further claims that it has rights as the “coastal state” to the Falklands. The UK’s lawyers said this claim highlighted that Argentina’s application was “at heart” about sovereignty.
paras.zh: 阿根廷进一步声称其拥有作为福克兰群岛“沿海国”的权利。英国律师表示，这一主张凸显了阿根廷的申请“本质上”是关于主权的。

paras.en: The Sea Lion project has been condemned as unlawful by Argentina’s president, Javier Milei. The tribunal was told by Argentinian lawyers that the permissions given by the UK government for drilling was the “unilateral conduct” of a “colonial power”.
paras.zh: 海狮项目被阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱谴责为非法。阿根廷律师告诉仲裁庭，英国政府给予钻探许可是“殖民国家”的“单方面行为”。

paras.en: Oyarzábal added: “In the event of a blowout or spill, it is Argentina that would bear its consequences and be called upon to respond, not a state that is 12,700km away.”
paras.zh: 奥亚扎瓦尔补充道：“如果发生井喷或泄漏，将由阿根廷承担后果并被要求做出反应，而不是远在 12,700 公里之外的国家。”

paras.en: UK lawyers responded that the risk of such an incident was low and that the companies involved had mitigated against it.
paras.zh: 英国律师回应称，此类事件发生的风险较低，涉事公司已采取缓解措施。

paras.en: Argentina invaded the Falklands in 1982 at the cost of the lives of 649 Argentinian military personnel, 255 British military personnel and three Falkland Islanders. The hearing is the first time that substantive matters relating to the islands have been litigated at an international tribunal. In a show of solidarity, Princess Anne arrived in Port Stanley on Monday. The hearing continues on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 1982年，阿根廷入侵福克兰群岛，造成649名阿根廷军人、255名英国军人和三名福克兰群岛居民丧生。此次听证会是首次在国际法庭就与岛屿有关的实质性问题提起诉讼。为了表示团结，安妮公主于周一抵达斯坦利港。听证会将于周三继续进行。

articles.title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned

paras.en: A UK court has overturned laws criminalising same-sex intimacy in Trinidad and Tobago.
paras.zh: 英国一家法院推翻了特立尼达和多巴哥将同性亲密行为定为犯罪的法律。

paras.en: London's Judicial Committee of the Privy Council (JCPC), the Caribbean island's final court of appeal, ruled the laws were not in keeping with the "fundamental individual right to respect for private and family life."
paras.zh: 加勒比岛屿的终审法院伦敦枢密院司法委员会（JCPC）裁定，这些法律不符合“尊重私人和家庭生活的个人基本权利”。

paras.en: The judgement is the result of an 11-year legal battle brought by dual-citizen Jason Jones, 62, who said he hoped it would "accelerate the fight for full equality."
paras.zh: 该判决是 62 岁的双重公民杰森·琼斯 (Jason Jones) 长达 11 年法律诉讼的结果，他表示希望该判决能够“加速争取完全平等的斗争”。

paras.en: Jones had successfully challenged the laws in 2018 in Trinidad's High Court, however the ruling was overturned on appeal by the Trinidadian government.
paras.zh: 琼斯于 2018 年在特立尼达高等法院成功挑战了这些法律，但特立尼达政府在上诉中推翻了裁决。

paras.en: It is the first time the JCPC has ever decided on a case to decriminalise same-sex intimacy, and campaigners hope it will spark similar successful legal challenges elsewhere in the Commonwealth.
paras.zh: 这是 JCPC 首次就同性亲密行为合法化的案件做出决定，活动人士希望这能在英联邦其他地方引发类似的成功法律挑战。

paras.en: Prior to this historic decision, Trinidad and Tobago was one of some 34 Commonwealth countries continuing to criminalise homosexuality based on colonial-era British laws.
paras.zh: 在做出这一历史性决定之前，特立尼达和多巴哥是继续根据英国殖民时代法律将同性恋定为犯罪的约 34 个英联邦国家之一。

paras.en: Under these laws, consensual same-sex intimacy is punishable by imprisonment, and in some cases carries the death penalty.
paras.zh: 根据这些法律，双方同意的同性亲密关系可被判处监禁，在某些情况下甚至可判处死刑。

paras.en: The Attorney General of Trinidad and Tobago had argued that the law was protected from legal challenges by the "savings law clauses" - which carried over existing British laws into newly independent states.
paras.zh: 特立尼达和多巴哥总检察长辩称，该法律受到“储蓄法条款”的保护，免受法律挑战，该条款将现有的英国法律延续到新独立的国家。

paras.en: Representatives for Jones argued that the laws violated an individual's right to privacy and argued the government's changes to the laws in 1986 - which saw stricter punishments introduced - meant the savings clause protections no longer applied.
paras.zh: 琼斯的代表认为，这些法律侵犯了个人的隐私权，并认为政府 1986 年对法律的修改——引入了更严格的惩罚——意味着储蓄条款的保护不再适用。

paras.en: The judicial committee unanimously found in favour of Jones.
paras.zh: 司法委员会一致裁定琼斯胜诉。

paras.en: Handing down the judgement, Lord Sales told the court the laws "cannot be regarded as reasonably justifiable in a society that has a proper respect for the rights and freedoms of an individual".
paras.zh: 塞尔斯勋爵在作出判决时告诉法庭，“在一个适当尊重个人权利和自由的社会中，这些法律不能被视为合理合理”。

paras.en: Jones, human rights campaigner and appellant in the appeal, said: "These laws never reflected who we are as a people and a nation - diverse, multiracial, and secular.
paras.zh: 人权活动家兼上诉人琼斯表示：“这些法律从未反映出我们作为一个民族和一个国家的身份——多元化、多种族和世俗。

paras.en: "They told LGBTQ+ people that we were criminals in our own country. That message ends today."
paras.zh: “他们告诉 LGBTQ+ 人群，我们是自己国家的罪犯。这一信息今天结束。”

paras.en: Lawyer Anand Ramlogan SC, representing Jones, said the judgement was a "landmark victory for gay rights, equal dignity and respect for private and family life in Trinidad and Tobago."
paras.zh: 琼斯的代表律师阿南德·拉姆洛根 SC 表示，这一判决是“特立尼达和多巴哥同性恋权利、平等尊严以及对私人和家庭生活的尊重的里程碑式胜利”。

articles.title: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions

paras.en: Malaysia's disgraced former Prime Minister Najib Razak has arrived home to begin serving the rest of a jail sentence for corruption under house arrest.
paras.zh: 马来西亚名誉扫地的前总理纳吉布·拉扎克已回国，开始在软禁中服完因腐败而被判的剩余刑期。

paras.en: There was a big media presence at his Kuala Lumpur residence to see the 73-year-old return from prison in an SUV late on Tuesday night, escorted by a heavily armed police convoy.
paras.zh: 周二深夜，大批媒体在他吉隆坡的住所看到这位 73 岁的老人在全副武装的警察车队护送下，乘坐一辆 SUV 从监狱返回。

paras.en: Najib's return ended a four-year prison stint after he was found guilty over the embezzlement of billions of dollars from the country's sovereign wealth fund.
paras.zh: 纳吉布因挪用国家主权财富基金数十亿美元而被判有罪，他的回归结束了四年的监禁。

paras.en: The 1MDB scandal brought down his government and made headlines around the world when it came to light a decade ago, embroiling prominent figures from Malaysia to Goldman Sachs and Hollywood.
paras.zh: 十年前，1MDB 丑闻曝光后，导致他的政府垮台，并成为世界各地的头条新闻，牵涉到马来西亚、高盛和好莱坞等知名人士。

paras.en: Investigators estimated that $4.5bn (Â£3.3bn) was siphoned from the state-owned wealth fund, which Najib co-founded, into private pockets, including his own. More than $1bn allegedly ended up in accounts linked to Najib, according to prosecutors.
paras.zh: 调查人员估计，纳吉布共同创立的国有财富基金中有 45 亿美元（33 亿英镑）被转移到私人腰包，包括他自己的腰包。据检察官称，据称有超过 10 亿美元进入了与纳吉布有关的账户。

paras.en: Najib's lawyers claim he had been misled by his advisers - in particular the financier Jho Low, who has maintained his innocence and remains at large.
paras.zh: 纳吉布的律师声称，他被顾问误导了，尤其是金融家刘特佐，他坚称自己无罪，目前仍然逍遥法外。

paras.en: Najib's mansion in one of the capital's most exclusive neighbourhoods was declared a federal prison ahead of his homecoming on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 纳吉布在周二回国之前，位于首都最高档社区之一的豪宅被宣布为联邦监狱。

paras.en: Critics said his release from jail undermined efforts to fight corruption and questioned its legal basis, saying Malaysian law made no provision for house arrest.
paras.zh: 批评人士表示，他的出狱破坏了反腐败的努力，并质疑其法律依据，称马来西亚法律没有软禁的规定。

paras.en: Najib, who was prime minister from 2009 to 2018, denied wrongdoing but was convicted at two separate trials.
paras.zh: 2009年至2018年担任总理的纳吉布否认有不当行为，但在两次单独的审判中被定罪。

paras.en: In the first trial he was sentenced in 2020 to 12 years in prison and jailed in 2022. The term was later halved on appeal.
paras.zh: 在第一次审判中，他于 2020 年被判处 12 年徒刑，并于 2022 年入狱。后来上诉时刑期减半。

paras.en: In September, the King of Malaysia granted him a conditional pardon to see out the remaining two years of his sentence at home.
paras.zh: 9月，马来西亚国王给予他有条件赦免，让他在国内服完剩余两年的刑期。

paras.en: The transfer to his mansion was to take place on Friday but put on hold after the attorney general sought clarification of the royal decree. On Tuesday the high court ruled the house arrest was effective immediately.
paras.zh: 转移到他的宅邸原定于周五进行，但在司法部长寻求澄清皇家法令后被搁置。周二，高等法院裁定软禁立即生效。

paras.en: Najib's party paid a $12m fine as part of the terms of the royal pardon allowing him to serve the rest of his term at home.
paras.zh: 作为皇家赦免条款的一部分，纳吉布的政党支付了 1200 万美元的罚款，允许他在国内服完剩余的任期。

paras.en: He was sentenced after being convicted of abuse of power, money laundering and breach of trust over 42 million ringgit ($10m; Â£7.7m) transferred from SRC International - a former unit of 1MDB - into his private accounts.
paras.zh: 他因滥用权力、洗钱和违反信托罪而被判刑，该笔资金从 SRC International（1MDB 的前子公司）转入他的私人账户，金额超过 4200 万林吉特（1000 万美元；770 万英镑）。

paras.en: Najib is appealing against a 15-year prison sentence, handed down at a second trial in December 2025, in a case involving much larger sums of money. In that case he was convicted of misappropriating nearly 2.3 billion Malaysian ringgit ($569m; Â£422m) from the nation's sovereign wealth fund 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB).
paras.zh: 纳吉布正在对 2025 年 12 月二审中判处 15 年徒刑提出上诉，该案涉及金额大得多。在那起案件中，他被判挪用国家主权财富基金一马发展有限公司（1MDB）近 23 亿马来西亚林吉特（5.69 亿美元；4.22 亿英镑）的罪名。

paras.en: He is due to start serving that sentence after his house arrest ends, which is expected in August 2028.
paras.zh: 他预计将于 2028 年 8 月软禁结束后开始服刑。

articles.title: Meet the Peaky Blinders, Ukraine's drone unit protecting a devastated front-line city

paras.en: Meet the Peaky Blinders, Ukraine's drone unit protecting a devastated front-line city
paras.zh: 来认识一下“浴血黑帮”吧，这是乌克兰的无人机部队，保护着被摧毁的前线城市

paras.en: The BBC's Jonathan Beale reported from inside Slovyansk, one of four cities that make up Ukraine's "fortress belt" - a system of heavily reinforced defence lines in the parts of eastern region of Donetsk still under its control.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 的乔纳森·比尔 (Jonathan Beale) 在斯拉维扬斯克内部报道，斯拉维扬斯克是构成乌克兰“堡垒带”的四个城市之一，“堡垒带”是乌克兰“堡垒带”的一个重兵强化的防线系统，仍在其控制下的顿涅茨克东部地区的部分地区。

paras.en: The town has become almost uninhabitable and has been under heavy bombardment from Russian drones, missiles and glide bombs.
paras.zh: 该镇几乎无法居住，并受到俄罗斯无人机、导弹和滑翔炸弹的猛烈轰炸。

paras.en: Members of a Ukrainian drone unit that call themselves Peaky Blinders, named after the cult BBC TV series, have taken on the task of intercepting Russian drones.
paras.zh: 乌克兰无人机部队的成员自称“浴血黑帮”（以 BBC 热播电视剧命名），承担了拦截俄罗斯无人机的任务。

paras.en: Russia wants Kyiv to give up the fortress cities and they are central to talks on a possible peace deal that have resumed after nine months between Ukraine, Russia and the US in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯希望基辅放弃这些要塞城市，这些要塞城市对于乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国在阿布扎比举行九个月后恢复的可能和平协议谈判至关重要。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。 Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理形成的矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。而这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们在一起的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，并且以人才发展为中心。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia
paras.zh: 资料来源：《晚邮报》——伦巴第版
