articles.title: After 40 years, CERN finds evidence of a one-in-10-billion particle decay

paras.en: After 40 years, CERN finds evidence of a one-in-10-billion particle decay
paras.zh: 40 年后，CERN 发现了百亿分之一粒子衰变的证据

paras.en: - CERN scientists have finally found evidence of a particle decay so rare that it happens only once in roughly 10 billion decays, ending a search spanning more than 40 years. The breakthrough could help physicists uncover hidden particles and forces that lie beyond the reach of today's most powerful accelerators.
paras.zh: - CERN 科学家终于找到了粒子衰变的证据，这种衰变非常罕见，大约 100 亿次衰变中只发生一次，结束了长达 40 多年的搜索。这一突破可以帮助物理学家揭示当今最强大的加速器无法企及的隐藏粒子和力。

paras.en: After more than 40 years of searching, physicists at CERN have reached a major milestone in their hunt for one of the rarest known particle decays. Researchers working with the LHCb experiment have detected evidence of a process expected to occur only once in approximately 10 billion beauty particle decays.
paras.zh: 经过 40 多年的探索，欧洲核子研究中心的物理学家在寻找已知最罕见的粒子衰变之一的过程中达到了一个重要的里程碑。研究大型强子对撞机实验的研究人员发现了一个过程的证据，该过程预计在大约 100 亿个美丽粒子衰变中只会发生一次。

paras.en: The finding, announced during a seminar at CERN, marks the first time a single experiment has produced sufficient evidence for this extraordinarily rare event. Beyond its rarity, the decay is particularly valuable because it could help scientists investigate particles that are too massive to be created directly in the Large Hadron Collider.
paras.zh: 这一发现是在欧洲核子研究组织（CERN）的一次研讨会上宣布的，标志着首次通过单个实验为这一极其罕见的事件提供了足够的证据。除了稀有之外，这种衰变还特别有价值，因为它可以帮助科学家研究那些质量太大而无法直接在大型强子对撞机中产生的粒子。

paras.en: At the center of the discovery is a particle called Bd, which contains a beauty quark and a down antiquark. Scientists found evidence that this particle can decay into a pair of muons (μ+μ-). Muons are similar to electrons but have greater mass. The results agree with predictions from the Standard Model, the leading theory describing fundamental particles and their interactions, and help narrow the possibilities for new particles beyond it.
paras.zh: 这一发现的核心是一种名为 Bd 的粒子，它包含一个美夸克和一个下反夸克。科学家发现证据表明这种粒子可以衰变成一对μ子（μ+μ-）。 μ子与电子相似，但质量更大。结果与标准模型（描述基本粒子及其相互作用的主要理论）的预测一致，并有助于缩小超出标准模型的新粒子的可能性。

paras.en: Why Rare Particle Decays Could Reveal New Physics
paras.zh: 为什么罕见粒子衰变可以揭示新物理学

paras.en: One reason physicists are so interested in these unusual decays is that quantum effects allow other particles to influence how they occur. Even particles too heavy to be produced in the Large Hadron Collider can potentially leave subtle traces in the rates of these processes.
paras.zh: 物理学家对这些不寻常的衰变如此感兴趣的原因之一是量子效应允许其他粒子影响它们的发生方式。即使粒子太重而无法在大型强子对撞机中产生，也可能在这些过程的速率中留下微妙的痕迹。

paras.en: By measuring extremely rare decays with high precision, researchers can look for differences between experimental results and theoretical predictions. Such discrepancies could provide indirect evidence of previously unknown particles. Generally, the rarer a decay is, the more sensitive it can be to these hidden influences.
paras.zh: 通过高精度测量极其罕见​​的衰变，研究人员可以寻找实验结果与理论预测之间的差异。这种差异可以为以前未知的粒子提供间接证据。一般来说，衰变越罕见，对这些隐藏的影响就越敏感。

paras.en: The decay known as Bd → μ+μ-belongs to a special category that physicists have long considered 'golden channels' for investigating physics beyond the Standard Model. During this process, a beauty quark and an antiquark with the opposite electric charge annihilate each other. Their energy is transformed into a muon and its antiparticle.
paras.zh: 被称为 Bd → μ+μ- 的衰变属于一个特殊类别，物理学家长期以来一直将其视为研究标准模型之外的物理学的“黄金通道”。在此过程中，美夸克和带相反电荷的反夸克相互湮灭。它们的能量转化为μ子及其反粒子。

paras.en: Scientists have previously observed a related process involving a different beauty particle, called Bs. In 2015, a joint analysis by the LHCb and CMS collaborations reported the first confirmed observation of Bs → μ+μ-, along with initial evidence for the much rarer Bd decay.
paras.zh: Scientists have previously observed a related process involving a different beauty particle, called Bs. 2015 年，LHCb 和 CMS 合作进行的联合分析报告了首次确认的 Bs → μ+μ- 观察结果，以及更为罕见的 Bd 衰变的初步证据。

paras.en: However, subsequent analyses incorporating data collected through 2018 could not confirm the earlier evidence for Bd → μ+μ-. The difference in rarity is substantial. The Bs decay occurs approximately three times per billion beauty particle decays, while the Bd process is predicted to happen about 30 times less frequently.
paras.zh: 然而，随后结合 2018 年收集的数据进行的分析无法证实 Bd → μ+μ- 的早期证据。稀有度差异很大。每十亿个美丽粒子衰变中，Bs 衰变大约发生三次，而 Bd 过程预计发生的频率要低大约 30 倍。

paras.en: Upgraded CERN Detector Makes the Breakthrough Possible
paras.zh: 升级后的 CERN 探测器使突破成为可能

paras.en: A significant improvement to the LHCb experiment helped researchers overcome the enormous difficulty of detecting such a rare event.
paras.zh: LHCb 实验的重大改进帮助研究人员克服了检测这种罕见事件的巨大困难。

paras.en: Following a major upgrade, the experiment began collecting data in 2024 at five times the rate achieved between 2010 and 2018. The upgraded detector also became better at identifying different kinds of particles, giving researchers a clearer picture of the activity produced during collisions.
paras.zh: 经过重大升级后，该实验于 2024 年开始收集数据，收集数据的速度是 2010 年至 2018 年期间的五倍。升级后的探测器也能更好地识别不同种类的粒子，使研究人员能够更清楚地了解碰撞过程中产生的活动。

paras.en: The team combined these improvements with machine learning techniques to distinguish the exceptionally rare signals from the vast number of other particle processes. Without these advances, the events scientists wanted to study would have been overwhelmed by the background.
paras.zh: 该团队将这些改进与机器学习技术相结合，以区分异常罕见的信号和大量其他粒子过程。如果没有这些进步，科学家想要研究的事件就会被背景淹没。

paras.en: "Physicists have been chasing this decay for more than forty years," said Marco Santimaria, who co-led the international analysis team of 19 scientists. "Extreme precision is required to pick the muons out of the overwhelming background."
paras.zh: “四十多年来，物理学家一直在追踪这种衰变，”由 19 名科学家组成的国际分析小组的共同领导者 Marco Santimaria 说。 “需要极高的精度才能从巨大的背景中挑选出μ介子。”

paras.en: Four Decades of Searching Finally Produce Strong Evidence
paras.zh: 四个十年的搜寻终于产生了强有力的证据

paras.en: In particle physics, scientists use a statistical measure called standard deviations to evaluate how likely an apparent signal is to result from random fluctuations rather than a genuine physical process.
paras.zh: 在粒子物理学中，科学家使用一种称为标准差的统计测量来评估明显信号由随机波动而不是真正的物理过程产生的可能性。

paras.en: A result must reach three standard deviations to qualify as evidence of a new phenomenon. At that level, the probability of random fluctuations producing a signal at least as statistically extreme is approximately 0.3%.
paras.zh: 结果必须达到三个标准差才有资格作为新现象的证据。在该水平上，随机波动产生至少在统计上极端的信号的概率约为 0.3%。

paras.en: Using data collected during 2024 and 2025, the LHCb researchers identified evidence of Bd → μ+μ- at a significance of 3.0 standard deviations. When they combined those measurements with earlier data gathered between 2011 and 2018, the statistical significance increased to 3.2 standard deviations, exceeding the widely accepted threshold for evidence.
paras.zh: 利用 2024 年和 2025 年期间收集的数据，LHCb 研究人员确定了 Bd → μ+μ- 的证据，显着性为 3.0 个标准差。当他们将这些测量结果与 2011 年至 2018 年期间收集的早期数据结合起来时，统计显着性增加到 3.2 个标准差，超过了广泛接受的证据阈值。

paras.en: The same investigation also produced the most precise measurements ever obtained for the related Bs → μ+μ-decay, providing additional information about these exceptionally uncommon processes.
paras.zh: 同一项研究还对相关 Bs→μ+μ-衰变进行了有史以来最精确的测量，提供了有关这些异常罕见过程的更多信息。

paras.en: Although the new findings represent a major achievement, physicists have not yet reached the threshold required to declare a confirmed observation. That milestone requires a significance of five standard deviations.
paras.zh: 尽管新发现代表了一项重大成就，但物理学家尚未达到宣布已证实的观察结果所需的门槛。该里程碑需要五个标准差的显着性。

paras.en: If future measurements achieve that level of certainty, Bd → μ+μ-would become the rarest beauty particle decay ever observed.
paras.zh: 如果未来的测量达到这样的确定性水平，Bd→μ+μ-将成为有史以来观察到的最罕见的美丽粒子衰变。

paras.en: Future Large Hadron Collider Upgrades Could Uncover Hidden Particles
paras.zh: 未来大型强子对撞机的升级可以发现隐藏的粒子

paras.en: Researchers expect upcoming improvements to the Large Hadron Collider to make these measurements even more powerful.
paras.zh: 研究人员预计大型强子对撞机即将进行的改进将使这些测量变得更加强大。

paras.en: The High Luminosity LHC, also known as the HiLumi LHC, is scheduled to begin operating in 2030. Another major upgrade to the LHCb experiment is planned for the middle of the following decade. Together, these developments could eventually increase the experiment's data collection rate by another factor of ten.
paras.zh: 高亮度 LHC（也称为 HiLumi LHC）计划于 2030 年开始运行。LHCb 实验的另一次重大升级计划在下一个十年中期进行。总之，这些进展最终可能会使实验的数据收集率再提高十倍。

paras.en: Collecting much larger datasets would allow physicists to detect more of these extremely rare decays and measure their properties with greater precision. That increased sensitivity could make it possible to identify subtle effects associated with particles that remain beyond the direct reach of existing accelerators.
paras.zh: 收集更大的数据集将使物理学家能够检测到更多这些极其罕见的衰变，并更精确地测量它们的特性。灵敏度的提高可以识别与现有加速器无法直接到达的粒子相关的微妙效应。

paras.en: "Seeing evidence of this rare decay is incredibly exciting, opening up new possibilities to probe beyond the direct reach of the LHC," explained Harry Cliff, LHCb's Rare Decays Convener and Analysis Co-lead.
paras.zh: LHCb 稀有衰变召集人和分析联合负责人 Harry Cliff 解释道：“看到这种罕见衰变的证据令人难以置信地兴奋，这为探索大型强子对撞机直接覆盖范围之外的探索提供了新的可能性。”

paras.en: "The future LHCb upgrade will allow us to observe many more of these decays, providing even greater sensitivity to undiscovered particles."
paras.zh: “未来的大型强子对撞机升级将使我们能够观察到更多此类衰变，从而为未发现的粒子提供更高的灵敏度。”

paras.en: For physicists who have pursued this elusive signal for more than four decades, the new evidence represents a long-awaited advance. It also offers a promising way to investigate whether the known laws of particle physics are part of a much larger picture.
paras.zh: 对于四十多年来一直在追求这一难以捉摸的信号的物理学家来说，新的证据代表了期待已久的进展。它还提供了一种有前途的方法来研究已知的粒子物理定律是否是更大图景的一部分。

articles.title: Alzheimer’s may have early warning signs outside the brain

paras.en: Alzheimerâs may have early warning signs outside the brain
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病可能在大脑外有早期预警信号

paras.en: - A surprising discovery suggests that some early signs of Alzheimerâs disease may begin outside the brain. Using miniature laboratory systems made from human cells, scientists found that genetic mutations associated with inherited Alzheimerâs can disrupt nerve-to-muscle connections without any involvement from the brain or spinal cord. This could help explain why some patients experience changes in balance, walking, and coordination long before memory problems develop.
paras.zh: - 一项令人惊讶的发现表明，阿尔茨海默病的一些早期症状可能始于大脑外部。科学家利用由人类细胞制成的微型实验室系统发现，与遗传性阿尔茨海默病相关的基因突变可以破坏神经与肌肉的连接，而无需大脑或脊髓的任何参与。这可能有助于解释为什么一些患者在出现记忆问题之前很久就经历了平衡、行走和协调性的变化。

paras.en: Alzheimer's disease is best known for its effects on memory and thinking, but new research suggests that some symptoms may develop in a surprising place: outside the brain.
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病以其对记忆和思维的影响而闻名，但新的研究表明，某些症状可能会在一个令人惊讶的地方出现：大脑之外。

paras.en: Scientists at the University of Central Florida (UCF) have discovered that genetic mutations associated with Alzheimer's can interfere with the nerves that control muscle movement, even without involvement from the brain or spinal cord. The findings could help explain why some people with Alzheimer's experience changes in walking, balance, or coordination long before noticeable memory problems emerge.
paras.zh: 中佛罗里达大学 (UCF) 的科学家发现，与阿尔茨海默氏症相关的基因突变会干扰控制肌肉运动的神经，即使大脑或脊髓没有参与。这些发现可能有助于解释为什么一些患有阿尔茨海默氏症的人在出现明显的记忆问题之前很久就经历了行走、平衡或协调性的变化。

paras.en: The discovery raises the possibility that movement difficulties could provide earlier warning signs of the disease and that treatments focused exclusively on the brain may overlook important problems elsewhere in the body.
paras.zh: 这一发现提出了一种可能性，即运动困难可能会提供该疾病的早期预警信号，而专门针对大脑的治疗可能会忽视身体其他部位的重要问题。

paras.en: The research was led by James Hickman, a professor at UCF's Nanoscience Technology Center, and Research Professor Xiufang "Nadine" Guo, working alongside scientists at the healthcare technology company Hesperos. Funded by the National Institutes of Health's National Institute on Aging, the study used laboratory systems built from human cells to investigate how inherited Alzheimer's mutations affect movement. The findings were published in Alzheimer's & Dementia: The Journal of the Alzheimer's Association.
paras.zh: 这项研究由 UCF 纳米科学技术中心教授 James Hickman 和研究教授 Xiufang“Nadine”Guo 领导，他们与医疗保健技术公司 Hesperos 的科学家一起工作。该研究由美国国立卫生研究院国家衰老研究所资助，利用人体细胞构建的实验室系统来研究遗传性阿尔茨海默病突变如何影响运动。研究结果发表在《阿尔茨海默病与痴呆：阿尔茨海默病协会杂志》上。

paras.en: "Motor deficits may be an earlier indication [of Alzheimer's]," Guo says. "If we can detect those changes and intervene earlier, that could help delay the onset of central nervous system symptoms."
paras.zh: “运动缺陷可能是[阿尔茨海默病]的早期迹象，”郭说。 “如果我们能够检测到这些变化并尽早进行干预，这可能有助于延缓中枢神经系统症状的发作。”

paras.en: Why Alzheimer's Symptoms May Appear Before Memory Loss
paras.zh: 为什么阿尔茨海默病的症状可能出现在记忆丧失之前

paras.en: Alzheimer's is generally associated with progressive memory loss, confusion, and declining cognitive abilities. However, doctors have also observed that some patients develop physical symptoms, including changes in balance, coordination, and gait (manner of walking), years before clear cognitive difficulties become apparent.
paras.zh: 阿尔茨海默病通常与进行性记忆丧失、混乱和认知能力下降有关。然而，医生也观察到，一些患者在明显的认知困难变得明显之前几年就出现了身体症状，包括平衡、协调和步态（行走方式）的变化。

paras.en: These observations have raised an important question: Are such movement problems simply a consequence of damage occurring in the brain, or could Alzheimer's also interfere directly with nerves elsewhere in the body?
paras.zh: 这些观察结果提出了一个重要的问题：这种运动问题是否仅仅是大脑损伤的结果，或者阿尔茨海默病也可能直接干扰身体其他部位的神经？

paras.en: To investigate, the UCF team focused on familial Alzheimer's, a rare inherited form of the disease that typically develops earlier in life (from 40 to 65 years of age) than the more common form.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，UCF 团队将重点放在家族性阿尔茨海默氏症上，这是一种罕见的遗传性疾病，通常比更常见的疾病更早（40 至 65 岁）发病。

paras.en: Their experiments revealed that motor neurons carrying mutations linked to familial Alzheimer's could disrupt the connections responsible for controlling muscles, even when the brain and spinal cord were completely absent from the experimental system.
paras.zh: 他们的实验表明，携带与家族性阿尔茨海默氏症相关突变的运动神经元可能会破坏负责控制肌肉的连接，即使实验系统中完全不存在大脑和脊髓。

paras.en: Motor neurons are specialized nerve cells that transmit signals to muscles, telling them when to contract and produce movement. The new findings suggest that Alzheimer's mutations can interfere with this process directly, rather than affecting movement only through damage to the brain.
paras.zh: 运动神经元是专门的神经细胞，它们向肌肉传递信号，告诉它们何时收缩和产生运动。新发现表明，阿尔茨海默氏症突变可以直接干扰这一过程，而不是仅通过损害大脑来影响运动。

paras.en: "This is the first time it's been demonstrated that deficits in the peripheral nervous system can arise directly from these mutations," Hickman says. "It means drugs that target the brain may not fix problems in the rest of the body."
paras.zh: “这是第一次证明周围神经系统的缺陷可以直接由这些突变引起，”希克曼说。 “这意味着针对大脑的药物可能无法解决身体其他部位的问题。”

paras.en: The peripheral nervous system includes the nerves located outside the brain and spinal cord. These nerves carry signals between the central nervous system and the rest of the body, helping control movement, sensation, and other essential functions.
paras.zh: 周围神经系统包括位于大脑和脊髓之外的神经。这些神经在中枢神经系统和身体其他部位之间传递信号，帮助控制运动、感觉和其他基本功能。

paras.en: Guo also points out that preserving the ability to move could have benefits beyond physical health. Regular physical activity is associated with better cognitive well-being, so protecting motor function may also help support brain health.
paras.zh: 郭还指出，保持活动能力除了身体健康之外还有其他好处。定期的体育活动与更好的认知健康有关，因此保护运动功能也可能有助于支持大脑健康。

paras.en: How a Miniature Human Cell System Revealed the Discovery
paras.zh: 微型人体细胞系统如何揭示这一发现

paras.en: To examine the relationship between Alzheimer's mutations and muscle movement, the scientists used an innovative laboratory platform known as "human-on-a-chip" technology.
paras.zh: 为了研究阿尔茨海默氏症突变与肌肉运动之间的关系，科学家们使用了一种称为“人类芯片”技术的创新实验室平台。

paras.en: Developed and manufactured through Hesperos, a company co-founded by Hickman, these miniature systems bring different types of human cells together under controlled conditions. They allow researchers to recreate specific biological functions and observe how diseases interfere with them.
paras.zh: 这些微型系统由希克曼共同创立的 Hesperos 公司开发和制造，在受控条件下将不同类型的人体细胞聚集在一起。它们使研究人员能够重建特定的生物功能并观察疾病如何干扰它们。

paras.en: Unlike conventional laboratory experiments that examine isolated cells, these systems can reproduce important interactions between different tissues. They also provide an alternative to animal models, which do not always accurately reflect how human diseases behave.
paras.zh: 与检查分离细胞的传统实验室实验不同，这些系统可以重现不同组织之间的重要相互作用。它们还提供了动物模型的替代方案，动物模型并不总是准确地反映人类疾病的表现。

paras.en: For this study, the team created a miniature model of the neuromuscular junction, the connection where a motor neuron communicates with a muscle cell.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，研究小组创建了神经肌肉接头的微型模型，神经肌肉接头是运动神经元与肌肉细胞进行交流的连接。

paras.en: The model was deliberately designed without a brain or spinal cord. This was a crucial part of the experiment because it allowed the researchers to investigate whether Alzheimer's-related changes could cause movement problems independently of the central nervous system.
paras.zh: 该模型经过精心设计，没有大脑或脊髓。这是实验的关键部分，因为它使研究人员能够研究阿尔茨海默病相关的变化是否会导致独立于中枢神经系统的运动问题。

paras.en: The scientists combined healthy muscle cells with motor neurons derived from stem cells that carried genetic mutations associated with familial Alzheimer's disease. Stem cells are cells that can develop into specialized types of cells, making them valuable tools for studying human diseases in the laboratory.
paras.zh: 科学家们将健康的肌肉细胞与源自干细胞的运动神经元结合起来，这些干细胞携带与家族性阿尔茨海默病相关的基因突变。干细胞是可以发育成特殊类型细胞的细胞，使其成为实验室研究人类疾病的宝贵工具。

paras.en: The researchers then examined how effectively the altered nerve cells communicated with otherwise healthy muscle tissue.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后检查了改变的神经细胞与健康肌肉组织沟通的效率。

paras.en: The results showed that the Alzheimer's-associated mutations could interfere with normal nerve-to-muscle function. This suggests that at least some movement difficulties linked to the disease may arise directly in the peripheral nervous system rather than being caused entirely by degeneration in the brain.
paras.zh: 结果表明，与阿尔茨海默病相关的突变可能会干扰正常的神经肌肉功能。这表明至少一些与该疾病相关的运动困难可能直接出现在周围神经系统中，而不是完全由大脑退化引起。

paras.en: Why Damaged Nerve Connections Can Affect Walking and Balance
paras.zh: 为什么受损的神经连接会影响行走和平衡

paras.en: Every voluntary movement depends on successful communication between the nervous system and the muscles.
paras.zh: 每个自愿运动都取决于神经系统和肌肉之间的成功沟通。

paras.en: At the neuromuscular junction, an electrical signal traveling along a motor neuron triggers chemical communication that causes a muscle to contract. This process makes everyday activities possible, from walking and maintaining posture to lifting objects and performing precise movements.
paras.zh: 在神经肌肉接头处，沿着运动神经元传播的电信号会触发化学通讯，导致肌肉收缩。这个过程使日常活动成为可能，从行走和保持姿势到举起物体和执行精确的动作。

paras.en: When the connection becomes impaired, muscles may respond less effectively to nerve signals. Depending on the severity and location of the problem, this can contribute to weakness, reduced coordination, and difficulty sustaining physical activity.
paras.zh: 当连接受损时，肌肉对神经信号的反应可能会降低。根据问题的严重程度和位置，这可能会导致无力、协调性降低以及难以维持身体活动。

paras.en: To evaluate these effects, the research team measured how consistently nerve signals produced muscle contractions and how long the muscles could continue contracting before becoming fatigued.
paras.zh: 为了评估这些影响，研究小组测量了神经信号产生肌肉收缩的一致性以及肌肉在疲劳之前可以持续收缩的时间。

paras.en: These measurements provided a direct assessment of how well the nerve and muscle cells worked together. They also resemble aspects of the functional testing physicians use when examining patients with movement disorders.
paras.zh: 这些测量可以直接评估神经和肌肉细胞的协同工作情况。它们还类似于医生在检查运动障碍患者时使用的功能测试。

paras.en: "You can't move unless the motor circuit works," Hickman says. "When a doctor taps your knee to check your reflex, they're testing that exact connection."
paras.zh: “除非电机电路正常工作，否则你无法移动，”希克曼说。 “当医生轻拍你的膝盖来检查你的反射时，他们正在测试这种确切的联系。”

paras.en: By demonstrating impaired nerve-to-muscle communication in a system containing no brain or spinal cord, the study provides evidence that mutations linked to familial Alzheimer's can produce effects beyond the central nervous system.
paras.zh: 通过证明不含大脑或脊髓的系统中神经与肌肉通讯受损，该研究提供了证据，证明与家族性阿尔茨海默病相关的突变可以产生中枢神经系统以外的影响。

paras.en: However, the experiments do not establish that these changes necessarily occur before memory loss in patients. Further research will be needed to determine how closely the laboratory findings reflect the progression of Alzheimer's in people, particularly those with the more common forms of the disease.
paras.zh: 然而，实验并没有证实这些变化一定发生在患者记忆丧失之前。需要进一步的研究来确定实验室研究结果在多大程度上反映了阿尔茨海默病在人类中的进展，特别是那些患有这种疾病的更常见形式的人。

paras.en: Could This Discovery Lead to Earlier Alzheimer's Detection?
paras.zh: 这一发现能否促进阿尔茨海默病的早期检测？

paras.en: The findings suggest a potentially important new direction for Alzheimer's research: looking beyond memory and other cognitive symptoms when investigating the disease.
paras.zh: 这些发现为阿尔茨海默氏症研究提出了一个潜在的重要新方向：在研究该疾病时超越记忆和其他认知症状。

paras.en: If future studies confirm that changes in motor function are detectable early in certain patients, tests of walking, coordination, or nerve-to-muscle activity might eventually help identify disease-related changes before more obvious neurological symptoms develop.
paras.zh: 如果未来的研究证实某些患者的运动功能变化可以在早期检测到，那么步行、协调或神经肌肉活动的测试可能最终有助于在出现更明显的神经系统症状之前识别与疾病相关的变化。

paras.en: The results also raise questions about treatment. Many Alzheimer's therapies are designed to address processes occurring in the brain, but medications that target the central nervous system may not necessarily correct abnormalities affecting peripheral nerves and muscles.
paras.zh: 研究结果还引发了有关治疗的问题。许多阿尔茨海默病疗法旨在解决大脑中发生的过程，但针对中枢神经系统的药物可能不一定能纠正影响周围神经和肌肉的异常。

paras.en: Understanding these separate effects could help researchers investigate treatments that protect physical function alongside cognitive health.
paras.zh: 了解这些单独的影响可以帮助研究人员研究保护身体功能和认知健康的治疗方法。

paras.en: Human-on-a-Chip Technology Could Transform Disease Research
paras.zh: 人类芯片技术可以改变疾病研究

paras.en: Beyond the implications for Alzheimer's, the researchers see considerable potential in using human-on-a-chip systems to investigate other diseases and evaluate possible treatments.
paras.zh: 除了对阿尔茨海默氏症的影响之外，研究人员还看到了使用人体芯片系统来研究其他疾病和评估可能的治疗方法的巨大潜力。

paras.en: Because these platforms contain human cells and reproduce measurable biological activities, they can help scientists observe disease-related changes in conditions that more closely resemble human physiology than some conventional experimental models.
paras.zh: 由于这些平台包含人类细胞并重现可测量的生物活性，因此它们可以帮助科学家观察与疾病相关的条件变化，这些变化比一些传统的实验模型更接近人类生理学。

paras.en: This approach may be particularly useful in drug development, where researchers need to understand not only how a potential treatment affects individual cells but also how it influences interactions between different tissues.
paras.zh: 这种方法可能在药物开发中特别有用，研究人员不仅需要了解潜在的治疗方法如何影响单个细胞，还需要了解它如何影响不同组织之间的相互作用。

paras.en: Such systems can also uncover biological effects that may be difficult to detect in animal experiments, potentially helping researchers identify promising therapies and recognize limitations earlier in development.
paras.zh: 此类系统还可以揭示在动物实验中可能难以检测的生物效应，可能帮助研究人员识别有前途的疗法并在开发早期认识到局限性。

paras.en: For Hickman, the progress represents the culmination of three decades of work devoted to understanding disease through more realistic laboratory models.
paras.zh: 对于希克曼来说，这一进展代表了三十年来致力于通过更现实的实验室模型了解疾病的工作的顶峰。

paras.en: "These systems let us study disease in a way that's closer to what actually happens in the human body, and that's what we need to develop better treatments," he says.
paras.zh: “这些系统让我们能够以更接近人体实际情况的方式研究疾病，这就是我们开发更好的治疗方法所需要的，”他说。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Central Florida. Original written by Emily Dougherty. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由中佛罗里达大学提供。原文由艾米丽·多尔蒂撰写。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Akhmetzada Kargazhanov, Romy Aiken, Kenneth Hawkins, Rafael Lopez, Ahmad Nawaz, Gaurav Srivastava, Chase Miller, Will Bogen, Christopher Long, David Morgan, Xiufang Guo, James Hickman. Evaluating the peripheral nervous system pathology of Alzheimer\'s disease utilizing a functional human NMJ microphysiological system. Alzheimer\'s, 2026; 22 (4) DOI: 10.1002/alz.71281
paras.zh: - 艾哈迈德扎达·卡尔加扎诺夫、罗密·艾肯、肯尼思·霍金斯、拉斐尔·洛佩兹、艾哈迈德·纳瓦兹、高拉夫·斯里瓦斯塔瓦、蔡斯·米勒、威尔·博根、克里斯托弗·朗、大卫·摩根、郭秀芳、詹姆斯·希克曼。利用功能性人类 NMJ 微生理系统评估阿尔茨海默病的周围神经系统病理学。阿尔茨海默病，2026； 22 (4) DOI：10.1002/alz.71281

articles.title: NASA just launched a $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge to award cash prizes to students that solve lunar base problems
articles.author: Chelsea Gohd

paras.en: CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. — NASA has officially launched the Moon Base Student Challenge, asking students to help build humanity's future on the moon. And there's $1 million in prizes up for grabs for the winners.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角——美国宇航局 (NASA) 正式启动月球基地学生挑战赛，要求学生帮助在月球上建设人类的未来。获胜者还有 100 万美元的奖金可供争夺。

paras.en: To build and sustain a base on the moon, NASA will have to solve a myriad of problems. And they're looking to the next generation for help, the space agency's chief Jared Isaacman said Sunday (Nov. 8).
paras.zh: 为了在月球上建造和维持基地，美国宇航局必须解决无数问题。航天局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 周日（11 月 8 日）表示，他们正在向下一代寻求帮助。

paras.en: "We are inviting students from across the country to help solve some of the problems that stand between humanity and a permanent presence on another world," Isaacman said. "We're putting 1 million in prizes together to support the best ideas and recognize the teams behind them."
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼说：“我们邀请来自全国各地的学生帮助解决人类与在另一个世界永久存在之间的一些问题。” “我们将设立 100 万美元的奖金来支持最佳创意并表彰其背后的团队。”

paras.en: Isaacman made this announcement wearing his blue flight suit from the rocket garden at NASA's Kennedy Space Center Visitor Center amidst the agency's MAX POWER air show event. Just the day before, he flew fighter jets in that suit and even jumped out of a plane, skydiving into the event. Soon after this announcement, he was flying another fighter plane above the crowd.
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼在美国宇航局肯尼迪航天中心游客中心的火箭花园举行的 MAX POWER 航空展活动中，穿着蓝色飞行服宣布了这一消息。就在前一天，他穿着这套衣服驾驶战斗机，甚至从飞机上跳伞参加活动。消息公布后不久，他驾驶着另一架战斗机在人群上空飞行。

paras.en: The audience for this announcement was filled with students of all ages. Some young children wearing costume spacesuits squeezed as close as they could to the front of the room while teenagers considering their futures listened intently. It was clear that Isaacman's presence and words were landing with this group.
paras.zh: 听到这一消息的听众中充满了各个年龄段的学生。一些穿着宇航服的幼儿尽可能地挤到房间前面，而考虑自己未来的青少年则聚精会神地听着。很明显，艾萨克曼的出现和话语正落在这群人身上。

paras.en: But what moon base challenges does NASA want to see these students tackle? In short, all of them.
paras.zh: 但美国宇航局希望看到这些学生解决哪些月球基地挑战？简而言之，全部。

paras.en: "The moon base will allow us to conduct groundbreaking science, test new technologies, and prepare again for where we inevitably go next, which is the red planet," he said. "But before any of that can happen, we have an awful lot of problems that need to be solved."
paras.zh: 他说：“月球基地将使我们能够进行突破性的科学，测试新技术，并为我们下一步必然要去的地方（即红色星球）再次做好准备。” “但在这一切发生之前，我们还有很多问题需要解决。”

paras.en: "We need ways to generate power through the long lunar night. We need to protect our astronauts from that incredibly harsh and dangerous and demanding environment on the surface. We need to move people and equipment around on the surface and support human life three days away from Earth," Isaacman said, illustrating just a few of the big issues that present with the concept of a moon base.
paras.zh: “我们需要在漫长的月球夜晚发电的方法。我们需要保护我们的宇航员免受月球表面极其恶劣、危险和苛刻的环境的影响。我们需要在月球表面运送人员和设备，并在距离地球三天的地方维持人类的生活，”艾萨克曼说，他仅说明了月球基地概念所带来的一些重大问题。

paras.en: This challenge is open to high school and post-secondary students based in the U.S. For participating students, they will form teams that will work on an idea from one of six different technical topics related to creating and running a moon base. These six topics include power systems, habitats, communications, mobility, life support and astronaut safety.
paras.zh: 这项挑战向美国的高中生和大专生开放。对于参与的学生，他们将组成团队，研究与创建和运行月球基地相关的六个不同技术主题之一的想法。这六个主题包括电力系统、栖息地、通信、移动性、生命支持和宇航员安全。

paras.en: This will be what Isaacman described as a "multi-phase competition that mirrors how ideas are developed actually in the aerospace industry."
paras.zh: 这将是艾萨克曼所描述的“多阶段竞争，反映了航空航天业中创意的实际开发方式”。

paras.en: "Teams will first submit concepts, then they're going to refine them, and finalists will have the opportunity to present their solutions directly to NASA leaders and stakeholders," he further explained.
paras.zh: “团队将首先提交概念，然后对其进行完善，决赛入围者将有机会直接向 NASA 领导人和利益相关者展示他们的解决方案，”他进一步解释道。

paras.en: "The prize money is great for sure, but the the real opportunity is to work on problems NASA is actively trying to solve right now, so students don't need to wait to graduation to contribute to that effort," Isaacman added.
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼补充说：“奖金肯定是巨大的，但真正的机会是解决美国宇航局目前正在积极努力解决的问题，因此学生不需要等到毕业才能为这一努力做出贡献。”

paras.en: Right now, NASA has a long road ahead of them before a moon base is actually built. In mid-2027, the agency is planning to launch its Artemis III mission which will see a crew of four astronauts practice rendezvous maneuvers with two different lunar landers. If all goes to plan, this will be followed by Artemis IV landing humans on the moon's surface for the first time since the final Apollo mission in 1972.
paras.zh: 目前，在月球基地真正建成之前，美国宇航局还有很长的路要走。该机构计划于 2027 年中期启动阿耳忒弥斯 III 任务，届时四名宇航员将与两个不同的月球着陆器进行交会演习。如果一切按计划进行，阿耳忒弥斯四号将载人登陆月球表面，这是自 1972 年最后一次阿波罗任务以来首次载人登陆月球表面。

paras.en: The agency is making these big steps forward to not just a crewed return to the moon, but a sustained, long-term return to the moon. However, knowing that a fully-fledged moon base is still firmly in the future, they are banking on the ingenuity, creativity and passion of
paras.zh: 该机构正在向前迈出这些重大一步，不仅是为了载人重返月球，而且是为了持续、长期地重返月球。然而，他们知道，成熟的月球基地在未来仍然遥遥无期，他们依靠的是人类的聪明才智、创造力和热情。

paras.en: If you're a student or know a student interested in participating in this challenge, you can find more information on NASA's website here. Interested students can register until Jan. 25, 2027.
paras.zh: 如果您是学生或认识有兴趣参加此挑战的学生，您可以在 NASA 网站上找到更多信息。有兴趣的学生可以在 2027 年 1 月 25 日之前注册。

paras.en: Chelsea Gohd served as a Senior Writer for Space.com from 2018 to 2022 before returning in 2026, covering everything from climate change to planetary science and human spaceflight in both articles and on-camera in videos. With a M.S. in Biology, Chelsea has written and worked for institutions including NASA JPL, the American Museum of Natural History, Scientific American, Discover Magazine Blog, Astronomy Magazine, and Live Science. When not writing, editing or filming something space-y, Gohd is writing music and performing as Foxanne, even launching a song to space in 2021 with Inspiration4. You can follow her online @chelsea.gohd and @foxanne.music
paras.zh: Chelsea Gohd 于 2018 年至 2022 年担任 Space.com 的高级作家，并于 2026 年回归，在文章和视频中报道了从气候变化到行星科学和载人航天的所有内容。拥有硕士学位在生物学领域，Chelsea 曾为 NASA JPL、美国自然历史博物馆、《科学美国人》、Discover 杂志博客、天文学杂志和 Live Science 等机构撰写文章和工作。在创作、编辑或拍摄太空作品之余，Gohd 会创作音乐并以 Foxanne 的身份进行表演，甚至于 2021 年与 Inspiration4 一起向太空推出了一首歌曲。您可以在线关注她@chelsea.gohd 和@foxanne.music

articles.title: Starfish Space loses contact with 1st 'Otter' servicing spacecraft, ending NASA tech-demo mission
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Starfish Space's first Otter has died, just a month after it reached the final frontier.
paras.zh: 海星空间的第一只水獭在到达最后边界一个月后就死了。

paras.en: The Seattle startup announced on Tuesday (Nov. 3) that its Otter 24C satellite suffered a glitch in low Earth orbit (LEO) and is not recoverable.
paras.zh: 这家西雅图初创公司周二（11 月 3 日）宣布，其 Otter 24C 卫星在低地球轨道 (LEO) 中遭遇故障，无法恢复。

paras.en: The anomaly killed an ambitious mission in the cradle, as Otter 24C was still in the commissioning phase.
paras.zh: 这一异常现象扼杀了一项雄心勃勃的任务，因为 Otter 24C 仍处于调试阶段。

paras.en: Otter 24C launched Oct. 1 on SpaceX's Transporter-18 mission, a rideshare flight that carried a total of 130 payloads to LEO (including a prototype satellite for Project Suncatcher, Google's planned AI constellation).
paras.zh: Otter 24C 于 10 月 1 日在 SpaceX 的 Transporter-18 任务中发射升空，这是一次共乘飞行，将总共 130 个有效载荷运送到近地轨道（包括 Google 计划的人工智能星座 Suncatcher 项目的原型卫星）。

paras.en: The Starfish satellite was flying a mission for NASA called Small Spacecraft Propulsion and Inspection Capability, or SSPICY for short. The goal was to "demonstrate technologies necessary for future debris-removal missions as well as for future applications in the servicing and inspection of active spacecraft," according to NASA's SSPICY site.
paras.zh: 海星卫星正在为美国宇航局执行一项名为小型航天器推进和检查能力（简称 SSPICY）的任务。据 NASA 的 SSPICY 网站称，其目标是“展示未来碎片清除任务以及未来在现役航天器维修和检查中的应用所需的技术”。

paras.en: "This advances NASA's in-space manufacturing and assembly (ISAM) goals to ensure a sustainable space operating environment and builds towards a future where objects can be assembled, repaired and maintained in space, significantly expanding possibilities for science and human exploration," the agency added.
paras.zh: 该机构补充说：“这推进了 NASA 的太空制造和组装 (ISAM) 目标，以确保可持续的太空操作环境，并构建一个可以在太空组装、维修和维护物体的未来，从而显着扩大科学和人类探索的可能性。”

paras.en: Starfish Space was a natural partner. The Seattle company plans to become a big player in the nascent field of satellite servicing, using its line of Otter craft to repair, refuel or deorbit other satellites for a variety of customers.
paras.zh: 海星空间是天然的合作伙伴。这家西雅图公司计划成为新兴卫星服务领域的重要参与者，利用其 Otter 飞船系列为各种客户维修、补充燃料或使其他卫星脱离轨道。

paras.en: SSPICY marked Otter's spaceflight debut. The mission plan called for the 739-pound (335-kilogram) Otter 24C spacecraft to approach and inspect "up to four inoperable space objects of U.S. origin" over the course of a two-year mission, performing detailed visual inspections.
paras.zh: SSPICY 标志着 Otter 的太空首次亮相。该任务计划要求重 739 磅（335 公斤）的 Otter 24C 航天器在两年的任务过程中接近并检查“多达四个来自美国的无法操作的太空物体”，进行详细的目视检查。

paras.en: But Otter 24C never got the chance to perform any of these orbital rendezvous.
paras.zh: 但 Otter 24C 从未有机会进行任何此类轨道交会。

paras.en: "While working through commissioning steps, Starfish eventually stopped receiving data from Otter 24C," the company said in a Nov. 3 X post.
paras.zh: 该公司在 11 月 3 日的帖子中表示：“在完成调试步骤时，Starfish 最终停止接收来自 Otter 24C 的数据。”

paras.en: "An investigation into the loss of communications has determined that fault protection on the satellite bus provided by [California company] Astro Digital had an error that turned off the radio and prevented re-establishing communications," Starfish added. "Starfish, NASA, and Astro Digital have concluded that Otter 24C is not recoverable."
paras.zh: 海星补充说：“对通信中断的调查确定，[加州公司] Astro Digital 提供的卫星总线故障保护存在错误，导致无线电关闭并无法重新建立通信。” “Starfish、NASA 和 Astro Digital 得出的结论是，Otter 24C 无法回收。”

paras.en: The company further said that it's implementing fixes to reduce the chances that the problem will crop up in the future. And it stressed that Otter 24C's death will not be in vain.
paras.zh: 该公司进一步表示，正在实施修复措施，以减少未来出现该问题的可能性。并强调Otter 24C的死不会白白死去。

paras.en: "The work completed through Otter 24C will directly contribute to the success of future Otter missions, as Starfish continues developing the technologies and operations required to make satellite servicing a routine capability in orbit," Starfish said.
paras.zh: Starfish 表示：“通过 Otter 24C 完成的工作将直接有助于未来 Otter 任务的成功，因为 Starfish 将继续开发使卫星服务成为轨道上常规能力所需的技术和操作。”

paras.en: The Seattle company has other work to do in LEO at the moment as well: Its Otter Pup 2 prototype craft is currently gearing up to conduct a historic docking of its own in LEO.
paras.zh: 这家西雅图公司目前在近地轨道上还有其他工作要做：其 Otter Pup 2 原型飞船目前正准备在近地轨道上进行历史性的对接。

paras.en: Otter Pup 2, which launched in June 2025, has been getting closer and closer to another private spacecraft, Gilmour Space's ElaraSat. Last week, the company announced that Otter Pup 2 got within a mere 82 feet (25 meters) of its target.
paras.zh: Otter Pup 2 于 2025 年 6 月发射，距离另一艘私人航天器 Gilmour Space 的 ElaraSat 越来越近。上周，该公司宣布 Otter Pup 2 距离目标仅 82 英尺（25 米）。

paras.en: "With this progress, Otter Pup 2 has officially completed Characterize, the penultimate phase of its mission. That leaves just one phase left: attempting docking, and a chance to make history," Starfish Space said in an Oct. 27 X post.
paras.zh: “随着这一进展，水獭幼崽 2 号已经正式完成了表征，这是其任务的倒数第二阶段。只剩下一个阶段：尝试对接，以及创造历史的机会，”Starfish Space 在 10 月 27 日的一篇帖子中表示。

paras.en: Two private satellites have docked before, but only much higher above Earth, in geostationary orbit. Such a meetup has not yet happened in LEO.
paras.zh: 两颗私人卫星之前曾在地球静止轨道上对接过，但只是距离地球高得多。 LEO 还没有发生过这样的聚会。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: NYT bestseller ‘Robopocalypse’ is getting a TV series with Oscar winners Ron Howard and Akiva Goldsman at the helm
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: They say all good things come to those who wait… and WAIT. Well, the wait for "Robopocalypse" fans might finally be over, as Oscar winners Ron Howard and Akiva Goldsman have announced they're working on a TV adaptation.
paras.zh: 他们说所有美好的事情都会降临在那些等待的人身上……等待。好吧，《机器人末日》粉丝的等待可能终于结束了，奥斯卡奖得主朗·霍华德和阿齐瓦·高斯曼宣布他们正在制作电视剧版。

paras.en: It does seem like an eternity since news first broke that Portland-based New York Times bestselling author Daniel H. Wilson’s "Robopocalypse" (Doubleday, 2011) was bought by Steven Spielberg’s DreamWorks SKG for a sci-fi spectacle, with Drew Goddard ("The Martian") brought in to pen the screenplay.
paras.zh: 自从《纽约时报》畅销书作者丹尼尔·H·威尔逊的《机械启示录》（Doubleday，2011 年）被史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格旗下的梦工厂 SKG 收购用于制作一部科幻奇观，并聘请德鲁·戈达德（《火星救援》）撰写剧本的消息首次传出以来，这似乎已经是永恒的事了。

paras.en: That was back in 2009, and since then the story of a rogue AI named Archos and a hearty band of indigenous people in America’s heartland battling to save humanity from extinction has been placed on Hollywood’s back burner. After numerous stalled starts and director Michael Bay getting involved in 2018, "Robopocalypse" was quietly powered down due to script issues, filmmaker scheduling conflicts, and the enormous budget required.
paras.zh: 那是在 2009 年，从那时起，一个名叫阿科斯 (Archos) 的流氓人工智能和一群热情的美国腹地原住民为拯救人类免于灭绝而奋斗的故事就被好莱坞搁置了。在经历了无数次的开拍停滞以及导演迈克尔·贝在 2018 年的介入后，《机器人启示录》由于剧本问题、电影制作人档期冲突以及所需的巨额预算而悄然停播。

paras.en: But now we have been blessed with the news, first broken by The Hollywood Reporter, that Ron Howard ("Apollo 13," "The Da Vinci Code") and Akiva Goldsman ("A Beautiful Mind," "Star Trek: Strange New Worlds") have taken up the mantle of this chilling sci-fi project to develop as a new TV series. And what timing, just as AI fever has gripped the planet with paranoia centered around our eventual robot overlords.
paras.zh: 但现在我们有幸获悉《好莱坞报道》首先报道的消息，朗·霍华德（《阿波罗十三号》、《达芬奇密码》）和阿基瓦·高斯曼（《美丽心灵》、《星际迷航：奇异新世界》）已经接手了这个令人毛骨悚然的科幻项目，并将开发为一部新的电视剧。就在人工智能热潮席卷全球之际，人们对我们最终的机器人霸主产生了偏执。

paras.en: "'Robopocalypse' has all the scale and suspense of a major action story, but what drew me to it are the thought-provoking themes and humanity at its center," Ron Howard shared in a statement.
paras.zh: “《机器人末日》拥有大型动作故事的所有规模和悬念，但吸引我的是它发人深省的主题和核心的人性，”朗·霍华德在一份声明中分享道。

paras.en: "Daniel created a future that feels both startling and increasingly plausible, with characters who must figure out what connects us when the technology we rely on turns against us. I am also thrilled to work with Akiva again. We have shared some incredibly meaningful creative experiences, and this feels like the right story to bring us back together."
paras.zh: “丹尼尔创造了一个既令人震惊又越来越可信的未来，其中的角色必须弄清楚当我们所依赖的技术对我们不利时，是什么将我们联系在一起。我也很高兴再次与 Akiva 合作。我们分享了一些非常有意义的创意经历，这感觉像是让我们重新走到一起的正确故事。”

paras.en: As a PhD graduate of Carnegie Mellon University’s Robotics Institute and a future king of the techno-thriller, Wilson was the ideal writer to bring this frightening story to life, and a 2014 sequel titled "Robogenesis" was equally gripping.
paras.zh: 作为卡内基梅隆大学机器人学院的博士毕业生和未来的科技惊悚片之王，威尔逊是将这个可怕的故事变为现实的理想作家，2014 年的续集《机器人创世》同样扣人心弦。

paras.en: The prolific, award-winning writer has since set up a multitude of other Hollywood projects spawned from his catalog of works, including "Amped," "The Clockwork Dynasty," the authorized sequel to Michael Crichton's "The Andromeda Strain," "The Andromeda Evolution," and his 2025 alien invasion novel "Hole in the Sky," still alive at Netflix.
paras.zh: 这位多产、屡获殊荣的作家此后又根据他的作品目录催生了许多其他好莱坞项目，包括《Amped》、《发条王朝》、迈克尔·克莱顿的《仙女座应变》、《仙女座进化》的授权续集，以及他的 2025 年外星人入侵小说《天空之洞》，该小说仍在 Netflix 上播出。

paras.en: Howard's Imagine Entertainment will partner with Akiva Goldsman's Weed Road Pictures on this episodic adaptation, with Howard attached to direct the pilot episode and Goldsman serving as series showrunner.
paras.zh: 霍华德的 Imagine Entertainment 将与 Akiva Goldsman 的 Weed Road Pictures 合作制作这部剧集改编作品，霍华德将执导试播集，高斯曼则担任剧集主管。

paras.en: "Robopocalypse" marks a creative reunion for the distinguished creators, following their collaborations on "A Beautiful Mind," "Cinderella Man," "The Da Vinci Code," and "Angels & Demons." Spielberg's Amblin Entertainment is slated to executive produce the ambitious show alongside Imagine's Brian Grazer and Jeb Brody and Weed's Rachel Wizenberg and Greg Lessans.
paras.zh: 《机器人启示录》标志着杰出创作者继《美丽心灵》、《灰姑娘》、《达芬奇密码》和《天使与魔鬼》合作后的创意重聚。斯皮尔伯格的安布林娱乐公司将与 Imagine 的布莱恩·格雷泽、杰布·布罗迪以及威德的雷切尔·维森伯格和格雷格·莱桑一起担任这部雄心勃勃的节目的执行制片人。

paras.en: It's too early to tell which streaming service the "Robopocalypse" TV show will be attached to yet. Hopefully the pilot episode wows one of the big names, and we can finally see the "Robopocalypse" adaptation of our dreams.
paras.zh: 现在判断“Robopocalypse”电视节目将附加到哪个流媒体服务还为时过早。希望试播集能让其中一位大腕惊叹不已，我们终于可以看到根据我们的梦想改编的《机器人末日》了。

paras.en: In the meantime, we'd recommend checking out the original book by Daniel H. Wilson.
paras.zh: 同时，我们建议您阅读 Daniel H. Wilson 的原著。

paras.en: Not far into our future, the dazzling technology that runs our world turns against us. Controlled by a childlike—yet massively powerful—artificial intelligence known as Archos, the global network of machines on which our world has grown dependent suddenly becomes an implacable, deadly foe.
paras.zh: 距离我们的未来不远，统治我们世界的令人眼花缭乱的技术开始与我们作对。在一个被称为爱可视 (Archos) 的孩子气但又非常强大的人工智能控制下，我们的世界日益依赖的全球机器网络突然变成了一个不可调和的致命敌人。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: DETUMBLER: Airbus’ Passive Spin Stabilization Solution
articles.author: Airbus

paras.en: The tumbling crisis: why dead satellites threaten orbit
paras.zh: 翻滚危机：为何失效卫星威胁轨道

paras.en: Every year, hundreds of satellites reach end-of-life, most are deorbited, but some fail abruptly. Yet, even when properly decommissioned, some dead satellites may start tumbling on their own, through the accumulation of tiny disturbances like solar radiation pressure, to the point where they become impossible to capture by active debris removal missions.
paras.zh: 每年都有数百颗卫星报废，大多数卫星脱离轨道，但也有一些卫星突然失效。然而，即使正确退役，一些报废的卫星也可能会通过太阳辐射压力等微小扰动的积累而开始自行翻滚，直至主动碎片清除任务无法捕获它们。

paras.en: With over 36,500 tracked debris objects in orbit, the risk of cascading collisions is real. ESA warns that without ADR (Active Debris Removal) solutions, some LEO orbits will become unusable. Ensuring that all dead satellites are properly detumbled would be a major element towards making ADR economically feasible.
paras.zh: 轨道上有超过 36,500 个被跟踪的碎片物体，级联碰撞的风险是真实存在的。欧空局警告说，如果没有 ADR（主动碎片清除）解决方案，一些低地球轨道将变得无法使用。确保所有报废卫星得到适当的修复将是使 ADR 在经济上可行的一个主要因素。

paras.en: Detumbler: the game-changing alternative
paras.zh: Detumbler：改变游戏规则的替代方案

paras.en: Developed by Airbus R&D, the Detumbler is a passive magnetic damping device that stabilizes tumbling satellites before they become uncontrollable. Acting like an induction brake, it dissipates kinetic energy through the Earth’s magnetic field, stopping tumbling in a few months. For the first time, operators have a reliable, low-cost, fully passive solution to prevent post-mission tumbling.
paras.zh: Detumbler 由空客研发部开发，是一种无源磁阻尼装置，可在翻滚的卫星变得失控之前稳定它们。它的作用就像感应制动器，通过地球磁场耗散动能，几个月后就停止翻滚。运营商第一次拥有了可靠、低成本、完全被动的解决方案来防止任务后翻滚。

paras.en: Without power and thus actuators, the only phenomenon that can limit tumbling rates in a dead spacecraft are the natural eddy currents created by the Earth’s magnetic field in the satellite’s rotating metallic structure. Short circuiting the magnetorquers at the end of life could help boost that natural effect. Unfortunately, the resulting resistive torque is proportional to the low magnetic field squared (the induced dipole moment M is proportional to B, and the resulting magnetic torque is MxB), making such effects extremely weak, too weak to prevent spontaneous tumbling in case of any asymmetry in the external disturbances. As an example, in 2017, 12 years after decommissioning, Topex-Poseidon had reached a spin rate of 34 deg/s (40,000 Nms of accumulated momentum).
paras.zh: 在没有电源和执行器的情况下，唯一可以限制报废航天器翻滚速率的现象是地球磁场在卫星旋转金属结构中产生的自然涡流。在磁力器寿命结束时将其短路可能有助于增强这种自然效应。不幸的是，产生的阻力矩与低磁场的平方成正比（感应偶极矩M与B成正比，产生的磁力矩为MxB），使得这种效应极其微弱，太弱以至于无法在外部干扰不对称的情况下防止自发翻滚。例如，2017 年，即退役 12 年后，Topex-Poseidon 的旋转速度达到了 34 度/秒（累积动量 40,000 Nms）。

paras.en: Despite its very modest mass and volume, the Detumbler can reach efficiencies many orders of magnitude higher, by using permanent magnets so that the braking torque is proportional to B, not B².
paras.zh: 尽管其质量和体积非常适中，但通过使用永磁体，制动力矩与 B 而不是 B² 成正比，Detumbler 的效率可以提高许多数量级。

paras.en: ESA’s Space Safety Program requires detumbling capacities for LEO missions >500kg (1100 lbs), targeting detumbling performances from 3°/s to 0.75°/s in less than a year. Airbus’ Detumbler is a leading solution for meeting ESA’s requirements and thus enabling active debris removal (ADR).
paras.zh: ESA 的空间安全计划要求低地球轨道任务的减滚能力 >500 公斤（1100 磅），目标是在不到一年的时间内将减滚性能从 3°/s 提高到 0.75°/s。空中客车公司的 Detumbler 是满足 ESA 要求的领先解决方案，从而实现主动碎片清除 (ADR)。

paras.en: How the Detumbler works: a satellite’s “magnetic brake”
paras.zh: Detumbler 的工作原理：卫星的“磁力制动器”

paras.en: The magnetized rotor inside the Detumbler tends to remain aligned with the Earth’s magnetic field. As the satellite tumbles, the Detumbler’s conductive housing rotates around the magnetized rotor, thus causing magnetic braking through eddy currents. This slowly but steadily dissipates the satellite’s kinetic energy, reducing the angular momentum exponentially, ultimately reaching a detumbled steady-state with very low residual rates. This is achieved without the need for any electrical or computing power, contrary to all other attitude control actuators.
paras.zh: Detumbler 内部的磁化转子往往与地球磁场保持一致。当卫星翻滚时，Detumbler 的导电外壳围绕磁化转子旋转，从而通过涡流产生磁力制动。这缓慢但稳定地消耗了卫星的动能，以指数方式减少角动量，最终达到残余率非常低的稳定状态。与所有其他姿态控制执行器相反，这是不需要任何电力或计算能力即可实现的。

paras.en: The Detumbler can then cancel or respectively prevent tumbling in all situations that might cause it:
paras.zh: 然后，Detumbler 可以在所有可能导致翻滚的情况下取消或分别防止翻滚：

paras.en: - catastrophic dynamic events (leaks, propulsion failures, impacts from debris or micrometeoroids)
paras.zh: - 灾难性动态事件（泄漏、推进故障、碎片或微流星体的影响）

paras.en: - slow buildup of angular momentum through the relentless action of tiny disturbance sources such as asymmetric solar radiation pressure (similar to the YORP effect in astronomy).
paras.zh: - 通过微小扰动源（例如不对称太阳辐射压力）的持续作用，角动量缓慢积累（类似于天文学中的 YORP 效应）。

paras.en: Weighing around 200g (0,440 lbs), the palm-sized device can be integrated almost anywhere (just not too close to the magnetometer) into existing platform designs, with little-to-no modifications, making it an easy decision for future LEO space missions.
paras.zh: 这款手掌大小的设备重约 200 克（0,440 磅），几乎可以在任何地方（只是距离磁力计不太近）集成到现有平台设计中，几乎不需要任何修改，这使其成为未来低地球轨道太空任务的一个轻松决定。

paras.en: Detumbler is no longer in R&D, it’s TRL 8 and already commercially available through the Airbus Space Electronics product portfolio.
paras.zh: Detumbler 不再处于研发阶段，它是 TRL 8，并且已经通过空中客车航天电子产品组合投入商业使用。

paras.en: ✔ 100% passive: Neither power nor attitude-control actuators intervention; working even after the end of the mission
paras.zh: ✔ 100%被动：动力和姿态控制执行器均不干预；任务结束后仍继续工作

paras.en: ✔ Compatible with a large range of platform sizes (from ~150 kg (330 lbs) to ~1.5 tons (3300 lbs)
paras.zh: ✔ 与多种平台尺寸兼容（从约 150 公斤（330 磅）到约 1.5 吨（3300 磅））

paras.en: ✔ Detumbling within weeks for the smaller platforms, within a year for the upper end of the size range
paras.zh: ✔ 对于较小的平台，可在数周内进行除滚；对于较大的平台，可在一年内进行除滚

paras.en: ✔ Prevents tumbling despite average external disturbances up to 5 µNm
paras.zh: ✔ 即使平均外部干扰高达 5 µNm，也能防止翻滚

paras.en: ✔ Tested under launch vibrations and orbital conditions.
paras.zh: ✔ 在发射振动和轨道条件下进行测试。

paras.en: While available now, Detumbler’s potential lies in large-scale adoption. MDA Space has selected the Detumbler for its first MDA AURORATM LEO satellite constellation order, with a view to tangibly ensuring a safer, sustainable use of Space. When the constellation launches, it will mark the first commercial large-scale integration of passive detumbling in orbit.
paras.zh: Detumbler 现已推出，其潜力在于大规模采用。 MDA Space 为其首个 MDA AURORATM LEO 卫星星座订单选择了 Detumbler，以切实确保更安全、可持续地利用太空。当该星座发射时，将标志着被动减滚在轨的首次商业化大规模集成。

paras.en: Detumbler is more than a product; it’s a cornerstone of Airbus’ sustainable space vision. By enabling active debris removal, it supports ESA’s Zero Debris targets and EU Space Traffic Management regulations, ensuring long-term orbital viability.
paras.zh: Detumbler 不仅仅是一种产品；它更是一种产品。它是空客可持续太空愿景的基石。通过主动清除碎片，它支持欧空局的零碎片目标和欧盟空间交通管理法规，确保长期轨道可行性。

paras.en: For Airbus, Detumbler proves that even the most complex space challenges can be solved through innovation and responsibility. As mega-constellations expand, technologies like Detumbler will be essential to preserving the usability of the shared low Earth orbit environment.
paras.zh: 对于空中客车公司来说，Detumbler 证明即使是最复杂的太空挑战也可以通过创新和责任来解决。随着巨型星座的扩张，像 Detumbler 这样的技术对于保持共享的近地轨道环境的可用性至关重要。

paras.en: The Detumbler effect: stability for a sustainable future
paras.zh: Detumbler 效应：稳定的未来

paras.en: The problem of tumbling satellites has persisted for decades, but Detumbler, ESA’s mandates, and renewed urgency for sustainability now require industry to solve it. By stabilizing uncontrolled satellites, Detumbler reduces ADR risks, costs, and complexity, making removal feasible at scale.
paras.zh: 卫星翻滚的问题已经持续了数十年，但 Detumbler、欧空局的指令以及可持续发展的新紧迫性现在需要工业界来解决这个问题。通过稳定不受控制的卫星，Detumbler 降低了 ADR 风险、成本和复杂性，使大规模移除成为可能。

paras.en: For operators, the message is clear: integrating Detumbler is not just compliance, it’s a business imperative. For the industry, it’s a step toward a stable and accessible orbit.
paras.zh: 对于运营商来说，信息很明确：集成 Detumbler 不仅仅是合规性，更是业务的当务之急。对于该行业来说，这是迈向稳定且可进入的轨道的一步。

paras.en: Ready to upgrade your next platform for meeting the sustainability imperatives of the upcoming decades? Contact Airbus Space Electronics to learn how the Detumbler secures the endgame in your mission’s life-cycle.
paras.zh: 准备好升级您的下一个平台以满足未来几十年的可持续发展要求了吗？联系空中客车航天电子公司，了解 Detumbler 如何确保任务生命周期的最后阶段。

paras.en: Avionics Actuators | Space Equipment | Airbus
paras.zh: 航空电子执行器|空间设备|空客

paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请联系：space_ electronics.sales@airbus.com

articles.title: Simera Sense and Spacemanic to Collaborate on a New Complete Dual-Use Mission Solution
articles.author: Spacemanic

paras.en: Czech company Spacemanic and Belgian optical leader Simera Sense are teaming up to deliver a new dual-use satellite solution that can compete with bigger and heavier satellites. Simera Sense xScape200 Dual-Use (DU) camera is integrated into Spacemanic 16U CubeSat platform, bringing high-resolution imaging capabilities to a lightweight, compact spacecraft designed for repeatable deployment and constellation growth.
paras.zh: 捷克公司 Spacemanic 和比利时光学领导者 Simera Sense 正在联手提供一种新的两用卫星解决方案，可以与更大、更重的卫星竞争。 Simera Sense xScape200 两用 (DU) 相机集成到 Spacemanic 16U CubeSat 平台中，为专为可重复部署和星座增长而设计的轻型紧凑型航天器带来高分辨率成像功能。

paras.en: The xScape200 DU combines a compact 12U form factor, low SWaP, and standardised integration to give commercial and defence organisations high-resolution, dual-use imaging capabilities without the need for a larger spacecraft, increased launch costs, or power-intensive mission architectures.
paras.zh: xScape200 DU 结合了紧凑的 12U 外形尺寸、低 SWaP 和标准化集成，为商业和国防组织提供高分辨率、两用成像功能，而无需更大的航天器、增加发射成本或功耗密集型任务架构。

paras.en: Spacemanic designs and builds its satellite platforms, core subsystems and deployers in-house. Owning the whole chain lets the company shape the satellite around the camera instead of forcing the camera into a standard form factor. That covers the satellite’s structure and envelope, its mechanical, electrical, thermal and data interfaces, and how the satellite integrates with the deployer.
paras.zh: Spacemanic 在内部设计和建造卫星平台、核心子系统和部署器。拥有整个链条可以让公司围绕相机塑造卫星，而不是强迫相机采用标准的外形尺寸。其中涵盖了卫星的结构和外壳、机械、电气、热和数据接口，以及卫星如何与部署者集成。

paras.en: The SPACE CANNON deployer accommodates CubeSats up to 16U, with an expanded integration envelope for payloads with protruding elements on the sides and a tuna can at the bottom. This additional space supports larger payload configurations such as the xScape200 DU camera. Removable side panels on all four sides provide direct access to the satellite after integration, enabling final adjustments right before launch. SPACE CANNON is designed for integration with launch vehicles including Falcon 9, Ariane 6, Vega-C, HyImpulse SL1, InnoSpace Hanbit, Spectrum by Isar Aerospace, RFA ONE and HyPrSpace Baguette One.
paras.zh: SPACE CANNON 部署器可容纳高达 16U 的立方体卫星，并具有扩展的有效载荷集成外壳，侧面有突出元件，底部有一个金枪鱼罐头。这个额外的空间支持更大的有效负载配置，例如 xScape200 DU 相机。所有四个侧面的可拆卸侧面板可在集成后直接访问卫星，从而在发射前进行最终调整。 SPACE CANNON 设计用于与 Falcon 9、Ariane 6、Vega-C、HyImpulse SL1、InnoSpace Hanbit、Spectrum by Isar Aerospace、RFA ONE 和 HyPrSpace Baguette One 等运载火箭集成。

paras.en: Together, the camera, tailored platform and deployer form a complete mission solution that simplifies the path from payload integration to launch. Beyond the technical development, Spacemanic and Simera are shaping the future of the commercial and dual use market.
paras.zh: 相机、定制平台和部署器共同构成了完整的任务解决方案，简化了从有效载荷集成到发射的路径。除了技术开发之外，Spacemanic 和 Simera 还在塑造商业和军民两用市场的未来。

articles.title: CesiumAstro Secures $730 Million in Janus Henderson-Led Series D at a Valuation Above $4.5 Billion; Unveils Synchronicity Satellite Constellation Following Fully Successful Element-1 Mission
articles.author: CesiumAstro

paras.en: CesiumAstro Inc., a global leader in space and defense communications systems and satellites, today announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion. The financing brings CesiumAstro’s total capital announced in 2026 to more than $1.2 billion and supports its expansion into developing and operating its own satellite infrastructure.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro Inc. 是太空和国防通信系统及卫星领域的全球领导者，今天宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元。此次融资使 CesiumAstro 宣布的 2026 年总资本超过 12 亿美元，并支持其扩张至开发和运营自己的卫星基础设施。

paras.en: The company also announced Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation for commercial, sovereign, and defense missions. The announcement follows the launch of CesiumAstro’s first satellite Element-1, and the start of its on-orbit operations.
paras.zh: 该公司还宣布了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座，用于商业、主权和国防任务。该公告是在 CesiumAstro 的第一颗卫星 Element-1 发射并开始在轨运行之后发布的。

paras.en: This expansion builds on three strategic acquisitions that have strengthened CesiumAstro’s vertical integration from semiconductors to mission operations, helping accelerate the development and deployment of Synchronicity. The company is also expanding its engineering and manufacturing operations worldwide. As part of that effort, CesiumAstro has announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its Austin-area headquarters, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space.
paras.zh: 此次扩张建立在三项战略收购的基础上，这些收购加强了 CesiumAstro 从半导体到任务运营的垂直整合，有助于加速 Synchronicity 的开发和部署。该公司还在全球范围内扩展其工程和制造业务。作为这一努力的一部分，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元来扩建其奥斯汀地区总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。

paras.en: The equity round was led by Janus Henderson, with participation from Insight Partners, Sands Capital, Sumitomo Corporation of Americas, Woven Capital – Toyota’s Growth Fund, Incharge Capital, Magnetar, AV, and NewSpace Capital, alongside $100 million in debt financing provided through the Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) and JPMorgan.
paras.zh: 此轮股权融资由 Janus Henderson 领投，Insight Partners、Sands Capital、Sumitomo Corporation of Americas、Woven Capital – 丰田成长基金、Incharge Capital、Magnetar、AV 和 NewSpace Capital 参与，此外还通过美国进出口银行 (EXIM) 和摩根大通提供了 1 亿美元的债务融资。

paras.en: The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: 新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: “For nearly a decade, we have invested in the engineering, intellectual property, manufacturing infrastructure, and the talented people required to build an enduring space technology company,” said Shey Sabripour, Founder and CEO of CesiumAstro. “With our technology proven on orbit, on the ground and in the air, a significantly expanded set of capabilities, and more than $1.2 billion in new capital raised this year, we are positioned to take the next major step in our growth.”
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 创始人兼首席执行官 Shey Saripour 表示：“近十年来，我们在工程、知识产权、制造基础设施和人才方面进行了投资，以建立一家持久的太空技术公司。” “凭借我们在轨道、地面和空中验证的技术、显着扩展的能力以及今年筹集的超过 12 亿美元的新资本，我们已准备好在增长方面迈出下一个重大步骤。”

paras.en: “Shey Sabripour is an extraordinary entrepreneur, and CesiumAstro is poised to revolutionize the space communications industry. This industry is at an inflection point; legacy solutions are not equipped for the demands of today’s customers,” said Aaron Schaechterle, Portfolio Manager, Janus Henderson. “When we met Shey and his team, it became clear that CesiumAstro provides transformative technology that is critical to the industry’s future. This investment was originated through the Janus Henderson Ascent platform, which was created to provide private market capital to visionary companies that redefine their industries and to support these companies on the journey from private to public markets.”
paras.zh: Janus Henderson 产品组合经理 Aaron Schaechterle 表示：“Shey Sabripour 是一位杰出的企业家，CesiumAstro 有望彻底改变太空通信行业。这个行业正处于拐点；传统解决方案无法满足当今客户的需求。” “当我们见到 Shey 和他的团队时，我们发现 CesiumAstro 提供的变革性技术对行业的未来至关重要。这项投资源自 Janus Henderson Ascent 平台，该平台的创建是为了向有远见的公司提供私募市场资本，重新定义其行业，并支持这些公司从私募市场走向公开市场。”

paras.en: Introducing Synchronicity: A 737-Satellite, AI-Enabled Constellation
paras.zh: 同步性简介：由 737 颗卫星组成、支持人工智能的星座

paras.en: Synchronicity takes CesiumAstro beyond supplying advanced space technologies and complete spacecraft to developing and operating its own integrated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 同步性使 CesiumAstro 不仅提供先进的空间技术和完整的航天器，还开发和运营自己的综合空间基础设施。

paras.en: The constellation is designed around a dynamically managed, multi-beam, multi-frequency architecture supporting Ku-, Ka-, and V-band communications, advanced edge compute, and multi-orbit operations. This unified system aims to deliver more flexible, resilient, and adaptable connectivity across a broad range of commercial and national security missions.
paras.zh: 该星座围绕动态管理、多波束、多频率架构设计，支持 Ku、Ka 和 V 频段通信、高级边缘计算和多轨道操作。这个统一的系统旨在为广泛的商业和国家安全任务提供更灵活、有弹性和适应性强的连接。

paras.en: AI is integrated throughout the architecture, enabling network optimization, dynamic allocation of communications resources, and autonomous adaptation to changing mission requirements and operating conditions. Edge processing capabilities are intended to bring compute closer to where data is generated, reducing dependence on terrestrial infrastructure and supporting increasingly time-sensitive applications.
paras.zh: 人工智能集成在整个架构中，可实现网络优化、通信资源的动态分配以及自主适应不断变化的任务要求和操作条件。边缘处理功能旨在使计算更接近数据生成的地方，减少对地面基础设施的依赖并支持对时间日益敏感的应用程序。

paras.en: Unlike architectures assembled from independently sourced components, Synchronicity will leverage CesiumAstro’s vertically integrated technology portfolio, including custom silicon, best-in-class active phased arrays, software-defined payloads, advanced processors, spacecraft, mission software, and terminals for air, ground, mobility, and maritime platforms. This approach enables system-wide performance optimization.
paras.zh: 与由独立采购的组件组装而成的架构不同，Synchronicity 将利用 CesiumAstro 的垂直集成技术组合，包括定制芯片、一流的有源相控阵、软件定义的有效载荷、先进处理器、航天器、任务软件以及空中、地面、移动和海上平台的终端。这种方法可以实现系统范围的性能优化。

paras.en: “Synchronicity is the culmination of the technology stack we have methodically built since CesiumAstro was founded,” said Sabripour. “We designed the silicon, the active phased array, the payload, processors, the spacecraft, ground terminals, and the network as one system. That vertical integration gives us the ability to build capabilities in space that evolve as mission requirements, technology, and operating conditions change.”
paras.zh: “同步性是我们自 CesiumAstro 成立以来有条不紊地构建的技术堆栈的顶峰，”Saripour 说。 “我们将芯片、有源相控阵、有效载荷、处理器、航天器、地面终端和网络设计为一个系统。这种垂直整合使我们能够在太空中构建随着任务要求、技术和操作条件的变化而发展的能力。”

paras.en: Three Strategic Acquisitions Expand CesiumAstro’s Capabilities
paras.zh: 三项战略收购扩大了 CesiumAstro 的能力

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has brought critical semiconductor, mission software, and artificial intelligence capabilities together through three acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr.
paras.zh: 在过去 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项收购将关键的半导体、任务软件和人工智能能力整合在一起：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr。

paras.en: Jariet Technologies — A leading millimeter-wave RF System-on-Chip (RF-SoC) semiconductor company specializing in advanced solutions for satellite communications, electronic warfare, and radar systems. The acquisition strengthens CesiumAstro’s technology portfolio with advanced mixed-signal semiconductors, digital signal processing, and digital beamforming capabilities, enabling greater performance and control across its communications payloads, active phased arrays, and spacecraft.
paras.zh: Jariet Technologies — 一家领先的毫米波射频片上系统 (RF-SoC) 半导体公司，专注于卫星通信、电子战和雷达系统的先进解决方案。此次收购增强了 CesiumAstro 的技术组合，包括先进的混合信号半导体、数字信号处理和数字波束形成功能，从而实现其通信有效载荷、有源相控阵和航天器的更高性能和控制。

paras.en: 1Aardvark — A company specializing in mission software, algorithms, and systems engineering for national defense programs. The acquisition expands CesiumAstro’s autonomous mission capabilities, enabling spacecraft to dynamically respond to changing conditions, operate with greater resilience, and maintain mission effectiveness in contested or connectivity-constrained environments.
paras.zh: 1Aardvark — 一家专门从事国防项目任务软件、算法和系统工程的公司。此次收购扩大了CesiumAstro的自主任务能力，使航天器能够动态响应不断变化的条件，以更大的弹性运行，并在有争议或连接受限的环境中保持任务有效性。

paras.en: Vidrovr — An AI company specializing in real-time multimodal signal analysis. The acquisition accelerates CesiumAstro’s integration of AI into space communications and sensing systems, enabling intelligent RF optimization, autonomous satellite operations, and reconfigurable edge compute across its space and defense platforms.
paras.zh: Vidrovr — 一家专门从事实时多模态信号分析的人工智能公司。此次收购加速了 CesiumAstro 将人工智能集成到空间通信和传感系统中，从而在其空间和国防平台上实现智能射频优化、自主卫星操作以及可重新配置的边缘计算。

paras.en: Element: A Decade of Engineering Proven on Orbit
paras.zh: 元素：在轨道上经过十年验证的工程

paras.en: CesiumAstro successfully launched and began on-orbit operation of Element-1 in October 2026.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 于 2026 年 10 月成功发射 Element-1 并开始在轨运行。

paras.en: Element-1 integrates CesiumAstro’s proprietary communications payloads, active phased array technology, compute systems, and spacecraft engineering in an operational satellite. The mission validates nearly a decade of investment in proprietary intellectual property, specialized engineering expertise, and in-house manufacturing capabilities.
paras.zh: Element-1 在一颗运行卫星中集成了 CesiumAstro 专有的通信有效载荷、有源相控阵技术、计算系统和航天器工程。该任务验证了近十年来在专有知识产权、专业工程专业知识和内部制造能力方面的投资。

paras.en: Element-1 is the first of eight planned spacecraft, with seven more launches secured for the next deployment phase. The Element program also advances CesiumAstro’s space-based edge processing and compute capabilities, enabling data to be processed closer to its source and supporting more intelligent, responsive, and autonomous missions.
paras.zh: Element-1 是计划中的八艘航天器中的第一艘，下一部署阶段还有七次发射。 Element 计划还提升了 CesiumAstro 的天基边缘处理和计算能力，使数据能够在更接近其来源的地方进行处理，并支持更智能、响应更快和自主的任务。

paras.en: Expanding Global Operations and Manufacturing Capacity
paras.zh: 扩大全球运营和制造能力

paras.en: In Texas, CesiumAstro announced a $500 million investment over five years to expand its global headquarters in Austin, including the purchase of 270,000 square feet of advanced manufacturing space. The expansion will support precision electronics and spacecraft manufacturing, engineering, integration, and test, with plans to add 550 jobs and grow the Austin-area workforce to more than 1,000 employees by 2030.
paras.zh: 在德克萨斯州，CesiumAstro 宣布在五年内投资 5 亿美元，以扩建其位于奥斯汀的全球总部，包括购买 270,000 平方英尺的先进制造空间。此次扩建将支持精密电子和航天器制造、工程、集成和测试，计划到 2030 年增加 550 个就业岗位，并将奥斯汀地区的员工人数增加到 1,000 多人。

paras.en: Across the United States, the company is investing hundreds of millions of dollars to expand its engineering, manufacturing, and operational capabilities, with additional facilities in Colorado, California, Alabama, Florida, and the Washington, D.C. area.
paras.zh: 在美国各地，该公司正在投资数亿美元来扩大其工程、制造和运营能力，并在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、阿拉巴马州、佛罗里达州和华盛顿特区设立了额外的工厂。

paras.en: In Europe and Asia, the company is expanding its presence, with operations in the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, Taiwan, Singapore, and Japan.
paras.zh: 在欧洲和亚洲，该公司正在扩大其业务，在英国、德国、瑞士、台湾、新加坡和日本开展业务。

paras.en: These expansions will support scaled production of its communications and sensing systems, advanced compute technologies, and spacecraft, as well as development and deployment of its next-generation space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 这些扩建将支持其通信和传感系统、先进计算技术和航天器的规模生产，以及下一代空间基础设施的开发和部署。

articles.title: Allen's Bills dominate slumping Vikings

paras.en: Josh Allen's Buffalo Bills dominate slumping Minnesota Vikings to improve to 7-1
paras.zh: 乔什·艾伦 (Josh Allen) 的布法罗比尔队 (Buffalo Bills) 战胜了低迷的明尼苏达维京人队 (Minnesota Vikings)，战绩提高到 7-1

paras.en: The Buffalo Bills improve to 7-1 on the season as they take advantage of a sputtering Minnesota Vikings in a 23-6 win on Monday night; the NFL returns to Europe on Sunday when the Detroit Lions face the New England Patriots in Munich, Germany, live on Sky Sports NFL from 2pm
paras.zh: 布法罗比尔队在周一晚上以 23-6 击败了状态不佳的明尼苏达维京人队，将本赛季战绩提升至 7 胜 1 负； NFL 将于周日返回欧洲，届时底特律雄狮队将在德国慕尼黑迎战新英格兰爱国者队，天空体育 NFL 从下午 2 点开始直播

paras.en: Josh Allen threw a touchdown pass with 44 seconds left before half-time, James Cook rushed 31 times for 107 yards and a late score, and the Buffalo Bills beat Minnesota 23-6 on Monday night, sending Vikings deeper into their unrelenting offensive slump.
paras.zh: 半场结束前 44 秒，约什·艾伦 (Josh Allen) 传球达阵，詹姆斯·库克 (James Cook) 冲球 31 次，推进 107 码并在最后时刻得分，周一晚上，布法罗比尔队 (Buffalo Bills) 以 23-6 击败明尼苏达队，让维京人队的进攻陷入更深的低迷。

paras.en: Linebackers Terrel Bernard and Dorian Williams had interceptions and Tyler Bass made four field goals to stretch his franchise-record streak to 25 straight as the Bills (7-1) matched their best eight-game start since 1993. That season ended with their last of four straight Super Bowl losses.
paras.zh: 线卫特雷尔·伯纳德 (Terrel Bernard) 和多里安·威廉姆斯 (Dorian Williams) 被拦截，泰勒·巴斯 (Tyler Bass) 投进四球，将他的队史连胜纪录扩大到 25 场，比尔队 (7-1) 追平了自 1993 年以来最好的八场开局。那个赛季以超级碗四连败中的最后一场结束。

paras.en: With Kyler Murray sidelined by a hamstring injury, Carson Wentz started at quarterback for the Vikings (6-2) and didn't finish what became one of the worst performances of his 11-year career.
paras.zh: 由于凯勒·穆雷因腿筋受伤缺阵，卡森·温茨在维京人队以四分卫身份首发（6胜2负），但未能完成比赛，这成为他 11 年职业生涯中最糟糕的表现之一。

paras.en: Wentz went 8 for 25 for 81 yards and three turnovers, including a backward pass in the first quarter that was thrown too high for even Justin Jefferson to catch it - resulting in a lost fumble near midfield.
paras.zh: 温茨25投8中，推进81码，出现3次失误，其中包括第一节的一次向后传球，传球传得太高，连贾斯汀·杰弗森都接不住，导致中场附近失球。

paras.zh: - 最新 NFL 赛程、赛果和英国开球时间

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Wentz, who was checked out in the medical tent at one point for an apparent lower leg injury, was replaced by Max Brosmer midway through the fourth quarter. Wentz completed 1 of 8 passes in the second half.
paras.zh: 温茨曾因小腿明显受伤而在医疗帐篷中接受检查，他在第四节中途被马克斯·布罗斯默换下。温茨下半场8次传球完成1次。

paras.en: The battle of Buffalo's highest-scoring offense in the league against the least-scored-on defense might well have gone to Minnesota had the offense been able to muster a decent drive or two.
paras.zh: 如果布法罗的进攻能够有一两次像样的进攻，那么联盟中得分最高的进攻队与得分最少的防守队的战斗很可能会输给明尼苏达队。

paras.en: But the Vikings had four straight possessions in the first half start beyond their 40-yard line, and the furthest they made it was the Bills' 48.
paras.zh: 但维京人队在上半场开始时就连续四次控球超出了他们的 40 码线，其中最远的是比尔队的 48 码。

paras.en: The Vikings as usual sent blitzers at Allen from every angle possible, recording four sacks and an interception of a heave into the end zone that Byron Murphy ran down and returned 55 yards.
paras.zh: 维京人一如既往地从各个角度对艾伦发起闪电战，共完成四次擒杀和一次拦截，拜伦·墨菲跑下并返回 55 码。

paras.en: But the Bills eked out just enough in the first half to give themselves a cushion, when Allen found tight end Keleki Latu open in the back of the end zone for a 25-yard touchdown as he rolled right and was hit hard by Andrew Van Ginkel.
paras.zh: 但比尔队在上半场的表现刚刚好，为自己提供了缓冲，艾伦发现近端锋凯莱基·拉图在达阵区后部空位，在右滚球时完成 25 码达阵，但被安德鲁·范·金克尔重重击中。

articles.title: England Lions hit record score as McKinney runs riot

paras.en: England Lions hit their highest List A cricket score of 487-5 as Durham's Ben McKinney smashes 145 from 65 balls
paras.zh: 达勒姆队球员本·麦金尼 (Ben McKinney) 65 个球中打出 145 个球，英格兰雄狮队 (England Lions) 取得了 487 胜 5 负的 A 类板球最高成绩

paras.en: Durham opener Ben McKinney smashes 15 fours and 10 sixes in his eye-catching century as England Lions make it five wins from five on West Indies tour; James Rew also scores a ton as Lions eclipse the Ben Duckett-inspired 425-1 the Lions amassed against Sri Lanka A in Canterbury in 2016
paras.zh: 达勒姆揭幕战球员本·麦金尼 (Ben McKinney) 在令人瞩目的世纪比赛中打出 15 个四分球和 10 个六分球，帮助英格兰雄狮队在西印度群岛巡回赛中取得五胜五负的成绩； 2016 年在坎特伯雷对阵斯里兰卡 A 队时，詹姆斯·鲁 (James Rew) 也取得了巨大的进球，帮助雄狮队以 425-1 的成绩击败了本·达克特 (Ben Duckett) 启发的雄狮队

paras.en: England Lions thumped their highest List A score of all time as they piled on 487-5 from 50 overs against West Indies A in the second unofficial ODI in St Kitts.
paras.zh: 在圣基茨举行的第二场非官方 ODI 比赛中，英格兰雄狮队以 50 轮比赛以 487 胜 5 负的战绩击败了西印度群岛 A 队，创下了 A 队历史最高成绩。

paras.en: The total, in which Durham opener Ben McKinney looted 145 from 65 deliveries and James Rew scored 107 not out from 56, eclipsed the 425-1 the side racked up against Sri Lanka A at Canterbury a decade ago.
paras.zh: 达勒姆队揭幕战球员本·麦金尼 (Ben McKinney) 65 次传球中拿下 145 次，詹姆斯·鲁 (James Rew) 56 次传球中拿下 107 分，超过了十年前球队在坎特伯雷对阵斯里兰卡 A 队时取得的 425 胜 1 负的战绩。

paras.en: In that match, current England Test and ODI opener Ben Duckett plundered 220 not out from 131 balls and Kent's Daniel Bell-Drummond 171 from 139 after Dawid Malan had fallen for 23.
paras.zh: 在那场比赛中，目前英格兰测试和ODI揭幕战的本·达克特(Ben Duckett)从131个球中掠夺了220个球，而肯特大学的丹尼尔·贝尔-德拉蒙德(Daniel Bell-Drummond)在大卫·马兰(Dawid Malan)落入23个球之后，从139个球中掠夺了171个球。

paras.en: Ten years on, McKinney and Rew were the stars, with the former smoking 15 fours and 10 sixes and the latter - who made his Test debut against New Zealand at The Kia Oval in June, keeping wicket with Jamie Smith on paternity leave - struck 15 fours and two sixes.
paras.zh: 十年后，麦金尼和鲁成为了明星，前者打出了 15 个四分球和 10 个六分球，后者于 6 月在起亚椭圆形球场对阵新西兰队的测试赛中首次亮相，与休陪产假的杰米·史密斯一起保持三柱门，打出了 15 个四分球和两个六分球。

paras.en: McKinney was linked with a Test call-up earlier this summer when it became clear that England were going to drop Zak Crawley but the spot as Duckett's partner at the top of the order went to the youngster's Durham team-mate Emilio Gay instead.
paras.zh: 今年夏天早些时候，麦金尼与测试征召联系在一起，当时英格兰队显然将放弃扎克·克劳利，但达克特搭档的第一名位置却被这位年轻球员的达勒姆队友埃米利奥·盖伊取代。

paras.en: McKinney and Rew flogged a bowling attack that included full West Indies international Oshane Thomas - the seamer has played 46 white-ball games for his nation, most recently in February 2024.
paras.zh: 麦金尼和鲁发起了一场保龄球进攻，其中包括西印度群岛国家队球员奥沙恩·托马斯（Oshane Thomas）——这位接缝者已经为他的国家队打了 46 场白球比赛，最近一次是在 2024 年 2 月。

paras.en: The Lions won the match by 276 runs after skittling their hosts for 211 in reply in Basseterre, thanks chiefly to a five-wicket haul from Hampshire quick Eddie Jack, who has been included in England's T20I squad to take on Australia later this month.
paras.zh: 雄狮队在巴斯特尔以 211 分击败东道主后，以 276 分的优势赢得了比赛，这主要归功于来自汉普郡的快手埃迪·杰克 (Eddie Jack) 的五个三柱门，他已被纳入英格兰 T20I 阵容，将于本月晚些时候对阵澳大利亚。

paras.en: Glamorgan leg-spinner Mason Crane bagged three wickets.
paras.zh: 格拉摩根旋转腿球员梅森·克莱恩 (Mason Crane) 攻入三个三柱门。

paras.en: Earlier on with the bat, Lions captain Dan Lawrence - in England's Test squad for the winter trip to South Africa - chipped in with 76 from 56 deliveries and Hampshire youngster Ben Mayes notched an unbeaten 58 from 46.
paras.zh: 早些时候，雄狮队队长丹·劳伦斯（参加冬季南非之旅的英格兰测试队成员）在 56 次投球中投出 76 球，而汉普郡年轻球员本·梅耶斯则在 46 次投球中取得不败的 58 分。

paras.en: The Lions have won all five of their matches on the tour so far, following a 3-0 sweep in the T20 series by taking a 2-0 lead in the five-match one-day international leg.
paras.zh: 雄狮队在 T20 系列赛中以 3-0 横扫对手后，迄今为止已经赢得了巡回赛的所有五场比赛，并在五场比赛的一日国际赛中以 2-0 领先。

paras.en: The remaining 50-over matches are also in St Kitts, on Wednesday, Saturday and next Monday.
paras.zh: 剩余的 50 场以上比赛也将于周三、周六和下周一在圣基茨举行。

paras.en: Jack, Rew's younger brother Thomas - who made 22 in Monday's run-fest - and James Coles are the uncapped players in the senior England T20 international squad to battle Australia in five matches from November 21, with the opening fixture in Melbourne.
paras.zh: 杰克、卢的弟弟托马斯（在周一的跑步比赛中打进22分）和詹姆斯·科尔斯是英格兰T20国际成年队中未上场的球员，他们将从11月21日起与澳大利亚队进行五场比赛，首场比赛将在墨尔本举行。
