articles.title: Red counties with data center projects swung away from GOP in midterms, analysis finds

paras.en: FIRST ON FOX: A new analysis from a conservative AI safety group found that deep-red counties with large data centers or proposed projects shifted further toward Democrats in last week's midterm elections than comparable counties without such projects.
paras.zh: 福克斯第一时间：保守派人工智能安全组织的一项新分析发现，在上周的中期选举中，拥有大型数据中心或拟议项目的深红色县比没有此类项目的同类县进一步向民主党倾斜。

paras.en: Humans First’s analysis, obtained by Fox News Digital, examined public election returns and data-center project records in 1,540 counties across 16 states. The memo used several comparisons to measure what the group describes as a "data center penalty." Across all counties examined, those hosting large data centers shifted an additional 2.2 percentage points toward Democrats compared with non-host counties in the same states. The pattern appeared in 14 of the 16 states and 25 of the 27 governor and Senate races examined.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道获得的 Humans First 的分析检查了 16 个州 1,540 个县的公共选举结果和数据中心项目记录。该备忘录使用了多项比较来衡量该组织所描述的“数据中心惩罚”。在所有接受调查的县中，与同一州的非托管县相比，那些拥有大型数据中心的县向民主党的支持率增加了 2.2 个百分点。这种模式出现在 16 个州中的 14 个州以及所审查的 27 个州长和参议院竞选中的 25 个州中。

paras.en: Restricting the analysis to deep-red counties — those President Donald Trump won by at least 20 points in 2024 — produced a 2.1-point raw gap between counties hosting large data centers and comparable counties without projects.
paras.zh: 将分析限制在深红色县（即唐纳德·特朗普总统在 2024 年赢得至少 20 个百分点），导致拥有大型数据中心的县与没有项目的类似县之间存在 2.1 个百分点的原始差距。

paras.en: Among deep-red counties with projects still in the proposal stage, the gap was 1.1 percentage points after accounting for past voting patterns, rural or urban status, population size, racial and ethnic makeup and recent voting trends.
paras.zh: 在项目仍处于提案阶段的深红色县中，考虑到过去的投票模式、农村或城市状况、人口规模、种族和民族构成以及最近的投票趋势后，差距为1.1个百分点。

paras.en: The group identified 114 proposed large data center projects across 92 deep-red counties, potentially setting up more local fights.
paras.zh: 该组织在 92 个深红色县确定了 114 个拟议的大型数据中心项目，这可能会引发更多的地方冲突。

paras.en: The memo found that Republican vote totals fell an additional 1.1% in deep-red host counties compared with comparable counties without large data centers, while Democratic vote totals showed no significant change.
paras.zh: 备忘录发现，与没有大型数据中心的类似县相比，深红色所在县的共和党选票总数额外下降了 1.1%，而民主党选票总数没有显着变化。

paras.en: The memo cautioned that its findings show an association rather than proof that data centers caused voters to change their behavior. County-level results also cannot determine whether Republicans switched their votes or simply stayed home.
paras.zh: 该备忘录警告说，其调查结果显示了数据中心导致选民改变行为的关联，而不是证据。县级结果也无法确定共和党人是改变投票还是干脆呆在家里。

paras.en: "Our analysis looked at how counties with data centers voted and how those counties moved to the left," Humans First Chairwoman Amy Kremer told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: “我们的分析着眼于拥有数据中心的县如何投票，以及这些县如何向左移动，”人类第一主席艾米·克莱默告诉福克斯数字新闻。

paras.en: "I think this happened for the reason I’ve been warning conservatives and Republicans about for some time: People engage politically when issues affect them personally. There’s nothing more personal than your pocketbook, your health care, your kids and family, your home and your community. A data center involves all of those things, which is why I believe these counties moved away from Republicans," she continued.
paras.zh: “我认为发生这种情况的原因是我一段时间以来一直在警告保守派和共和党人：当问题影响到他们个人时，人们就会参与政治。没有什么比你的钱包、你的医疗保健、你的孩子和家庭、你的家庭和你的社区更个人化的了。数据中心涉及所有这些事情，这就是为什么我相信这些县远离共和党人，”她继续说道。

paras.en: Humans First’s September "Data Center Revolt" bus tour made 35 stops in 27 states, including 14 stops in the states covered by the analysis. Nine of those stops were in deep-red counties, all of which hosted a large data center project. Those nine counties shifted 2.2 points further toward Democrats after the analysis accounted for its controls, compared with a 0.75-point shift among deep-red host counties overall. The group said those same nine counties showed no comparable gap from 2020 to 2024.
paras.zh: Humans First 9 月份的“数据中心起义”巴士之旅在 27 个州停靠了 35 站，其中 14 站停靠在分析所覆盖的州。其中九个站点位于深红色县，所有这些县都拥有一个大型数据中心项目。在分析考虑到民主党的控制权后，这 9 个县进一步向民主党倾斜了 2.2 个百分点，而深红色东道县整体的倾斜度为 0.75 个百分点。该组织表示，从 2020 年到 2024 年，这 9 个县没有显示出可比的差距。

paras.en: The findings do not establish whether the group's visits influenced voting behavior or whether those counties already had stronger opposition to data center development.
paras.zh: 研究结果并没有确定该小组的访问是否影响了投票行为，也没有确定这些县是否已经强烈反对数据中心的开发。

paras.en: Separately, voters favored restrictions on data center development or rejected measures supporting such projects in 46 of 47 local data center ballot measures in 2026, according to Ballotpedia. The measures included different types of proposals, including restrictions on development and advisory questions.
paras.zh: 另外，根据 Ballotpedia 的数据，在 2026 年 47 项本地数据中心投票措施中，有 46 项选民赞成限制数据中心开发或拒绝支持此类项目的措施。这些措施包括不同类型的提案，包括发展限制和咨询问题。

paras.en: Kremer said this is a local control issue, stressing that Republicans should focus on protecting property rights and ensuring people have control over how things affect their lives.
paras.zh: 克雷默表示，这是一个地方控制问题，并强调共和党人应该专注于保护财产权，并确保人们能够控制事情如何影响他们的生活。

paras.en: "Whether you’re talking about AI technology or the infrastructure needed to build AI data centers, the American people have not had a seat at the table," Kremer said. "They haven’t had a say in how the technology affects them or how the data center buildout affects their communities. In many places across the country, developers and companies have gone in and cut deals behind closed doors, under a cloak of darkness, using nondisclosure agreements and shell companies. By the time people in the community find out about the project, it’s too late to stop it."
paras.zh: 克雷默表示：“无论是谈论人工智能技术还是构建人工智能数据中心所需的基础设施，美国人民都没有在谈判桌上占有一席之地。” “他们对技术如何影响他们或数据中心建设如何影响他们的社区没有发言权。在全国许多地方，开发商和公司已经在黑暗的掩护下，利用保密协议和空壳公司秘密地达成交易。当社区中的人们发现这个项目时，想要阻止它已经太晚了。”

paras.en: "These projects affect the quality of life and how much money people have. They can increase the cost of electricity and water, while tax abatements are given to trillion-dollar companies — some of the wealthiest companies in the world. That is money coming out of the pockets of the American people," she continued.
paras.zh: “这些项目影响生活质量和人们的财富。它们会增加水电成本，同时给价值数万亿美元的公司——世界上最富有的一些公司——带来减税。这些钱都是从美国人民的口袋里掏出来的，”她继续说道。

paras.en: Kremer added, "When you talk about Iran and gas prices, tariffs and now the AI data center buildout, all of these costs are coming out of people’s pockets. That’s when people engage politically, and I think that’s what we saw last Tuesday."
paras.zh: 克雷默补充道，“当你谈论伊朗和天然气价格、关税以及现在的人工智能数据中心建设时，所有这些成本都来自人们的口袋。这就是人们参与政治的时候，我认为这就是我们上周二所看到的。”

paras.en: The concerns come amid a broader debate over how data centers should pay for the electricity and grid infrastructure they require. The Energy Department estimates data centers used 4.7% of U.S. electricity in 2024 and, in its reference case, could account for 11.8% by 2030. The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has directed regional grid operators to address safeguards against shifting the costs of serving large electricity users onto other customers. Those developments do not establish that data centers caused higher household rates in the counties examined by Humans First.
paras.zh: 这些担忧是在关于数据中心应如何支付其所需电力和电网基础设施费用的更广泛辩论中出现的。美国能源部估计，2024 年数据中心的用电量占美国电力的 4.7%，在其参考案例中，到 2030 年可能占到 11.8%。联邦能源管理委员会已指示区域电网运营商采取保障措施，防止将为大电力用户提供服务的成本转嫁到其他客户身上。这些发展并不能证明数据中心导致Humans First调查的县的家庭比率上升。

paras.en: Tax incentives also vary by state. The National Conference of State Legislatures reported that at least 38 states offer incentives specifically for data centers, including equipment-tax exemptions and, in some states, exemptions involving electricity or property taxes. The Data Center Coalition, an industry trade group, says such incentives are similar to those offered to other capital-intensive industries and argues that data centers generate jobs, investment and tax revenue.
paras.zh: 税收优惠也因州而异。全国州立法机构会议报告称，至少有 38 个州专门针对数据中心提供激励措施，包括设备税豁免，在某些州还豁免涉及电力或财产税。行业贸易组织数据中心联盟表示，此类激励措施与向其他资本密集型行业提供的激励措施类似，并认为数据中心可以创造就业机会、投资和税收。

paras.en: Humans First does not support a nationwide or statewide moratorium on data centers, but Kremer said individual communities should be free to approve or reject projects.
paras.zh: “人类第一”组织不支持在全国范围内或全州范围内暂停数据中心，但克雷默表示，各个社区应该可以自由批准或拒绝项目。

paras.en: "If a community comes together and votes for a moratorium, that is its prerogative. If a community wants a data center, that is its prerogative as well. It is all about local control," she said.
paras.zh: “如果一个社区聚集在一起并投票支持暂停，这就是它的特权。如果一个社区想要一个数据中心，这也是它的特权。这都是关于本地控制的，”她说。

paras.en: Kremer said she learned that people engage more when it comes to issues that affect them personally, noting that data centers "encompass all of those issues."
paras.zh: 克雷默表示，她了解到，当涉及到影响他们个人的问题时，人们会更多地参与其中，并指出数据中心“涵盖了所有这些问题”。

paras.en: "Whether you’re talking about pocketbook issues, health care, kids and family, or your home and community, the data center battle is a physical manifestation of all those concerns," she said. "When it comes to the economic impact on their communities, I think data centers absolutely played a role in the election."
paras.zh: “无论你谈论的是钱包问题、医疗保健、孩子和家庭，还是你的家庭和社区，数据中心之争都是所有这些问题的实际表现，”她说。 “当谈到对社区的经济影响时，我认为数据中心绝对在选举中发挥了作用。”

paras.en: "I hope we can get on the right page and give local control back to communities. People should have a say in how they live and what goes into their communities. That is very personal, and I hope we can move in that direction," Kremer added.
paras.zh: “我希望我们能够找到合适的页面，并将本地控制权交还给社区。人们应该对自己的生活方式和社区内发生的事情有发言权。这是非常个人化的，我希望我们能够朝着这个方向前进，”克雷默补充道。

articles.title: New Knesset speaker could be key to ousting Netanyahu as Israel’s PM
articles.author: Emma Graham-Harrison Chief Middle East correspondent

paras.en: Israel’s new Knesset will be sworn in on Tuesday, giving opposition politicians their first chance to take control of some levers of power, even as they struggle to form a new government to unseat Benjamin Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 以色列新一届议会将于周二宣誓就职，这将给反对派政客们第一次有机会控制一些权力杠杆，尽管他们正在努力组建新政府以推翻本杰明·内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: High on the agenda will be replacing the speaker, who wields immense influence by controlling the legislature’s agenda. The role is currently held by Amir Ohana, a close ally of Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 议程上的首要任务将是更换议长，议长通过控制立法机构的议程而拥有巨大的影响力。该职位目前由内塔尼亚胡的亲密盟友阿米尔·奥哈纳担任。

paras.en: Gadi Eisenkot, the former Israeli military chief who got the presidential mandate to try to form a coalition government at the weekend, may take the role himself, Israeli media reported on Monday.
paras.zh: 以色列媒体周一报道称，周末获得总统授权试图组建联合政府的以色列前军事首长加迪·艾森科特可能会亲自出任这一职务。

paras.en: The effort to wrest away control of the Knesset is significant enough that more than 160 top former security officials, including heads of the military, intelligence and police, warned that rightwing activists were planning to disrupt the day with violent attacks.
paras.zh: 夺取议会控制权的努力意义重大，以至于包括军方、情报部门和警察部门负责人在内的 160 多名前安全高级官员警告说，右翼活动分子正计划通过暴力袭击来扰乱这一天。

paras.en: “Actors who oppose replacing the Knesset speaker intend to go to the Knesset on the day of the swearing-in ceremony and to prevent the MKs and their family members from entering the building,” a forum of retired commanders, the Democracy’s Protective Wall, warned in a letter to serving security chiefs.
paras.zh: “反对更换议会发言人的行为者打算在宣誓仪式当天前往议会，并阻止议员及其家人进入大楼，”退休指挥官论坛“民主防护墙”在给现任安全负责人的一封信中警告说。

paras.en: “These same actors are encouraging tens of thousands of citizens who support their stance to come and to help them with their mission,” Ma’ariv newspaper quoted the letter saying.
paras.zh: 《Ma’ariv》报纸援引​​信中的话说：“这些演员正在鼓励数以万计支持他们立场的公民前来帮助他们完成使命。”

paras.en: If Eisenkot does not take the speaker role, opposition parties have agreed that someone from his Yashar party will be the nominee.
paras.zh: 如果艾森科特不担任议长一职，反对党已同意由他所在的亚沙尔党的某人担任提名人。

paras.en: The opposition parties hold 67 seats in the 120-seat legislature, enough to install a consensus choice for speaker. All have described the current prime minister as a threat to the state and are keen to start moving against him, despite divides blocking the formation of a coalition.
paras.zh: 反对党在立法机构 120 个席位中拥有 67 个席位，足以就议长人选达成共识。尽管分歧阻碍了联合政府的组建，但所有人都将现任总理描述为对国家的威胁，并热衷于开始反对他。

paras.en: But several of the Jewish-Israeli opposition parties in his “change” bloc have sworn not to sit with the Palestinian-led parties that hold over a quarter of the bloc’s seats, or even join a minority government that has their backing.
paras.zh: 但他的“变革”集团中的几个犹太-以色列反对党发誓不会与占据该集团四分之一以上席位的巴勒斯坦领导的政党坐在一起，甚至不会加入得到他们支持的少数派政府。

paras.en: Eisenkot has vowed to broker a national emergency government, promising to achieve it with “creative and unconventional political acts”.
paras.zh: 艾森科特发誓要促成一个国家紧急政府，并承诺通过“创造性和非传统的政治行动”来实现这一目标。

paras.en: In a sign of challenges ahead, he effectively warned that some election promises would have to be broken to unseat Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 作为未来挑战的迹象，他有效地警告说，必须打破一些选举承诺才能让内塔尼亚胡下台。

paras.en: “No one will be able to fulfil all the [campaign] promises they made, and all of us will need to compromise. That is also leadership, to know when to decide and set priorities,” he said.
paras.zh: “没有人能够履行他们做出的所有[竞选]承诺，我们所有人都需要妥协。这也是领导力，知道何时做出决定并确定优先事项，”他说。

paras.en: There have been protests across Israel urging Jewish-Israeli opposition parties to put unseating Netanyahu ahead of a racist commitment to excluding Palestinian-led parties from government.
paras.zh: 以色列各地爆发抗议活动，敦促犹太以色列反对党在做出将巴勒斯坦领导的政党排除在政府之外的种族主义承诺之前先罢免内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: Palestinian citizens of Israel make up about 20% of Israel’s population and voted in unprecedented numbers this year, giving them 19 seats. Without them, the opposition bloc has fewer seats than Netanyahu’s diminished coalition.
paras.zh: 以色列的巴勒斯坦公民约占以色列人口的 20%，今年投票人数空前，获得 19 个席位。没有他们，反对派集团的席位将少于内塔尼亚胡的削弱联盟。

paras.en: Rightwing opposition leader Avigdor Lieberman has been trying to seek an alternative path to government through an alliance with ultra-Orthodox parties. They have long been Netanyahu allies but have been frustrated by his failure to deliver on the promise to pass broad military draft exemptions for their community into law. Lieberman has campaigned hard for universal conscription, but appears to prefer compromise on this issue to working with Palestinians.
paras.zh: 右翼反对派领袖阿维格多·利伯曼一直试图通过与极端正统政党结盟来寻求另一种执政途径。他们长期以来一直是内塔尼亚胡的盟友，但因内塔尼亚胡未能兑现将广泛的军事征兵豁免纳入法律的承诺而感到沮丧。利伯曼一直在努力争取全民征兵，但似乎更愿意在这个问题上妥协，而不是与巴勒斯坦人合作。

paras.en: “Has the End of Times arrived?” leading Haredi (ultra-Orthodox) journalist Arye Erlich wrote in a column for Yedioth Ahronoth newspaper.
paras.zh: “末世来临了吗？”正统派（极端正统派）领袖记者 Arye Erlich 在《新消息报》的专栏中写道。

paras.en: “Has Avigdor Lieberman … the biggest persecutor of Haredim Israeli politics has seen in decades, suddenly come to believe that he can compromise on a military draft bill and sit in a coalition government alongside the Haredim?”
paras.zh: “阿维格多·利伯曼……几十年来以色列政治最大的迫害者，是否突然相信他可以在军事草案法案上妥协，并与正统派一起组成联合政府？”

paras.en: Even if Eisenkot does broker a coalition deal, he may delay announcing it until Netanyahu’s speaker has been replaced. Netanyahu is a master of political survival and last-minute deals, fracturing past coalitions by luring defectors into his own alliance.
paras.zh: 即使艾森科特确实促成了一项联合协议，他也可能会推迟宣布，直到内塔尼亚胡的议长被替换为止。内塔尼亚胡是政治生存和最后一刻交易的大师，他通过引诱叛逃者加入自己的联盟​​来分裂过去的联盟。

paras.en: Ohana could delay signing in a new government for up to a week, and some of the opposition do not want to give Netanyahu that much time to attack the pressure points of any fragile deal.
paras.zh: 奥哈纳可能会将新政府的签署推迟长达一周，一些反对派不想给内塔尼亚胡那么多时间来应对任何脆弱协议的压力点。

paras.en: If Eisenkot cannot form a government, the mandate is passed to other leaders and if they too fail Israel must hold elections again. In the meantime Netanyahu and his far-right allies would stay on as a caretaker government.
paras.zh: 如果艾森科特无法组建政府，则权力将移交给其他领导人，如果他们也失败，以色列必须再次举行选举。与此同时，内塔尼亚胡和他的极右翼盟友将继续担任看守政府。

paras.en: Although Netanyahu is calling for his opponents to join him in a unity government, a long period of limbo followed by a new vote offers him a likelier path back to power.
paras.zh: 尽管内塔尼亚胡呼吁他的对手与他一起组成联合政府，但随后的长期悬而未决的新投票为他重新掌权提供了一条更有可能的道路。

paras.en: If an alternative government takes power, it will be harder for Netanyahu to destabilise it, said Gideon Rahat, chair in political science at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 耶路撒冷希伯来大学政治学系主任吉迪恩·拉哈特表示，如果替代政府上台，内塔尼亚胡将更难破坏稳定。

paras.en: “Once they establish a government, they might be a minority government, it might be hard for them to do things, but nevertheless, they will be governing and it would be hard to oust them.”
paras.zh: “一旦他们建立政府，他们可能是少数派政府，他们可能很难做事，但无论如何，他们会执政，很难推翻他们。”

articles.title: Australia to introduce mandatory reporting after OpenAI hack to combat artificial intelligence ‘going rogue’
articles.author: Tess Ikonomou and Josh Butler

paras.en: OpenAI will not face criminal penalties over the Medicare data breach, but the prime minister has flagged changes to Australia’s criminal law to crack down on future breaches by artificial intelligence companies.
paras.zh: OpenAI 不会因医疗保险数据泄露而面临刑事处罚，但总理已表示要修改澳大利亚刑法，以打击人工智能公司未来的违规行为。

paras.en: Anthony Albanese on Tuesday released the recommendations of a “rapid review” into the June breach of a Medicare statistics reporting service portal administered by Services Australia, but not the findings or the report itself, which he committed to releasing in the future.
paras.zh: Anthony Albanese 周二发布了对 6 月份澳大利亚服务部管理的医疗保险统计报告服务门户网站违规事件进行“快速审查”的建议，但没有发布调查结果或报告本身，他承诺在未来发布。

paras.en: A key recommendation is for the Attorney-General’s Department, Australian Federal Police and Department of Home Affairs to consider introducing “penalties for egregious regulatory non-compliance” and a “failure to prevent” offence, which would criminalise developing an AI model that engaged in harmful conduct while failing “to take reasonable steps to prevent that harm”.
paras.zh: 一项重要建议是司法部、澳大利亚联邦警察和内政部考虑引入“对严重不合规行为的处罚”和“未能防止”犯罪，这将把开发从事有害行为但未能“采取合理措施防止这种伤害”的人工智能模型定为刑事犯罪。

paras.en: The rapid review came in response to an AI agent, developed by OpenAI, accessing data from Services Australia and three other systems in June. The company did not notify the Australian government until mid-September despite becoming aware of the incident itself in August, prompting criticism from Labor and Albanese.
paras.zh: 此次快速审查是针对 OpenAI 开发的人工智能代理在 6 月份访问澳大利亚服务部和其他三个系统的数据而进行的。尽管该公司在 8 月份就意识到了这一事件，但直到 9 月中旬才通知澳大利亚政府，引发了工党和 Albanese 的批评。

paras.en: Guardian Australia revealed last month OpenAI used AI to help write the email to notify Australian authorities.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚卫报上个月透露，OpenAI 使用人工智能帮助编写通知澳大利亚当局的电子邮件。

paras.en: Albanese said the government would set up a new AI safety regulator and implement six key obligations on AI companies:
paras.zh: Albanese表示，政府将设立新的人工智能安全监管机构，并对人工智能公司履行六项关键义务：

paras.en: - Maintaining security controls across all stages of development and deployment.
paras.zh: - 在开发和部署的所有阶段维护安全控制。

paras.en: - Identifying and managing serious risks associated with their models.
paras.zh: - 识别和管理与其模型相关的严重风险。

paras.en: - Providing mandatory notification of incidents to the Australian government rapidly.
paras.zh: - 迅速向澳大利亚政府强制通报事件。

paras.en: - Allowing independent evaluation of their models.
paras.zh: - 允许对其模型进行独立评估。

paras.en: - Maintaining and publishing safety and security frameworks to ensure good governance, risk management and transparency.
paras.zh: - 维护和发布安全框架，以确保良好的治理、风险管理和透明度。

paras.en: - Responding to updated standards and rules as technologies change.
paras.zh: - 随着技术的变化，响应更新的标准和规则。

paras.en: The review recommended the federal government “consider mandatory, time-bound AI safety reporting”, including around AI agents behaving in ways their creators may not have intended.
paras.zh: 该审查建议联邦政府“考虑强制性的、有时限的人工智能安全报告”，包括围绕人工智能代理的行为方式进行报告，这些行为可能是其创造者没有预料到的。

paras.en: The home affairs minister, Tony Burke, appearing with Albanese, told reporters: “It should never be the case that there’s an argument that someone didn’t know the computer was loaded.
paras.zh: 内政部长托尼·伯克 (Tony Burke) 与阿尔巴尼斯一起出现，他告诉记者：“绝不应该出现有人不知道计算机已加载的情况。

paras.en: “We need to make sure that our laws and our systems keep pace with the technology and also make sure that we’re able to use the technology to find vulnerabilities before others do,” Burke said.
paras.zh: 伯克说：“我们需要确保我们的法律和系统与技术保持同步，并确保我们能够在其他人之前使用该技术发现漏洞。”

paras.en: “The mandatory reporting, when artificial intelligence goes rogue, gives us a chance to be able to make sure that when this happens, the reporting occurs and occurs immediately.”
paras.zh: “当人工智能失控时，强制报告使我们有机会确保当这种情况发生时，报告会立即发生。”

paras.en: But despite the government’s earlier public anger at OpenAI, Albanese on Tuesday characterised OpenAI’s breach of Services Australia as “minor” in terms of the implications for personal privacy. Guardian Australia understands OpenAI is unlikely to face further legal proceedings related to the June breach.
paras.zh: 尽管政府早些时候对 OpenAI 表示愤怒，但 Albanese 周二表示，就对个人隐私的影响而言，OpenAI 违反澳大利亚服务部的行为“轻微”。澳大利亚卫报了解到，OpenAI 不太可能面临与 6 月份违规事件相关的进一步法律诉讼。

paras.en: While Albanese did not directly answer a question about whether the OpenAI incident in June would have breached the proposed new laws if they were in place, government sources indicated that the new legislation would address similar future incidents.
paras.zh: 虽然 Albanese 没有直接回答有关 6 月份的 OpenAI 事件是否会违反拟议的新法律（如果新法律到位）的问题，但政府消息人士表示，新立法将解决未来类似的事件。

paras.en: “The clear indication is that no information was got that involves people’s personal details,” Albanese said.
paras.zh: “明确的迹象是，没有获得涉及人们个人详细信息的信息，”阿尔巴内斯说。

paras.en: “All of that was confirmed essentially … but that doesn’t mean that it wasn’t a serious issue and that in other areas there might be more serious implications.”
paras.zh: “所有这些基本上都得到了证实……但这并不意味着这不是一个严重的问题，而且在其他领域可能会产生更严重的影响。”

paras.en: In a statement, an OpenAI spokesperson said the company was reviewing the recommendations and the government’s proposals.
paras.zh: OpenAI 发言人在一份声明中表示，该公司正在审查这些建议和政府的提议。

paras.en: “We have been in close dialogue with the Government and we’ll continue to engage constructively as it develops its proposed legislation,” they said.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“我们一直在与政府密切对话，我们将继续建设性地参与政府制定拟议立法的过程。”

paras.en: A separate OpenAI-led process, which is discussing better coordination between AI developers and the government, is expected to report back by 31 December.
paras.zh: 由 OpenAI 主导的一个单独流程正在讨论人工智能开发人员和政府之间更好的协调，预计将于 12 月 31 日之前报告。

paras.en: The review made 18 recommendations. Albanese said “we accept all of the recommendations and we’ve commenced work to implement them”.
paras.zh: 审查提出了 18 条建议。阿尔巴内塞表示，“我们接受所有建议，并已开始实施这些建议”。

paras.en: The AI researcher Toby Walsh said the people in charge of these companies needed to be criminally liable to ensure they did the right thing.
paras.zh: 人工智能研究员托比·沃尔什表示，这些公司的负责人需要承担刑事责任，以确保他们做了正确的事。

paras.en: “We’ve tried fining them, and we’re not the only ones. These companies are incredibly wealthy, and it’s almost impossible to fine them enough,” he told Guardian Australia.
paras.zh: “我们已经尝试过对他们罚款，而且我们并不是唯一的公司。这些公司非常富有，几乎不可能对他们处以足够的罚款，”他告诉澳大利亚卫报。

paras.en: But the Greens leader, David Shoebridge, branded the news a “capitulation” to the AI industry, claiming the reforms would not do enough to change the behaviour of those companies. He said the government should have committed to implementing even stronger changes, rather than the review’s recommendation that Labor simply “consider” them.
paras.zh: 但绿党领袖 David Shoebridge 将这一消息称为对人工智能行业的“投降”，并声称改革不足以改变这些公司的行为。他表示，政府应该致力于实施更强有力的变革，而不是审查建议工党简单地“考虑”这些变革。

paras.en: “Safety keeps coming second to corporate investment, and this review locks that priority in by tying every AI safety effort to bringing in more AI money and more datacentres,” Shoebridge claimed.
paras.zh: Shoebridge 声称：“安全始终排在企业投资之后，而这次审查通过将每项人工智能安全工作与引入更多人工智能资金和更多数据中心联系起来，锁定了这一优先事项。”

paras.en: “Being a world leader in AI doesn’t mean being a doormat to big tech. It means being prepared to regulate it, to protect Australians and to make sure corporate profits don’t come at the expense of everyone else.”
paras.zh: “成为人工智能领域的世界领导者并不意味着成为大型科技公司的受气垫。而是意味着准备好对其进行监管，保护澳大利亚人并确保企业利润不会以牺牲其他人的利益为代价。”

paras.en: The shadow home affairs minister, Jonno Duniam, said the Coalition backed the announcement, and had no criticism of the government. He said “AI is too important to become an unnecessarily partisan political contest”, signalling an “enduring and multi-partisan approach” to the technology.
paras.zh: 影子内政部长乔诺·杜尼亚姆(Jonno Duniam)表示，联盟党支持这一声明，并且对政府没有批评。他表示，“人工智能太重要了，不能成为一场不必要的党派政治竞赛”，这表明该技术将采取“持久且多党派的方式”。

articles.title: Author Jojo Moyes among UK travellers at risk of EU ban amid digital border system glitches
articles.author: Anna Tims

paras.en: The writer Jojo Moyes is facing a two-year EU travel ban and €10,000 (£8,300) fine because of glitches with the bloc’s digital security controls.
paras.zh: 由于欧盟数字安全控制出现故障，作家乔乔·莫耶斯面临欧盟两年旅行禁令和 10,000 欧元（8,300 英镑）罚款。

paras.en: She is one of a number of UK travellers who say their trips to the EU have not been properly recorded since the introduction of the EU digital entry and exit system (EES).
paras.zh: 她是众多英国旅行者之一，他们表示自欧盟数字出入境系统（EES）推出以来，他们前往欧盟的旅行并未得到正确记录。

paras.en: The system, which launched last year, has replaced passport stamps with biometrics recorded at border control in Schengen zone countries.
paras.zh: 该系统于去年推出，已用申根区国家边境管制处记录的生物识别技术取代了护照印章。

paras.en: However, the botched rollout has led to some Britons being denied their post-Brexit right to spend 90 days out of 180 in Europe because the system falsely states they have used up their allowance.
paras.zh: 然而，这一拙劣的推出导致一些英国人在脱欧后被剥夺了在欧洲度过 180 天中的 90 天的权利，因为系统错误地表明他们已经用完了津贴。

paras.en: Moyes, a bestselling novelist, was detained by French border guards after a holiday and accused of overstaying. She had spent only 23 days in the EU over six months.
paras.zh: 畅销小说家莫耶斯在假期结束后被法国边防人员拘留，并被指控逾期居留。六个月来，她只在欧盟待了 23 天。

paras.en: She discovered that her departure from Portugal after a trip in May had not been logged on the system.
paras.zh: 她发现她五月份旅行后离开葡萄牙的信息并没有被记录在系统上。

paras.en: “The clock had been ticking ever since,” she told the consumer organisation Which? “The border control senior officer at Marseille warned me that I should not attempt to re-enter Europe until it is sorted out, or face a €10,000 fine and a two-year ban.”
paras.zh: “从那时起，时间就一直在流逝，”她告诉消费者组织Which？ “马赛边境管制高级官员警告我，在事情解决之前，我不应该尝试重新进入欧洲，否则将面临 10,000 欧元的罚款和两年的禁令。”

paras.en: Over the summer, some countries suspended the EES and resorted to manual passport checks due to technical glitches and staff shortages. On Monday, it emerged that the EU is suing three firms over the failures.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，由于技术故障和人员短缺，一些国家暂停了 EES 并采用人工护照检查。周一，有消息称欧盟正在因失败而起诉三家公司。

paras.en: The problem affects passengers whose biometrics were collected on their arrival in the EU, but not on their departure. In some cases, this means the system has failed to record that they have left.
paras.zh: 该问题影响到在抵达欧盟时收集生物识别信息的乘客，但在离开欧盟时则没有。在某些情况下，这意味着系统无法记录他们已经离开。

paras.en: The rolling 180-day window starts as soon as they enter the EU and, since Brexit, those who are deemed to have remained for more than 90 days face deportation or fines of up to €10,000.
paras.zh: 一旦他们进入欧盟，180 天的滚动窗口就开始了，自英国脱欧以来，那些被认为居留超过 90 天的人将面临驱逐出境或最高 10,000 欧元的罚款。

paras.en: Jane Nolan and her husband discovered that the EES wrongly showed them as having used up their 90-day travel allowance, preventing them from booking a trip to France. “We travelled to France in April by LeShuttle and spent 40 days there,” she said. “We have made no subsequent Schengen visits.
paras.zh: Jane Nolan 和她的丈夫发现 EES 错误地显示他们已用完 90 天的旅行津贴，导致他们无法预订前往法国的旅行。 “我们四月份乘坐 LeShuttle 前往法国，并在那里度过了 40 天，”她说。 “我们随后没有进行申根访问。

paras.en: “We should have 50 days remaining, but the EU’s ‘check how long you can stay’ tool says: ‘Authorised stay: not OK,’ and zero remaining days. It does not show us which entry or exit record produced that result.”
paras.zh: “我们应该还剩 50 天，但欧盟的‘检查你可以停留多久’工具说：‘授权停留：不行’，剩余天数为零。它没有向我们显示哪个出入境记录产生了这个结果。”

paras.en: The couple’s passports were manually stamped on their return to the UK in June as French authorities had suspended the EES to prevent long queues.
paras.zh: 6 月，这对夫妇返回英国时，他们的护照上被手动盖章，因为法国当局暂停了 EES，以防止排长队。

paras.en: “We have asked the French authorities to check our records, but do not yet know what has gone wrong or whether the result could affect us at the border,” said Nolan.
paras.zh: 诺兰说：“我们已要求法国当局检查我们的记录，但尚不知道出了什么问题，也不知道结果是否会影响我们在边境的情况。”

paras.en: In a case reported by the Telegraph a holidaymaker from the UK was detained at the Italian border and deported under police guard after a system error suggested she had overstayed in the EU.
paras.zh: 据《每日电讯报》报道，一名来自英国的度假者在意大利边境被拘留，并在警察看守下被驱逐出境，因为系统错误显示她在欧盟逾期居留。

paras.en: Rory Boland, Editor of Which? Travel described the situation as unacceptable.
paras.zh: 罗里·博兰（Rory Boland），《哪个？》的编辑Travel称这种情况令人无法接受。

paras.en: “This is one of the most serious in a long line of European border control failures,” he said. “The lack of care and accountability shown towards travellers, who risk being locked up and fines of thousands of pounds for rules they have not broken, is utterly indefensible.”
paras.zh: “这是欧洲边境管制一系列失败中最严重的一次，”他说。 “对旅行者缺乏关心和问责，他们可能会因为没有违反规则而被关起来并被罚款数千英镑，这是完全站不住脚的。”

paras.en: The Advantage Travel Partnership, which represents independent travel agents, said British travellers were being penalised for a chaotic system.
paras.zh: 代表独立旅行社的优势旅游合作伙伴表示，英国游客因混乱的系统而受到惩罚。

paras.en: Its CEO, Julia Lo Bue-Said, said: “Travellers should not be penalised for failures in a system that is entirely outside their control. There needs to be greater accountability, alongside a straightforward process to challenge and correct inaccurate records.”
paras.zh: 其首席执行官 Julia Lo Bue-Said 表示：“旅客不应因完全超出其控制范围的系统故障而受到惩罚。需要更大的问责制，以及挑战和纠正不准确记录的简单流程。”

paras.en: The Foreign Office said the problem was concerning. A spokesperson said: “We are aware of reports of inaccuracies in some EES records affecting British nationals, including incomplete records and the registration of some individuals who are exempt from EES. We are raising these issues as part of our engagement with the European Commission.”
paras.zh: 外交部表示这个问题令人担忧。一位发言人表示：“我们注意到一些影响英国国民的 EES 记录不准确的报道，包括不完整的记录和一些免于 EES 的个人的注册。作为与欧盟委员会接触的一部分，我们正在提出这些问题。”

paras.en: It advised travellers to carry evidence of when they last left the EU and to raise any anomalies with border officials.
paras.zh: 它建议旅行者携带上次离开欧盟时间的证据，并向边境官员提出任何异常情况。

paras.en: Travellers can check how many days of their allowance they have left by typing their passport number into the EES website. This records all visits to the Schengen zone since 10 April 2026.
paras.zh: 旅客可以通过在 EES 网站上输入护照号码来查看他们的津贴还剩多少天。该记录记录了自 2026 年 4 月 10 日以来对申根区的所有访问。

paras.en: If there is an unexpected shortfall, they can ask to have their record corrected before travelling by selecting the last country they visited on the Travel to Europe data protection page and contacting the relevant data controller.
paras.zh: 如果出现意外的短缺，他们可以在旅行前要求更正记录，方法是在前往欧洲数据保护页面上选择他们最后访问的国家并联系相关数据控制者。

paras.en: Moyes said her efforts to do this have so far been in vain.
paras.zh: 莫耶斯表示，她为此所做的努力迄今为止都是徒劳的。

paras.en: “In the last two weeks, I’ve tried every possible avenue,” she said. “I have now engaged an immigration lawyer, but not everyone is lucky enough to be able to afford this remedy. I have no idea how much time they think I have spent in Europe, and no idea whether I am safe to travel.”
paras.zh: “在过去的两周里，我尝试了一切可能的途径，”她说。 “我现在已经聘请了一位移民律师，但并不是每个人都足够幸运，能够负担得起这种补救措施。我不知道他们认为我在欧洲呆了多少时间，也不知道我旅行是否安全。”

paras.en: The European Commission has been contacted for a comment.
paras.zh: 已联系欧盟委员会征求意见。

articles.title: Australia considers criminal penalties for rogue AI in wake of OpenAI hack

paras.en: Australia plans to create a new AI safety regulator and has flagged criminal penalties for tech companies who do not comply, months after an OpenAI hack.
paras.zh: 在 OpenAI 遭到黑客攻击几个月后，澳大利亚计划建立一个新的人工智能安全监管机构，并对不遵守规定的科技公司进行刑事处罚。

paras.en: In September, Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese revealed that a rogue OpenAI agent had "infiltrated" a government health website and other systems, and criticised the company for taking months to tell them about the hack.
paras.zh: 9 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 透露，一名流氓 OpenAI 代理“渗透”了政府健康网站和其他系统，并批评该公司花了几个月的时间才向他们通报此次黑客攻击事件。

paras.en: On Tuesday, he released the 18 recommendations made after a "rapid review" into the breaches including new safety and security standards for AI companies such as mandatory reporting of hacks.
paras.zh: 周二，他发布了对违规行为进行“快速审查”后提出的 18 项建议，其中包括人工智能公司的新安全标准，例如强制报告黑客行为。

paras.en: AI brings opportunities, he said, but Australia must prepare for the "new risks" from this "rapidly advancing technology".
paras.zh: 他说，人工智能带来了机遇，但澳大利亚必须为这种“快速发展的技术”带来的“新风险”做好准备。

paras.en: "The law needs to get ahead of and, in some cases, make sure that it catches up with, what is a very fast changing world," Albanese said.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞说：“法律需要走在前面，在某些情况下，还要确保赶上这个瞬息万变的世界。”

paras.en: One of the recommendations suggests changes to criminal law to have a standalone "failure to prevent" offence .
paras.zh: 其中一项建议建议修改刑法，将“未能预防”列为独立罪名。

paras.en: This would criminalise instances where a company develops "an AI model that engages in harmful conduct" and "fails to take reasonable steps to prevent that harm".
paras.zh: 这将把公司开发“从事有害行为的人工智能模型”并且“未能采取合理措施防止这种伤害”的情况定为刑事犯罪。

paras.en: The review also recommended "mandatory, time-bound AI safety reporting" of hacks.
paras.zh: 该审查还建议对黑客行为进行“强制性、有时限的人工智能安全报告”。

paras.en: This point addresses what Albanese had earlier called his "disappointment" in the months-long delay for OpenAI to tell his government about the breach.
paras.zh: 这一点解决了 Albanese 早些时候所说的他对 OpenAI 长达数月的延迟向政府通报此次泄露事件感到“失望”的问题。

paras.en: In June, a statistics portal containing "non-sensitive" data from Australia's universal healthcare scheme Medicare was hacked by a rogue OpenAI agent.
paras.zh: 6 月，一个包含澳大利亚全民医疗保健计划 Medicare 的“非敏感”数据的统计门户遭到流氓 OpenAI 代理的黑客攻击。

paras.en: OpenAI said it only learnt of the breach in August while reviewing "misaligned model activity" and emailed a general inbox of an Australian government agency on 10 September.
paras.zh: OpenAI 表示，它是在 8 月份审查“失调的模型活动”时才得知这一漏洞，并于 9 月 10 日向澳大利亚政府机构的一般收件箱发送了电子邮件。

paras.en: It took several more days before the email was escalated to Australia's cybersecurity centre, with a message then sent to a government minister ahead of the prime minister being told.
paras.zh: 又过了几天，该电子邮件才被升级到澳大利亚网络安全中心，然后在总理被告知之前向政府部长发送了一条消息。

paras.en: Albanese said he spoke to OpenAI boss Sam Altman and raised "Australia's extreme concern about this incident", with Altman acknowledging there were "issues with protocols" at OpenAI.
paras.zh: Albanese 表示，他与 OpenAI 老板萨姆·奥尔特曼进行了交谈，并提出了“澳大利亚对这一事件的极度担忧”，奥尔特曼承认 OpenAI 存在“协议问题”。

paras.en: Days after the hacks were revealed, OpenAI delayed its rollout of a new AI model, citing safety concerns.
paras.zh: 黑客事件曝光几天后，OpenAI 以安全问题为由推迟了新人工智能模型的推出。

articles.title: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'

paras.en: Donald Trump has said "Iran militarily is effectively over", and said that there is "positive momentum" behind negotiations to end the Middle East conflict.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示“伊朗军事行动实际上已经结束”，并表示结束中东冲突的谈判背后存在“积极势头”。

paras.en: "We're just keeping it the status quo," the US president said on Monday. "And we're doing that really at the behest of countries that are their neighbours."
paras.zh: “我们只是保持现状，”美国总统周一表示。 “我们这样做确实是应邻国的要求。”

paras.en: Addressing reporters from the White House press briefing room, Trump said that renewed US attacks on Iran were "highly unlikely" but that the US was "locked and loaded" should the circumstances change.
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫新闻发布室向记者发表讲话时表示，美国“极不可能”再次对伊朗发动袭击，但如果情况发生变化，美国将“上膛并上膛”。

paras.en: Iranian officials have repeatedly expressed doubts about Trump's prior comments about resolving the conflict.
paras.zh: 伊朗官员多次对特朗普此前有关解决冲突的言论表示怀疑。

paras.en: This is not the first time that Trump has said the Iran war is "militarily" over, but the circumstances for him are different now.
paras.zh: 这并不是特朗普第一次表示伊朗战争已经“军事”结束，但他现在的情况不同了。

paras.en: The president has hinted at de-escalation in Iran after a bruising set of midterm election results for the Republicans last week, which senior figures including Vice-President JD Vance blamed on the Iran war.
paras.zh: 上周共和党中期选举结果惨重，包括副总统万斯在内的高级人士将其归咎于伊朗战争，总统暗示伊朗局势将缓和。

paras.en: Ahead of the midterms, Trump had said US forces conducted what he described as "minor strikes" on an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz. However, in an interview with 60 Minutes that aired on Sunday, the president said that he did not currently see "any reason" to escalate the conflict.
paras.zh: 中期选举前，特朗普曾表示，美军对霍尔木兹海峡的伊朗岛屿进行了他所说的“小规模打击”。然而，总统在周日播出的《60 分钟》采访中表示，他目前认为没有“任何理由”使冲突升级。

paras.en: Responding to a question over why he would not officially declare an end to the war, Trump said that some of the Gulf allies could still face Iranian aggression.
paras.zh: 在回答为何不正式宣布结束战争的问题时，特朗普表示，一些海湾盟友仍可能面临伊朗的侵略。

paras.en: "We have some great allies there and we have to make sure they're not hurt," he said, suggesting that the US naval blockade on Iranian ports was helping to make the region more secure.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们在那里有一些伟大的盟友，我们必须确保他们不会受到伤害。”他表示，美国对伊朗港口的海上封锁有助于使该地区更加安全。

paras.en: Global oil prices, which have fallen sharply since the midterms, dipped further after Trump's comments.
paras.zh: 自中期选举以来大幅下跌的全球油价在特朗普发表言论后进一步下跌。

paras.en: On Tuesday afternoon in Asia, Brent crude was more than 1% lower at $91.50 (Â£52) while US-traded was down by 1.2% at $85.82.
paras.zh: 周二下午，亚洲布伦特原油价格下跌超过 1%，至 91.50 美元（52 英镑），而美国原油价格下跌 1.2%，至 85.82 美元。

paras.en: Trump hosted Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdul Rahman Al Thani in the Oval Office earlier on Monday, saying they had an "excellent conversation" about negotiations to end the war.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一早些时候在椭圆形办公室接待了卡塔尔总理谢赫·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·阿勒萨尼，称他们就结束战争的谈判进行了“精彩的对话”。

paras.en: In a post on X, the Qatari leader said he held "positive discussions" with Trump and Vance on "reaching a deal and bringing peace to the region".
paras.zh: 这位卡塔尔领导人在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，他与特朗普和万斯就“达成协议并为该地区带来和平”进行了“积极讨论”。

paras.en: Efforts to broker a peace between Washington and Tehran have largely been held indirectly through mediators since the war first broke out following joint US-Israeli strikes in February.
paras.zh: 自二月份美以联合袭击爆发战争以来，华盛顿和德黑兰之间的和平努力很大程度上是通过调解人间接进行的。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates are among the US's Gulf allies that have been hit by Iranian strikes over the course of the war, in addition to the threat of strikes that have led to major air travel disruptions in the region.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔和阿拉伯联合酋长国是美国在海湾地区的盟友，在战争过程中受到伊朗袭击的打击，此外袭击威胁还导致该地区航空旅行严重中断。

paras.en: Post-election recriminations over the US war in Iran are already placing pressure on members of the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 选举后对美国伊朗战争的相互指责已经给特朗普政府成员带来了压力。

paras.en: Republican congressman Thomas Massie launched a strong attack against Trump's Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Monday over the war in Iran, requesting a vote in the House of Representatives to impeach him.
paras.zh: 共和党众议员托马斯·马西周一就伊朗战争问题对特朗普的国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯发起猛烈攻击，要求众议院投票弹劾他。

paras.en: Trump has backed Hegseth, who says he is "not worried" about the looming impeachment threats, calling Massie's effort a "sham".
paras.zh: 特朗普支持赫格斯，赫格斯表示他“并不担心”迫在眉睫的弹劾威胁，并称马西的努力是“骗局”。

paras.en: While the move is unlikely to succeed with Republicans still in control of Congress until January, Democrats have expressed willingness to impeach Hegseth once the new session begins and they have control of both the House and the Senate.
paras.zh: 虽然这一举措不太可能成功，因为共和党在一月之前仍控制着国会，但民主党已表示愿意在新会议开始并且控制众议院和参议院后弹劾赫格塞斯。

articles.title: Polish unity on show in silent march to honour Krakow shooting victims

paras.en: Thousands of people joined a silent march through central Krakow on Monday night, in memory of those killed and injured when a gunman went on a violent rampage at the weekend.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，数千人参加了克拉科夫市中心的无声游行，以纪念周末枪手暴力袭击中丧生和受伤的人。

paras.en: The crowd were led by Poland's president and prime minister, the bitter political rivals putting on a rare show of unity after the country's deadliest attack in modern times.
paras.zh: 人群由波兰总统和总理带领，这对激烈的政治对手在该国现代最严重的袭击事件发生后罕见地表现出了团结。

paras.en: As they reached the historic Market Square, a bugler played from the tower.
paras.zh: 当他们到达历史悠久的集市广场时，塔楼上响起了号手的演奏。

paras.en: Many people were carrying flowers or candles to leave at the shrines that now dot the cobblestones, each one marking a spot where someone died.
paras.zh: 许多人带着鲜花或蜡烛前往现在点缀在鹅卵石上的神殿，每一个都标记着一个有人死去的地方。

paras.en: Fiercely proud of its reputation for safety, Poland has been profoundly shaken by this attack. It has left people struggling to make some kind of sense of what happened.
paras.zh: 波兰对其安全声誉感到非常自豪，但此次袭击却深深震撼了波兰。这让人们很难理解所发生的事情。

paras.en: The alleged gunman has been named as 24-year-old Michal Oksinski by local media.
paras.zh: 当地媒体称这名枪手为 24 岁的米哈尔·奥克辛斯基 (Michal Oksinski)。

paras.en: Critically injured in a shoot-out with police, he did not regain consciousness and died in hospital early on Monday.
paras.zh: 他在与警方的枪战中受重伤，没有恢复意识，周一早些时候在医院去世。

paras.en: Initially, the interior minister claimed that Oksinski was driven by far-right, extremist views. The national prosecutor's office now says that it's too soon to say he was "inspired" by any ideology.
paras.zh: 最初，内政部长声称奥克辛斯基是受到极右翼极端主义观点的驱使。国家检察官办公室现在表示，现在说他受到任何意识形态的“启发”还为时过早。

paras.en: "The minister wanted to win domestic political points. That's not responsible behaviour," Dr Pawel Musialek of the Jagiellonian University suggests, in a country where politics is highly - and often viciously - polarised.
paras.zh: 雅盖隆大学的帕维尔·穆西亚莱克博士表示：“部长想要赢得国内政治分数。这不是负责任的行为。”在一个政治高度两极分化且往往是恶性两极分化的国家。

paras.en: "So far we've seen no clear message that this guy was strongly ideological, and that it's not more like something from the darknet."
paras.zh: “到目前为止，我们还没有看到任何明确的信息表明这个人具有强烈的意识形态，而且它更像是来自暗网的东西。”

paras.en: There's been no mention of any letter or manifesto that Oksinski left. One neighbour told Polish news site Onet that the 24-year-old was a "bit of a loner" but few who knew him well have spoken publicly.
paras.zh: 没有提及奥克辛斯基留下的任何信件或宣言。一位邻居告诉波兰新闻网站 Onet，这位 24 岁的人“有点孤独”，但很少有熟悉他的人公开发表过言论。

paras.en: In addition to his electronic devices like his phone, investigators are examining a number of badges that Oksinski had attached to his military-style outfit.
paras.zh: 除了手机等电子设备外，调查人员还在检查奥克辛斯基在其军装上佩戴的一些徽章。

paras.en: The prosecutor's office says a yellow Gadsden flag with a coiled snake symbol was displayed in his bedroom. "It has various meanings of freedom and rebellion," a spokesman emphasised. "Not necessarily negative."
paras.zh: 检察官办公室称，他的卧室里挂着一面带有盘绕蛇符号的黄色加兹登旗帜。 “它具有自由和反叛的多种含义，”一位发言人强调说。 “不一定是负面的。”

paras.en: It was at Oksinski's home that the bodies of his parents and sister were discovered.
paras.zh: 正是在奥克辛斯基的家中，人们发现了他父母和妹妹的尸体。

paras.en: It's alleged that he shot them, before driving some 200km (125 miles) south to continue the killing in Krakow.
paras.zh: 据称，他开枪射杀了他们，然后驱车向南约 200 公里（125 英里）前往克拉科夫继续杀戮。

paras.en: Two days on, shops and cafes around the market square are beginning to fill up again, but the mood is subdued.
paras.zh: 两天过去了，集市广场周围的商店和咖啡馆又开始挤满了人，但气氛却很压抑。

paras.en: A Zara clothes shop is still boarded up, after bullets smashed the glass. A local man in his 50s died just outside.
paras.zh: 子弹击碎玻璃后，Zara 一家服装店仍用木板封着。一名 50 多岁的当地男子就在外面死亡。

paras.en: Jo, a Scottish tourist, saw paramedics "who got there ridiculously fast", fighting to save him. "It was all pretty grim."
paras.zh: 苏格兰游客乔看到医护人员“以惊人的速度赶到现场”，奋力营救他。 “一切都非常严峻。”

paras.en: Like many, she initially mistook the rifle shots for fireworks.
paras.zh: 和许多人一样，她最初将步枪枪声误认为是烟花。

paras.en: On the opposite corner of the square, beside another cluster of flowers, people keep pausing to take pictures of the holes that were blasted into the wall by gunfire.
paras.zh: 在广场的另一角，另一簇花旁，人们不停地停下来拍摄墙上被炮火炸出的洞。

paras.en: One of the six victims has been identified as a Polish painter in her 50s, who was a mother of four, and in town with friends for an exhibition opening.
paras.zh: 六名受害者中的一名被确认为一名 50 多岁的波兰画家，她是四个孩子的母亲，当时正在城里与朋友一起参加展览开幕式。

paras.en: A British citizen and an Austrian who died are yet to be named publicly.
paras.zh: 死亡的一名英国公民和一名奥地利人的姓名尚未公开。

paras.en: Several drivers of the horse-drawn carriages that are usually poised to trot tourists around the square were seriously injured.
paras.zh: 通常准备在广场上运送游客的马车的几名司机受了重伤。

paras.en: Olha, who works in a nearby chocolate shop says everyone is now nervous.
paras.zh: 在附近一家巧克力店工作的奥尔哈说，现在每个人都很紧张。

paras.en: On Saturday, people rushed into her store to escape the gunman who was tearing around in his car, firing through the window.
paras.zh: 周六，人们冲进她的店里躲避枪手，枪手在车里四处乱窜，从窗户开枪。

paras.en: Olha is Ukrainian, and moved to Krakow when Russia invaded. "We left our own country for safety. This is supposed to be a safe place!" she exclaimed.
paras.zh: 奥尔哈是乌克兰人，在俄罗斯入侵时移居克拉科夫。 “为了安全，我们离开了自己的国家。这里应该是一个安全的地方！”她惊呼道。

paras.en: "It's so sad, and so scary. Especially that he drove all the way here for two hours, planning this and thinking about it."
paras.zh: “太悲伤了，太可怕了。尤其是他开了两个小时的车来到这里，计划着这件事，思考着。”

paras.en: She regrets that the gunman did not survive: "So many are dead, so many lives have been ruined, and now there will be no justice."
paras.zh: 她对枪手没能生还感到遗憾：“这么多人死了，这么多人的生命被毁了，现在正义将不复存在。”

paras.en: When Oksinski's car was searched, four firearms and "hundreds of rounds of ammunition" were found, all owned legally by the alleged killer and his father.
paras.zh: 当奥克辛斯基的汽车被搜查时，发现了四把枪和“数百发弹药”，这些都是嫌疑凶手及其父亲合法拥有的。

paras.en: Both were members of the Swit Starachowice sports club, where there is a shooting range. A spokesman recalls Michal Oksinski as unremarkable: average competition results and normal behaviour.
paras.zh: 两人都是 Swit Starahowice 体育俱乐部的成员，该俱乐部设有射击场。一位发言人回忆说，米哈尔·奥克辛斯基（Michal Oksinski）表现平平：比赛成绩一般，行为正常。

paras.en: He had been just three times this year, most recently in August with his father. The club spokesman is adamant that it does not train combat firing, only shooting from a fixed point.
paras.zh: 他今年只去过三次，最近一次是在八月，和他的父亲一起。俱乐部发言人坚称，他们不训练战斗射击，只训练定点射击。

paras.en: Gun ownership in Poland has grown considerably since war broke out in Ukraine just across the border, but this is the first mass shooting anyone here can remember.
paras.zh: 自边境另一边的乌克兰爆发战争以来，波兰的枪支拥有量大幅增加，但这是这里任何人记忆中的第一起大规模枪击事件。

paras.en: Inevitably, it has brought scrutiny of the checks over who qualifies to handle such weapons, including psychological tests, as Michal Oksinski passed all of them.
paras.zh: 不可避免地，它对谁有资格使用此类武器进行了审查，包括心理测试，因为米哈尔·奥克辛斯基通过了所有这些测试。

paras.en: On Monday, the government announced an urgent review.
paras.zh: 周一，政府宣布紧急审查。

paras.en: At the spot where Oksinski's car was intercepted and he was shot by police there is another memorial, this one in honour of the officers still in hospital.
paras.zh: 在奥克辛斯基的汽车被拦截并被警察开枪射击的地方，还有另一座纪念碑，这是为了纪念仍在医院的警察。

paras.en: Some have brought flowers, but a girl called Bianka has left a card that reads: "Thank you Mr Policemen, get better soon."
paras.zh: 有些人带来了鲜花，但一位名叫比安卡的女孩留下了一张卡片，上面写着：“谢谢警察先生，祝你早日康复。”

paras.en: A couple of steps away, there's a series of bullet holes in the glass.
paras.zh: 几步之外，玻璃上有一系列弹孔。

paras.en: "This man was a real hero, he didn't hesitate," Ania says, referring to officer Jakub Kulik who was shot in the chest. His condition remains serious. "We're here to help him fight for his life."
paras.zh: “这个人是一位真正的英雄，他毫不犹豫，”阿尼亚说，他指的是胸部中弹的警官雅库布·库里克。他的病情仍然很严重。 “我们来这里是为了帮助他为自己的生命而战。”

paras.en: "Nothing like this has never happened before, it's terrible," a young man called Wojtek tells me.
paras.zh: “以前从未发生过这样的事情，太可怕了，”一位名叫沃伊泰克的年轻人告诉我。

paras.en: He's only glad that the gunman responsible for such horror turned out to be Polish.
paras.zh: 他唯一庆幸的是，制造如此恐怖事件的枪手竟然是波兰人。

paras.en: "People here are already against immigration, so that would have been even worse."
paras.zh: “这里的人们已经反对移民，所以情况会更糟。”

paras.en: Ania thinks Poles will pull through, though the country's image as a low-crime oasis has been shattered.
paras.zh: 阿尼亚认为波兰人将会渡过难关，尽管该国作为低犯罪绿洲的形象已经被打破。

paras.en: Most of all, she's angry that Michal Oksinski died without accounting for the devastation he allegedly wrought.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，她对米哈尔·奥克辛斯基（Michal Oksinski）死时没有考虑到他所造成的破坏感到愤怒。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为 #CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上展示。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.
paras.zh: 这种专业知识与我们卓越的规模和地理覆盖范围相结合，使我们成为可靠的合作伙伴，帮助我们的客户实现他们的目标，并为最终用户提供最好的设备。 Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.

articles.title: bauma 2025

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is one of five CentroMotion brands exhibiting at bauma, April 7–13 in Munich, booth A2, 402.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 4 月 7 日至 13 日在慕尼黑举行的 bauma 展会上参展的五个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位 A2, 402。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the construction market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于建筑市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing product highlights from their industry-leading brake, transmissions/clutch and motion control systems.
paras.zh: 分享其行业领先的制动、变速箱/离合器和运动控制系统的产品亮点。

paras.en: Showcasing display and on-board computing platforms.
paras.zh: 展示显示和机载计算平台。

paras.zh: 采用最新的热管理解决方案，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、排气再循环阀和排气背压阀。

paras.zh: 演示基于微控制器的仪器仪表和 HMI 平台。

articles.title: Visit Us @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: CarlisleCBF is one of seven CentroMotion brands exhibiting at Agritechnica, November 9 - 15, 2025, in Hanover, Germany, stand No. B35, hall 17.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是参加 2025 年 11 月 9 日至 15 日在德国汉诺威举行的 Agritechnica 展会的七个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位号为 B35，展厅 17。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information, and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the agriculture market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于农业市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing a powerful lineup of brake system solutions engineered for the demands of modern agriculture equipment. Attendees can explore highlights from industry-leading brake assemblies, designed to deliver unmatched stopping power and durability in off-highway environments. The display will also feature both the EPD and N680 advanced friction technologies, built to optimize performance and reliability in high-torque applications. Together, these products represent a century of engineering excellence and a future-focused commitment to solving the toughest challenges in agricultural mobility.
paras.zh: 分享一系列强大的制动系统解决方案，专为满足现代农业设备的需求而设计。与会者可以探索行业领先的制动组件的亮点，这些组件旨在在非公路环境中提供无与伦比的制动力和耐用性。该显示器还将采用 EPD 和 N680 先进摩擦技术，旨在优化高扭矩应用中的性能和可靠性。这些产品共同代表了一个世纪以来的卓越工程技术和着眼于未来解决农业移动领域最严峻挑战的承诺。

paras.en: Showcasing the leading on-board computing platform for machine intelligence and HMI solutions. New products, designed specifically to meet the needs of agricultural machinery, include 10- and 12-inch smart terminals, central vehicle computing with monitors, and 5- and 7-inch displays featuring programmable soft keys for tactile control. The CCpilot V1090 and V1290 are the first displays with an integrated network switch that makes it easier to incorporate elements like camera systems, sensors and precision systems, into one display computer. The vehicle computer and monitors (CrossCore A100 with monitors from 10 to 12 inches) highlight the new centralized computing architecture. This approach provides a flexible, scalable platform for vehicle intelligence. It includes innovative component life cycle management and increased support for functional safety.
paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增加对功能安全的支持。

paras.en: Highlighting how Elliott’s flexible planting products deliver precision performance, highly operational reliability and mechanical advantages without the need for additional power sources. The flexible drive and control shaft products bring enhanced performance to original equipment machinery, providing simple and dependable aftermarket upgrades for an ongoing return on your investment. Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Featuring the latest innovations in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, hot- and cold-side exhaust gas recirculation valves, and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用热管理解决方案的最新创新，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、热侧和冷侧废气再循环阀以及排气背压阀。

paras.en: Presenting the latest solutions to help operators sense, see and know more. Show attendees will find a broad portfolio of products, including displays, clusters and sensors for vehicle and equipment monitoring in demanding applications. The displays are built on a microcontroller architecture which offers lean performance with inherent support for key features including fast boot (typically around a second for instant access to machine data). Visitors to Agritechnica can get a hands-on look at the display range, from 1.3 to 4.3 inches, with demos to show general I/O, CAN channel support and application examples. The displays can share multiple screens of information, with intuitive navigation, including diagnostic codes and machine status. The platform offers devices with robust and compact housings suitable to withstand the toughest environments and designed to easily fit 52 or 86 mm SAE case sizes to make installation simple for new and existing cabins.
paras.zh: 呈现最新的解决方案，帮助操作员感知、看到和了解更多。展会与会者将发现广泛的产品组合，包括用于在要求苛刻的应用中监控车辆和设备的显示器、仪表组和传感器。这些显示器基于微控制器架构构建，可提供精益性能以及对快速启动（通常大约一秒即可即时访问机器数据）等关键功能的固有支持。 Agritechnica 的参观者可以亲身体验从 1.3 英寸到 4.3 英寸的显示屏范围，并通过演示展示通用 I/O、CAN 通道支持和应用示例。这些显示器可以共享多个信息屏幕，并具有直观的导航功能，包括诊断代码和机器状态。该平台提供的设备具有坚固而紧凑的外壳，适合承受最恶劣的环境，并可轻松安装 52 或 86 毫米 SAE 外壳尺寸，使新的和现有的驾驶室的安装变得简单。

paras.en: Showcasing the Power-Packer portfolio of manual and electric pumps and cylinders for hydraulic cab tilt and hood-lift applications, as well as the latest electro-hydraulic actuator. All products are designed with a focus on efficiency and perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications. Hydraulic solutions offer precise motion control and ensure reliable performance in the most demanding environments.
paras.zh: 展示用于液压驾驶室倾斜和发动机罩升降应用的手动和电动泵和油缸的 Power-Packer 产品组合，以及最新的电动液压执行器。所有产品的设计都注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。液压解决方案提供精确的运动控制，并确保在最苛刻的环境中提供可靠的性能。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. Products are engineered for reliability and precision, ensuring the seamless operation and longevity of agricultural equipment.
paras.zh: 了解 Weasler 的产品系列，从传动轴和扭矩限制器到阻尼器和其他组件，所有产品均采用最佳技术设计，旨在解决客户的动力传输问题。产品的设计注重可靠性和精确性，确保农业设备的无缝运行和使用寿命。
